title: Call Processing Representative
description:
Position Summary:
The Call Center representative works in a high volume, fast-paced inbound call center and is responsible for providing an excellent customer service experience to our patients, demonstrating a high level of commitment to SYHealth’s mission and core values. SYHealth’s Call Center is the central communications hub for our network of primary care and specialty clinics, responsible for handling appointment related requests, helping patients navigate our health system and routing calls to the appropriate departments, as well as providing information on the services available at SYHealth.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Answering phones to respond to inquiries made by patients, vendors, insurance companies and other medical facilities. Must be able to handle 60-80 incoming calls per day.
Efficiently and actively provides excellent customer service by properly greeting, listening, assisting, directing, and closing each call.
Re-scheduling patient appointments as required via telephone calls, SMS or messages received thru our Patient Portal
Screening and routing patient calls to other departments efficiently, insuring accurate registration, appointment scheduling and follow-up appointment scheduling in EMR
Taking clear and accurate messages on behalf of patients when completing an internal communication template.
Responding to patient’s questions and needs by editing, canceling, and re-scheduling appointments as necessary according to clinic protocols.
Maintains a good working relationship and effective communication both within the department and with other departments for the benefit of the patient.
Demonstrates knowledge and understanding of SYHealth programs and services.
Adheres to current department productivity and quality assurance requirements.
Other duties as assigned.

Additional Duties and Responsibilities:

Follows established departmental policies and procedures, objectives, quality assurance program, safety, environmental and infection control standards.
Enhances professional growth and development through participation in educational programs, in-service meetings, and workshops.
Attends meetings as required and participates in committees as directed.

Job Requirements
Experience Required:

1 year of experience in customer service, call center or in a healthcare setting. Or successful completion of an externship program with San Ysidro Health.

Education Required:

High School Diploma or GED equivalent

Minimum Qualifications and Requirements:

English fluency in both Spoken and Written language
Exceptional phone manner
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Ability to type 35 wpm with 90% accuracy.
Must be flexible, organized, and function well under pressure.
Ability to apply knowledge of office procedures and carry out tasks accordingly.
Multitasking capacity

Highly Preferred Skills:

Experience using an Electronic Health Record system, EPIC preferred.
Medical Terminology
Fluent in either Spanish, Arabic or Tagalog

Technical Knowledge and Skills Required to Perform the Job:
Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows OS, MS-Office, telephone devices and voice mail.

Equipment Used:
PC systems and peripherals, multi-key telephone devices, centralized telephone console and other office equipment as applicable

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:
Prolonged periods of sitting, keyboarding, and use of computer mouse. Push/pull up to 10 lbs. Normal business hours, evenings, and weekends. (Holiday schedule determined by administration).

Universal Requirements:
Pre-employment requirements include I-9, physical, positive background and reference check results, complete application, new hire orientation, pre-employment PPDs. Compliance with all mandated vaccinations and all boosters is a term and condition of employment.

title: Software Engineer Intern
location: Chicago, Illinois, United States; Jersey City, New Jersey, United States; Mountain View, California, United States
description:
Overview:

If you're looking for the stability of a profitable, growing company with the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup, we’re hiring. SageSure, a leader in catastrophe-exposed property insurance, is seeking an Intern to join the Rising Pioneer Program as part of our Software Engineering team.

Over the course of this 10-week program, interns will gain tangible, hands-on experience and insight into our business operations. After 3 days of orientation and training, you’ll join our Software Engineering team, where you’ll be assigned projects with unlimited opportunity for challenges and achievement. We have, very often, considered our interns for post-graduation roles within the company.

What you’d be doing:

  • Learn and network with employees, leaders, and other interns during an on-the-job experience.
  • Potential to earn college credit.
  • Provide research and analysis support on ad-hoc projects.
  • Fulfill tasks and project assignments set out by team leaders.
  • Receive coaching, mentoring, and feedback from knowledgeable SageSure professionals.
  • Support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software applications and solutions.
  • Write, review, and troubleshoot code, with a primary focus on Java-based development.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and other technology partners to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and other software development lifecycle activities.
  • Assist with identifying and resolving software defects and technical issues.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable, reliable, and maintainable software solutions.
  • Learn and apply software engineering best practices, including source control, documentation, testing, and agile development methodologies.
  • Participate in team meetings, technical discussions, and project planning activities.

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Is currently enrolled in a relevant degree program with a focus on Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, with an anticipated graduation date in 2028.
  • Has foundational programming knowledge and experience with Java through coursework, projects, or prior experience.
  • Demonstrates strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and analytical skills.
  • Understands object-oriented programming concepts and software development fundamentals.
  • Has strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members.
  • Is detail-oriented and able to approach technical problems with curiosity and persistence.
  • Is comfortable multitasking and eager to learn new technologies, tools, and development practices.
  • Has the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively as a team member.
  • Is authorized to work in the United States.

Highly preferred candidates also have:

  • Prior internship, technical project, or software development experience.
  • GPA of 3.0 or higher.
  • Experience developing applications or completing academic projects using Java.
  • Familiarity with Git or other source control tools.
  • Exposure to APIs, databases, SQL, cloud technologies, or web application development.
  • Familiarity with automated testing, debugging tools, or software testing concepts.
  • Exposure to Agile or Scrum development environments.
  • Experience with additional programming languages or technologies beyond Java.

Software at SageSure:

Originally founded as a software and analytics business, SageSure's proprietary technology has always been a key source of competitive advantage. We offer agents and policyholders best-in-class, modern capabilities to quote and bind insurance, service policies, and submit and track claims. We operate a microservices-based SaaS platform and conduct a substantial share of our business through our API. Our software product, engineering, and operations teams set the bar for talent in our industry. We work remotely from numerous states across the country and are always looking for exceptional individuals to join us.

We are continually innovating with modern tools and technologies, and we welcome new perspectives. An ideal candidate will have a passion for some of our key technologies and advocate pragmatic industry practices around availability, scalability, security, and automation. A cloud-based infrastructure, continuous integration and delivery, and a quality-first approach help us to better deliver software. A metrics-driven mindset has become part of our DNA and helps us make data-driven decisions. If you have interests across these domains, we want to help grow and foster them.

About SageSure:

Named among the Best Places to Work in Insurance by Business Insurance for four years in a row (2020-2023), SageSure is one of the largest managing general underwriters (MGU) focused on catastrophe-exposed property in the US. Since its founding in 2009, SageSure has experienced exceptional growth while generating underwriting profits for carrier partners through hurricanes, wildfires, and hail. Available in 16 states, SageSure offers more than 110 home, flood, and commercial products on behalf of its highly rated carrier partners. Today, SageSure manages more than $3.2 billion of inforce premium and helps protect more than 970,000 policyholders.

We have more than 1,000 employees in a distributed workforce environment across 12 offices—Fairfield, CA; Mountain View, CA; Cheshire, CT; Jacksonville, FL; Tallahassee, FL; Tampa, FL; Chicago, IL; Jersey City, NJ; Marlton, NJ; Cincinnati, OH; Houston, TX; Sheboygan, WI—who are tackling the industry’s toughest challenges.

SageSure is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a workforce that reflects the spectrum of perspectives, experiences, and abilities of the world we live in. We recognize that our differences make us strong, and we actively seek out diverse candidates through partnerships with organizations, institutions and communities that represent various backgrounds. We champion belonging and inclusion for all identities, including, but not limited to, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, ability status, gender, and country of origin, striving to create a culture where all individuals feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.

Our nimble, highly responsive culture nurtures critical thinkers who run toward problems and engineer solutions. We relentlessly pursue better outcomes by investing in the technology, talent, and tools that position us to succeed in demanding markets. Come join our team! Visit to find a position for you.

title: Catering & Convention Services Coordinator
description:
Overview
The Catering and Convention Services Coordinator provides administrative support to the Catering and Convention Services Departments. The Coordinator will help to ensure that each client, or prospective client, is given professional, accurate and timely information.

Responsibility

Correspond with all colleagues, vendors and clients in a professional manner.
Handle inquiry calls according to departmental procedures. Qualify space requests by obtaining pertinent information. Transfer calls and messages to the appropriate personnel.
Record messages legibly and completely. Deliver all messages in a timely manner.
Maintain accurate trace files and communicate daily traces to Catering and Convention Services (CCS) Managers.
Establish and maintain filing system procedures and annual storage of catering/convention files.
Prepare and distribute the Daily Event Sheet from the B.E.O.'s to all departments via email.
Accurately prepare B.E.O.’s to meet specifications given by clients and/or CCS Managers.
Process all changes to B.E.O.'s in a timely manner, following departmental procedures.
Prepare the Weekly Event Sheet according to procedures and distribute to CCS Managers for verification of information listed.
Complete and distribute necessary reports on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.
Prepare posting reports for each function one day prior to scheduled event and distribute to the Operations staff.
Organize all pre-con collateral and set up for Director of CCS and CCS Managers.
Assist CCS Managers in contacting authorized vendors to coordinate arrangements for functions.
Assist CCS Managers in site inspections.
Assist CCS Managers in preparing proposals for prospective clients.
Attend designated meetings, take minutes, transcribe and distribute.
Complete and distribute amenity requests and cards; follow up on any changes.
Maintain confidentiality and of hotel and client information, correspondence, reports and files.
Review status of incomplete work and follow up actions with CCS Managers daily.
Manage office supply and collateral inventory. Replenish as needed.
Maintain knowledge of all Hotel services/features and hours of operation.
Maintain knowledge of, and comply with, all hotel and departmental policies and procedures.
Responsible for posting and managing Omni Charlotte social media channels to include, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok and Facebook
Other duties as assigned.

Qualification

Ability to clearly communicate in English with guests, clients and hotel staff is required.
Proficiency in MS Word, Excel and Power Point programs is required.
Proficiency in Delphi is preferred.
Previous hospitality experience is strongly preferred.
Previous administrative experience is strongly preferred.
Ability to multitask and complete a variety of tasks in an accurate and timely manner is required.
Strong attention to detail is required.
Strong customer service skills are required.

title: Principal, Corporate Development
description:
Come join the Intuit Corporate Strategy and Development team as a Principal on the Corporate Development team. We are looking for creative problem solvers with a passion for innovation to join our team and revolutionize the way the world does business.

About Corporate Strategy and Development:

Intuit's Corporate Strategy and Development team works on highly visible, key acquisition and strategy initiatives. The team is focused on identifying, evaluating and executing on opportunities to drive growth and/or operational excellence for Intuit and its portfolio of businesses. The work mirrors the work found at top venture capital/private equity firms, investment banks and strategy consulting firms. Key activities include evaluating M&A opportunities, investigating strategic opportunities, designing and conducting qualitative and quantitative research and analyses, and presenting findings to corporate leadership.

The Principal of Corporate Development position offers significant exposure to senior leaders across the company as well as greater responsibility and career progression than is often found in professional services.


Responsibilities


  • Driving the entire M&A process including inorganic strategies, market scans, target valuation, due diligence and deal negotiations
  • Managing a comprehensive due diligence process that involves several Intuit functions
  • Applying rigorous financial and valuation acumen to assess M&A opportunities and strategic initiatives
  • Preparing written narratives and making presentations to business unit leaders and senior corporate executives
  • Coordinating with the Integration team on planning and execution
  • Ability to engage with key business unit and corporate stakeholders across multiple projects and work streams
  • Developing network of industry contacts, venture capital/private equity investors, and investment banking/advisory executives

Qualifications


  • More than 10+ years of work experience in corporate development, venture capital/private equity, investment banking or related roles
  • MBA or equivalent experience desired
  • Desire to be a key leader in an active deal team which regularly engages with start-up and established tech companies, venture capital/private equity investors, investment banks, and strategy consulting firms
  • Excellent valuation/analytical skills, creativity in problem solving, and a keen business sense
  • Superior communication (written/verbal), presentation and meeting facilitation skills
  • Well-rounded interpersonal skill set with the capacity to lead teams and build highly engaged senior executive relationships
  • Committed to Intuit’s Values and championing diversity, inclusion, and a respectful environment
  • Proven ability to learn quickly and work well under pressure with appropriate attention to detail

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
Mountain View $212,000 - $287,000

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring a talented and execution-oriented Senior Graphic Designer to join our design team. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for taking our creative content to the next level.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at .

About the Job

The Senior Graphic Designer will report to our Head of Product Design and play a role in the conceptualization, design, and development of brand campaigns, concepts and assets.

Responsibilities

  • Produce breakthrough designs for a variety of media: presentation decks, digital ads, social media graphics, blogs, infographics, email campaigns, website graphics, etc.
  • Maintain a polished and consistent brand expression across all touchpoints
  • Edit and improve existing designs and templates
  • Work with the marketing and communications teams assisting with the creative and production process for all projects
  • Partner with other teams at Keeper to develop creative solutions for new product launches, promotions, announcements, helpful content, and more
  • Effectively communicate complex concepts into digestible designs for consumers and IT professionals alike

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional graphic design experience
  • Strong sense of typography and appropriate use of brand colors, images & fonts, allowing for effective legibility and functionality
  • Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite; Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign
  • Strong understanding of Figma, Google Suite (Docs, Slides, etc.) and AI tools to improve design workflows and productivity.
  • Experience in the creation and preparation of designs for printing such as brochures, labels, business cards, and a range of other marketing materials
  • Exhibit a range of varied styles and techniques to visualize and bring early-stage ideas to life
  • Excellent written, verbal communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to collaborate with stakeholders, team members and cross-functional teams
  • Ability to multitask, stay organized, and meet multiple deadlines across a variety of projects
  • Link to a strong visual portfolio with an emphasis on digital design
  • Bachelor’s degree in graphic design or related field is preferred

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

Information You provide:

  • Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter
  • Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility
  • Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

  • Interview notes, assessments, communications
  • Scheduling information

Information From Others:

  • Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile
  • References (with your consent, before final offer)
  • Public professional profiles
  • Background verification (post offer)

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

  • We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Assess your application and suitability
  • Manage interviews and recruitment workflow
  • Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)
  • Comply with employment law obligations

3. Legal Basis

  • Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)
  • Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)

4. Who We Share Information With

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

title: Assistant Controller
description:
Job Title: Assistant Controller

Location: Ogden, UT

About Us: Cubiscan is an employee-owned (ESOP) technology company that develops innovative solutions for data collection, automation, logistics, and supply chain. With our experience, we guide our customers to solutions that help them be more efficient, profitable, and environmentally responsible. At Cubiscan, every eligible employee is a beneficial owner of the company. We pride ourselves on fostering a positive and inclusive work environment where every employee is valued and can grow with the company.

Job Summary:

Cubiscan is seeking an experienced Assistant Controller to join our finance and accounting team and work closely with our Controller in supporting the company's accounting and financial operations. This position will play an important role in financial reporting, accounting processes, internal controls, and day-to-day financial management while developing a strong understanding of Cubiscan's business, systems, and operations. The ideal candidate will bring strong accounting knowledge, sound business judgment, and the ability to take on increasing responsibility as the needs of the organization evolve.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist with the day-to-day management of accounting functions.
  • Prepare and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and provide meaningful financial information to management.
  • Manage and review general ledger activity and account reconciliations.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing processes.
  • Prepare journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and financial reports.
  • Assist with accounts receivable, accounts payable, cash management, fixed assets, sales tax reporting and inventory accounting.
  • Assist with annual budgeting, forecasting, valuation, and financial analysis.
  • Support external audits, tax preparation, annual valuation, and other financial compliance activities.
  • Work with department managers to understand and explain financial performance and variances.
  • Champion accounting system modernization and process improvement while maintaining effective accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Develop proficiency in Cubiscan's ERP and accounting system. (Syteline)
  • Develop an understanding of Cubiscan's ESOP and 401(k) reporting requirements.
  • Work closely with the Controller to develop a thorough understanding of key accounting responsibilities, financial processes, and institutional knowledge.
  • Assume increasing levels of responsibility within the finance and accounting function as experience and organizational needs evolve.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • CPA, active CPA candidacy, or MBA.
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Strong knowledge of general ledger accounting and financial reporting.
  • Experience with month-end and year-end close processes.
  • Strong Excel, database, and analytical skills.
  • Experience working with an ERP or accounting system.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with management and other departments.
  • High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential financial information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience as an Assistant Controller, Controller, or in a comparable senior accounting role.
  • Manufacturing or industrial accounting experience.
  • Experience with payroll, open enrollment, and employee benefits.
  • Experience with ESOP and 401(k) accounting or administration.
  • Experience with inventory accounting, standard costing, job costing, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
  • Experience with multi-state sales tax reporting.

What Success Looks Like:

The successful candidate will develop a thorough understanding of Cubiscan's financial operations, systems, and accounting processes while becoming a trusted resource to the Controller and management team. Over time, this individual will take on increasing responsibility within the finance and accounting function and demonstrate the knowledge, judgment, and leadership capabilities needed to support Cubiscan's continued growth.

What We Offer:

  • We offer a competitive salary.
  • Benefits package, including health, dental, vision and 401K.
  • The opportunity to be a beneficial owner of the company as a participant in our ESOP.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • A collaborative and supportive work environment.

Cubiscan is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To learn more about our company visit www.cubiscan.com.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior QA Engineer
Key Skills: Python, Playwright, SQL, REST APIs, Test Automation, AI-Assisted Testing
Experience: 5+ YOE.
Location: Costa Rica
Mode: Remote.

We at Coforge are hiring Senior QA Engineer (#20934-21-1) with the following skill set.

Key Responsibilities
· Plan, design, and execute manual and automated testing for investor funding, payment processing, data flows, and system integrations.
· Build and maintain automated test suites using Python (pytest, Robot Framework) and Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript).
· Validate REST APIs, file-based integrations, and data pipelines to ensure data accuracy and system reliability.
· Write complex SQL queries to perform data validation, reconciliation, and defect investigation.
· Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
· Execute performance and load testing to validate scalability and transaction processing capabilities.
· Test responsive web applications across browsers, devices, and screen sizes.
· Leverage AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to accelerate test development, maintenance, and analysis.
· Develop AI-assisted testing solutions and automation tools to improve quality engineering efficiency.
· Collaborate with developers, product owners, and business stakeholders throughout the Agile development lifecycle.
· Participate in Sprint Planning, Refinement, Daily Standups, Reviews, and Retrospectives.
· Report, track, and validate defect resolution while providing quality metrics and testing insights to the team.

Required Skills & Qualifications
· 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance covering both manual and automated testing.

title: Tableau Developer, People Analytics (Contract)
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Tableau Developer, People Analytics (6-Month Contract)

Remote (Preference for CST)

About the Team

At PlayStation, we're not just building the Best Place to Play — we're also building the Best Place to Work.

The People Analytics team within Sony Interactive Entertainment's (SIE) People & Places organization partners with leaders across the business to transform people data into meaningful insights and smarter decisions. We're a small but mighty team passionate about making data more accessible, actionable, and engaging for the people who use it.

We're currently on a mission to level up our entire portfolio of People Analytics dashboards — reimagining how we visualize workforce and workplace data, expanding access to insights, and empowering more leaders to make informed decisions through intuitive, self-service analytics.

We're looking for an experienced Tableau Developer to join us on a 6-month contract and help bring this vision to life.

About the Role

As a Tableau Developer on the People Analytics team, you'll play a critical role in modernizing our dashboard portfolio, combining exceptional data visualization skills with the technical expertise needed to make people data more accessible without compromising security.

You'll focus on two key priorities:

  • Dashboard Modernization: Transform existing Tableau dashboards into visually compelling, intuitive, and high-impact analytical products. Improve aesthetics, functionality, usability, and content to help our stakeholders find the insights they need and understand what actions to take.
  • Expanded Access & Row-Level Security: Design and implement scalable row-level security solutions within Tableau, enabling us to safely expand dashboard access to new audiences while ensuring users see only the employee data they're authorized to access.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves building exceptional data products, enjoys solving technical challenges, and takes pride in creating solutions that people genuinely want to use.

What You'll Be Doing

Dashboard Design & Development

  • Lead the redesign, development, and enhancement of existing Tableau dashboards, incorporating modern data visualization best practices, intuitive navigation, and engaging user experiences.
  • Partner with People Analytics team members and stakeholders to understand business questions, identify opportunities for improvement, and translate requirements into effective dashboard solutions.
  • Optimize dashboard performance, usability, and maintainability, ensuring solutions are scalable and deliver a seamless user experience.
  • Incorporate user feedback into iterative improvements, balancing visual appeal, analytical accuracy, and practical business needs.
  • Build dashboards that empower stakeholders to independently explore data, answer business questions, and make informed decisions.

Row-Level Security & Data Access

  • Design, implement, test, and maintain robust row-level security (RLS) solutions within Tableau to support expanded access to sensitive employee data.
  • Develop scalable security models that dynamically restrict data visibility based on user identity, organizational hierarchy, role, or other defined access permissions.
  • Collaborate with People Analytics and relevant technology/security partners to ensure security implementations align with organizational data governance and privacy requirements.
  • Validate security configurations through comprehensive testing, including different user roles, access scenarios, and organizational changes.
  • Document security architecture, configuration, and maintenance procedures to enable reliable ongoing administration by the People Analytics team.

Data Integration & Technical Excellence

  • Develop and optimize Tableau data sources, connections, and underlying data models, primarily leveraging Snowflake.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and prepare data for dashboard development.
  • Troubleshoot data quality, performance, and integration issues across dashboards and underlying data sources.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and standardize dashboard development and maintenance processes.
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure knowledge transfer, thorough documentation, and sustainable solutions beyond the contract period.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Significant hands-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining complex Tableau dashboards in a professional environment.
  • Advanced Tableau expertise, including dashboard design, calculated fields, parameters, filters, actions, data modeling, performance optimization, and visualization best practices.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and maintaining row-level security in Tableau, including user-based access controls, entitlement/security mapping, and dynamic data filtering.
  • Strong understanding of Tableau's security architecture and how permissions, data sources, and row-level security interact.
  • Proficiency working with relational databases and querying data using SQL or comparable technologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical challenges independently.
  • Experience translating business requirements into intuitive, high-quality analytical products.
  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with sensitive or confidential information.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to independently manage priorities, deliver high-quality work within defined timelines, and document solutions for long-term sustainability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Snowflake, including querying, data modeling, and optimizing Tableau connections to Snowflake datasets.
  • Experience with Alteryx or similar ETL/data preparation tools for automating data transformation and integration workflows.
  • Experience working with HRIS or People Analytics data, particularly employee records, organizational hierarchies, and workforce metrics.
  • Familiarity with enterprise Tableau environments, including Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud administration, permissions, and governance.
  • Experience implementing dynamic row-level security based on organizational hierarchies or complex business rules.
  • Experience modernizing existing dashboard portfolios, including establishing reusable design patterns and development standards.
  • Familiarity with Workday or other enterprise HR systems.

Who You Are

  • Design-minded: You believe a great dashboard should be as intuitive and engaging as it is analytically rigorous.
  • Technically curious: You enjoy untangling complex data and security challenges and finding elegant, scalable solutions.
  • Impact-driven: You care about more than delivering a dashboard — you want to know whether people use it and whether it helps them make better decisions.
  • Collaborative: You're an approachable partner who welcomes feedback, shares knowledge, and helps others succeed.
  • Detail-oriented: You understand that accuracy, privacy, and security are non-negotiable when working with people data.
  • Pragmatic and adaptable: You balance innovation with practical execution, recognizing that delivering sustainable improvements matters more than chasing perfection.

The Impact You'll Make

By the end of this 6-month engagement, you'll have helped transform how leaders across PlayStation access and interact with workforce insights.

Your work will contribute to a modernized, more intuitive dashboard portfolio, a scalable foundation for secure access to people data, and a more self-sufficient People Analytics team equipped to maintain and expand these capabilities into the future.

Most importantly, you'll help us turn people data into better decisions — and better experiences for the people who make PlayStation extraordinary.

title: Packaging Technician
description:
General Purpose: Properly package finished Cheese product as per packaging instructions while meeting safety and quality standards. Operate various packaging equipment, box finished and packaged cheese product. Assist the Packaging Lead Person and Scale Operator as needed and maintain the packaging room to 5S standards to maintain a safe, sanitary and efficient operation.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Operate the ULMA
  • Operate the Quadrille
  • Operate the Snorkel Vac
  • Operate the Cryovac
  • Package finished cheese product
  • Box finished and packaged cheese product
  • Maintain safe working conditions for employees and compliance with all state and federal regulations regarding health and safety issues
  • Dedicate effort to safety as we expect every employee to leave work in the same condition as they arrive
  • Follow all DFA good manufacturing practices (GMP) and work in a manner consistent with all corporate regulatory, food safety, quality, and sanitation requirements
  • Exhibit the values and ethics of Dairy Farmers of America through honesty, discretion, and sound judgment
  • Adhere to all DFA Quality, Safety and GMP policies and procedures and report any nonconformity
  • Attend required training, including but not limited to, Safety, GMP, Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Point (HACCP), and Safe Quality Foods (SQF)
  • Responsible for monitoring and taking corrective actions when necessary for a critical control point as part of the plant HACCP plan
  • Ensure that all documentation is done correctly and turned in promptly
  • The requirements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employee, but is not a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Other duties may be assigned as required

Pay

  • Competitive pay $22.00 per hour based on experience
  • Rate includes $1.00 shift differential for hours worked between 6 PM and 6 AM
  • Paid Overtime

BENEFITS

  • Medical

  • 401k Employer Match
  • Life Insurance – Company Paid
  • AD&D, STD and LTD - Company Paid

title: Vice President of Finance
description:
VICE PRESIDENT OF FINANCE
About Voltava:
At Voltava, people power everything we do. We are a premier global manufacturing an assembly partner formed through the combination of Detroit Manufacturing Systems, Android Industries, and Avancez with approximately 5,400 Team Members across 21 facilities worldwide. Our vibrant, collaborative, and people-focused culture is the foundation for everything we deliver, from complex module assembly and sequencing to contract manufacturing, supply chain, automation, and tooling and equipment design for OEM customers across the automotive, industrial, e-mobility, heavy truck, defense, and technology sectors. Kinetyc, our scalable contract manufacturing arm based in Wixom, Michigan, expands our capabilities and capacity to support customers across a range of industries. Together, we are Building A Better Everything.
About the Role:
The Vice President of Finance is a senior finance leader and trusted strategic partner to the Chief Financial Officer, with broad responsibility for the organization’s financial health, capital strategy, and finance operations. This role provides executive-level leadership across financial reporting, planning and forecasting, cash management, capital sourcing, banking relationships, transactions, risk management, and organizational development.
Working closely with the CFO, the VP of Finance helps shape and execute the company’s financial strategy, providing the insight, discipline, and financial infrastructure needed to support growth and long-term value creation. The role serves as a key financial partner to ownership, investors, lenders, and executive leadership and represents the finance function with credibility and confidence.
This is an opportunity for a strategic finance leader who can operate at both the enterprise level and in the details—bringing strong financial judgment, commercial acumen, and a proactive approach to complex business decisions.
What You Will Do:
Strategic Finance & CFO Partnership

Serve as a key extension of the CFO in developing and executing the company’s financial strategy and priorities.
Provide financial perspective and decision support on enterprise strategy, investments, growth initiatives, and operational performance.
Translate complex financial information into clear insights, recommendations, and actions for executive leadership, ownership, and investors.
Partner with the CFO to strengthen financial processes, infrastructure, and organizational capabilities as the company evolves.
Identify opportunities to improve profitability, cash generation, capital efficiency, and long-term enterprise value.

Capital Strategy, Banking & Transactions

Lead or support the company’s capital strategy, including sourcing, structuring, and executing debt financing and other capital solutions.
Partner with the company’s Treasury function to develop and maintain senior-level relationships with banks, lenders, investors, family offices, and other financial partners.
Lead or support financial due diligence, valuation, financial modeling, and transaction analysis for acquisitions, dispositions, refinancings, and other strategic transactions.
Evaluate financing and capital allocation alternatives and provide recommendations to the CFO and executive leadership.

Financial Leadership & Performance

Provide executive oversight of consolidated financial reporting across a complex, multi-entity, multi-location organization.
Lead or support budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow planning, and financial performance management across corporate and business-unit operations.
Establish financial visibility and accountability through meaningful reporting, analysis, and performance metrics.
Lead or support accounting operations across accrual- and cash-basis entities, maintaining appropriate accounting practices and GAAP compliance where applicable.
Ensure the organization maintains strong internal controls, financial policies, and reporting standards.
Drive continuous improvement in finance systems, processes, reporting, and organizational effectiveness.

Risk, Compliance & Financial Stewardship

Serve as liaison to the CFO in managing relationships with external auditors, CPA firms, tax advisors, insurance providers, and other financial professionals.
Provide leadership or support for audits, reviews, tax filings, and other financial compliance requirements in collaboration with relevant finance leaders.
Identify and proactively address financial, operational, and liquidity risks that could impact the organization or its stakeholders.
Protect the financial integrity and capital of the company and its investors through disciplined financial management and controls.

Executive Leadership & Team Development

Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing finance organization spanning corporate and site-level finance and accounting teams.
Build organizational capabilities, succession plans, and talent strategies that position the finance function for continued growth.
Establish a culture of accountability, financial discipline, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Partner cross-functionally with operations and other executive leaders to align financial strategy with business objectives.
Support the CFO in investor, board, ownership, and executive-level communications and presentations.

What You Need To Be Successful:

10+ years of progressive finance and accounting leadership experience, including experience with complex, multi-entity or multi-location organizations.
Demonstrated success in capital sourcing, debt financing, lender relationship management, and financial transactions.
Experience with acquisitions, dispositions, refinancings, valuation, financial modeling, and due diligence.
Strong command of financial reporting, forecasting, cash management, internal controls, and financial performance management.
Experience leading and developing finance teams across multiple locations or business units.
Proven ability to build credibility and influence with executives, ownership, investors, lenders, and other senior stakeholders.
Strong financial systems, analytical, and technology capabilities; experience with hospitality or multi-site operating platforms is a plus.
Exceptional communication skills and the ability to distill complex financial matters into clear business insights and recommendations.
Strategic mindset with strong commercial judgment, executive presence, and the ability to balance long-term strategy with near-term execution.

What Success Looks Like:

The CFO has a trusted strategic partner who can independently lead major financial initiatives and provide sound, actionable insight.
Capital is sourced and deployed strategically, with strong relationships across the company’s banking, lending, and investment network.
Leadership has clear visibility into financial performance, liquidity, risks, and opportunities.
The finance organization operates with strong accountability, talent, controls, and scalable processes.
Finance is viewed across the organization as a strategic business partner that enables disciplined growth and long-term value creation.

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required.

Travel:

<10%

What We Offer:
We believe our team members are our greatest investment, which is why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support you at every stage of your career and life. Our benefits may include comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement savings programs with employer contributions, tuition reimbursement, paid time off and holidays, employee assistance resources, and additional wellness programs and benefits designed to support your health, financial well-being, professional growth, and overall quality of life.

Our Core Values:
Voltava is committed to creating an environment where every Team Member feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to make an impact.

Respect: We create belonging by bringing out the best in each other.
Integrity: We earn trust through every interaction.
Courage: We show up fully even when it would be easier not to.
Impact: We strengthen the people and places around us.

Together, we are Building A Better Everything.
Voltava is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We are committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
At Voltava, employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce strengthens our ability to innovate, serve our customers, and achieve our goals.
Accessibility and Accommodations
Voltava is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and during employment. If you require assistance or an accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact careers@voltava.com. Requests for accommodation will be reviewed and considered in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

title: Begeleider Gehandicaptenzorg | Heerde | Kanaalstraat
description:
Soms zit het verschil in iets kleins: de rust bewaren tijdens een zorgmoment, herkennen wat iemand zonder woorden probeert te vertellen of een bewoner nét dat stukje zelf laten doen wat nog lukt. Op de Kanaalstraat in Heerde begeleid en verzorg je ouder wordende mensen met een verstandelijke beperking. Geen bewoner is hetzelfde en juist die combinatie van begeleiding en intensieve zorg maakt jouw werk bijzonder.

Jouw werkplek

Op de Kanaalstraat in Heerde wonen 24 mensen met een verstandelijke beperking, ieder in een eigen appartement. De locatie heeft vier gezamenlijke huiskamers, verdeeld over drie verdiepingen. Veel bewoners worden ouder en hebben naast begeleiding steeds meer lichamelijke ondersteuning nodig.

De ondersteuningsvraag verschilt per bewoner. Bij de één ligt de nadruk op begeleiding, structuur, communicatie en het behouden van eigen regie. Een ander is juist afhankelijk van intensieve lichamelijke verzorging en ondersteuning bij ADL.

Je hebt een vast team als thuisbasis, waardoor je bewoners en collega's goed leert kennen. Tegelijkertijd werken we op de Kanaalstraat samen als één locatie. Als het nodig is, ondersteun je daarom ook collega's en bewoners op een andere woning.

We werken vanuit belevingsgerichte zorg. Je kijkt naar wat iemand nodig heeft, sluit aan bij verbale en non-verbale signalen en helpt bewoners zoveel mogelijk hun eigen keuzes te blijven maken

Wat ga je doen?

Als begeleider bied je zowel begeleiding als lichamelijke zorg. Juist die combinatie maakt de functie afwisselend en geeft je de mogelijkheid om jezelf breed te ontwikkelen.

Je:

  • biedt bewoners begeleiding, structuur en nabijheid;
  • ondersteunt bewoners bij de ADL en persoonlijke verzorging en neemt deze waar nodig volledig over;
  • werkt verantwoord met verschillende hulpmiddelen;
  • sluit je communicatie aan op verbale en non-verbale signalen;
  • stimuleert eigen regie en kijkt naar wat iemand nog wél zelf kan;
  • signaleert veranderingen in gezondheid, gedrag en welzijn;
  • werkt samen met collega's en andere betrokken disciplines rondom de bewoner.

Op momenten werk je zelfstandig op een woning. Je durft dan verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, blijft rustig en weet wanneer je de hulp of expertise van een collega moet inschakelen.

Waarom werken op de Kanaalstraat?

Op de Kanaalstraat ontwikkel je jezelf breed als begeleider. Je krijgt te maken met begeleiding, ouder wordende bewoners, intensieve lichamelijke zorg en verschillende manieren van communiceren.

Tegelijkertijd bouw je vanuit je vaste team een band op met bewoners en collega's. Je leert bewoners goed kennen en ontdekt wat voor hen belangrijk is. Soms is dat een activiteit of gesprek, maar soms zit kwaliteit van leven juist in een rustig zorgmoment, herkenning of simpelweg nabij zijn.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een betrokken begeleider die rustig kan werken, goed observeert en verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen. Intensieve lichamelijke zorg hoort voor jou bij het vak en je kunt jouw manier van begeleiden aanpassen aan verschillende bewoners.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je een afgeronde mbo-opleiding niveau 3 richting Zorg & Welzijn, bijvoorbeeld Maatschappelijke Zorg of Verzorgende IG;
  • heb je kennis van of ervaring met belevingsgerichte zorg en het begeleiden en verzorgen van mensen met een intensieve zorgvraag;
  • kun je verantwoord werken met veelvoorkomende hulpmiddelen of ben je bereid je hierin verder te ontwikkelen;
  • ben je flexibel en bereid om binnen de gehele Kanaalstraat te werken;
  • beheers je de Nederlandse taal goed in woord en schrift;
  • ben je bereid om onregelmatig te werken.

We vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf blijft ontwikkelen. Daarom krijg je de mogelijkheid om trainingen en scholingen te volgen die passen bij jouw werk en ontwikkeling.

Werktijden

Je werkt 20 uur per week. Op dit moment hebben we ruimte voor meerdere begeleiders. Wil je iets meer of minder werken? Bespreek dit gerust met ons, dan kijken we samen naar de mogelijkheden.

Je werkt van maandag tot en met zondag in wisselende diensten. Globaal zijn de diensten:

  • 07.00 tot 15.00 uur;
  • 16.00 tot 23.00 uur.

De exacte tijden kunnen per dienst iets verschillen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Philadelphia krijg je de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en met plezier je werk te doen. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een salaris volgens CAO Gehandicaptenzorg, FWG 35 CAO Gehandicaptenzorg (€ 2.649 – € 3.708 bruto per maand bij 36 uur)
  • onregelmatigheidstoeslag boven op je salaris;
  • 8% vakantietoeslag en een 13e maand;
  • Mogelijkheden voor opleidingen, trainingen en verdere ontwikkeling;
  • Aantrekkelijke extra's en regelingen via Philadelphia.

Enthousiast?

Zie jij jezelf werken op een locatie waar begeleiding én intensieve zorg samenkomen? Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatieknop.

Heb je vragen? Bel of WhatsApp met Cem Canan (Corporate Recruiter bij Philadelphia) op 06 27 25 40 36.

title: Leerkracht groep 4-5 Universum (tijdelijk)
description:
• Aantal uren: 24 uur
  • Werkdagen: woensdag, donderdag en vrijdag

Jij brengt structuur, enthousiasme en vertrouwen. Onze kinderen brengen hun eigen talenten en ideeën mee. Samen maken we er in groep 4/5 iedere dag een mooie leerervaring van!

Jouw toekomstige werkplek:

Welkom bij Kindcentrum Universum in Hoorn! Voor onze leuke groep 4-5 zoeken we een enthousiaste leerkracht die met plezier voor de klas staat en kinderen helpt om iedere dag een stapje verder te komen.

Bij Universum werken we met een diverse groep kinderen. Ieder kind brengt iets eigens mee en heeft zijn eigen manier van leren en ontwikkelen. We bieden duidelijkheid en structuur met herkenbare routines en spreken hoge verwachtingen uit. Zo weten kinderen waar ze aan toe zijn en krijgen ze de ruimte om hun talenten te ontdekken en te groeien.

Je komt terecht in een klein en betrokken team. We kennen onze kinderen goed, staan voor elkaar klaar en werken samen aan onderwijs waarin elk kind zich gezien voelt en de kans krijgt om zich optimaal te ontwikkelen.

Hier word jij enthousiast van:

Jij krijgt energie van lesgeven en vindt het mooi om te zien hoe kinderen groeien in hun kennis, vaardigheden en zelfvertrouwen. Je weet een fijne balans te vinden tussen structuur bieden en kinderen uitdagen om zelf stappen te zetten. Je hebt oog voor verschillen tussen leerlingen en weet jouw lessen daarop af te stemmen.

Je staat stevig voor de groep, bent duidelijk in je verwachtingen en creëert een veilige sfeer waarin kinderen fouten durven maken en met plezier leren. Daarbij sta je open voor ideeën van collega's en vind je het vanzelfsprekend om samen te werken aan goed onderwijs.

Daarnaast:

  • Ben je bevoegd als leerkracht basisonderwijs;
  • Ben je beschikbaar op woensdag, donderdag en vrijdag;
  • Krijg je energie van de dynamiek en diversiteit van groep 4/5;
  • Bied je kinderen structuur, duidelijkheid en passende uitdaging;
  • Geloof je in de mogelijkheden van ieder kind en stimuleer je hen om het beste uit zichzelf te halen;
  • Werk je graag samen in een klein en betrokken team.

Word jij onze nieuwe collega op het Universum? We maken graag kennis met je!

Dit krijg je van ons:

  • Salaris conform cao PO loonschaal LB (min. € 3.622 en max. € 5.520 op fulltime basis);
  • Voorrang en personeelsvoordeel bij plaatsing van jouw kinderen op een van onze kinderopvanglocaties;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding: €0,25 per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van je OV-reis;
  • Eindejaarsuitkering 8,33%;
  • Vakantiegeld: 8%;
  • Pensioenopbouw;
  • Bedrijfsfitness en fietsenplan;
  • Toegang tot de SCIO Academie (wij vinden het belangrijk dat je je blijft ontwikkelen).

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Een afgeronde lerarenopleiding (PABO).
  • Interesse in en visie op High Performance School (HPS);

    Deze functie is intern en extern beschikbaar; interne kandidaten hebben voorrang bij gelijke geschiktheid.

    Is deze vacature toch niet helemaal wat je zoekt? Geen probleem! Neem een kijkje in ons vacatureoverzicht.

    De vacature sluit zodra wij de juiste kandidaat hebben gevonden. Wij hanteren bij al onze vacatures de NVP-sollicitatiecode.

title: Per Diem Educational Consultant (6-12 ELA)
location: IN, US; IA, US; MI, US; US; IL, US; WI, US; KY, US; Washington, DC, US; VA, US; MN, US; DE, US; MO, US; OH, US; MD, US
description:
The Per Diem Educational Consultant for 6-12 ELA is an onsite representative of Savvas Learning Company helping to initiate lasting change in districts and schools by delivering core content, intervention and supplemental professional development, Change of Practice, and Job-embedded services. This resource provides individual and group support for district personnel and school faculty to incorporate effective strategies into classroom practice.

Additional responsibilities include delivering professional development and technical assistance to schools that have contracted with Savvas for professional development and job-embedded services. In addition, this position requires deep knowledge and extensive experience with academia, standards-based school reform and the ability to deliver high quality job-embedded professional development and site-based technical support to school personnel using innovative Savvas products, technology resources and/or research-based methodologies for school turn around.

Desired applicants must have 5+ years of successful teaching experience in a 6-12 school setting and preference will be given to candidates who can provide evidence through demonstration of existing knowledge of Savvas products, experience in effective coaching and training to teachers and teacher leaders.

Candidates must be local to the Midwest or Mid-Atlantic region.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Effectively implement classroom components and resources in the program:

Apply the philosophy, pedagogy, and basic organization of the program.

Implement each segment of the daily instructional block.

Differentiate instruction based on student need.

Effectively manage a Savvas curriculum classroom, technology integration and devices.

Effectively utilize data and reporting tools to impact instruction and decision making.

Model coaching conversations that support admin with providing effective teacher feedback.

Job-Embedded Coaching and Modeling:

Coach teachers to apply the philosophy, pedagogy, and basic organization of the program.

Differentiate instruction based on teacher/student need.

Observation and Support:

Observe classroom practices following the professional development to identify implementation progress of the Savvas program.

Provide teachers with critical feedback to guide implementation progress of the key instructional features of the program.

Provide feedback on observable practices learned from Model Lesson/Lesson Study opportunity.

Data-Based Decision Making:

Use of two dashboards within the product (Performance and Assignment).

Differentiate instruction based on student need.

Administrator Support:

Utilize Savvas program tools to determine the implementation needs.

Observe the strategies and practices implemented in the instructional block and provide teachers with feedback on implementation.

Understand and identify the philosophy, pedagogy, and basic organization of the program.

Administrator Coaching:

Classroom/Instructional coaching.

Facilitation of training to support implementation.

Provision of onsite technical support.

Regular and ongoing communication with school and district leaders.

B.A. or B.S. degree required; M.A. preferred.

Experience offering workshops/coaching to teachers.

Experience with classroom-based technology integration.

Experience with differentiated instruction.

Demonstrated success as a classroom teacher and at least five years of successful experience as a 6-12 professional in the ELA content area.

Strong collaboration and team building skills.

Knowledge of standards-based reform, curriculum, instruction, and assessment.

Ability to plan strategically with and coach school leaders and classroom teachers.

Ability to provide instructional support relating to effective teaching strategies for teachers across content areas using instructional technology.

title: Principal Software Engineer I - CI/CD - Platform Engineering Productivity
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role :

The Platform Engineering Productivity team operates the CI, CD, and Release infrastructure for the company. We ensure developers can efficiently and safely deploy changes across our various environments and at scale. In an age of AI, the landscape is evolving rapidly from scaling needs to, more than ever, securing our supply chain. There are interesting challenges to tackle.
We're looking for a proactive systems thinker who delivers on business-driven projects while identifying and driving the work that keeps our infrastructure ahead before scaling and security challenges become problems. If you're energized by work that makes every engineering team at Elastic ship faster and more securely, we'd love to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing :

  • Define the roadmap and technical vision for CI/CD, from problem identification through org-wide adoption.
  • Identify where CI/CD is a bottleneck, a source of friction, or a security risk before it becomes an incident, and drive the remediation rather than waiting to be assigned it.
  • Design and enforce release gates covering supply chain integrity, artifact provenance, and release readiness, built to scale across teams without becoming a tax on engineering velocity.
  • Direct engineers on your team through complex, multi-quarter projects: break down the architecture, assign the work, and own the outcome even when the execution is distributed.
  • Drive clear technical communication and alignment across teams, and produce high-quality documentation for systems, processes, and architectural decisions.
  • Serve as Incident Commander on high-severity supply chain or release incidents, and use each incident as a forcing function for structural improvements.
  • Raise the engineering bar across the org through code review, mentorship, design review, and by setting standards others adopt voluntarily.
  • Remain hands-on at the right depth: you'll review code, prototype approaches, and debug production issues, but your primary leverage at this level is through the work of others, not your own output.

What You Bring :

  • Deep expertise in CI/CD and what it takes to harden a release pipeline against supply chain attacks.
  • Strong debugging instincts across the full pipeline stack: you trace failures from test runner to artifact store to cluster deployment without needing a specialist for each layer.
  • Hands-on with CI infrastructure (Buildkite, GitHub Actions, or equivalent), GitOps/ArgoCD, and Kubernetes.
  • You use AI to accelerate your own work and your team's and you understand AI's impact on supply chain security and scale.
  • A track record of multi-quarter, cross-org ownership: you've identified the right problem, designed the solution, and gotten organizations that didn't report to you to change how they work.
  • The judgment to push back on a prescribed plan when it's the wrong call, and the credibility to get alignment on a better approach.
  • Experience directing the work of other engineers toward outcomes not just collaborating, but breaking down complex problems into executable work and holding the outcome.


Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. title: Data Engineer in Test
description:
Who Are We?

Prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes.

This is precision cardiology, and we know it’s within reach.

What Will You Do?

The Overview

As a Data Engineer in Test, you will play a critical role in advancing Prolaio’s mission to transform heart care. In this position, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to validate and optimize data pipelines, ensuring the accuracy and reliability of the data infrastructure that underpins our SaMD products. Your work will be essential in delivering scalable, high-quality data systems that directly support the development of life-changing heart care solutions for patients.


We are looking for a highly driven individual with deep expertise in testing data pipelines, analytical workflows, and large datasets. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with cloud-based Data Lake environments (including services like Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Databricks, or Snowflake), and generating synthetic data to support testing where real patient data is limited, restricted, or unavailable. Your contributions will ensure the integrity, performance, and scalability of our data infrastructure, aligning with our commitment to delivering safe, effective, and accessible heart care solutions.

The Specifics

  • Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and automated test suites for data pipelines to ensure data quality, consistency, and system performance.
  • Test and validate ETL/ELT processes and data workflows across Data Lake environments, confirming the accuracy of data transformations and adherence to business logic.
  • Validate data ingestion, processing, and storage within scalable cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, ensuring computed data correctly reflects raw time-series biosensor inputs.
  • Design, build, and maintain synthetic data generation tools and datasets that mimic real-world time-series biosensor data, enabling thorough test coverage where real patient data is limited or restricted.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to define testing requirements and ensure data accuracy throughout the entire data lifecycle.
  • Conduct performance testing and benchmarking on data systems to evaluate scalability under high data loads and identify performance bottlenecks.
  • Monitor and report on key performance metrics, identifying potential data anomalies, inconsistencies, or performance issues.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes, automation frameworks, and tools used across data workflows.

Why Prolaio?

  • Impactful Work: You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology.
  • Innovative Environment: You will be part of an organization doing something that’s never been done before.
  • Professional Growth: You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow.
  • Collaborative Team: You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology.

Who You Are?

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in software testing, with a specific focus on data pipelines, Data Lake, and data warehouses.
  • Strong understanding of data engineering concepts and technologies, including ETL/ELT processes, Data Lake , and cloud-based data warehouses.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python for data querying, analysis, and test automation.
  • Experience working with cloud-based data platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery.
  • Demonstrated experience generating synthetic data for testing purposes, including designing datasets that realistically represent production data characteristics.
  • Familiarity with data testing tools and frameworks such as pytest, unittest, or TestNG.
  • Strong knowledge of time-series data processing, analysis techniques, and best practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

Additional Qualifications (Nice to Haves)

  • Certifications in data engineering or cloud platforms (e.g., GCP Certified Data Engineer, Databricks Certified Data Engineer).
  • Experience in a regulated industry (Healthcare, MedTech, or BioTech), with familiarity with data governance and regulatory compliance frameworks.
  • Prior experience testing systems subject to IEC 62304 or similar SaMD quality standards.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Meaningful Compensation: Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity so you can share in what we build.
  • Great Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision plans with multiple options and strong company contributions.
  • Flexible Spending Perks: HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and a $1,200 annual Lifestyle Spending Account to support wellness, commuting, family needs, and more.
  • Time to Recharge: Generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays.
  • Family-First Benefits: Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and support for growing families.
  • Security & Peace of Mind: Company-paid life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.
  • Plan for the Future: 401(k) plan to help you build long-term financial security.
  • Care When You Need It: Easy access to telehealth and optional supplemental coverage for life’s unexpected moments.

Starting Salary is at $134,000.00 (Exact Compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location)

  • Qualify all prospective renters using company approved procedures
  • Move-in new renters, discuss lease and apartment complex rules, and conduct move-in inspection. Move-out departing renters to include conducting a move-out inspection

  • Other duties as assigned by Property Manager
  • Attend required trainings and meetings

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience:

Skills and Abilities:

  • Organizational and time management skills
  • Basic computer literacy (email, web applications)

Must possess mobility to work in a standard office setting and to use standard office equipment, including a computer; strength to lift and carry items weighing up to 10 pounds; vision to read printed material and a computer screen; and hearing and speech to communicate in-person and over the telephone. Must be able to quickly and easily navigate the property/building as required to meet the job functions, including climbing stairs and walking the hallways and common areas.

Personal Protective Equipment: None

Work Environment: Office working conditions, on property
