title: Director, Compliance
description:
Tonix Pharmaceuticals* is a fully integrated, commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on central nervous system (CNS) and immunology treatments in areas of high unmet medical need. TONMYA® (cyclobenzaprine HCl sublingual tablets 2.8 mg) is the first new treatment for fibromyalgia in adults in more than 15 years. Tonix’s CNS commercial infrastructure supports its marketed products, including its acute migraine products, Zembrace® Symtouch® (sumatriptan injection 3 mg) and Tosymra® (sumatriptan nasal spray 10 mg). Tonix is investigating TONMYA® in Phase 2 clinical trials to evaluate its potential in major depressive disorder and acute stress disorder/acute stress reaction. Tonix is also advancing a pipeline of immunology programs, including TNX-4800, a Phase 2 ready long-acting human anti-Borrelia OspA monoclonal antibody (mAb) for the prevention of Lyme disease in the U.S., and TNX-1500, a Phase 2 ready third-generation CD40 ligand inhibitor for the prevention of kidney transplant rejection. In addition, the Company is progressing TNX-2900 (intranasal potentiated oxytocin), which is Phase 2 ready for the treatment of Prader-Willi syndrome, a rare disease. To learn more, visit www.tonixpharma.com and follow the Company on LinkedIn and X.

*Tonix’s product development candidates are investigational new drugs or biologics; their efficacy and safety have not been established and have not been approved for any indication.

Zembrace SymTouch and Tosymra are registered trademarks of Tonix Medicines. TONMYA is a registered trademark of Tonix Pharma Limited. All other marks are property of their respective owners.

Position Overview

The Director, Compliance reports to the VP, Legal & Compliance and supports the function in developing, implementing, and maintaining an effective Compliance Program that (1) supports and promotes a companywide culture of ethics and compliance, and (2) meets or exceeds applicable regulatory standards for effective compliance programs, including the Office of Inspector General (OIG) Guidance

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic direction across all OIG seven elements of an effective compliance program leveraging knowledge of industry best practices
  • Assume primary responsibility for all healthcare compliance policies and educating business stakeholders in their application
  • Working collaboratively, draft, implement, administer and maintain relevant compliance policies, procedures, and work instructions
  • Management and oversight of 1) engagements with healthcare professionals and patients including FMV and 2) external funding (including sponsorships and grants) in collaboration with relevant stakeholders
  • Assist with designing and overseeing a comprehensive compliance monitoring program to assess adherence to internal policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards. Lead risk-based monitoring activities across key business functions, including Commercial, Medical Affairs, and Market Access, to proactively identify and mitigate compliance risks. Develop actionable insights from monitoring outcomes, drive continuous improvement, and ensure timely reporting and remediation in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Develop training plans and deliver effective compliance training programs to employees, enhancing awareness and understanding of ethical standards and legal obligations.
  • Lead the ongoing oversight of federal and state transparency reporting programs, including Open Payments (Sunshine Act) and state-specific disclosure requirements. Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Medical Affairs, and Commercial teams to build scalable processes that support transparency, mitigate risk, and promote ethical business practices.
  • Maintain a current working knowledge of various laws, regulations, and industry guidance that affect the compliance program, including antikickback and fraud and abuse laws, bribery and corruption, transparency laws, price reporting, OIG and DOJ guidelines, and industry standards, such as the PhRMA Code

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • MS, JD, MBA or other relevant advanced degree strongly preferred
  • 10+ years (with a B.S. degree), or 8+ years (with a graduate degree) of recent, relevant in-house experience in a compliance or related department of a healthcare organization or directly applicable law firm experience
  • Direct compliance experience in the pharmaceutical or medical device industry
  • Direct experience building programs and selecting and managing vendors
  • Direct experience leading significant programs and projects
  • Experience managing compliance programs, including drafting policies, developing and implementing training standards, leading monitoring initiatives, and conducting investigations on sensitive matters
  • Ability to apply a risk-based analysis to legal and compliance issues and develop creative and practical solutions that satisfy both business requirements and legal obligations
  • Ability to manage and drive the implementation of technical solutions (e.g., dashboards, portals) to manage processes including the HCP and patient engagement processes; monitoring; investigations workflows
  • Communicates complex compliance concepts effectively to the organization in a way that is connected to business objectives
  • Strong oral, written and presentation communication skills with superior attention to detail
  • Demonstrates initiative and excellent judgment; proactive; ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team setting; able to build relationships, both internally and externally
  • Demonstrated commitment to compliance, ethics, integrity, accountability and innovation

Salary Range
$180,000—$210,000 USD

*Please note that Tonix does not offer sponsorship for this role.

Recruitment & Staffing Agencies

Tonix does not accept agency resumes unless contacted directly by internal Tonix Talent Acquisition. Please do not forward resumes to Tonix employees or any other company location; Tonix is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Compensation & Benefits

Tonix provides a comprehensive compensation and benefits package which includes:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance, Basic and Voluntary Life and AD&D Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Account, and Employee Assistance Programs
  • Pet Insurance
  • Retirement Savings 401k with company match and annual discretionary stock options
  • Generous Paid Time Off, Sick Time, & Paid Holidays
  • Career Development and Training

Tonix provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, genetics, or any other characteristic protected by law. In addition to federal law requirements, Tonix complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Tonix expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic, information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Instructional Aide
description:
About the Team

ACCEL Schools is seeking an Instructional Aide for Northside Preparatory Academy in Cincinnati, OH.

Be part of the difference at Northside Preparatory Academy! Founded in 2020, Northside Preparatory Academy is a public charter school serving EK-8 grade students throughout the Spring Grove and Northside communities. The school offers a well-rounded academic program that places emphasis on good citizenship and service to the community. The school’s nurturing teachers, small group instruction, and focus on social-emotional wellbeing create a positive school culture. Northside Preparatory Academy is part of ACCEL Schools, an established network of public charter schools serving K-12 students throughout the United States since 2014.

About the Opportunity:

The Instructional Aide assists the Teacher with classroom activities and helps to promote positive student behaviors in both academics and extra-curricular activities. The Instructional Aide provides oversight to ensure student safety and a positive school climate. The Instructional Aide assists the School Leader and Teachers by administering the assigned duties in conformity with the philosophy and policies of ACCEL Schools, the assigned school, the school’s governing board, the State Board of Education, and all applicable laws.

Duties:

  • Supports lessons taught by the teacher to individual students or groups of students and follows instructional plans as assigned by the Teacher or School Leader
  • Helps plan classroom activities as directed by the Teacher and supports the Teacher in all student and parent relations
  • Assists with school activities, including, but not limited to, parent-faculty nights, faculty meetings, assemblies, commencement exercises, fundraiser, chaperoning student activities, providing guidance for students, participating on faculty committees, etc.
  • Performs clerical duties, including, but not limited to, grading papers and making copies
  • Assists the Teacher in the use of classroom technology
  • Helps maintain the cleanliness of the classroom, lunchroom and other school areas
  • Understands, accepts, abides by, and implements the school’s philosophy and mission statement in all school activities
  • Other duties as assigned, including, but not limited to, field trips, morning duty, dismissal duty, and lunch duty

Performance Expectations:

  • Works cooperatively with the Teacher and others
  • Acts in accordance with directives from the Administrator (or designee) and teacher
  • Contributes to a positive climate and culture by exhibiting high professional standard

About You:

  • Associate degree, two years of college coursework, or the passage of the Paraprofessional’s Exam
  • Proficiency in MS Office
  • Successful completion of BCI/FBI check
  • Ability to meet educational standards as applicable
  • Ability to work well under pressure, and effectively prioritize and execute tasks to meet deadlines consistently
  • Understanding and ability to manage confidential information
  • High quality written and verbal communication skills
  • Physical ability to lift 25-40 lbs.
  • Experience in a school or social services setting is a plus

About Us

“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” – Ron Packard, CEO & Founder

ACCEL Schools is a network of 80+ high-performing, public charter schools serving PK-12 students. We proudly advocate for school choice and work to address educational inequities throughout the United States. Our schools are inclusive and widely differ to reflect the unique values of the many urban, suburban, and rural communities we serve. Our brick and mortar, and virtual schools specialize in closing educational gaps and offer innovative models such as career-technical education, sports training, bilingual programming, and more. We have been recognized and praised by legislators, authorizers, and researchers for providing exceptional education options to students in historically under-resourced communities.

We offer the following benefits:

Compensation

The starting hourly rate for this position is $16.25/hour. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Life benefits – time & peace of mind

  • Paid time off
  • Retirement contributions
  • Optional Basic Life and AD&D insurance
  • Voluntary life insurance (employee, spouse, child)
  • Discounted childcare at Early Learning Academies locations

Health benefits – stay well & thrive

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Voluntary short-term disability insurance
  • Voluntary long-term disability insurance

Career benefits – keep growing

  • Career advancement opportunities throughout Accel Schools and our strong network of 4,000+ instructors and education professionals

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

It is our policy to abide by all federal, state and local laws prohibiting employment discrimination based solely on a person’s race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental and/or intellectual disability, age, military status, veteran status (including protected veterans), marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, familial status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any other protected status except where a reasonable, bona fide occupational qualification exists.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Description - External

Our Company

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology, to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Come makes an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

Position Summary

As a Sr Software Engineer at Optum Technology, you will design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and cloud-native microservices using Java and Spring Boot. In this role, you will partner with architects, product owners, business analysts, and QA teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams, drive code quality and security standards, support CI/CD pipelines, troubleshoot production incidents, and leverage automated tools and AI-assisted development practices to elevate engineering efficiency and application reliability.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and deploy scalable, secure microservices and RESTful APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and cloud-native architectures
  • Translate business requirements into robust technical designs, system architectures, and distributed solutions
  • Provide technical guidance, conduct code reviews, enforce development standards, and mentor junior and mid-level software engineers
  • Build and manage applications on cloud platforms (e.g., Azure or AWS) using containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments
  • Implement unit, integration, and automated testing frameworks while identifying and remediating security vulnerabilities
  • Monitor application health, troubleshoot production incidents, perform root cause analysis, and participate in on-call support to ensure high availability
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and tools to drive continuous improvement, performance tuning, and engineering automation
  • Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools to streamline workflows, automate tasks, evaluate technical trends, and drive engineering efficiency

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience building microservices and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot
  • 3+ years of experience working with distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and relational or non-relational databases
  • 3+ years of experience deploying and operating applications on cloud platforms (Azure or AWS) using container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • 3+ years of experience supporting CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and monitoring/observability tools
  • 3+ years of experience leading design reviews, conducting code reviews, and providing technical guidance to software development teams

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Experience utilizing AI-assisted development tools and automation to optimize software engineering efficiency
  • Experience in production incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance tuning for high-throughput healthcare applications

*All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $91,700 to $163,700 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location, and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups, and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

UnitedHealth Group is a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.

title: Template Adviseur Werving en Selectie
description:
DCMR is de milieudienst met de grootste uitdaging in Nederland: de milieukwaliteit bewaken en verbeteren in het meest bedrijvige en dichtbevolkte gebied dat we rijk zijn, het Rijnmondgebied en namens de provincie Zeeland ook voor de Zeeuwse BRZO-bedrijven. Wij zoeken vastberaden naar het ideale evenwicht tussen de ambities van de ruim 27.000 bedrijven die hier opereren en de 1,2 miljoen mensen die hier leefbaar en veilig willen wonen en werken. Dat is balanceren voor gevorderden. Daarom zoekt DCMR betrokken specialisten die hun kennis en vaardigheden willen inzetten voor een betere leefomgeving en die willen groeien tussen professionals.

Economische topregio én koploper in duurzaamheid. Bloeiende industrie én schone lucht voor alle ruim 1,3 miljoen inwoners. Een 24/7-economie én een ongestoorde nachtrust. Ruimte voor recreatie én zeldzame vogelsoorten. Een belangrijke haven én gezonde rivieren. Een succesvol heden én een duurzame toekomst. Werken bij DCMR betekent belangrijk werk waar je trots op kunt zijn.

Jouw expertise maakt impact! Als Adviseur Werving en Selectie ga jij je inzetten om bij te dragen aan een schone, gezonde en veilige leefomgeving. In deze baan komt voor jou alles samen!

Dit is jouw uitdaging

In het dynamische werkveld van HR neemt Werving & Selectie een cruciale positie in. Aan de ene kant ben je verantwoordelijk voor recruitment van collega’s die in het werkveld het verschil gaan maken. Aan de andere kant ben jij de business partner die de organisatie van advies gaat voorzien op jouw vakgebied En die adviezen kunnen we goed gebruiken als het gaat om:

  • Strategisch recruitment;
  • Arbeidsmarktcommunicatie;
  • Doelgroep- en competentiegericht werven;
  • Optimale candidate journey.


Samen met jouw collega adviseurs Tim, Joëlle en Daniëlle, ben je de sparringpartner voor onze managers. Voor jou is het vanzelfsprekend dat jij de lead neemt in het recruitmentproces tot en met de succesvolle aanname van de kandidaat.

Dit maakt deze job leuk

  • Jouw creativiteit als ambassadeur, netwerker en wervingsspecialist vinden we veel belangrijker dan dat je goed kunt sourcen;
  • Jij wordt verantwoordelijk voor het bedrijfsonderdeel Bedrijfsvoering met een grote variëteit aan vacatures;
  • Veel ruimte om zelfstandig projecten op te zetten, denk bijvoorbeeld aan de selectie van een nieuw ATS;
  • Meewerken aan de verdere professionalisering van onboarding bij DCMR;
  • Innovaties op recruitment-gebied waar jij een verbetering in ziet? Deze gaan we graag met je verkennen;
  • Samenwerking met de Zuid-Hollandse Omgevingsdiensten: samen maken we De Betere Wereldbaan;
  • Met je collega’s van communicatie geef je jobmarketing en het employer brand een nieuwe boost.

DCMR is met zijn bijna 700 collega’s groot genoeg om complex te zijn en voldoende uitdaging te kunnen bieden én tegelijkertijd klein genoeg zodat jij impact kunt maken. Samen met je team ben je in control voor Werving & Selectie!

Dit is wat jij daarvoor terug krijgt

Een uitgebreid pakket met:

  • een salaris van maximaal € 4.778,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur per week;
  • een keuze budget van 22,37% dat je elke maand bovenop je salaris ontvangt;
  • flexibiliteit in werktijden en waar je werkt;
  • CAO provincies met ruime vergoedingen voor thuiswerken, sport en vitaliteit;
  • 100% reiskostenvergoeding op basis van OV;
  • een persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van € 5.000,- per vijf jaar, waarvan je zelf de inzet bepaalt;
  • ons kantoor ligt direct naast station Schiedam Centrum en aan de A20 en is daarmee goed bereikbaar met alle vervoer;
  • een aanstelling voor een jaar die we daarna graag omzetten in een vast dienstverband, als het ons beiden bevalt natuurlijk;
  • een goed geregeld pensioen bij het ABP;
  • een iPhone of Samsung smartphone en laptop zodat jij je werk goed kunt uitvoeren.


Dit is wie jij bent

Allereerst: een prettige en stevige gesprekspartner. Het maakt jou niet uit met wie je aan tafel zit, jij weet waarover je praat en hoe je de juiste informatie bij een ander naar boven kunt halen. De rol van adviseur Werving en selectie kent veel stakeholders met verschillende belangen. Dat is voor jou geen probleem, aangezien je dit al in een eerdere functie uitstekend wist te managen. Je bent een expert op jouw vakgebied, werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je een projectmatige aanpak kunt inzetten. En natuurlijk niet te vergeten: een leuke collega!

Om in deze rol volledig tot je recht te komen, heb je verder:

  • hbo werk- en denkniveau;
  • serieuze werkervaring als adviseur werving en selectie of als recruiter.


Dit is het team

Het HR team bestaat uit 13 collega’s met een mix van verschillende expertises, leeftijden, achtergronden en persoonlijkheden. Het team wordt aangestuurd door de manager HR.

We werken hybride en schakelen online gemakkelijk om met elkaar inhoudelijk te sparren. We vinden het ook prettig om elkaar op kantoor te zien, halen we een koffietje en kletsen informeel of doen we een lunchwandeling.

Er wordt hard gewerkt, maar ook veel gelachen!

We zijn met het HR team mooie stappen aan het maken om onze dienstverlening aan de organisatie beter vorm te geven en te optimaliseren. Met jouw visie op en kennis van zaken ga jij een waardevolle bijdrage leveren.

Enthousiast geworden bij het lezen van deze vacature?

Wij kijken uit naar jouw sollicitatie! Laat je cv bij ons achter vóór 29 februari 2024 via de sollicitatiebutton!

Meer weten over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Gerardo Garcia Romay , teammanager HR a.i. ,gerardo.garciaromay@dcmr.nl of Claudia Alberts, Adviseur Werving en Selectie via 06-29699739 of recruitment@dcmr.nl.

title: Aircraft Maintenance Scheduler
description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

Stratolaunch is seeking an Aircraft Maintenance Scheduler to develop integrated operational plans one to six months ahead for our carrier aircraft, hypersonic programs, and other programs requiring operational execution. The scheduler aligns personnel, maintenance, operations, testing, parts, and engineering readiness. At 30 days before execution, the scheduler hands a coordinated planning package to Maintenance Control for final planning, adjustments, and execution, while continuing to support changes and maintain the longer-range schedule.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain a rolling one-to-six-month schedule integrating aircraft maintenance, modifications, ground operations, testing, flight activities, and program milestones.
  • Translate operational priorities into sequenced work with durations, dependencies, resource needs, and readiness dates; identify critical-path activities and schedule conflicts.
  • Coordinate personnel assignments and capacity with team leaders, accounting for qualifications, shifts, leave, training, inspection coverage, and competing program demands.
  • Forecast calendar-, flight-hour-, and cycle-driven maintenance against expected utilization; coordinate required work within applicable limits and available ground time.
  • Coordinate parts procurement with Supply Chain; track requisitions, lead times, repairs, delivery commitments, receiving inspections, and material kitting against need dates.
  • Track engineering definition, drawing and procedure releases, configuration requirements, and open technical dispositions; establish owners and dates for missing inputs.
  • Align tooling, GSE, facilities, vendor support, and test resources with Aircraft Maintenance, Flight Operations, Flight Test, Engineering, Quality, and program teams.
  • Lead planning reviews, resolve resource conflicts, evaluate schedule alternatives, and escalate readiness risks with owners, recovery actions, and required decisions.
  • At the 30-day mark, deliver a reviewed package containing work scope, schedule, staffing, technical-data status, parts, tools, facilities, test needs, and open risks.
  • Document Maintenance Control acceptance, outstanding actions, owners, and due dates; support its final planning, adjustments, and execution inside the 30-day window.
  • Maintain schedule versions and change records; incorporate execution feedback and actual labor into future plans, track readiness and handoff performance, and perform other assigned duties.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

REQUIRED

  • 3+ years of aircraft maintenance planning, scheduling, production control, or comparable aviation operations experience, including preparation of coordinated work packages.
  • Ability to build and maintain multi-month, resource-loaded schedules with logical dependencies, milestones, critical paths, and realistic labor and duration estimates.
  • Working knowledge of aircraft maintenance processes, inspection intervals, utilization forecasting, maintenance records, and applicable airworthiness requirements.
  • Ability to interpret maintenance manuals, task cards, engineering orders, drawings, and configuration records, and distinguish released data from pending definition.
  • Experience matching work to personnel qualifications and availability, including maintenance, inspection, engineering, and test support; ability to identify capacity shortfalls.
  • Understanding of procurement lead times, repair turnaround, material availability, parts traceability, and kitting; ability to track shortages through resolution.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, scheduling software such as Microsoft Project or equivalent, and maintenance or enterprise work-management systems.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills; ability to lead cross-functional planning reviews and communicate risks and tradeoffs.
  • Experience managing changing priorities, maintaining accurate schedule and action records, and preparing clear handoffs with accountable owners and completion dates.
  • Knowledge of flight-line safety, FOD and tool control, and the effect of safety, quality, and technical approvals on work sequencing and operational readiness.

PREFERRED

  • FAA Mechanic Certificate with Airframe and Powerplant ratings; hands-on aircraft maintenance or military aviation planning and scheduling experience.
  • Experience with large or transport-category aircraft, flight-test or experimental operations, hypersonic programs, or complex aerospace integration and testing.
  • Experience with maintenance forecasting, ERP/MRO systems, Jira, schedule risk analysis, and continuous improvement of planning and execution processes.

EDUCATION

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; degree or technical training in aviation maintenance, operations, engineering, or a related discipline preferred.

Special remarks regarding work environment, if applicable

  • This position is located in Mojave, CA. Primarily office-based work with regular coordination in hangar, shop, and flight-line environments.
  • Must use a computer for extended periods and access operational work areas, with or without reasonable accommodation. Follow site safety requirements and use required PPE around noise, weather, and moving equipment.
  • Ability and willingness to support flexible or off-shift hours and weekends when operational needs dictate; occasional mission travel may be required.
  • 4/10 Schedule
  • 2-5 years relevant experience: $71,000-$86,000
  • 5+ years relevant experience: $82,000-$101,000
  • Eligible for up to 10% annual bonus

Base salary and leveling are established on a case-by-case basis. We consider several factors to ensure a competitive offer, including your location, educational background, and a comprehensive assessment of the skills and experience demonstrated during your interviews.

Benefits and our location(s):

  • Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave
  • 50% company match per contributed dollar into 401(k) savings plan, up to $11,500
  • Tuition reimbursement

This position may involve the operation of company vehicles as part of assigned duties.

Mojave Air & Spaceport is located just outside of Lancaster/Palmdale and is only 95 miles north of Los Angeles. The area offers both affordability and central access to a variety of California's best attractions and landmarks.

Not much for the outdoors and prefer the city life? title: Project Manager - eCOA - Operations
description:
About Signant Health
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

About the Role
The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, execution and completion of projects considering budget, timelines, resources and task management. The Project Manager will communicate in a transparent and timely manner with the assigned Signant Health clients and internal stakeholders. He/she will manage project risks and ensure timely resolution while reporting out on project status with the appropriate internal and external stakeholders.

The Project Manager contributes to the implementation of company-wide process improvements to ensure effective and efficient project delivery.

This role requires an effective leader that excels in problem-solving, able to motivate a result-oriented team, and can build trust-based relationships with Signant Health’s clients.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function

Manage and lead the initial project delivery tasks, including, but not limited to the software development lifecycle (SDLC) of Simple to Medium complexity studies.
Ensure project systems are built and released in accordance with client expectations inclusive of leading the project system change control process.
Support the implementation of complex, multi product projects as needed.
Manage projects in accordance with established timelines, budget, quality standards, and/or contractual requirements.
Review, approve and maintain project and corporate systems and documentation.
Handle client escalations independently and work with internal and client teams to resolve. Escalate as appropriate in a timely manner.
Responsible for quality of communication with client - cadence, content and audience. Serves as the primary contact for customers on assigned projects.
Accountable for financial health of the assigned projects. This can include vendor services, licensing, payments, invoicing, devices, resource assignments and vendor management activities.
Collaborate with other functional areas for project delivery to ensure timelines and client expectations are met within budget.
Responsible for identification and documentation of Incident Reports with Quality Management group. (Inclusive of Client Notification and Closure)
Responsible for reporting of project status updates.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Role

As a Project Manager, the employee is expected to recognize the importance of and to create a culture of process improvement with a focus on streamlining our processes adding value to our business and meeting client needs.
As a member of staff, the employee is expected to embrace and contribute to our culture of process improvement with a focus on streamlining our processes adding value to our business and meeting client needs.
Responsible for compliance with Company Procedures in support of client deliverables.
Recognize, exemplify and adherence to the company values which centre around our commitment to People, Clients, and performance.

DECISION MAKING AND INFLUENCE

Demonstrated ability to lead through influence.
Capable of weighing risks and making decisions that align with Signant values and strategy.
Manage customer escalations effectively, with follow up and closure.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES
Essential:

Bachelors’ degree or equivalent or relevant experience
Understanding of the software development life cycle and the specification and configuration of software products
Able to multi-task and work with multiple team members
Must have excellent time management, communication (oral and written), and organizational skills
Must be detail, and first-time quality delivery, orientated
Must have solid MS Office Suite experience – Word, Excel, MS Project, PowerPoint
Ability and experience of direct project activities and ensuring customer satisfaction while understanding and adhering to the study budget
Must be comfortable speaking in front of diversified and/or large audiences
Must be able to communicate and engage effectively with all levels of the organization and have excellent written and spoken English skills
Must have experience in a Project Management role OR equivalent
Must show initiative and be able to work independently as needed

Desirable:

Background in Pharmaceutical, Medical education and/or CRO
Experience of clinical trials/pharmaceutical industry/life sciences
Ability to travel for business trips (overnight business trips could be expected quarterly)
Experience/understanding of the clinical research environment and GCP principles is preferred
PMP or equivalent certificate.

title: Healthcare Advocate - Field-Based Position
description:
Optum Insight is improving the flow of health data and information to create a more connected system. We remove friction and drive alignment between care providers and payers, and ultimately consumers. Our deep expertise in the industry and innovative technology empower us to help organizations reduce costs while improving risk management, quality and revenue growth. Ready to help us deliver results that improve lives? Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Healthcare Advocate serves as a strategic partner to physicians, medical groups, IPAs, and hospitals, supporting accurate documentation and coding practices to ensure a complete and accurate health picture of members across government and regulated lines of business, including Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and ACA. This role focuses on improving quality of care, closing gaps in care, and driving performance in Risk Adjustment and Quality programs through education, collaboration, and data-driven strategies.

This is a field-based position covering travel territory based in Honolulu, HI.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Act as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to providers and medical groups, assisting in accurate documentation and coding to reflect members' true health status
  • Travel independently across the assigned territory (approximately 80% field-based, with occasional overnight travel) to engage providers in Optum tools and programs that enhance quality of care for Medicare Advantage members
  • Responsible for gaining participation and deployment of Prospective Programs achieving business goals and metrics
  • Utilize data analysis to identify and target providers who would benefit from coding, documentation, and quality training resources
  • Establish positive, long-term, consultative relationships with physicians, medical groups, IPAs and Hospitals
  • Develop and implement comprehensive, provider-specific plans to improve RAF performance, coding specificity, and gap closure
  • Manage end-to-end Risk Adjustment and Quality programs, including In-Office Assessment initiatives
  • Consult with provider groups on documentation and coding gaps; provide actionable feedback to improve compliance with CMS standards
  • Offer guidance on EMR/EHR system issues impacting documentation and coding accuracy.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to implement prospective programs as directed by leadership
  • Educate providers on Medicare quality programs and CMS-HCC Risk Adjustment methodology, emphasizing the importance of accurate chart documentation for proper reimbursement
  • Support providers in ensuring documentation aligns with ICD-10 and CPT II coding guidelines and national standards
  • Deliver ICD-10 HCC coding training and develop tools for providers and office staff
  • Provide measurable, actionable solutions to improve documentation and coding accuracy
  • Partner with physicians, coders, and facility staff on Risk Adjustment and Quality education efforts
  • Assist in chart collection and analysis as needed
  • Demonstrated communication skills with ability to engage multiple stakeholders and collaborate across teams
  • Self-driven, goal-oriented, and able to work independently while prioritizing tasks and meeting deadlines

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of healthcare experience with solid knowledge of medical terminology and clinical issues
  • 2+ years of experience with EMR systems
  • Experience in a physician office, clinic, hospital, or similar medical setting
  • Demonstrated knowledge of ICD-10, HEDIS, and Stars programs
  • Demonstrated proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) with ability to manipulate data, create documents, and deliver presentations
  • Demonstrated ability to identify automation opportunities and leverage AI to improve productivity and quality
  • Reside in the Honalulu, HI area to perform daily field travel requirements
  • Able/willing to travel approximately 80% of the time, this is a field-based position that required daily local state travel
  • Proof of a valid Driver's License, reliable transportation, and current auto insurance to perform daily local state travel

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC/CPC-A) or equivalent certification
  • CRC certification
  • 2+ years of clinic/hospital or managed care experience
  • Experience in nursing (LPN, RN, NP)
  • Demonstrated advanced proficiency in MS Excel (pivot tables, advanced functions)
  • Experience in Risk Adjustment, HEDIS/Stars, and gap closure initiatives
  • Demonstrated knowledge of billing claims submission, and coding software
  • Project management experience
  • Experience in provider network management, physician contracting, healthcare consulting, or Medicare Advantage sales
  • Territory management experience

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $72,800 - $130,000 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

title: Head of Data & Analytics (vikariat)
description:
Välkommen till vår värld! 👑 Vår vision är en värld som mår bra, och du kan hjälpa oss att göra den visionen verklig. Vi tror att meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter, starka teamrelationer och en generös dos skratt skapar en arbetsmiljö som inspirerar och stärker oss och alla våra kunder. Med fokus på både här och nu, samt på framtiden - bidrar vi tillsammans till en värld som mår bra! 🌍🧡🚀

Nu söker vi en Head of Data & Analytics som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för att utveckla och stärka Kronans Apoteks data- och analysförmåga. Detta är ett vikariat med start i november/december som pågår fram till oktober 2027.

I rollen leder du ett kompetent team bestående av fem specialister inom Business Intelligence och Master Data. Du ansvarar för att säkerställa hög datakvalitet, effektiv informationshantering och ett tydligt informationsägarskap, samtidigt som du driver utvecklingen av moderna och skalbara lösningar inom BI, Analytics och AI.

Som Head of Data & Analytics har du en nyckelroll i verksamheten och samarbetar nära både affärsfunktioner, IT och externa partners för att skapa förutsättningar för datadrivet beslutsfattande och långsiktigt affärsvärde.

Exempel på dina arbetsuppgifter:

  • Ta fram och utveckla strategi, målbild och roadmap för Data & Analytics i linje med företagets affärsstrategi.
  • Etablera och vidareutveckla Data Governance samt säkerställa effektiv hantering av masterdata, metadata och andra affärskritiska informationsobjekt.
  • Leda utvecklingen inom Business Intelligence, Analytics och AI samt säkerställa att lösningarna möter verksamhetens behov.
  • Prioritera, följa upp och säkerställa affärsnyttan av initiativ och investeringar inom Data & Analytics.
  • Driva organisationens datadrivna arbetssätt genom förändringsledning, kommunikation och kompetensutveckling.
  • Säkerställa att data och analyser är tillgängliga, tillförlitliga och används som stöd för verksamhetens beslut.
  • Bygga starka samarbeten med verksamheten, IT, arkitektur, informationssäkerhet och externa partners.
  • Leda, coacha och utveckla teamet samt ansvara för budget, resursplanering och leverantörsstyrning

Du rapporterar till vår CFO, George Raheb, och välkomnas till vårt fina kontor i Stadshagen, Kungsholmen där vi sitter minst tre dagar i veckan.

Detta är ett vikariat vilket ställer krav på att du snabbt kan sätta dig in i verksamheten, skapa förtroende hos dina intressenter och ta ansvar för pågående initiativ från dag ett. Vi söker därför en erfaren ledare med gedigen kompetens inom Data & Analytics som är van att navigera i komplexa organisationer och omsätta strategi till resultat.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

  • Flerårig erfarenhet av ledande roller inom Data & Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Governance, Master Data Management eller närliggande områden.
  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av personalansvar och att leda och utveckla team.
  • Erfarenhet av att etablera eller utveckla styrning, processer och arbetssätt för data, information och analys.
  • Erfarenhet av att driva strategiska och tvärfunktionella initiativ i större organisationer.
  • Erfarenhet av förändringsledning, budgetansvar och leverantörsstyrning.
  • God förståelse för informationshantering, dataplattformar, Business Intelligence, Analytics och AI.
  • Flytande i både svenska och engelska är ett krav.

Din ansökan
I din ansökan vill vi ha ditt CV eller din LinkedInprofil. Personligt brev? Det kan du skippa! Vi är intresserade av din kompetens, lära känna dig gör vi vid en eventuell intervju. I slutet av rekryteringsprocessen tillämpar vi en bakgrundskontroll på samtliga personer vi vill anställa, oavsett roll eller funktion. Då vi enbart tillämpar detta på slutkandidat informerar vi mer om det längre fram.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi bryr oss mer - och det är även något vi delar med våra fackliga parter och tillsammans arbetar vi för en värld som mår bra. För att komma i kontakt med våra fackliga representanter kan du maila Stephanie Nielsen på Unionen via stephanie.nielsen@kronansapotek.se eller Aisha Karimi på Sveriges Farmaceuter via af.kronan@sverigesfarmaceuter.se. Vill du fördjupa dig i vårt kollektivavtal? Du hittar hela avtalet här!

title: Senior Cyber Security Specialist II - Threat Detection and Response
description:
Job Summary

This role supports Walgreens’ Threat Detection and Response function, with a focus on leading complex security investigations, advancing enterprise detection capabilities, and improving incident response effectiveness across hybrid environments.

As a senior-level individual contributor, you will serve as a technical escalation point for high-impact and complex security incidents, owning investigations end to end from triage through root cause analysis, containment, remediation, and post-incident improvement. This role requires deep hands-on expertise, strong judgment, and the ability to operate independently in ambiguous and time-sensitive situations.

You will help shape detection strategy by building and tuning detection logic, proactively hunting for threats, and using automation to improve response speed, consistency, and scalability. This work spans hybrid infrastructure, cloud environments, applications, identity systems, endpoints, and enterprise platforms, using log analysis, behavioral signals, threat intelligence, and attacker TTPs to identify and mitigate risk.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing, implementing, and tuning detection logic across enterprise and cloud environments

  • Leading complex incident response efforts and driving investigations through resolution

  • Conducting proactive threat hunting and converting findings into actionable detections

  • Developing automation to improve detection, enrichment, triage, and response workflows

  • Partnering with security, engineering, infrastructure, and business teams to improve logging, telemetry, and observability

  • Identifying gaps in detection coverage, tooling, processes, and response procedures, and driving improvements

  • Providing technical guidance, mentoring team members, and contributing to overall team capability through knowledge sharing, documentation, and tabletop exercises

  • Communicating technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership when needed

Success in this role requires the ability to take ownership, make sound decisions under pressure, and independently drive outcomes across complex security scenarios. The ideal candidate is hands-on, technically strong, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and able to influence improvements that strengthen Walgreens’ overall security posture.

Location Requirement:
This is a hybrid role based in Deerfield, IL, with 4 days onsite and 1 day remote.

Work Authorization:
Work visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Job Responsibilities

  • Leads threat detection by identifying threats at the first phase of an attack or compromise. Detects threat actor activity including exploitation and risk to critical systems.

  • Monitors specific cyber threat actors to understand their tactics and techniques.

  • Utilizes data analysis, threat intelligence and cutting-edge security technologies to find unusual behavior and malicious activity.

  • Leads the hunt for hidden and unidentified threats to the organization’s cyber environment.

  • Tracks down the malicious agents who are already in a network and removes them from the environment once discovered.

  • Works with security monitoring tools such as firewalls, data loss prevention, network intrusion detection and antivirus software.

  • Uses a hypothesis-driven approach and behavioral analysis to uncover connections and correlations between potential cyber threats.

  • Reviews audit logs to identify unusual behavior in the network and endpoint devices. Documents findings and incident investigations. Provides feedback and training to improve security controls.

  • Leads in assessing network vulnerabilities and identifying critical security flaws by testing and validating the security of the network and/or testing the network to understand where vulnerabilities exist and where corrections are needed

About Walgreens
Founded in 1901, Walgreens (www.walgreens.com) has a storied heritage of caring for communities for generations and proudly serves nearly 9 million customers and patients each day across its approximately 8,500 stores throughout the U.S. and Puerto Rico, and leading omni-channel platforms. Walgreens has approximately 220,000 team members, including nearly 90,000 healthcare service providers, and is committed to being the first choice for retail pharmacy and health services, building trusted relationships that create healthier futures for customers, patients, team members and communities.



Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree and at least 5 years of Information/Cyber Security experience OR a High School Diploma/GED and at least 7 years of Information/Cyber Security experience
  • Experience presenting to and interacting with the Executive level.
  • At least 4 years of Cyber Security experience in at least three of the following: Active threat hunting (open source or commercial tooling), Intrusion analysis, Managed or enterprise information security services, Incident response, Endpoint forensics (Windows, MAC, or Linux), Malware analysis, Penetration testing, Network defense, Threat hunting, Information security consulting
  • Experience establishing & maintaining relationships with individuals at all levels of the organization, in the business community & with vendors.
  • Experience analyzing and reporting data in order to identify issues, trends, or exceptions to drive improvement of results and find solutions.
  • At least 2 years of experience contributing to financial decisions in the workplace.

title: Maintenance Controller
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Air Mobility Group (AIRMOB) is responsible for developing and delivering Metrea’s aerial refueling (AAR) capabilities, ensuring the readiness and operational effectiveness of the tanker fleet. AIRMOB oversees fleet management, maintenance, and airworthiness, working to sustain and enhance refueling operations. It manages the integration of new processes and technologies, ensuring that tanker aircraft remain mission-ready through effective logistics, maintenance oversight, and regulatory compliance. By coordinating across various teams, AIRMOB ensures the fleet meets both current and future operational needs, supporting a range of specialized air mobility missions.

Position Summary

The Maintenance Controller is responsible for coordinating and planning maintenance activities on their assigned shift for MSM's KC-135 fleet. This role ensures efficient execution of maintenance operations, provides technical support to maintenance activities, and maintains effective communication between Maintenance, Operations, and Logistics Departments. The position requires technical expertise in aviation maintenance and the ability to ensure compliance with FAA regulations and company policies while reporting directly to the Maintenance Control Manager.

What You'll Do

  • Coordinate and plan maintenance activities and provide technical support on assigned shift
  • Coordinate maintenance activities conducted by Contract Agencies, where applicable
  • Ensure contracted maintenance personnel are properly briefed and understand the nature of problems to be worked, as well as company policies and procedures for maintenance activities
  • Ensure all work is performed in accordance with current FARs, company manuals, and other Technical Data acceptable to the Administrator
  • Provide technical assistance to all maintenance activities and personnel
  • Monitor all DMIs (Deferred Maintenance Items) to ensure time limits are not exceeded
  • Monitor, update, and verify aircraft status; report aircraft status changes as they occur to Operations and Maintenance
  • Execute planning and scheduling of airframe and line engine maintenance/inspections, airworthiness directives, service bulletins, corrosion program requirements, scheduled modifications, and mandatory replacement items as directed
  • Assemble Aircraft Maintenance/Inspection Packages, including compliance with applicable AD Notes, Mandatory Modifications, Corrosion Program requirements, and Deferred Maintenance Items
  • Actively participate in company Safety Programs and Safety Management System; report all safety concerns in a timely manner and ensure safe work practices
  • Follow Occupational Safety and Health standards applicable to work location
  • In the absence of the Maintenance Control Manager, Reports to the Sr. Maintenance Controller
  • Perform other duties as assigned

What You Bring

  • Requires an appropriate airman certificate with A&P (Airframe and Powerplant) ratings and minimum 3 years of aircraft maintenance experience. Other experience may be considered in lieu of Both licenses. Must possess thorough knowledge of FAA regulations (14 CFR 43, 14 CFR 91), aircraft maintenance documentation, and maintenance planning systems. Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills are essential for coordinating complex maintenance activities and ensuring regulatory compliance
  • Previous maintenance control or planning experience preferred. Experience with KC-135 or similar military aircraft preferred
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective coordination with maintenance teams, leadership, and external agencies, and ability to establish effective working relationships with all levels of management and technicians
  • Ability to read and interpret system wiring diagrams, structural repair manuals, and aircraft maintenance documentation, strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with ability to resolve complex maintenance issues, analytical skills to define problems, gather data, establish facts, and recommend corrective actions, and ability to review and interpret maintenance records and develop comprehensive maintenance plans
  • Proactive planning skills for maintenance scheduling with excellent time management skills and forward-thinking perspective
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word and Excel) and enterprise maintenance software systems
  • Valid Driver's License and ability to obtain and maintain necessary security clearances, if required. Must be a US citizen

Benefits

  • Medical insurance options
  • Dental and vision insurance
  • Retirement plan eligibility
  • Parental leave

Work Authorization / Security Clearance

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

AAP/EEO Statement

This Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Hours and work shifts may change in accordance with department and business needs. Exempt Employees must have the ability to be on-call and available, as business needs require. Non-Exempt employees may be required to work over 40 hours per week with approval from the department manager.

Work Environment

This position operates primarily in an office environment with occasional visits to aircraft maintenance areas for documentation verification. Work involves extensive computer use for data entry and records processing. May require lifting and moving boxes of records (up to 30 lbs). The role requires sustained concentration for detailed documentation review and the ability to work in a deadline-driven environment. Occasional overtime may be required during aircraft inspections or audit preparations.

Travel

As required

Base Pay Range

This is just one component of Metrea's overall approach to total rewards and final compensation decisions, including the ultimate salary or hourly rate agreed upon, may vary depending on factors such as job location, job-specific knowledge, skills, experience, and the overall negotiated compensation package. Eligible full-time employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package designed to support their health, wellbeing, and long-term success.

$40—$50 USD

Our Firmware

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. title: Diet Technician, Rogers Hixon Ontario Human Milk Bank
description:
This is more than a hospital-based nutrition role—it’s a rare opportunity to be part of Ontario’s only accredited human milk bank, one of just three in Canada recognized by the Human Milk Banking Association of North America. As a Diet Technician, Rogers Hixon Ontario Human Milk Bank (RHOHMB), you’ll play a vital role in in supporting the distribution of pasteurized donor human milk for hospitalized infants not just in Toronto, but across Ontario, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland, and PEI. Operating within a specialized food manufacturing facility inside the hospital, you’ll apply rigorous food safety and quality assurance standards to support the production of life-saving nutrition to medically fragile newborns. If you’re looking for a one-of-a-kind opportunity to combine science, precision, and purpose in a hospital setting, this role offers an impact you won’t find anywhere else.

Is this you?
You are highly detail-oriented and thrive in situations where precision and organization matter. In this role, you’ll work with numbers, labels, and specialized equipment, ensuring donor milk is accurately logged, processed, and distributed according to strict safety protocols. Using aseptic techniques, you will carefully handle donor human milk, maintaining the highest standards of hygiene and quality control. Your ability to accurately weigh, pool, and bottle milk for pasteurization will play a direct role in ensuring medically fragile infants receive safe, life-sustaining nutrition.

Are you a problem solver who thrives under pressure while meeting deadlines? As a Diet Technician in the Milk Bank, you’ll work collaboratively with your team, but you’ll also need to complete tasks independently, using your critical thinking skills to troubleshoot any technical issues that arise. Whether addressing equipment malfunctions or adapting to unexpected challenges, your proactive approach and clear communication will help maintain smooth operations and ensure that donor milk is processed efficiently.

If you are eager to develop your technical skills in a cutting-edge environment, this role offers the opportunity to work with specialized equipment for pooling and bottling donor human milk. You will gain hands-on experience with specialized dispensing equipment, hermetically sealing bottles, and high-capacity pasteurization equipment while monitoring temperature with logging devices, enhancing your technical skill set in the field of human milk banking.

About the Rogers Hixon Ontario Human Milk Bank
Located at our Mount Sinai Hospital campus, the Rogers Hixon Ontario Human Milk Bank is the sole human milk bank in Ontario. We collect, process, and distribute pasteurized donor milk to medically fragile hospitalized infants across the province.

With about 1,500 low birth weight babies born in Ontario annually, our mission is crucial. Around 70% of preterm babies in the province lack sufficient volume of their parent’s milk, which is essential for vital nutrients and immune protection. Donor milk significantly improves health outcomes for preterm infants, reducing serious complications.

The Milk Bank is regularly involved in research projects. Our team's contributions frequently lead to authorship in presentations and publications.

In this role you will:

Liaise with the nurse lactation consultants and the production supervisor
Answer the Milk Bank phone, retrieve voicemail messages and redirect/liaise with the appropriate personnel
Document daily temperatures for all fridges, freezers, and dishwasher
Disinfect and sanitize work surfaces and equipment according to established SOPs
Efficiently manage shipments of donor human milk, including unpacking, sorting, and weighing. Prepare labels and document inventory in the Milk Bank software to ensure traceability
Prepare the pasteurization room for milk pooling
Accurately weigh, pool, and bottle milk for pasteurization
Take samples of milk pre- and post- pasteurization
Generate labels to identify each batch for pasteurization, as well as samples taken for further microbiological analysis
Maintain daily inventory and ensure all supplies are adequately restocked
Manage outgoing shipments by courier (e.g., shipping kits to donors, pasteurized donor human milk to recipient hospitals)
Perform other duties consistent with the job classification as required

Job Requirements:
Mandatory

Food and Nutrition Degree/Diploma from a recognized university or community college Food Safety Training Certificate

Preferred

2 years of experience in a Diet Technician role
Recent Diet Technician experience in a health care environment

Canadian Society of Nutrition Management membership an asset

Skills and Knowledge

Knowledge of safe food handling procedures
Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to liaise with all health professionals and patient- families
Excellent oral and written communication skills, excellent problem solving skills
Proven leadership skills
Computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office ( Excel and Word)
Demonstrated satisfactory work performance and attendance history

Note: This role requires the ability to stand for long periods of time, including repetitive actions, bending, pushing, and lifting up to 20 lbs.

If this sounds like you and you feel ready to build your career within nutrition and dietetics, apply now and let us know why you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: Sr Staff Analog IC Design Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Ambiq is on a mission to enable intelligence everywhere — powering the AI edge revolution with the world's lowest-power semiconductor solutions.

Built on our proprietary sub- and near-threshold technology, our chips deliver multi-fold improvements in energy efficiency without costly process scaling. Since 2010, we've shipped over 300 million units to customers building smarter wearables, medical devices, IoT products, and AI-powered edge applications.

Our cross-functional teams span design, research, development, production, marketing, sales, and operations across Austin, Hsinchu, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Singapore. We move fast, tackle hard problems, and create space for people to grow through complex, meaningful work that shapes the future of technology.

We're looking for self-motivated, creative problem-solvers who are eager to push technological limits and make a real impact in energy efficiency.

At Ambiq, we live by five values: Innovate. Collaborate. Focus. Learn. Achieve.

If that's you, join us — the intelligence everywhere revolution starts here.

Ambiq develops ultra-low-power semiconductor solutions that enable intelligent, battery-powered devices. We are seeking a Senior Staff Analog IC Design Engineer to lead the definition and development of critical analog and mixed-signal subsystems across our product portfolio.
This is a hands-on senior technical role with influence extending beyond a single circuit or project. You will help establish subsystem specifications and architectures, design the highest-risk circuits, guide implementation and validation, and serve as a technical resource to experienced engineers across the organization.
The position is onsite five days per week in NW Austin, Texas.

Role Impact

Your work will directly affect power consumption, performance, reliability, manufacturability, and customer success. You will help Ambiq translate product requirements into production-ready analog subsystems in advanced process technologies, including 22nm, 12nm, and future nodes.

Responsibilities

  • Lead block- and chip-level specification development for related analog subsystems.
  • Define circuit architectures for power management, clocking, data-conversion, or comparable mixed-signal functions.
  • Perform transistor-level design and verification for complex, high-risk analog blocks.
  • Conduct or technically supervise layout, extraction, and post-layout closure.
  • Lead design reviews and resolve cross-block technical issues.
  • Define robust analog/digital interfaces in partnership with architecture, RTL, and verification teams.
  • Guide Staff and Senior engineers through technical reviews and day-to-day design decisions.
  • Develop prototype-silicon validation and characterization strategies.
  • Define manufacturing test requirements and support efficient test-program development.
  • Work with product, test, applications, and marketing teams on product definition, production issues, and complex customer problems.
  • Drive designs from initial requirements through production release.

Qualifications

  • BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex analog subsystems from specification through production.
  • At least 8 years of experience in analog or mixed-signal IC design with multiple completed silicon design cycles.
  • Deep transistor-level design and verification expertise in at least one relevant area, such as power management, clocking, or data converters.
  • Strong understanding of analog layout, parasitics, matching, noise, variation, reliability, and advanced-node design constraints.
  • Experience with post-silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and manufacturing test.
  • Ability to lead architecture and design decisions across teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Effective collaboration with digital, physical-design, product, test, applications, and systems teams.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and improving the quality of design reviews.
  • Current authorization to work in the United States for any employer.
  • Must be willing to come into an office in NW Austin 5 days a week.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ultra-low-power, battery-constrained, or subthreshold circuit-design experience.
  • Design experience at 22nm or below.
  • Breadth across PMU, clocking, and data-converter subsystems.
  • Experience supporting multiple products or concurrent tapeouts.
  • Familiarity with MCU, wearable, medical, edge-AI, wireless, or sensor-oriented SoCs.

Why Ambiq

Ambiq offers the opportunity to solve unusually difficult power-efficiency problems while remaining close to the circuits. This role provides meaningful architectural influence, ownership throughout the complete silicon lifecycle, and the ability to shape both products and the analog team's technical growth.

title: Adviseur Internationale Voertuigregelgeving
description:
Jij zet Nederland op de kaart in Brussel en Genève! Als senior adviseur internationale voertuigregelgeving bij de RDW in Zoetermeer vertegenwoordig je ons land in internationale overleggen over voertuigregelgeving en mobiliteitsbeleid.

Jouw missie? Veiliger en duurzamere voertuigen, en (internationale) regelgeving die werkt voor Nederland en de RDW.

Wil je weten wat interessant is aan deze baan? Lees het verhaal van Anna en Niels:

“Wij zitten namens de RDW aan tafel met Europese beleidsmakers” | RDW

Lees de verhalen van andere RDW’ers >

Werken aan de mobiliteit van morgen

Werken aan de mobiliteit van morgen

Als senior adviseur Internationale Voertuigregelgeving werk aan de regels waar voertuigen in Europa aan moeten voldoen, zodat deze veiliger en duurzamer worden. Je gebruikt daarvoor jouw technische kennis en affiniteit. Je doorziet de besluitvormingsprocessen die doorlopen moeten worden. Je vindt het leuk om een (internationaal) netwerk te bouwen en in te zetten ter bevordering van ons werk.

Samen met collega‑adviseurs van de afdeling Internationale Betrekkingen vertegenwoordig je Nederland en de RDW in EU‑ en UNECE‑overleggen, waar over de internationale voertuigreglementen wordt onderhandeld.

Je stemt prioriteiten af met het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en houdt opdrachtgevers op de hoogte van voortgang en uitkomsten. Je signaleert knelpunten, adviseert over de achtergrond van regelgeving en doet voorstellen voor verbeteringen die veiligheid, duurzaamheid en uitvoerbaarheid versterken.

Voor de inhoud van je werk moet je denken aan technische onderwerpen met betrekking tot emissies, actieve en passieve veiligheidssystemen, elektromagnetische comptabiliteit en geautomatiseerde rijhulpsystemen, etc... Bij je werk doorzie je de belangen op verschillende niveaus: het maatschappelijk belang van veiligheid en duurzaamheid, het uitvoeringsbelang van de RDW als typegoedkeuring- en registratieautoriteit, maar ook het politiek/bestuurlijke belang.

Dit is jouw thuisbasis

Welkom bij de afdeling Internationale Betrekkingen! Wij zijn een stafafdeling van circa 20 collega’s die Nederland internationaal vertegenwoordigen en de RDW breed ondersteunen bij het realiseren van haar internationale doelen. Binnen onze afdeling werk je nauw samen met collega’s om onze inbreng te versterken en inhoudelijke thema’s met elkaar te verbinden. Vanuit het cluster Ontwikkeling Voertuigreglementering (OVR) werken we met name aan voertuigregelgeving. Zo vertegenwoordigt elke collega Nederland in EU- en UNECE-overleggen vanuit een eigen portefeuille. De internationale overleggen vinden vaak in Brussel en Genève plaats, maar kunnen ook wereldwijd gepland worden. Jouw portefeuille bepalen we in onderling overleg

Zo helpen wij jou graag op weg

Bij de RDW werk je met ruim 2.000 collega’s aan veilige en duurzame mobiliteit in Nederland en daarbuiten. Hier sta je vooraan bij slimme oplossingen en technologische innovaties in de automotive.
