title: Licensed Professional Counselor
description:
Licensed Professional Counselor

Deer Oaks Behavioral Health — Long-Term Care Clinical Services

Join a mission-driven behavioral health organization that has been a trusted partner to Long-Term Care (LTC) communities for over 30 years. Deer Oaks is a nationally recognized leader in geriatric behavioral health, partnering with thousands of facilities across the country to deliver compassionate, evidence-based care to older adults and individuals with chronic medical conditions.

We are seeking a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) to join our integrated clinical team. In this role, you will work onsite in one or more long-term care facilities within your local community, providing therapy, assessment, care planning, and behavioral health support. This position offers professional autonomy, a predictable Monday–Friday schedule, and robust administrative and clinical support so you can focus on what matters most—helping patients thrive.

What You’ll Do

As a key member of the interdisciplinary team, you will:

Clinical Care

  • Provide individual, family, and group therapy to LTC residents.
  • Conduct clinical assessments, psychosocial evaluations, screenings, and treatment planning.
  • Support residents with depression, anxiety, adjustment to illness, grief, trauma, substance use, behavioral disturbances, and other conditions common in LTC settings.
  • Deliver behavioral management and brief, goal-oriented interventions aligned with best practices in geriatric care.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

  • Work closely with nursing, social services, rehabilitation, and medical providers to coordinate treatment and improve resident outcomes.
  • Participate in care plan discussions, facility meetings, and case collaborations as needed.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain complete and timely documentation using our Geriatric Notes Tool (GNT).
  • Follow ethical, professional, and regulatory guidelines for clinical documentation, confidentiality, and care delivery.

Facility Partnership

  • Build strong, professional relationships with facility staff and leadership.
  • Serve as a behavioral health resource and trusted partner in supporting residents’ mental and emotional needs.

Why Choose Deer Oaks?

We are a provider-centric organization that takes pride in supporting our clinicians with the tools, training, and benefits they need to succeed.

Work-Life Balance

  • Flexible scheduling — create your own Monday–Friday schedule
  • No evenings, weekends, or on-call
  • Autonomy in organizing your daily workflow and caseload

Professional Growth

  • ASWB-accredited CEUs at no cost
  • Ongoing clinical support, mentorship, and consultation
  • Access to geriatric-specific clinical training and specialty resources

Robust Administrative Support

  • Dedicated teams for billing, collections, credentialing, insurance, and scheduling
  • HIPAA-compliant documentation system and efficient workflows
  • Liability insurance provided (100% company-paid) for full-time and part-time staff

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation model
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Generous PTO and paid holidays

Who Thrives in this Role?

  • LCPCs who value autonomy paired with team collaboration
  • Clinicians who enjoy working with older adults and medically complex individuals
  • Strong communicators comfortable partnering with facility staff
  • Providers who are organized, compassionate, and clinically confident
  • Clinicians seeking long-term stability in a supportive environment

What You’ll Need

  • Active, unrestricted LCPC license
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with an interdisciplinary team
  • Comfortable navigating LTC environments
  • Commitment to timely documentation and high-quality care

About Deer Oaks - The Behavioral Health Solution

Focused exclusively on behavioral health in long-term care since 1992, Deer Oaks proudly serves thousands of skilled nursing and assisted living facilities nationwide. Our mission is to enhance the emotional well-being and quality of life of residents through compassionate, clinically excellent behavioral health services.

To learn more about Deer Oaks Behavioral Health and explore current career opportunities, please visit , or contact Mariah Gonzales, Senior Recruitment Partner, at 210-993-1024 or mgonzales@deeroaks.com.

title: Laundry Attendant
description:
Hampton Inn Philadelphia/King Of Prussia (Valley Forge)

SECTION ONE: MCR Universal Role Standards

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CLEANLINESS and FRIENDLINESS!
The MCR standard is to provide clean, friendly, well-organized and safe hotels for our guests.

AREAS OF EXCELLENCE

Happy Guests
Spotless Cleanliness
Product Consistency & Quality
Teamwork

Duties and Expectations
1. Happy Guests

Guest Relations: Greet guests happily upon arrival and throughout their stay with a smile.
Name Use: Use the guests’ names whenever possible, ensuring they feel properly welcomed.
Guest Satisfaction: All Team Members work together to contribute to great guest satisfaction scores.
Recovery: Ability to handle challenging guest situations with hospitality and a sense of urgency.
Hotel Knowledge: Strong knowledge of all features of the hotel facility and amenities.
Events: Awareness and support for all groups and events at the hotel.
Technology: Understanding of relevant technology for each role.
Phone Etiquette: Answer all incoming calls with friendly service using the approved greeting.

2. Spotless Cleanliness

Sparkling Clean Workspaces: All areas, both front and back of the house, should be kept clean and well-organized.
Pitching In: Cleanliness is a team effort! Everyone may expect to pitch in to clean guest rooms and public spaces as needed, to ensure the hotel is well-organized and safe.
Hospitality While Cleaning: Always greet every guest happily with a smile, by name if possible, while cleaning.

3. Product Consistency & Quality

Checklists to 100% Accuracy: All operational checklists are completed accurately and at the designated times, every shift.
Shift Handover Reports: Handover reports must be accurate and on time, for effective shift-to-shift communication.
Flawless Uniform: All Team Members must wear a clean, approved uniform and be well-groomed per the Team Member Handbook, while wearing a nametag and smiling at all times.

4. Teamwork

Communication: Communication between Team Members should be clear, honest, and professional.
Can Do Attitude: Willing to stretch beyond traditional role to meet the needs of the business and MCR’s guests.
Collaboration: All Team Members at all levels must be committed to working together to create a welcoming environment for guests and an effective, positive workplace.

SECTION TWO: Laundry Attendant, Role Specific Duties and Expectations

Linen Processing: Performs all stages of linen processing, including collecting, transporting, sorting, weighing, loading, and unloading of washers, dryers, and laundry chutes, folding, storing and delivering.
Linen Cleaning and Folding: Wash and dry all dirty linens, towels, rags, etc., as directed by management. Remove and sort dirty linens and towels from laundry carts. Fold linens/towels and stock linen carts, as required.
Equipment Operation: Understand operation of washing machines and dryers. Clean dryer filter as directed and noted on checklist and maintain all equipment as trained.
Laundry Facility Cleanliness: Sweep and mop laundry floors storing all linens off the floor. Keep laundry carts clean and free of debris. Stocks all linen closets throughout the hotel, as applicable. All back of house areas should be well-organized and clean.
Chemical Management: Replace and replenish cleaning chemicals.

SECTION THREE: Success Metrics

Happy Guests

Management Performance Ratings
Guest Satisfaction Scores/Intent to Return

Spotless Cleanliness

GM/AGM Spot Checks
Leadership Walk-throughs (RVP, etc.)
Guest Ratings/Reviews

Product Consistency & Quality

Checklist Tracking
Management Performance Ratings
Guest Ratings

Teamwork

Management Performance Ratings

SECTION FOUR: Qualifications & Requirements
Qualifications & Requirements:

Experience in a hospitality, service, consumer-facing franchise or related field preferred.
Can-Do Attitude: Must have a positive attitude and willingness to learn.
Ability to Follow Guidelines: Must be able to understand and follow established guidelines and procedures.
Handle Pace and Pressure: Must work well in stressful, high-pressure situations.
Listening, Conflict Resolution: Must be effective at listening to, understanding, clarifying, and resolving the concerns and issues raised by co-workers and guests.
Communication Skills: Must be able to convey information and ideas clearly.
Hospitality and Guest Service: Must have a desire to serve all guests.
Age Requirement: Must be 18 years of age or older to perform this job.
Schedule and Travel: Must be willing to work a varied schedule that may include evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays based upon the demands of the hotel.
Clock-in/Out: Arrive and clock in on time for every shift worked and clock out at the scheduled shift ending time, unless otherwise directed by your immediate supervisor. Never work while off the clock.
Breaks: Clock in/out for breaks at the designated time on your schedule.
Call Outs: Provide sufficient notice as directed by your supervisor when calling out for a scheduled shift.

Physical Working Demands & Working Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to:

Standing: Remaining upright on the feet, particularly for sustained periods of time.
Walking: Moving about on foot to accomplish tasks, particularly for long distances or moving from one work site to another.
Repetitive Motions: Making substantial movements (motions) of the
wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
Lifting: Carrying certain laundry supplies, linens and other items.

Note: This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) of this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. Employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily and, if requested, reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. The Employer retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an at-will relationship.

title: Lead Systems Administrator
description:
Join our team at Core One! Our mission is to be at the forefront of devising analytical, operational and technical solutions to our Nation's most complex national security challenges. In order to achieve our mission, Core One values people first! We are committed to recruiting, nurturing, and retaining top talent! We offer a competitive total compensation package that sets us apart from our competition. Core One is a team-oriented, dynamic, and growing company that values exceptional performance!

*This position requires the ability to obtain a Secret Clearance*

Responsibilities:

The Lead Systems Administrator is responsible for the performance, security, reliability, and continuous improvement of the Company's information technology environment. This position is the functional owner of IT operations, cybersecurity coordination, technology planning, vendor management, and end-user support services. This position is accountable for departmental performance and is expected to independently prioritize work, execute technology initiatives, manage resources, and provide leadership with recommendations and escalation only when matters exceed established authority or present material business risk.

  • Independently manage routine IT operations, technology implementations, vendor relationships, user support activities, and cybersecurity compliance requirements.
  • Escalate matters involving significant operational disruption, cybersecurity incidents, substantial financial impact, legal exposure, or other material business risks.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, automate business processes, and support corporate growth objectives.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve IT policies, procedures, standards, and documentation to support operational consistency, cybersecurity compliance, and organizational growth.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute the Company's IT strategy and technology roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that improve security, scalability, operational efficiency, and business performance.
  • Own the management and performance of third-party IT service providers, including service delivery oversight, escalation management, contract performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead the Company's cybersecurity and information assurance activities in coordination with the Facility Security Officer and external service providers, including vulnerability management, incident response readiness, system hardening, access control governance, and compliance activities.
  • Establish departmental priorities, allocate resources, and manage workload distribution to ensure effective delivery of IT services and strategic initiatives.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop IT personnel, including workload management, quality assurance, performance feedback, professional development, and delegation of responsibilities.

Qualifications:.

  • An equivalent combination of education and 6+ years of relevant experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 4-5 years of progressive experience in information technology administration, infrastructure management, cybersecurity operations, or related functions, including experience leading projects, initiatives, or personnel.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology initiatives, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and driving projects from planning through implementation.
  • Familiarity with Python and PowerShell as system administration tools, with the ability to describe specific processes automated using these tools
  • Experience managing or coordinating third-party managed service providers, consultants, or technology vendors.
  • Experience supporting NIST 800-171, CMMC, DFARS 252.204-7012, or other government cybersecurity compliance frameworks.
  • Intermediate-to-advanced knowledge of Windows environments, Office365 administration, DNS, and Exchange Online.
  • Hands-on experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, MDM solutions, and SaaS provisioning.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including remote support capabilities.
  • Experience supporting and maintaining secure networks and working in DoD-compliant environments.
  • Excellent communication skills - capable of translating technical terms for both technical and non-technical users.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain at least a SECRET security clearance.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Active Secret clearance.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred
  • CompTIA A+ certification and CompTIA Network+ certification.
  • Experience administering Microsoft Intune.
  • Experience in mid to Large-sized government contracting environment.
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery processes and tooling.

Security Clearance:

  • Ability to obtain a Secret Security Clearance

Salary Range: $100,000 - $120,000

Final compensation is determined based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, education, certifications, security clearance level, contract requirements, geographic location, and internal pay equity, and may reflect market data specific to the awarded contract.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

title: Catalogue Librarian
description:
Purpose of the role

The Catalogue Librarian will play a pivotal role, through managing, maintaining and being the expert for our Global POS Asset Library. For those outside the industry, a ‘POS Asset Library’ refers to a digital library of Point of Sale items including visual and catalogue data fields

Working closely with our Regional and Global Teams you will maintain the structure, integrity and effectiveness of the library. Ensuring that assets are readily available and easily accessible using accurately recorded metadata and taxonomy. This will allow your colleagues to effectively deliver outsourced marketing execution solutions for our clients.

The Catalogue Librarian is an integral module within our online client partnership platform. Your role will extend to gaining an in-depth knowledge of the platform and associated modules in order to deliver training to new users as required

In this role, you will interact with all users (clients, colleagues, suppliers and tech services) and will provide support to enable them to maximise utilisation of the library and its functionality. To be successful in this role, you will need to have a positive outlook, you will be a self starter and strive to work efficiently and effectively at all times. You will be comfortable working within a busy team, dealing with ambiguity at times, but always withy a calm and considered approach.

You will be working with a variety of systems in this role, including those which are bespoke, ‘off the shelf’ and some at the ‘cutting edge’, you must therefore be comfortable with using technology as part of the your role and being open to change.

Key Responsibilities

Be the advocate for the POS library
Provide adhoc support to users and come up with effective solutions
Manage the POS library, uploading and cataloguing in a clear concise manner, keeping the business objectives in mind at all times
Manage the process for identifying and receiving relevant library content as well as ensuring the assets are accurately recorded and stored appropriately
Manage the user database, ensuring strict compliance to ISR requirements
Provide training, coaching and assistance to users with varied IT skills
Act as a troubleshooter and maintain the library error log
Liaise with end users, making them aware when the content is in place
Deliver monthly and adhoc reports to both local, regional and global teams as needed
Document, update and manage the user guides and other key system operational procedures
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of the system at all times.

Knowledge, Skills + Experience

An excellent communicator, including business English – Spanish, Turkish, Portuguese an advantage
Organized, detailed and methodical in your approach
IT literate, comfortable using a variety of systems
Able to work to tight deadlines, in often changing environments
Numerate and able to assimilate data and produce meaningful information
Our ideal candidate will have an intuitive understanding and demonstratable experience in managing and developing a digital asset library.
English speaking a necessity

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Purpose and Impact

The Software Engineer develops, tests & maintains secure, reliable Salesforce solutions while applying modern software engineering practices throughout the development lifecycle. With limited supervision, this job collaborates with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, writes clean & maintainable code, participates in peer code reviews, creates and maintains automated tests, supports CI/CD, troubleshoots moderately complex issues & helps ensure appropriate quality, security & production readiness. This job primarily develops on the Salesforce platform while contributing additional test engineering capability through functional, regression, integration & end-to-end test automation.

Key Accountabilities

  • SOFTWARE ENGINEERING: Develops and maintains high-quality Salesforce software solutions by writing clean, maintainable and efficient code that delivers measurable business value.
  • AUTOMATION: Applies internal software deployment platform, methodologies, CI/CD pipelines and tools to support automated builds, testing and reliable deployments.
  • COLLABORATION: Partners with product managers, designers and engineers to understand requirements and deliver Salesforce solutions that meet business needs.
  • TESTING, DEBUGGING & TEST AUTOMATION: Writes and maintains unit and integration tests, performs debugging, and develops, maintains and executes automated test scripts supporting functional, regression, integration and end-to-end testing. Helps expand automated test coverage and reduce reliance on repetitive manual testing.
  • DEFECT MANAGEMENT: Identifies, documents and tracks defects, collaborates with developers and product team members on resolution, and validates fixes through appropriate automated and manual testing.
  • AGILE COLLABORATION: Works closely with Product Owners, Developers and other team members in an Agile/Scrum environment to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle.
  • CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT: Identifies opportunities to improve software development, testing and deployment processes and applies approved engineering standards to improve quality, efficiency and reliability.
  • DOCUMENTATION: Creates and maintains documentation for Salesforce applications, automated tests, deployment processes and system configurations.
  • TECHNICAL SUPPORT: Provides technical support and troubleshooting for moderately complex issues with deployed applications and assists with timely resolution and verification.

Qualifications

  • Have a Bachelor’s degree with minimum requirement of 4+ years of relevant professional software development experience.
  • Hands-on experience in Salesforce software development using Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, Salesforce APIs and Salesforce administration.
  • Experience writing automated unit tests and contributing to integration, functional and regression test automation, with an emphasis on software quality and repeatability.
  • Experience with modern software engineering practices such as Git-based source control, peer code reviews, DevOps, CI/CD and automated quality practices.
  • Experience working across the software development lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment and production support.

Good to have:

  • Experience with test automation tools or frameworks for web, API and/or mobile applications.
  • Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, mobile applications using React Native, including integration with backend services and APIs.
  • Experience testing Salesforce integrations and APIs.
  • Good written and oral communication skills along with good product documentation skills.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer certification or other relevant Salesforce certifications.

title: Customer Experience Associate (West Coast)
description:
Keep Growing with Nutrafol

We’re a growing company. Everything we do, we do to help people grow into the best version of themselves. As the pioneers of hair wellness, we create clinically tested products for hair growth and provide support for people at every step of their hair journey.

Our multi-factorial approach targets key root causes of hair thinning using a patented blend of standardized vitamins, minerals and natural ingredients -- and is recommended by over 7,500 physicians and hair professionals for trusted, reliable results. We never settle, and are continuously challenging existing treatments and methodologies to advance the frontier of hair science. As we help our customers grow, we grow too -- by embracing individuality and differences, leading by example, and empowering ourselves and others with our passion for wellness and innovation.

Keep growing. It’s our mantra. Our commitment to helping anybody and everybody committed to realizing their own potential to grow.

About you:

Be the voice that makes someone’s day better.

At Nutrafol, our customers come to us during a vulnerable, sometimes emotional moment in their lives. How we show up for them, with empathy, expertise and a little creativity, is what sets us apart. We’re looking for a Customer Experience Associate to be that voice: the person who turns a frustrated email into a loyal customer and a potential shipping mishap into a five-star moment.

If you’re a natural problem-solver who thinks on your feet, loves working with people, and wants to support and enhance the Nutrafol customer journey - this is your role!

This position is open to candidates based in the Pacific timezone. Work schedule is: Tuesday-Saturday, 9am-6pm PT.

title: Coördinerend (persoonlijk) begeleider LVB/MVB
description:
Bij Philadelphia heet deze functie officieel Coördinerend Begeleider.

Een eigen appartement, zoveel mogelijk je eigen keuzes maken en begeleiding dichtbij wanneer dat nodig is. Op De Zonneberg in Wateringen help jij volwassenen met een verstandelijke beperking om zo zelfstandig mogelijk hun eigen leven te leiden.

We zoeken een Persoonlijk Begeleider voor 24 tot 32 uur per week die dichtbij bewoners staat én verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor de kwaliteit van hun begeleiding.

Jouw rol

Als Persoonlijk Begeleider combineer je het beste van twee kanten: je staat midden in het dagelijks leven van bewoners, maar houdt tegelijkertijd het overzicht over hun begeleiding.

Je coördineert de ondersteuning rondom een aantal bewoners en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor collega's, familie, wettelijk vertegenwoordigers en behandelaren. Je stelt ondersteuningsplannen op, bewaakt persoonlijke doelen en zorgt ervoor dat afspraken niet alleen op papier staan, maar ook terugkomen in de dagelijkse begeleiding.

Tegelijkertijd werk je gewoon mee op de locatie.

Je ondersteunt bewoners waar nodig bij ADL, brengt structuur aan en helpt hen om zoveel mogelijk zelf te blijven doen. De ene bewoner heeft daarbij vooral behoefte aan duidelijkheid en vertrouwen, terwijl een ander meer ondersteuning nodig heeft bij praktische zaken of persoonlijke verzorging.

Je:

  • coördineert de begeleiding rondom een aantal bewoners en bewaakt hun persoonlijke doelen;
  • stelt ondersteuningsplannen op, evalueert deze en vertaalt afspraken naar de dagelijkse praktijk;
  • stimuleert zelfstandigheid, eigen regie en deelname aan de maatschappij;
  • signaleert veranderingen in gedrag of ondersteuningsbehoefte en zet passende acties uit;
  • onderhoudt contact met familie, wettelijk vertegenwoordigers, behandelaren en andere betrokkenen;
  • ondersteunt en coacht collega's bij begeleidingsvragen en helpt om samen één duidelijke lijn te houden;
  • werkt vanuit onder andere Begeleid Ontdekkend Leren (BOL) en Leerbaar Weerbaar.

Je bent dus niet degene die vanaf de zijlijn vertelt hoe het moet. Juist doordat je bewoners goed kent en zelf meewerkt, kun je de coördinerende verantwoordelijkheid goed pakken.

Over de locatie

De Zonneberg is een moderne woonlocatie in Wateringen, midden in het Westland en vlak bij Den Haag.

Hier wonen 31 volwassenen met een lichte tot matige verstandelijke beperking (LVB/VB). Iedere bewoner heeft een eigen tweekamerappartement, verdeeld over vier verdiepingen.

Daarnaast zijn er twee gezamenlijke steunpunten waar bewoners elkaar kunnen ontmoeten en is er een ruime tuin met uitzicht op het Hofpark.

Bewoners hebben zoveel mogelijk hun eigen leven, eigen ritme en eigen keuzes. Begeleiding is 24 uur per dag dichtbij wanneer dat nodig is.

Wat De Zonneberg zo bijzonder maakt

Op De Zonneberg draait begeleiding niet om dingen van bewoners overnemen, maar juist om ontdekken wat iemand zelf kan.

Dat maakt jouw werk heel verschillend. Soms ondersteun je iemand bij persoonlijke verzorging of het starten van de dag. Een ander moment voer je een gesprek over een persoonlijk doel, bespreek je met collega's wat jullie in gedrag zien of heb je contact met familie of een behandelaar.

De bewoners verschillen in leeftijd, zelfstandigheid en ondersteuningsvraag. Daardoor moet je goed kunnen schakelen en achter gedrag kunnen kijken.

Je werkt in een betrokken team waarin collega's samen verantwoordelijkheid dragen voor de locatie. Iedereen brengt zijn eigen talent en expertise mee. Er is ruimte om mee te denken, initiatief te nemen en de begeleiding samen steeds een beetje beter te maken.

Wat wij bieden

Bij Philadelphia halen we het beste uit elkaar. Daarom zorgen wij voor:

  • Een brutosalaris volgens de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg van minimaal € 2951,- en maximaal € 3980,- FWG 40 bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur, gebaseerd op je ervaring en opleiding. En bij onregelmatige diensten krijg je een extra toeslag;
  • Ruimte om te groeien, zoals jij dat wilt: met jouw talent en ambitie, maar ook met ons Leerhuis en de vele opleidingsmogelijkheden;
  • De mogelijkheid om je vakantietoeslag en/of eindejaarsuitkering maandelijks te laten uitbetalen;
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng en het ontwikkelen van jouw talenten, je werkt mee aan projecten en activiteiten;
  • Korting op uitjes, je sportschool en een interessante laptop- en fietsregeling en voordelen als extra vrije dagen tot aan coaching. Kies wat jij wilt;
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng; Wij zijn altijd op zoek naar mogelijkheden om onze begeleiding te verbeteren;
  • Basisrooster wat voor een jaar wordt uitgerold ( vastgesteld rooster);
  • Direct een vast contract!

Bekijk al onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Wie ben jij?

Je houdt overzicht zonder de afstand tot bewoners te verliezen. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, kunt collega's meenemen in afspraken en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer dat nodig is.

Tegelijkertijd weet je dat goede begeleiding niet betekent dat jij bepaalt wat goed is voor iemand. Je observeert, stelt vragen en zoekt samen met de bewoner naar wat wél mogelijk is.

Verder:

  • heb je minimaal een relevante afgeronde mbo-opleiding niveau 4 in Zorg & Welzijn, bijvoorbeeld Persoonlijk Begeleider Maatschappelijke Zorg, MMZ 4 of SPW 4;
  • is een hbo-opleiding zoals Social Work natuurlijk ook passend;
  • heb je bij voorkeur ervaring in de gehandicaptenzorg en affiniteit met volwassenen met een lichte tot matige verstandelijke beperking;
  • kun je methodisch werken en ondersteuningsplannen vertalen naar de dagelijkse begeleiding;
  • ben je sterk in observeren, organiseren, communiceren en samenwerken;
  • kun je collega's ondersteunen en meenemen zonder alles van hen over te nemen;
  • ben je beschikbaar voor dag-, avond-, weekend- en slaapdiensten.

Solliciteren?

Wil jij als Persoonlijk Begeleider werken op een plek waar bewoners zoveel mogelijk hun eigen leven leiden en jij tegelijkertijd verantwoordelijkheid krijgt voor de kwaliteit van hun begeleiding?

Solliciteer dan eenvoudig met je cv; een motivatiebrief is erg welkom. We bekijken sollicitaties doorlopend, dus je kunt meteen reageren. Heb je vragen of wil je eerst even sparren? Neem gerust contact op met Marja Welman, Corporate Recruiter bij Philadelphia, via marja.welman@philadelphia.nl. We maken graag kennis met je.

title: Finance Operating Executive (REMOTE)
description:
We are seeking a Finance Operating Executive (REMOTE) for a full time and direct hire role for one of our amazing Private Equity partners. You will work remotely but will be required to work on-site with clients at times.


This Operating Executive will work with the firms respective portfolio companies and management teams to deliver service in the areas of accounting and finance operations. You will frequently operate as a team of one within highly granular (Rev $5M-$20M) environments. You will work full-time for the Private Equity company, but you will provide interim management services to various portfolio companies to help them integrate the people, processes and systems associated with acquisitions. You will lead and assist them with systems implementations, perform project work and search for every possible way to create value and optimize performance for the Private Equity firm.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as a true business partner to CEOs at portfolio companies.
  • Analyze accounting processes to identify issues and perform research on all solutions to ensure efficient workflows.
  • Review and prepare journal entries and ledger accounts to ensure reconciliation of statements according to US GAAP.
  • Prepare balance sheets, income statements, cash flows and provide support to external auditors and professionals.
  • Implement standardized monthly financial reporting packages and integrate with client GL/reporting systems.
  • Cleanup historical financials to align with quality of earnings analysis.
  • Convert clients from cash-basis accounting to accrual/GAAP.
  • Prepare opening balance sheets and post-closing working capital true ups for new acquisitions.
  • Implement comprehensive annual planning/budget processes.
  • Prepare and maintain rolling 13-week cash flow forecasts, reconciliations of Adjusted EBITDA vs. FCF.
  • Transition banking and cash management from local banks to regional and national platforms.
  • Review loan covenants, calculate and model financial covenants and produce quarterly lender reporting packages.
  • Develop month-end closing checklist and move clients from perpetual to 10-day close.
  • Evaluate suitability of existing accounting systems and recommend enhancements and changes as applicable.
  • Develop various online and offline systems to improve efficiency of accounting processes.
  • Collaborate with client project teams on operational systems implementations to ensure integration with accounting.
  • Perform and assist with inventory assessments and valuation performed internally and by third party professionals.
  • Develop internal control programs and maintenance programs.
  • Prepare monthly billing support schedules for each portfolio client.
  • Submit regular reports & communication to leadership regarding status of each portfolio client.


Requirements:

  • 15+ years of progressive experience within a broad range of accounting and finance environments, including private equity.
  • Hands-on experience converting a business from cash-basis accounting to accrual/GAAP accounting is required.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and/or integrating GL systems and processes.
  • Experience building & maintaining 3-statement financial consolidation models with high-level competency in Microsoft.
  • Strong experience with Excel (e.g. advanced database/financial functions and formula-building).
  • Experience with multiple GL systems including QuickBooks and cloud-based ERP/GL systems (Sage Intacct, NetSuite, Dynamics, etc).
  • Experience working with external auditors.
  • Strong verbal and written communications skills, including e-mail and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Comfortable with some travel as needed to portfolio companies.
  • Clear understanding of timelines, deliverables and ability to patiently & effectively communicate with a broad range of personality types and competency levels.
  • Confident self-starter with friendly and humble personality.
  • CPA/MAcc and MBA a plus.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, or military or veteran status. You must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.

title: PER DIEM - School-Based Therapist
description:
PER DIEM School-Based Therapist - Napa, CA Area

Transforming student mental health in schools.

About Effective School Solutions

Effective School Solutions (ESS) is a leading provider of school-based mental health services, serving 6,000+ K–12 students across 12 states.

We deliver the level of clinical care typically found in private practice, out-of-district placements, or higher levels of care directly within public schools- providing a full continuum of clinical programming, professional development, and district consultation.

Position Type: Per Diem

Hourly Rate: $55.00-$62.00/hour

This is a per diem position and is not eligible for benefits. Per diem therapist support ESS on an as-needed basis, including coverage for leave assignments (e.g., medical or maternity leave).

Therapist in this role have flexibility in their level of commitment. They may choose to pick up occasional shifts, work a few days per week on an ongoing basis, or take on a temporary full-time schedule when covering a longer-term leave assignment. Per diem clinicians can accept or decline assignments based on their availability.

This role does not follow a consistent full-time schedule; however, full-time hours may be required on a temporary basis when covering extended leave assignments.

Why This Role Matters

You’ll provide critical mental health support to students who may not otherwise have access to care—helping them succeed academically, build resilience, and thrive.

At ESS, clinicians are trusted partners in shaping supportive school environments.

Responsibilities

Direct Clinical Care & Family Support

  • Provide comprehensive, school-based mental health services, including individual, group, and family therapy, as well as intake, diagnostic, and clinical assessments
  • Partner with families and facilitate parent support programming
  • Conduct risk assessments and crisis intervention, ensuring student safety and coordinating referrals to appropriate levels of care when needed
  • Develop and implement individualized, evidence-based treatment plans that support students’ emotional, behavioral, and academic success

Supervision, Training & Collaboration

  • Oversee the day-to-day clinical operations of the assigned school-based program
  • Serve as the primary clinical point of contact for school partners, providing expert guidance, ensuring alignment on student support strategies, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships.
  • Facilitate weekly consultation sessions to ensure alignment on student goals and documentation standards
  • Collaborate with families, school staff, and interdisciplinary teams to deliver coordinated care, and provide consultation, coaching, and training on mental health and trauma-informed practices
  • Participate in team meetings, supervision, and ongoing professional development

Documentation, Compliance & Professional Expectations

  • Maintain timely, accurate clinical documentation in accordance with regulatory, ethical, and organizational standards
  • Uphold professional standards by maintaining active licensure, ethical practice, reliability, and a strong professional presence
  • Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with ESS clinical and operational standards
  • Support clinician performance through feedback, coaching, and evaluations

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field
  • Active associate number or clinical license (e.g., AMFT, APCC, ACSW or LMFT, LPCC, LCSW) in the state of California
  • 2+ years of experience working with children and/or adolescents with behavioral and emotional needs
  • Experience providing training and coaching to educational professionals and parents/caregivers on student mental health issues.
  • Experience working with schools, families, and community-based services (school-based experience preferred)
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain trusting relationships with students, families, and school staff
  • Commitment to delivering high-quality, evidence-based care and advocating for best practices
  • Proven ability to positively influence, motivate, and elevate team members and stakeholders
  • Ability to make confident, sound decisions in ambiguous or evolving situations
  • Proficient in clinical documentation and use of electronic systems (e.g., EMR, Microsoft Office), with the ability to maintain accurate and timely records

Why Clinicians Choose ESS

✔ School-day schedule — No weekends; occasional evening hours as needed to support family engagement
✔ Light summers
✔ Small caseloads
✔ Ongoing clinical support, and free CEUs
✔ Competitive Pay
✔ Clinical leadership at the heart of our company

Make a meaningful impact on student mental health.

title: Director, Infrastructure Engineering
description:
Here at Ooma we empower people to connect in smarter ways. We do this by creating powerful communication experiences through our cloud-based platform to bring people together at work and at home. Our solutions help small business owners stay connected with their customers and manage their businesses from anywhere. For larger companies we provide customized unified communications solutions to meet their unique needs. At home, we help our customers connect with their loved ones by providing the #1 rated VoIP phone service available. We also provide them with peace of mind through our innovative smart home security solution. At Ooma, all our products and services are priced competitively, because we believe advanced technology should be accessible to all.

About the Role:

Ooma is looking for a Director, Infrastructure Engineering to lead the organization responsible for the infrastructure Ooma's customers depend on: data centers, public cloud, Linux server fleets, Kubernetes clusters, networking, ISP relationships, network storage, logging and monitoring infrastructure, network security, compliance, and more.

Your core mandate is to run a high-performing infrastructure organization of 12 engineers—developing team leads, driving operational excellence and reliability, owning capital and operating budgets, and continuously finding opportunities to optimize cost, vendor spend, and efficiency—all while serving as a trusted infrastructure partner to peer teams in Network Operations and to Engineering. As the company grows, you'll modernize the technology stack and scale the team and its practices to match.

If you're an infrastructure leader who is technically credible with strong individual contributors, operationally rigorous, and polished enough to present strategy to executives, this role was written for you.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and run a high-performing, distributed infrastructure organization of ~12 engineers, driving operational excellence, reliability, and accountability across all infrastructure services.
  • Manage capital and operating budgets, own vendor relationships and contract negotiations, and continuously identify opportunities to reduce cost without compromising reliability.
  • Set technical direction across data centers, cloud environments, Linux, Kubernetes, networking, storage, observability (logging and monitoring), and network security. Bring the technical depth to earn the respect of strong individual contributors and make sound architectural trade-offs.
  • Operate as a service provider to sibling teams within Network Operations, building and maintaining the hardware platforms on which they deploy and upgrade Ooma's products and services.
  • Collaborate with Product and Development teams to define, architect, and document infrastructure solutions for upcoming products and services, bringing infrastructure into the design conversation early — including SLAs, performance targets, scalability, and capacity planning.
  • Establish and develop team leads, build a leadership bench, and evolve the team structure over time toward functional domains as the unified organization matures.
  • Partner with Security and broader organizational leadership to define security policies and standards for data center and cloud infrastructure and lead the implementation and enforcement of those policies across all environments—including security patch and operating system upgrade cadences, and partnering with audit and compliance teams (e.g., SOX, SOC).
  • Build strategic plans, roadmaps, and presentations for executive leadership that connect infrastructure investment to business outcomes.
  • Own the 24/7/365 on-call escalation path. Build an escalation model and on-call program where you're accountable for outcomes—without needing to personally join every incident bridge.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and modern infrastructure practices so the organization scales with the company's growth.
  • Bring a point of view on where AI can meaningfully improve infrastructure operations and engineering efficiency, and help the organization explore and adopt it thoughtfully.
  • Represent infrastructure externally with customers and partners as needed and serve as the infrastructure integration lead for future acquisitions.
  • Operate within a genuinely flexible work model—fully remote within the US, hybrid, or onsite at our Sunnyvale, CA headquarters, your choice—aligned with the organization's US business hours, with occasional travel as needed.

Experience We’re Looking For:

  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering or operations required, including 5+ years leading teams—ideally including experience leading through team leads or managers.
  • Must have deep technical fluency across the domains this organization runs: Linux, Kubernetes, and open-source tooling; cloud infrastructure and environments; and core disciplines including data center operations, networking, storage, observability, and network security.
  • A track record of owning capital and operating budgets, managing vendors, and negotiating contracts is essential.
  • Experience leading teams through a merger integration, org consolidation, or other significant structural change highly valued.
  • A background in telecom, VoIP, or other carrier-grade / high-availability service environments strongly preferred.
  • A demonstrated track record of measurable infrastructure cost optimization a plus. #LI-CC1

What We Offer:

Working at Ooma means being a team player, while allowing your individual voice to come through. And, you'll receive competitive compensation, benefits and generous company perks.

  • Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision insurance for you and eligible dependents
    • HMO, PPO’s or a PPO with a HDHP (including HSA, which Ooma helps fund)
  • Employer Paid Income Protection Benefits (Basic Life and AD&D, Short- and Long-term disability)
  • FSA Healthcare & Dependent Care

  • Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Legal

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Paid Time off, Sick Time, as well as corporate holidays observed
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Life Balance benefits with Travel Assistance Services and Identity Theft
  • Additional Benefits include a Discount Program, Credit Union, Medicare Assistance, etc

We do not discriminate on the basis of any trait or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

title: Director, Pharmacy Operations Strategy & Integration
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Director, Pharmacy Operations Strategy & Integration to join our Pharmacy team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

The Director, Pharmacy Operations Strategy & Integration reports to the SVP, Pharmacy is responsible for shaping and executing Oscar's pharmacy operational excellence agenda for the Pharmacy Clinical Strategy and Operations area. This role translates strategic priorities into a coherent portfolio of operating-model improvements, cross-functional programs, vendor capabilities, and scalable workflows that advance affordability, health outcomes, and the member and provider experience. The Director serves as a connective leader across Pharmacy, Clinical, Product, Engineering, Finance, Actuarial, Concierge, Compliance, and PBM/vendor partners—aligning priorities, decisions, and execution to deliver measurable business impact. This role balances enterprise affordability, member and provider experience, regulatory compliance, operational quality, and long-term scalability as Oscar advances its pharmacy operating model.

You will report into the SVP, Pharmacy.

Work Location: This position is based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $180,504.00 - $236,911.00 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, company equity grants and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

  • Set the pharmacy operational excellence strategy, operating rhythm, and execution model, ensuring priorities are aligned to Oscar's enterprise agenda, Pharmacy objectives, affordability goals, and member and provider outcomes.
  • Lead high-priority pharmacy operational transformation initiatives from strategy through execution, including opportunity definition, roadmap development, operational readiness, launch planning, and sustained adoption.
  • Serve as a primary operational partner across internal and external teams, translating pharmacy and PBM opportunities, member and provider needs, and frontline insights into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable outcomes.
  • Stay aware of applicable PBM, pharmacy benefit, managed care, and healthcare regulatory requirements, interpreting the business need and communicating it clearly to internal and external partners so solutions are designed and implemented appropriately.
  • Maintain deep understanding of the pharmacy and healthcare ecosystem, including payer economics, benefit and network dynamics, claims processes, formulary operations, prior authorization workflows, utilization patterns, vendor handoffs, and the drivers of affordability and experience.
  • Partner with cross-functional internal stakeholders and external vendors to manage implementation plans, business reviews, strategic meetings, issue escalation, performance monitoring, and operational integration.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally across Clinical, Pharmacy Operations, Product, Engineering, Finance, Actuarial, Concierge, Compliance, and vendor partners to align decision rights, dependencies, tradeoffs, and delivery plans for high-priority pharmacy initiatives.
  • Serve as an internal consultant and apply an operational excellence lens to diagnose complex process, data, technology, and vendor friction points, then design practical end-to-end solutions that improve throughput, quality, affordability, and member/provider experience.
  • Shape the end-to-end member and provider experience by partnering with Pharmacy, Clinical, Product, Engineering, Concierge, and vendor teams to identify friction points and translate insights into scalable, measurable improvements across pharmacy journeys.
  • Lead governance and executive reporting for pharmacy operational excellence initiatives, synthesizing operational, member, provider, clinical, and financial data into clear priorities, recommendations, and accountability for senior leadership.
  • Identify and manage implementation risks, dependencies, decisions, and change-management needs, ensuring stakeholders understand scope, impact, tradeoffs, and operational readiness requirements.
  • Build repeatable operating playbooks, process standards, controls, and best practices that support a scalable PBM operating model, continuous improvement, and a coherent end-to-end pharmacy experience.
  • Use independent judgment to resolve complex problems, evaluate variable factors, and determine the best course of action for technology-enabled process improvement and operational transformation.
  • Support capacity planning, budget management, business-case development, and value realization measurement for PBM, vendor, and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Ensure operational workflows, vendor capabilities, and program execution meet applicable regulatory, compliance, quality, and contractual requirements.
  • Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in healthcare, business operations, strategy and operations, product operations, or program leadership.
  • 7+ years of Managed Care, PBM, pharmacy operations, clinical operations, or related healthcare payer experience.
  • 5+ years leading large-scale, cross-functional strategy, operational transformation, or implementation initiatives from opportunity definition through launch and adoption.
  • 5+ years partnering directly with cross-functional business, Product, Engineering, vendor, or operations teams to set priorities, define requirements, influence solutions, and deliver business outcomes.
  • Experience interpreting regulatory, compliance, operational, or contractual business needs and translating them into actionable requirements for cross-functional partners.
  • Experience with strategic planning, roadmapping, business analysis, operational readiness, change management, and translating priorities into executable cross-functional plans.
  • Experience translating complex operational data and performance information into executive-level insights, recommendations, and governance materials.
  • Experience managing budgets, capacity models, business cases, or financial performance for operational or transformation initiatives.

Bonus points:

  • MBA, MPH, Master's degree in Business Administration or a related field preferred.
  • Management consulting, internal strategy and operations, process engineering, Lean, Six Sigma, or similar structured problem-solving experience.
  • Experience with PBM implementation, pharmacy benefit administration, claims adjudication, formulary operations, prior authorization, rebate/formulary systems, or healthcare data feeds.
  • Experience working in a matrixed teams through enterprise transformation, implementation, or operational excellence work.

title: Cooler Worker- 3rd Shift
description:
GENERAL PURPOSE

Perform various warehouse and inventory tasks. Receive, process, store, move, and distribute items (products, materials, ingredients, equipment, supplies, etc.) within a warehouse or cooler/refrigerated environment. Unload and load trucks, truck trailers, cases, pallets, stacks, etc. Read production schedules, customer orders, work orders, shipping orders, or requisitions to determine items to be moved, gathered, or distributed. Convey materials and items from receiving or production areas to storage or to other designated areas by hand, hand truck, or electric hand truck. Record received and shipped items. Maintain a clean and safe working environment. Work within clearly defined processes and tasks.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Load and unload stacks and move items as assigned; sort and place materials or items on racks, shelves, or in bins according to predetermined sequence, such as size, type, style, color, or product code
  • Sort and store perishable goods in refrigerated area
  • Maintain organization, rotation of stock, and neatness of all coolers and warehouse
  • Fill requisitions, work orders, or requests for materials, tools, or other items and distribute to production workers
  • Accurately pull and prepare customer orders for shipping and for efficient loading onto trucks/trailers
  • Check all information for accurate shipment of customer orders; check bills of lading for accuracy before any product is shipped or received; check products for cleanliness and condition prior to loading
  • Use computer to accurately scan or enter/maintain inventories and records
  • Complete daily pick sheets, cycle counts, and production take backs
  • Assist with monthly inventory counts, year-end inventory counts, and cycle counts as required
  • Monitor materials, product, and equipment at each step of the process and report irregularities or concerns to supervisor
  • May sort, bundle and fill containers or place in assembled units
  • May mark or put identifying labels on product loads
  • May operate a forklift, including a standing forklift, to load and unload trucks and move inventory from one location to another
  • Keep a clean and safe working environment and optimize space utilization
  • Follow all DFA GMP’s and work in a manner consistent with all corporate and regulatory, food safety, quality, and sanitation requirements. Inform QA personnel of any quality issues

title: Begeleider LVB & VB
description:
Wij zoeken een begleider voor 24 - 28 uur per week
Wil jij mensen met een verstandelijke beperking helpen om zo zelfstandig mogelijk hun eigen leven te leiden? Bij Het Baken in Gouda begeleid je volwassenen van 25 tot 75 jaar in hun eigen appartement én in het gezamenlijke leven op de groep.

Jouw rol

Als Begeleider Gehandicaptenzorg bij Het Baken ondersteun je bewoners bij de dingen die voor hen belangrijk zijn. Daarbij neem je niet automatisch iets over. Je kijkt eerst: wat kan iemand zelf, waarbij is een zetje nodig en wanneer moet jij juist wat meer nabijheid of ondersteuning bieden?

De ene bewoner heeft vooral behoefte aan structuur en duidelijkheid, terwijl een ander hulp nodig heeft bij praktische zaken of persoonlijke verzorging. Je leert de bewoners goed kennen en sluit jouw begeleiding aan op hun mogelijkheden en ondersteuningsvraag.

Je:

  • helpt bewoners bij het aanbrengen van structuur en het organiseren van hun dagelijkse leven;
  • stimuleert zelfstandigheid en helpt bewoners om zoveel mogelijk hun eigen keuzes te maken;
  • ondersteunt waar nodig bij persoonlijke verzorging;
  • begeleidt bij praktische zaken zoals koken, het huishouden en sociale contacten;
  • hebt oog voor de groepsdynamiek en zorgt samen met collega's voor een prettige en veilige sfeer;
  • betrekt familie, vrienden en het netwerk waar dat passend is;
  • signaleert veranderingen en rapporteert belangrijke informatie natuurlijk ook in het ECD.

Je werkt volgens het ondersteuningsplan, maar vooral mét de bewoner. Het doel is niet om alles voor iemand te regelen, maar om iemand te helpen zijn of haar eigen leven zo goed mogelijk vorm te geven.

Over de locatie

Het Baken is een woonlocatie van Philadelphia in een rustige woonwijk in Gouda. Hier wonen 16 volwassenen met een lichte tot matige verstandelijke beperking (LVB/VB).

Iedere bewoner heeft een eigen appartement en daarmee een eigen plek en zoveel mogelijk een eigen leven. De appartementen zijn verdeeld over twee woonlagen. Op iedere verdieping is daarnaast een gezamenlijke woonkamer met keuken en zitgedeelte. Hier wordt samen gegeten, televisiegekeken, een spelletje gedaan of gewoon even bijgepraat.

De bewoners verschillen in leeftijd en ondersteuningsvraag:

  • beneden wonen voornamelijk volwassenen van ongeveer 25 tot 40 jaar;
  • boven wonen bewoners van ongeveer 40 tot 75 jaar;
  • overdag gaan de meeste bewoners naar werk of dagbesteding;
  • de mate van zelfstandigheid verschilt per bewoner;
  • begeleiding wordt daarom altijd afgestemd op iemands mogelijkheden en behoeften.

Wat de locatie zo bijzonder maakt

Het Baken zit precies tussen zelfstandig wonen en samen leven in.

Bewoners hebben hun eigen appartement en zoveel mogelijk de regie over hun eigen leven. Tegelijkertijd is begeleiding dichtbij wanneer dat nodig is en kunnen bewoners elkaar ontmoeten in de gezamenlijke huiskamers.

Voor jou betekent dit dat je niet de hele dag hetzelfde doet. Het ene moment help je iemand bij het koken of persoonlijke verzorging, even later voer je een gesprek over familie of werk en daarna vraagt de sfeer binnen de groep jouw aandacht.

Je werkt bovendien in een enthousiast en betrokken team. En prettig: Het Baken werkt met een basisrooster dat voor een jaar wordt uitgerold. Je werkt onregelmatige diensten, maar weet daardoor wel ruim van tevoren waar je aan toe bent.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een leuke baan waar je met plezier naar toe gaat. Wij investeren in onze medewerkers en daarom krijg je de ruimte om te groeien, zoals jij dat wilt: met jouw talent en ambitie, maar ook met ons Leerhuis en de vele opleidingsmogelijkheden. Verder vinden we belanrijk dat er rust in een rooster zit zodat je weet waar je aan toe bent. Wij werken met een basisrooster wat voor een jaar wordt uitgerold ( vastgesteld rooster).Daarnaast krijg je:

  • Een brutosalaris volgens de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg van min. € 2.597,- en max. € 3.635,- (FWG 35) bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur. Bij onregelmatige diensten krijg je een toeslag van 122 tot 160%
  • Direct een contract voor onbepaalde tijd; tenzij er redenen zijn om hiervan af te wijken;
  • De mogelijkheid om je vakantietoeslag en/of eindejaarsuitkering maandelijks te laten uitbetalen
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng en het ontwikkelen van jouw talenten, je werkt mee aan projecten en activiteiten;
  • Korting op uitjes, je sportschool en een interessante laptop- en fietsregeling en voordelen als extra vrije dagen tot aan coaching. Kies wat jij wilt; ;
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng; Wij zijn altijd op zoek naar mogelijkheden om onze begeleiding te verbeteren. Werken mee aan projecten en activiteiten!

Bekijk al onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent iemand die niet direct alles van een bewoner overneemt. Je kunt ondersteunen met je handen op je rug als dat kan en bent er juist wél wanneer iemand je nodig heeft. Je houdt van duidelijkheid en structuur, maar begrijpt ook dat zestien verschillende bewoners zestien verschillende manieren van begeleiden kunnen vragen.

Verder:

  • heb je een relevante afgeronde mbo-opleiding niveau 3 of 4 in Zorg & Welzijn, bijvoorbeeld Begeleider Maatschappelijke Zorg;
  • heb je bij voorkeur ervaring met of kennis van mensen met een lichte of matige verstandelijke beperking;
  • vind je het geen probleem om waar nodig te ondersteunen bij persoonlijke verzorging;
  • kun je zelfstandig werken én goed afstemmen met collega's;
  • communiceer je gemakkelijk met bewoners, collega's en het netwerk rondom bewoners;
  • kun je werken met digitale systemen en zorgvuldig rapporteren in het ECD;
  • ben je beschikbaar voor onregelmatige dag-, avond-, weekend- en slaapdiensten.

Solliciteren?

Wil je deel uitmaken van deze warme en betrokken woonlocatie in Gouda? Solliciteer dan eenvoudig met je cv; een motivatiebrief is erg welkom. We bekijken sollicitaties doorlopend, dus je kunt meteen reageren.

Heb je vragen of wil je eerst even sparren? Neem gerust contact op met Mariska Verbeek, Manager Zorg en Begeleiding, via 06 - 25 06 40 57

title: Työfysioterapeutti, Haapavesi, Oulainen
description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt Työfysioterapeuttia Haapavedelle ja Oulaisiin.

Mitä työfysioterapeutin tehtävä pitää sisällään?

Haemme työfysioterapeuttia osaksi moniammatillista työterveyshuollon tiimiämme. Tehtävässäsi edistät asiakkaidemme työkykyä, terveyttä ja toimintakykyä ennaltaehkäisevästi ja kuntouttavasti työelämän eri vaiheissa. Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja vaikuttavan työn, nykyaikaiset työvälineet sekä mahdollisuuden osaamisen jatkuvaan kehittämiseen.

Työhösi kuuluu ergonomiakartoituksia ja työpaikkaselvityksiä, työn fyysisen kuormituksen arviointia sekä yksilöllistä ohjausta ja vastaanottotyötä. Toimit asiantuntijana tuki- ja liikuntaelinongelmien ennaltaehkäisyssä, varhaisessa tuessa ja työkyvyn edistämisessä tiiviissä yhteistyössä työterveystiimiemme ja asiakkaidemme kanssa.

Työssä korostuu myös aktiivinen asiakkuudenhoito ja yhteistyö asiakasyritysten kanssa. Osallistut asiakkuuksien kehittämiseen, asiakkaiden tarpeiden tunnistamiseen sekä työkykyä tukevien ratkaisujen suunnitteluun yhdessä muun työterveystiimin kanssa. Toimit asiantuntijana asiakkaiden arjessa ja rakennat pitkäjänteisiä yhteistyösuhteita eri sidosryhmien kanssa.

Työsuhde tehtävässä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja kokoaikainen. Olet osa moniammatillista osaajatiimiä. Työyhteisösi koostuu kokeneista työterveyden ammattilaisista. Yhteistyön tavoitteena on tuottaa asiakkaillemme vaikuttavia, laadukkaita ja sujuvia työterveyspalveluita.

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Meillä arki rakentuu sujuvuudesta ja toisista välittämisestä, jatkuvasta halusta kehittyä ja ennen kaikkea inhimillisistä kohtaamisista. Vaikka maailma muuttuu, meidän tapamme tehdä työtä säilyy: Terveystalossa sinä voit keskittyä tekemään sitä, mikä on tärkeintä – terveyttä.

  • Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö, joustavuus ja edistykselliset hoitopolkumme tukevat arjen työtä.
  • Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä.
  • Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun.
  • Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme.
  • Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen. title: Staff Software Engineer - Android
description:
About the Role:

Engages with stakeholders across teams to lead the design, development, and evolution of the build systems and CI infrastructure that every Android engineer at Uber depends on.

Every change to Uber's Android apps — Rider, Driver, Uber Eats, and more — flows through the build. In this role, you will own the Android build end to end: the Bazel build graph and rules, remote caching, and the CI pipelines that verify every change before it lands. You will set the technical direction for making Android builds faster, more reliable, and more cost-efficient at monorepo scale, and lead cross-team initiatives to achieve these goals.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the Android build end to end — the Bazel build graph, Starlark rules and toolchains (Android, Kotlin, Java), and dependency management across a large, multi-app Android monorepo.

  • Drive down CI and local build latency through remote build caching and remote execution, build-graph pruning, critical-path parallelism, and cost-aware CI sharding.

  • Make local and CI results consistent, so a green local build, test, or lint result means a green CI run.

  • Make every build failure actionable: eliminate flakiness and cache-correctness issues, add per-target telemetry and smarter retry policies, and ensure engineers and AI coding agents know what failed, how to fix it, and who to contact.

  • Keep the Android build modern: lead Bazel upgrades, Kotlin and Android toolchain upgrades, and dependency-automation (Gazelle) rollouts as coordinated, low-disruption initiatives.

  • Shrink the workload, not just speed it up: partner on smart test selection over the shared Bazel graph so each change runs only the tests it can affect, without sacrificing quality.

  • Define and track build health — latency, success rate, cache hit rate, and flakiness — and catch regressions before developers feel them.

  • Lead through influence: write design documents, set standards, mentor engineers, lead build incident response, and partner with Android Platform, CI Platform, and product teams to deliver improvements across the organization.

About the Team:

Core Build is Uber's centralized build platform team. We own the common build infrastructure — Bazel, Gazelle, build rules, client-side remote build caching and execution, and shared build/test CI pipelines — across Uber's Java, Go, Android, iOS, and Web monorepos.

Our vision is simple: make builds fast with less friction. Because the stack is shared, an improvement we make once benefits every engineer at Uber.

We work across three pillars:

  • Velocity: Make builds faster everywhere with fewer resources — in CI, remote development environments, and on laptops — through caching, remote execution, sharding, and build-graph optimization.

  • Reliability & Diagnosability: A build failure should never leave an engineer stranded. Every failure should communicate what failed, how to fix it, and who can help.

  • Modernization, Unification & Scale: Keep the platform on the latest Bazel, maximize CI fleet utilization with smart test selection and build-graph pruning, and apply GenAI/ML to automate diagnosis and optimization.

Our next major initiative is to stop compiling the same code thousands of times: make mobile builds remote-first, so a local build becomes a download rather than a compile, and run only the tests a change can actually affect.

As the Staff Android Engineer on the team, you will be the technical owner for the Android side of this roadmap.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of full-time engineering experience.

  • Systematic problem-solving approach and knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis.

  • Strong understanding of Android development.

Preferred Technical Skills:

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Bazel (or Buck) for Android builds: Starlark rules, rules_android / rules_kotlin, build-graph and dependency management.

  • Remote build caching and remote execution (Remote Execution API; e.g., Buildbarn, BuildBuddy, EngFlow).

  • Android build internals: Gradle, D8/R8, resource processing, and Kotlin compiler / annotation-processing performance.

  • CI systems at scale (e.g., Buildkite): sharding, test orchestration, and flaky-test management.

  • Build performance analysis and observability (Bazel profiles, Build Event Protocol, metrics, and regression dashboards).

  • Leading large-scale build migrations or upgrades (e.g., Buck/Gradle to Bazel, Bazel major versions, bzlmod).

  • Tooling development in Kotlin/Java.

  • Applying LLMs/AI agents to developer tooling (e.g., automated build-failure diagnosis).

  • Cross-platform experience (Android and iOS).

title: Research Associate II, Pluvinage Lab
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets, accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

We are seeking a Research Associate to join the Pluvinage Lab at the Arc Institute. Our goal is to improve the lives of patients with neurological diseases. We do this by exploring undiagnosed autoimmunity in rare mystery cases and common neurodegenerative conditions alike. Starting with clinical observations and primary patient tissue, we use functional genomics, protein display technologies, and computational tools to embark on deep mechanistic dives into the contribution of autoimmunity to cognitive function. Your work will have the potential to uncover novel autoantibodies that drive cognitive decline in autoimmune encephalitis, that modulate cognitive decline in dementia, and that promote cognitive resilience in healthy brain aging.

The questions we ask:

  1. How do autoantibodies regulate cognition?
  2. What is the source, target, and mechanism of pathogenic autoantibodies in neurological disease?
  3. How can we eliminate pathogenic autoantibodies while leaving the rest of the immune system intact?
  4. How does comorbid autoimmunity contribute to cognitive decline in neurodegeneration?
  5. Are there protective autoantibodies that promote cognitive resilience in healthy brain aging?

The approaches we take: discovery-driven projects starting with human samples (cerebrospinal fluid, PBMCs, brain tissue) from curated cohorts of patients with neurological diseases, CRISPR screens, phage display, immune repertoire sequencing.

In this role, you will work closely with senior lab members to drive high-throughput antibody discovery in autoimmune neurology and neurodegeneration. You will contribute across the full experimental workflow: designing constructs and libraries, cloning and validating reagents, executing screens across several protein display technologies, and analyzing and validating discoveries. This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys both the precision of molecular biology and the challenge of making complex discovery workflows reproducible and scalable. Your work will help advance new diagnostic approaches from bench to bedside.

About you

  • You are detail-oriented and rigorous, taking pride in well-designed experiments, reliable reagents, and reproducible results.
  • You are curious and self-motivated, with a strong foundation in molecular biology and an eagerness to learn new protein display and antibody discovery technologies.
  • You enjoy working across an entire experimental workflow, from sequence design and cloning to screening and data analysis.
  • You are organized and able to manage multiple experiments while maintaining careful sample tracking and documentation.
  • You collaborate closely with others, communicate results and challenges openly, and troubleshoot thoughtfully.
  • You are passionate about translating discoveries into better diagnostics for patients with neurological disease.
  • You explicitly wish to use this experience to gain entry into a PhD program and are able to provide a minimum 2-year commitment to build a portfolio of work to support you in that endeavor.

In this position you will

  • Build Discovery Reagents: Work with senior lab members to design DNA constructs and protein display libraries; perform molecular cloning, sequence verification, and quality control of constructs and libraries.
  • Execute High-Throughput Screens: Prepare reagents and patient samples, carry out antibody discovery and antigen-identification workflows across multiple protein display platforms, and maintain rigorous controls and sample tracking throughout.
  • Analyze and Validate Discoveries: Process screening data using established analysis workflows, assess data quality and reproducibility, and work with senior lab members to prioritize hits and validate antibody–antigen interactions using complementary assays.
  • Develop and Optimize Workflows: Work with senior lab members to troubleshoot experiments, compare assay conditions, and help improve the sensitivity, specificity, throughput, and reproducibility of discovery methods.
  • Maintain Research Quality: Keep complete experimental records, document protocols and analysis steps, and maintain organized inventories of samples, constructs, libraries, and reagents.
  • Contribute to a Collaborative Lab: Communicate progress at lab meetings, coordinate experiments with senior lab members and collaborators, and contribute to shared lab operations, equipment maintenance, and protocol training.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, immunology, genetics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant laboratory experience.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in an academic or industry setting (including independent lab work during your undergraduate studies).
  • Hands-on research experience in molecular biology
  • Demonstrated ability to execute multistep experimental protocols accurately, use appropriate controls, and maintain clear and complete laboratory records.
  • Growth mindset to stretch your scientific skillset in a supportive environment, and the awareness to know when to ask for help.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, including careful tracking of samples, reagents, and experimental conditions.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently on established workflows and collaboratively with senior scientists.
  • Commitment to rigorous, reproducible research and a strong interest in antibody discovery and its diagnostic applications.

The base salary for this position is $75,900. This amount does not include benefits or other forms of compensation.

title: Sr Dairy Lending Specialist
description:

The contributions you will make:

This position is responsible for developing and growing new business through counseling and servicing of existing clients while pursuing new loan sales development opportunities with prospective clients. The skills and experience we prefer you have:
