title: Korva-, nenä- ja kurkkutautien erikoislääkäriksi Terveystaloon
location: Helsinki; Kotka; Espoo; Vantaa; Salo; Hämeenlinna; Kokkola
description:
Korvalääkäriksi Terveystaloon!

Haluamme tarjota knk-lääkäreillemme kollegiaalisen työympäristön, jossa kasvaa ja kehittyä ammattilaisena. Meille on tärkeää, että osaajillamme on käytössä hyvät työvälineet ja työnteon tavat sekä alamme viimeisin tutkittu tieto. Oma lääkäriasiakkuusvastaavasi varmistaa arkesi sujuvuuden ja sen, että voit keskittyä täysillä potilaidesi hoitamiseen.

Tällä hetkellä etsimme korvalääkäreitä erityisesti seuraaviin toimipaikkoihimme:

  • Kamppi
    Joka päivä klo 18 jälkeen.
  • Itäkeskus
    Tiistaisin ja keskiviikkoisin aamut klo 8-14.
  • Kotka
    Yksikkö auki ma-pe klo 8-20 ja la-su klo 9-13. Vastaanotto joustavasti miten itsellesi sopii.
  • Iso Omena
    Perjantaisin klo 8-20 välillä, miten itsellesi sopii.
  • Tikkurila
    Parittomien viikkojen tiistai-illat ja keskiviikkoiltaisin.
  • Salo
    Joustavasti, miten itsellesi sopii.
  • Kokkola
    Ke, to tai pe joustavasti, miten itsellesi sopii,
  • Hämeenlinna
    Joka toinen keskiviikko, torstai ja perjantai.

Meillä Terveystalossa pääset säännöllisesti kouluttautumaan ja pitämään yllä omaa ammattitaitoasi. Laajan vastaanottotoiminnan lisäksi pääset halutessasi tekemään monipuolisesti erikoisalan toimenpiteitä ja vaativiakin leikkauksia sairaalayksiköissämme, joita löytyy ympäri Suomen. Asiakaskuntasi voit koostaa monipuolisesti eri asiakasryhmistä aina lapsista työikäisiin ja ikääntyneisiin, kuten myös eri kanavia pitkin ohjautuvista asiakkaista.

Terveystalo Kampissa työskentelevä korvalääkäri Karin Blomgren kuvailee Terveystaloa työntekopaikkana: "Työn monipuolisuuden lisäksi Terveystalossa työskentelyn vahvuuksia on esimerkiksi potilaskeskeisyys: kaikki ammattilaiset ovat sitoutuneita työhön. Ratkaisuja etsitään yhdessä, ja kaikki asiat pyritään aina järjestämään potilaalle parhain päin. Teenkin paljon yhteistyötä sairaanhoitajien, audionomien, vastaanottoavustajien ja röntgenhoitajien sekä oman ja muiden erikoisalojen lääkäreiden kanssa. Meillä on talossa mahtavia ammattilaisia, ja yhteistyö on sujuvaa.” Tutustu Karinin työhön tarkemmin artikkelissa.

Kiinnostuitko meillä työskentelystä?

Jätä yhteystietosi hakupainikkeen kautta tai ole suoraan yhteydessä minuun henry.kolehmainen@terveystalo.com / 050 533 6118 niin suunnitellaan juuri sinulle sopiva kokonaisuus

title: Head of Client Experience
location: Dallas, Texas, United States; Indianapolis, Indiana, United States; Phoenix, Arizona, United States
description:
About Allworth Financial

Allworth Financial (www.allworthfinancial.com) is an independent investment advisory firm providing full-context wealth planning solutions. The firm brings together investment, tax, retirement, estate, and other financial considerations to help clients evaluate decisions in the context of their whole financial lives.

Founded in Sacramento, California, in 1993, Allworth Financial is a high-growth, private equity-backed, multibranch registered investment adviser. Allworth is primarily a fee-based fiduciary advisory firm that emphasizes client well-being and education. The firm continues to expand through acquisitions and organic growth.

Allworth is a great place to work and build a career. The firm ranks among the top 15 on Barron’s Top 100 RIA Firms list, has a historical client retention rate of 97%, and is a National Business Research Institute (NBRI) Circle of Excellence Award winner. Learn more at AllworthFinancial.com.

The Head of Client Experience owns the firmwide strategy for how clients experience Allworth across advice, service, communications, events, technology, and relationship touchpoints. This leader defines the desired client experience, sets service standards, aligns cross-functional partners, and ensures the firm continuously improves the client journey as it grows.

Our vision is a client experience that is personal, proactive, seamless, and consistently excellent across the firm, where every client feels known, valued, and confident that Allworth understands their goals, anticipates their needs, and brings the full strength of the firm to help them make better decisions for their life, family, and legacy. This is a new, high-visibility role: the opportunity to build and lead a function that protects the intimacy of a boutique advisory relationship while delivering enterprise-level consistency, measurement, and scale.

Duties and Responsibilities

Strategy and Governance

  • Define the Client Experience vision, strategy, roadmap, and annual priorities.
  • Own the firmwide client experience charter and operating model.
  • Lead Client Experience governance across advisory teams, operations, technology, marketing, compliance, investments, and planning.
  • Prioritize client experience initiatives based on business impact, client need, and advisor-team adoption.

Service Model and Standards

  • Define the client service model by segment, in partnership with leadership, advisors, operations, and planning, so every client receives a clear, intentional experience appropriate to their value, complexity, and needs.
  • Establish standards for onboarding, responsiveness, client meetings, follow-up, communications, events, escalation, and service recovery.
  • Standardize the firm’s response to the moments that matter to clients, such as onboarding, market volatility, retirement, death of a spouse, liquidity events, estate transitions, and business sales, and equip advisors to deliver them.

Voice of Client and Continuous Improvement

  • Oversee the Voice of Client program and ensure client feedback turns into action across leadership decisions, training, process improvement, technology investment, and advisor coaching.
  • Own CX measurement, including the CX dashboard, and report results and recommendations to senior leadership.

Engagement, Communications, and Events

  • Set the strategic direction for client communications, client events, and advisor-enabled growth programs, in partnership with Marketing and Advisory.

Team Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop the Client Experience team, including the Client Journey & Service Excellence, Voice of Client & CX Insights, and Client Engagement & Growth Programs functions.
  • Partner with Practice Management to train and support teams on CX standards, and with field champions to drive adoption across offices.
  • Protect the client experience as the firm integrates new offices and acquisitions.

Areas of Ownership

  • Owns: CX strategy, CX charter, CX dashboard, and cross-functional CX governance.
  • Owns strategy: Voice of Client program.
  • Owns direction: client service model, client journey standards, and client events and communications strategy.

Success Measures

Success in this role is demonstrated through higher client retention, stronger client satisfaction, more client referrals, greater share of wallet, improved advisor capacity, and better service consistency across offices, teams, and segments.

Experience and Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of experience leading client experience, client service strategy, or client journey transformation in wealth management, financial services, or another high-trust, relationship-driven business.
  • Demonstrated experience designing segmented service models, client journeys, service standards, and “moments that matter” across the client lifecycle.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional work across operations, technology, marketing, compliance, planning, and leadership.
  • Experience using client feedback, data, and performance measures to prioritize improvements and demonstrate impact.
  • Experience leading and developing teams, including building a new function.
  • Strong communication and change leadership skills, with the ability to build alignment and adoption across advisors and client-facing teams.
  • Credibility with advisors and client-facing teams, with a practical appreciation for operational realities.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

title: Head of Global Procure to Pay (P2P)
description:

Key Responsibilities

Global AP Management

  • Oversee the global accounts payable function, ensuring timely and accurate processing of vendor payables across US, EMEA, and APAC entities.
    • Manage vendor invoice intake, approval workflows, validation, coding, and processing

Compliance & Controls

  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, company policies, and regulatory requirements across all regions

  • Implement and monitor segregation of duties and approval hierarchies
  • Manage audit requirements and support internal/external audits
  • Ensure tax compliance including 1099 reporting and VAT/GST requirements
  • Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for all transactions

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify and implement process improvements and efficiencies within the AP function to streamline operations and reduce costs.

  • Drive automation initiatives including e-invoicing, workflow automation, and touchless processing

System Implementation:

  • Lead the implementation of new systems and tools to enhance AP processes, including automation and digital transformation initiatives.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes
  • Provide accrual reporting and analysis for outstanding liabilities
  • Monitor aging reports and resolve outstanding items
  • Support budgeting and forecasting activities with spend data and analysis

Stakeholder Management and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Director of Global Shared Services and Transformation, as well as other departments such as teams that undertake procurement, finance, and IT, to align AP processes with broader business objectives.
  • Serve as primary point of contact for P2P-related inquiries

Leadership and Management:

  • Proven experience managing a global accounts payable function, including leading geographically dispersed teams across US, UK and APAC.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop high-performing teams.

Technical Expertise:

  • In-depth knowledge of accounts payable processes, systems, and best practices.
  • Experience with ERP systems (eg NetSuite, SAP, Oracle or similar) and AP automation tools.
  • Familiarity with global payment processes, including multi-currency transactions and regional compliance requirements
  • Experience maintaining SOX compliance for P2P processes and internal controls

title: Director of Data Center Construction - Site Development
description:
Do you want to work with high-caliber professionals in a dynamic and growing company? Are you entrepreneurial, hard-working, and collegial? Join us at SB Energy, a leading infrastructure company backed by SoftBank Group and Ares Infrastructure, pairing cutting-edge innovation with best-in-class execution. Our mission is to deliver reliable and secure data center and power infrastructure to strengthen America's future.

Founded in 2019, SB Energy is a SoftBank Group company headquartered in Redwood City, California. In 2026, SoftBank Group and OpenAI announced a $1 billion investment to support SB Energy as their leading development and execution partner for data center campuses, while Ares Infrastructure continues its long-standing support of the company's growth. SB Energy develops, builds, owns, and operates some of the largest and most technically advanced energy and data center infrastructure projects in the United States. Since its founding, the company has rapidly grown into a top-tier integrated platform with more than 3 gigawatts (GW) in operation and a multi-GW pipeline of energy and data center infrastructure nationwide.

SB Energy also leverages a strong culture of innovation to identify and integrate new technologies into its projects, including its AI-based digital platform, delivering energy infrastructure that is local, reliable, and matched to load. We are building the energy and infrastructure future—today.

Come join us in accelerating the energy and infrastructure transition!

Basic Function

The Project Director is responsible for leading the successful delivery of hyperscale data center campuses (1GW–8GW+) through a highly collaborative, integrated approach.

This leader is not only accountable for outcomes—schedule, cost, safety, and quality—but also serves as the central facilitator across development, design, construction, and operations, ensuring alignment among diverse stakeholders including internal teams, general contractors, trade partners, utilities, and customers.

Success in this role is defined by the ability to provide leadership, create clarity, foster trust, and orchestrate execution across a complex ecosystem.

In addition to driving project execution, the Director champions SB Energy’s culture—leading with ownership, accountability, collaboration, and a commitment to continuous improvement while building and mentoring high performing teams.

The Director will also lead site development planning and execution, partnering with development, real estate, engineering, and utility teams to advance sites from due diligence through construction readiness. This includes evaluating site constraints, coordinating entitlement and permitting activities, and overseeing site preparation and enabling infrastructure to support phased data center campus delivery and future expansion.

Responsibilities

Program Leadership

  • Lead multi-GW campus delivery by aligning cross-functional teams around shared goals, milestones, and constraints.
  • Establish a culture of transparency, accountability, and proactive communication.
  • Facilitate decision-making across stakeholders, ensuring issues are surfaced early and resolved collaboratively.
  • Translate executive strategy into clear, executable plans that can be effectively presented to leadership and communicated across all teams.
  • Ensure program provides incentive structure that ensures exceptional project outcomes with respect to cost, schedule, quality and overall execution.

Collaborative Execution & Team Integration

  • Act as the integration point across development, engineering, procurement, construction and operations.
  • Foster strong partnerships with general contractors and key trade partners, treating them as extensions of the core team.
  • Lead structured coordination forums (e.g., multi-GC alignment meetings, pull-planning sessions, interface workshops) and present measurable progress against agreed milestones using current schedules, dashboards, and documented action tracking.
  • Break down silos and ensure seamless information flow across disciplines.
  • Integrate the customer to the greatest extent without.

Execution Strategy & Phasing

  • Co-develop phased deployment strategies with internal and external partners (e.g., 100MW–300MW increments).
  • Align construction sequencing with utility delivery, procurement timelines, and customer commitments.
  • Facilitate collaborative schedule development (Last Planner System, pull planning, etc.)
  • Drive shared ownership of critical path milestones, track planned versus actual progress, and present schedule performance, risks, and recovery plans to leadership and project stakeholders.

Site Development & Infrastructure Delivery

  • Lead site development execution for large-scale data center campuses, including clearing, demolition where required, mass grading, earthwork, ground improvement, drainage, access roads, and underground utilities.
  • Partners with development and real estate teams on site feasibility and due diligence, evaluating geotechnical conditions, topography, environmental constraints, floodplain exposure, access, easements, and utility availability to identify cost, schedule, and constructability risks.
  • Oversee civil engineering and campus infrastructure planning, ensuring building pads, finished grades, stormwater systems, road networks, and utility corridors support phased construction and long-term campus expansion.
  • Coordinate with development, environmental, and permitting teams to align zoning, entitlements, site development approvals, and permit conditions with early works and construction milestones.
  • Coordinate with utility providers and internal infrastructure teams to confirm capacity, routing, connection points, and delivery schedules for power, water, wastewater, and telecommunications.
  • Direct civil contractors and early works packages, establishing clear scopes, budgets, schedules, and handoff requirements between site development and vertical construction teams.
  • Integrate off-site infrastructure improvements, including road access and utility extensions, into the overall campus delivery plan.
  • Establish and verify site readiness milestones for each construction phase, including approved permits, prepared building pads, construction access, temporary utilities, drainage, and laydown areas.

Construction & Field Leadership

  • Lead large, distributed teams by empowering field leaders while maintaining alignment to program objectives.
  • Promote a culture where field insights inform decision-making at all levels.
  • Ensure site logistics, productivity, and sequencing are collectively owned and continuously optimized.
  • Encourage cross-contractor collaboration rather than competition.

Commercial & Contract Strategy (Partnership-Focused)

  • Structure contracts that incentivize collaboration, performance, and shared success.
  • Lead commercial discussions with a solutions-oriented mindset, balancing risk and partnership.
  • Facilitate resolution of changes, claims, and disputes through alignment and transparency.
  • Ensure financial decisions support long-term program success—not just short-term outcomes.

Design & Preconstruction Integration

  • Lead integrated design and preconstruction efforts with a focus on constructability, scalability, and repeatability.
  • Facilitate value engineering sessions that leverage input from all stakeholders.
  • Ensure design decisions are informed by real-world execution constraints.
  • Promote standardization while allowing flexibility where needed.

Supply Chain & Procurement Coordination

  • Align procurement strategies with construction sequencing and program priorities.
  • Engage contractors and vendors early to ensure feasibility and buy-in.
  • Facilitate coordination across global supply chain stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate procurement risks through collaboration.

Commissioning & Turnover

  • Lead commissioning strategy with strong coordination between construction and operations teams.
  • Ensure all parties are aligned on readiness criteria and turnover expectations.
  • Facilitate integrated system testing and issue resolution.
  • Deliver facilities that are operationally ready and meet customer expectations.

Safety & Risk Culture

  • Champion a shared safety culture across all contractors and teams.
  • Facilitate open dialogue around risks, near misses, and lessons learned.
  • Lead program-level risk workshops and mitigation planning.
  • Ensure safety and risk management are collective responsibilities.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as a trusted partner to executives, customers, utilities, and regulatory agencies.
  • Communicate program status, risks, and opportunities with clarity and transparency.
  • Build long-term relationships that support future growth and collaboration.
  • Represent the program as a unified effort—not a collection of silos.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience managing data centers, or other large-scale capital construction projects.
  • 15+ years of professional experience in related fields.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing multiple complex projects and EPC contractors
    simultaneously.
  • Strong financial acumen with expertise in capital budgeting, forecasting, and contract management.
  • Experience in multi-prime, design-build, or alternative procurement delivery models preferred.
  • Proficiency in MS Office Suite, Primavera P6, MS Project, Monday.com, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), or similar project management tools.
  • Deep understanding of CSA and MEP construction management principles.
  • Experience interfacing with utilities, permitting authorities, lenders, and independent engineers.
  • Ability to travel 50-60% as needed.
  • Demonstrated experience leading site development and civil infrastructure delivery for large-scale data center, industrial, energy, or similarly complex campus projects.
  • Experience advancing greenfield sites from due diligence and preconstruction through site preparation, infrastructure installation, and turnover to vertical construction teams.
  • Strong understanding of civil site design, mass grading, earthwork, geotechnical conditions, ground improvement, stormwater management, underground utilities, and roadway construction.
  • Experience coordinating zoning, entitlements, site development permits, easements, and off-site infrastructure requirements with internal development teams, local authorities, and utility providers.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage civil contractors and consultants, including early works scope development, cost estimating, procurement, schedule management, and phased site turnover.

Location: Ohio, near the PORTS-Pike site in Piketon, OH.

Base Pay - $190,000 - $240,000

The pay range mentioned above is a guideline. We tailor each offer based on your unique skills, experience, location, and market benchmarks—while ensuring internal parity across our teams. The compensation range provided reflects base pay. Total rewards may also include performance-based bonuses, equity grants, and a market leading comprehensive health and wellness benefits package. Final details will be discussed during the later stages of the hiring process.

Our Health & Wellness Benefits

At SB Energy, we invest in our people and their families with benefits designed for flexibility, support, and peace of mind. Full-time employees enjoy:

  • 100% Company-Paid Medical, Dental & Vision (for employees and dependents)
  • 401(k) with Company Match

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for Medical, Dependent Care, Transit & Parking (with company contributions)
  • Mental, Physical & Social Wellness Support (with company contributions)
  • Flexible Work Arrangements & Hybrid Office Setup Benefits
  • Monthly Reimbursement for Phone, Internet & Data
  • Optional Legal & Pet Insurance Plans
  • Device Purchase Support

At SB Energy, the success of our projects is driven by a desire to see our projects benefit as many people as possible. We work to serve local communities through volunteering, fundraising, and much more. For example, we’re proud to support access and opportunity in engineering and clean energy through impactful mentorship programs and workforce training. When you join SB Energy, you can become a part of these efforts, collaborating with team members who share a vision of building a better future now!

title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Solutions & AI
location: San Francisco, California, United States; Seattle, Washington, United States
description:
Hubble Network was founded with the intention of delivering on the promise of what Internet-of-Things (IoT) was supposed to be. We're building a global Bluetooth® network dedicated to machine-to-machine connectivity. We differentiate ourselves as the first modem-less and gateway-less, direct-to-satellite network from off-the-shelf Bluetooth® Low Energy chips. Hubble is ideal for applications in logistics, AgTech, and maritime where economies of scale for volume consumer and enterprise asset tracking is a priority. Our goal is to be the first billion-endpoint-connected network in the world.

Hubble is an early-stage, venture-backed startup supported by some of the best investors in the world. In their previous lives, the founding team has been successful in raising $100s of millions in venture funding, developing the Amazon Sidewalk network, launching billions of dollars of space assets, and leading their teams to successful exits, both through acquisition and IPO. We are now looking to bring on talented team members who are the best at what they do to help us make Hubble a reality for the world.

This role will be a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own two connected areas of Hubble Network's product: data and AI-driven capabilities, and vertical solutions. On the data and AI side, this role owns how Hubble turns device, location, and network signals into insights customers act on, such as predictive alerts, anomaly detection, and operational analytics. On the vertical side, this role owns the customer experience for specific use cases such as cold chain, pallet and returnable-asset polling, and tool and equipment monitoring: the capabilities, workflows, and UX each vertical needs, built on a shared core platform.

You will work across product, design, engineering, legal, security, GTM, and customers. A core part of the role is partnering with GTM to decide which verticals Hubble serves and when. The ideal candidate combines data and AI product depth, strong UX and workflow judgment, commercial judgment, and a practical understanding of data quality, privacy, security, and ML workflows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITES

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Hubble's data and AI-driven product capabilities
  • Identify where data and AI can create differentiated value for customers, such as predictive alerts, anomaly detection, and operational insights
  • Define requirements for data collection, normalization, metadata, quality, lineage, and documentation
  • Establish product requirements for privacy, security, access controls, and data governance that protect customer trust
  • Partner with Legal and Security on privacy and compliance
  • Define how insights reach customers through dashboards, alerts, APIs, and integrations
  • Develop packaging and pricing for data and AI-driven features
  • Validate demand directly with customers and prospects
  • Create metrics for data quality, feature adoption, retention, and revenue impact
  • Partner with GTM to decide which verticals to pursue and in what order, based on pipeline, deal size, win/loss data, competitive position, technical fit, and reuse across verticals
  • Define the capability set for each priority vertical, for example temperature excursion alerts and chain-of-custody reporting for cold chain; dwell time, cycle counts, and loss detection for pallet polling; utilization, geofencing, and theft alerts for tool monitoring
  • Own the UX of verticalization, including vertical dashboards, alerting, onboarding, terminology, and reporting, and decide which elements are configured per vertical and which stay shared in the core platform
  • Decide when a vertical need calls for a new capability, a configuration of existing ones, or a partner integration, so the platform does not split into one-off builds
  • Turn field feedback, win/loss analysis, and customer requests into vertical requirements, packaging, and sales enablement
  • Connect vertical solutions to the data and AI roadmap, such as predictive features and anomaly detection for each vertical

AN IDEAL CANDIDATE MEETS OUR VALUES

  • A Sense of Urgency: Lead projects from concept to reality, rapidly and effectively
  • First Principles Engineering: Have a strong understanding of the whys behind the" what's"; have the ability to extrapolate from first principles to complex system design
  • High Learning Agility: Love to learn; have a grounded approach to recognizing your weaknesses and take the initiative to brush up on and sharpen your engineering foundations to better collaborate with your teammates with different backgrounds
  • System-Level Design and Analysis: Understand the requirements flow down process and be able to quickly iterate on evolving requirements
  • Excellent Communication Skills: Effectively convey ideas and communicate technical topics with engineering, build staff, and operations; run self-directed design reviews and participate in reviews of parallel systems
  • Anticipation of Needs: Identify problems, think creatively, and rapidly produce reliable and cost-effective solutions to meet the ever growing and changing needs of an early-stage company

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8+ years of product management experience in data and AI products, analytics, IoT, or B2B SaaS platforms
  • Experience shipping data or AI/ML-powered capabilities that customers rely on in their daily operations
  • Strong understanding of data quality, metadata, lineage, privacy, and access controls
  • Experience working with legal and security teams on data privacy and governance
  • Ability to engage credibly with data scientists, ML engineers, platform engineers, and business-development teams
  • Strong commercial judgment around packaging and pricing
  • Experience defining APIs, integrations, or enterprise data workflows
  • Comfort operating in an ambiguous, early-stage market and validating demand directly with buyers
  • Experience building vertical or industry-specific products on top of a horizontal platform, ideally in IoT, logistics, supply chain, or asset tracking
  • Strong UX judgment, with a track record of shipping workflow-heavy B2B dashboards, alerting, and reporting for operations users
  • Experience partnering with sales and GTM leaders on segment prioritization, market sizing, and launch planning
  • All applicants must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents (“green card holders”) as defined by ITAR (22 CFR §120.15)

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
💰 Salary: $126,000-$235,000 (commensurate with experience)
🩺 Comprehensive Benefits – Health, Dental, Vision, & HSA options
🌍 Unlimited PTO
🚇 Commuter Benefits (if working from HQ)
🎓 Learning & Development Allowance
💪 Health & Wellness Stipend
🌎 Sabbatical Program – Recharge and explore new ideas
🛠 Cutting-Edge Space Tech – Work on state-of-the-art satellite system

Final level placement and corresponding compensation will be determined through the interview and assessment process, taking into consideration factors such as the candidate's relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and geographical location.

title: IT Helpdesk Technician
description:
Title: IT Helpdesk Technician

Location: Hybrid, Primarily In-Office (North Bethesda, MD)

Reports To: IT Manager

Expion Health is building the future of pharmacy economics. As architects of prescription economics, we design how pharmacy value is created - aligning cost, clinical decisions, and performance into one accountable system that moves beyond rebates. We help organizations stay ahead of market change with clear insight, bold thinking, and strategies built for what's next.

The Role

You'll be the friendly, capable face of IT - the first call when something isn't working and the reason your colleagues walk away with their day back on track. While this is a hybrid position based primarily in our North Bethesda office, you'll support our team in person and back up remote employees across the country, troubleshooting hardware, software, and network issues with patience and skill. Whether you're setting up a new hire's laptop, walking a remote teammate through a fix over chat, or spotting patterns that point to a bigger improvement, your work directly shapes how productive and supported our people feel every day.

You'll be on site 2 to 3 days a week, with in-office days rotating among members of the IT team. Occasionally, such as for in-person events, additional on-site days may be needed, up to 5 days a week.

What You'll Do

  • Provide hands-on and remote technical support across the organization
  • Respond to user requests by phone, email, and ticketing system with professionalism and care
  • Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network issues
  • Walk users through clear, step-by-step solutions
  • Escalate the trickier puzzles to senior team members when needed
  • Document issues and resolutions to make life easier for the whole team
  • Create and maintain knowledgebase articles in FreshService
  • Maintain inventory of IT equipment and keep records accurate
  • Support onsite equipment like monitors, TVs, tablets, and printers
  • Own onboarding and offboarding - account provisioning and de-provisioning in Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (including license assignment), device setup and distribution, device retrieval, and re-deployment
  • Manage ongoing user account needs in Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, including password resets, MFA support, group membership, and license changes
  • Install, configure, and maintain computer systems and applications, including device enrollment and support through Intune and Iru

What We're Looking For

  • Associate's degree in IT or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 1–3 years in a helpdesk or technical support role
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting instincts
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Comfort working independently and as part of a hybrid team

Systems Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including SharePoint and OneDrive
  • Familiarity with Zscaler (ZIA - Internet Access, ZPA - Private Access and ZDX - Digital Experience)
  • Hands-on experience with mobile device management (MDM) solutions, such as Microsoft Intune and Iru
  • Familiarity with AI assistants such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot
  • Experience with service desk platforms for ticketing and knowledgebase management (FreshService preferred)

Other Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP)
  • Familiarity with network hardware, particularly Ubiquiti equipment
  • Familiarity with network video recorders, particularly Ubiquiti equipment
  • Proficiency with operating systems: Windows 11, macOS 26/27, and iPadOS 26/27

Bonus points for

  • Experience supporting hybrid workforces and remote collaboration tools
  • Familiarity with IT asset management and inventory platforms
  • Experience with Active Directory and identity management tools, including SSO, MFA, and conditional access policies in Microsoft Entra ID
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and endpoint protection
  • A knack for writing clear technical documentation and user guides
  • Genuine customer-service mindset, especially with non-technical users

Why Expion, Why Now

Pharmacy economics is at an inflection point, and the organizations getting it right are the ones moving fastest. Expion is leaning into that moment - investing in our technology, our people, and the tools that make our teams faster, smarter, and more connected. That's where you come in. As we scale, our employees need IT support that's responsive, thoughtful, and ready to grow with them. This role isn't about closing tickets in the background; it's about being a visible, valued partner who keeps our workforce moving so that we can focus on the work that changes the industry.

Our values say it best: Build boldly, improve relentlessly. If that resonates with how you want to work, we want to talk.

Benefits & Perks

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance
  • HSA & FSA options
  • Short & long-term disability
  • Life Insurance and AD&D
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid Time Off
  • Phone & internet allowance
  • Wellness benefits, including access to GLP-1 weight loss program
  • Town halls & direct access to executive leadership
  • A company that is genuinely investing in AI - and in you!

Expion Health is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Directeur de la stratégie produit et de la commercialisation | Director of Product Strategy and Commercialization
description:
À propos de TandemLaunch

TandemLaunch est un studio de création d'entreprises canadien. Depuis 2010, nous avons créé plus de 30 entreprises deep tech dont la valeur combinée du portefeuille dépasse 700 M$. Nous commercialisons des innovations en électronique grand public, en technologies matérielles, en apprentissage automatique et en systèmes embarqués, en travaillant directement avec des chercheuses et chercheurs issus de grands laboratoires universitaires. Nous sommes l'un des rares studios de création d'entreprises au monde à cumuler plus de 15 ans de succès dans la création d'entreprises bâties sur de la deep tech issue de la recherche.

À propos du poste

Nous recrutons une personne au poste de Directeur de la stratégie produit et de la commercialisation, qui portera la voix du produit et du marché au sein de plusieurs de nos entreprises à la fois.

Il s'agit d'entreprises dotées de technologies protégées par de la propriété intellectuelle issue de recherches universitaires de pointe, d'une équipe fondatrice, et qui font leurs premiers pas vers la traction commerciale. Votre rôle : appuyer nos équipes fondatrices pour cerner qui serait prêt à payer, obtenir les rencontres, mener la conversation de l'évaluation technique jusqu'au projet pilote payant ou au design win, puis réinjecter ces apprentissages dans ce que l'entreprise construira ensuite.

C'est un poste sur la voie du leadership, dont la réussite repose sur votre capacité à encadrer et à influencer des leaders en devenir. Vous vous joindrez à notre équipe de développement d'entreprises afin d'aider nos entreprises à atteindre la traction commerciale nécessaire pour décrocher leur prochaine ronde de financement.

Vos responsabilités

  • Piloter de bout en bout les relations clients et partenaires — de la première conversation à l'évaluation technique, jusqu'au projet pilote payant ou au design win. Vous trouvez l'acheteur, vous obtenez la rencontre et vous menez le dossier jusqu'à la vente, en collaboration avec les responsables de l'entreprise.
  • Piloter le positionnement produit et les outils clients qui le soutiennent — fiches produits, présentations, stratégies de démonstration — pour plusieurs entreprises en parallèle.
  • Transformer la voix du client en orientation produit. Vous êtes la personne qui aide l'entreprise à clarifier les raisons d'ajuster sa stratégie en fonction des besoins du marché, et qui réunit les données probantes qui le justifient.
  • Mener la découverte client et repérer le prochain marché — nouvelles applications et segments adjacents pour les entreprises qui commencent à gagner du terrain.
  • Représenter nos entreprises à l'externe : événements de l'industrie, rencontres avec des partenaires et conversations clients.
  • Encadrer les responsables de nos entreprises et travailler à leurs côtés, en tant que moitié commerciale de chaque équipe.

Profil recherché

Exigences

  • Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en développement des affaires, en gestion de produits ou en stratégie au sein d'une jeune entreprise
  • Vous avez déjà amené un produit technique jusqu'à un client payant : un bon de commande, un projet pilote payant, un design win signé, un contrat. Dites-nous de quoi il s'agissait, qui a acheté et à quel prix. Les subventions, le financement non dilutif, les enveloppes de maturation, les bourses d'accélérateur et les bourses de recherche ont tous de la valeur, mais l'expérience directe auprès de clients est essentielle.
  • Doctorat, M. Sc. ou M. Ing. — ou une aisance technique équivalente de niveau recherche. Vous pouvez tenir une véritable conversation avec des ingénieurs en matériel, des chercheurs en apprentissage automatique ou des physiciens, et les conseiller sur leur stratégie technologique.
  • Français et anglais professionnels.
  • Vous avez évolué dans l'ambiguïté — comme responsable de produit, chef de produit fondateur, cofondateur ou cofondatrice, ingénieur d'applications ou de solutions, ou première embauche commerciale d'une entreprise en démarrage.

Ce qui est aussi vrai des personnes qui s'épanouissent chez TandemLaunch

  • Une curiosité sincère pour les technologies inédites.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise d'élaborer une stratégie dans des environnements où l'information est rare.
  • Vous êtes honnête quant à ce que vous ne savez pas.

Vous pourriez venir de

La gestion de produit technique dans une entreprise de matériel ou d'apprentissage automatique · la première embauche commerciale d'une jeune entreprise deep tech · l'ingénierie d'applications ou de solutions · le marketing produit d'un produit technique · la vente technique ou le développement des affaires en matériel B2B · une équipe fondatrice où vous étiez responsable de la mise en marché.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Une place au sein de l'un des rares studios de création d'entreprises au monde à cumuler plus de 15 ans d'expérience éprouvée en deep tech.
  • Une exposition à l'ensemble du portefeuille — des entreprises en IA, capteurs, matériel, matériaux et audio dès votre première année.
  • Une participation aux retombées du fonds par l'entremise du régime d'intéressement des employés de TandemLaunch — un potentiel de valeur à long terme qui croît avec le portefeuille.
  • Le mentorat direct d'opérateurs : cofondateurs, responsables de produit et PDG de l'ensemble du portefeuille.
  • Une équipe bienveillante qui valorise la curiosité, l'initiative et la collaboration.

TandemLaunch s'engage à bâtir une communauté d'excellence, d'équité et de diversité. Nous encourageons les candidatures des femmes, des minorités sous-représentées, des personnes en situation de handicap, des communautés 2ELGBTQ+ ainsi que de toute personne dont les idées et les perspectives viendront enrichir les nôtres.

____________________________________________________________________

About TandemLaunch

TandemLaunch is a Canadian venture studio. Since 2010 we have created 30+ deep-tech ventures with a combined portfolio value exceeding $700M. We commercialize innovations in consumer electronics, hardware-enabled technologies, machine learning, and embedded systems, working directly with researchers from major university labs. We are one of very few venture studios globally with 15+ years of track record in building successful companies on research-backed deep tech.

About the Role

We are hiring a Director of Product Strategy and Commercialization to be the product-and-market voice inside several of our ventures at once.

These are companies with IP-backed technologies from cutting edge university research, a founding team, and on their first steps to commercial traction. Your job is to support our founders in identifying who would pay, get in front of them, carry the conversation through technical evaluation to a paid pilot or a design win, and feed what you learn back into what the venture builds next.

This is a leadership-track role that hinges on your ability to mentor and influence growing leaders. You will join our venture development team to help our ventures reach the necessary commercial traction to secure their next stage of financing.

What You'll Do

  • Own customer and partner engagements end-to-end — from first conversation, through technical evaluation, to a paid pilot or design win. You find the buyer, you get the meeting, you carry it to money in collaboration with the venture’s leads.
  • Own product positioning and the customer-facing materials that support it — product sheets, decks, demo strategies — across multiple ventures simultaneously.
  • Turn what customers tell you into product direction. You are the person who helps the venture clarify the reasons to adjust their strategy in response to market needs, and collect the evidence that justifies it.
  • Run customer discovery and find the next market — new applications and adjacent segments for ventures that are starting to get traction.
  • Represent ventures externally at industry events, partner meetings, and customer conversations.
  • Mentor and directly work alongside our venture leads as the commercial half of each venture team.

What We're Looking For

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in business development, product management, or strategy within a startup environment.
  • You have taken a technical product to a paying customer. A purchase order, a paid pilot, a signed design win, a contract. Tell us what it was, who bought it, and what they paid. Grants, non-dilutive funding, maturation envelopes, accelerator awards and research scholarships are all valuable, but direct customer engagement is critical.
  • PhD/M.Sc/M.Eng degree or equivalent research-level technical fluency. You can hold a real conversation with hardware engineers, ML researchers, or physicists — and are able to provide guidance on their technology strategy.
  • Professional French and English.
  • You have worked in ambiguity — as a product lead, founding PM, co-founder, applications or solutions engineer, or the first commercial hire at an early-stage company.

Also true of the people who thrive at TandemLaunch

  • Genuine curiosity about novel technology.
  • You are comfortable navigating low-information environments to develop a strategy.
  • You are honest about what you do not know.

You might be coming from

Technical product management at a hardware or ML company · the first commercial hire at a deep-tech startup · applications or solutions engineering · product marketing for a technical product · technical sales or business development in B2B hardware · a founding team where you owned go-to-market.

What We Offer

  • A seat at one of very few venture studios globally with 15+ years of track record in deep tech.
  • Cross-portfolio exposure — ventures spanning AI, sensors, hardware, materials and audio in your first year.
  • Participation in fund economics through TandemLaunch's employee incentive pool — long-term upside that grows with the portfolio.
  • Direct mentorship from operators — co-founders, product leads and CEOs across the portfolio.
  • A supportive team that values curiosity, initiative and collaboration.

TandemLaunch is committed to building a community of excellence, equity, and diversity. We welcome applications from women, underrepresented minorities, persons with disabilities, 2SLGBTQ+ communities, and other candidates who will enrich our ideas and perspectives.

Job Description

Job Title: Senior Maintenance and Utilities Technician
Location: Lexington, Massachusetts


About the role:

As a Senior Maintenance and Utilities Technician, you will work within the Site Engineering organization to ensure the safe, compliant, and reliable operation of critical process equipment, manufacturing systems, and utility infrastructure supporting Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) manufacturing operations. You will perform advanced maintenance, troubleshooting, operational monitoring, alarm response, and non-routine event triage to maintain plant readiness, maximize equipment reliability, and minimize risks to product supply, quality, safety, and regulatory compliance. Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Validation, and external service providers, you will take ownership of equipment performance, support operational continuity, and drive continuous improvement while maintaining high standards of safety, documentation, and compliance.


How you will contribute:

  • Respond to alarms, abnormal conditions, and non-routine equipment or utility events by assessing priorities, communicating operational impacts, and ensuring timely escalation, coordination, and documentation.
  • Serve as the primary operational contact during assigned shifts by triaging issues, screening calls, prioritizing responses, determining resource requirements, and coordinating support to minimize disruptions to manufacturing operations.
  • Monitor, maintain, and take ownership of process equipment and utility systems to ensure continuous plant readiness, proactively identifying and addressing performance deviations.
  • Execute maintenance and reliability activities in accordance with site safety requirements, current GMP (cGMP) standards, and regulatory expectations, including hazard assessments, proper personal protective equipment (PPE) use, and adherence to approved procedures.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely documentation, including work orders, logbooks, maintenance and calibration records, alarm and event reports, and other GMP records required to support compliant, audit-ready operations.
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Validation, contractors, vendors, and equipment manufacturers to troubleshoot issues, improve equipment reliability, and ensure work is completed safely, compliantly, and right-first-time.
  • Provide technical leadership, guidance, and knowledge transfer to peers and contractors, promoting accountability, collaboration, and high standards of workmanship.
  • Identify and support reliability and continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing equipment performance data and operational trends to strengthen maintenance strategies, improve equipment reliability, and reduce operational risk.
  • Support the maintenance, operation, and troubleshooting of process equipment and critical utility systems, including water for injection (WFI), reverse osmosis (RO), autoclaves, clean utilities, chromatography systems, ultrafiltration skids, and other GMP manufacturing support systems, as applicable.
  • Support inspection and audit readiness by maintaining compliant maintenance practices and documentation, using computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), and following site procedures for safety, confined space entry, and other assigned activities.

What you bring to Takeda:

  • High school diploma or equivalent with 4–8 years of relevant experience, or technical certification, associate degree, military technical training, or equivalent technical education in a related field with at least 3 years of relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated competency in maintaining, operating, and troubleshooting process equipment and critical utility systems, including WFI, RO, autoclaves, clean utilities, chromatography systems, ultrafiltration skids, and other GMP manufacturing support systems, as applicable.
  • Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for process and utility systems, with the ability to interpret technical documentation, including piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), equipment drawings, and technical manuals.
  • Strong understanding of cGMP requirements, maintenance documentation, regulatory compliance, and audit readiness, with demonstrated ownership of equipment performance, operational readiness, and work quality.
  • Proficiency in preventive and corrective maintenance execution and computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS), along with the ability to use digital tools and electronic business systems supporting procurement, safety, maintenance, and quality management.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, manage competing priorities in a dynamic environment, and collaborate effectively with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, contractors, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong commitment to safety, compliance, and continuous improvement, with the ability to guide peers and contractors. Ability to obtain and maintain an Industrial 1I or higher Massachusetts Wastewater Operator license as required by site needs, and to perform or support confined space entry activities when applicable and authorized. Ability to meet physical requirements, including wearing required PPE, gowning for pharmaceutical manufacturing areas, lifting, pushing, or pulling up to 50 pounds, standing for extended periods, climbing ladders and working from platforms, bending or stooping to troubleshoot equipment, handling approved site chemicals, and traveling or working across Massachusetts Bio Ops facilities as required.

Important Considerations

At Takeda, our patients rely on us to deliver quality products. As a result, we must follow strict rules in our manufacturing facilities to ensure we are not endangering the quality of the product. In this role, you may:

  • Work in a controlled environment requiring special gowning and wear protective clothing over the head, face, hands, feet and body. This may include additional hearing protection for loud areas.
  • Need to remove all make-up, jewelry, contact lenses, nail polish and/or artificial fingernails while in the manufacturing environment.
  • Work in a cold, wet environment.
  • Work multiple shifts, including weekends, or be asked to work supplemental hours, as necessary.
  • Work around chemicals such as alcohol, acids, buffers and Celite that may require respiratory protection.

This is an on-site role in Lexington, Massachusetts, required to support GMP manufacturing operations, plant readiness, and shift coverage needs.


More about us:

At Takeda, we are transforming patient care through the development of novel specialty pharmaceuticals and best in class patient support programs. Takeda is a patient-focused company that will inspire and empower you to grow through life-changing work.

Certified as a Global Top Employer, Takeda offers stimulating careers, encourages innovation, and strives for excellence in everything we do. We foster an inclusive, collaborative workplace, in which our teams are united by an unwavering commitment to deliver Better Health and a Brighter Future to people around the world.

title: Nutanix Engineer / Networking IT Support Engineer (Break & Fix Support) - Israel
description:
Nutanix Engineer / Networking IT Support Engineer (Break & Fix Support)

Location: Israel

Employment Type: Freelance (On-Call Basis)

Priority: Low

Requirements: ID/ Passport/ valid work permit and CCNA Certification

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Nutanix Engineer / Networking IT Support Engineer to provide Break & Fix support services across enterprise infrastructure environments. This freelance, on-call role requires a highly skilled professional who can diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, network, and infrastructure-related incidents efficiently while maintaining a high level of customer service and professionalism.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in Nutanix and networking technologies, hold a valid CCNA certification, and demonstrate excellent communication skills with fluent English proficiency.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide onsite and remote Break & Fix support for networking and infrastructure-related incidents.

* Deploy, configure, and manage Nutanix HCI environments (AOS, AHV, Prism).

* Perform system upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management activities.

* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, virtualization, and network issues.

* Diagnose and resolve network connectivity problems involving TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and related technologies.

* Implement and support backup and disaster recovery solutions.

* Respond to critical incidents and service requests within agreed response times.

* Collaborate with global and regional teams on infrastructure and cloud-related projects.

* Maintain accurate technical documentation, incident reports, and service records.

* Ensure professional interaction with end users, stakeholders, and customers at all times.

Required Skills & Experience

* Minimum 5 years of experience in infrastructure, virtualization, networking, or IT support engineering.

* Strong hands-on experience with the Nutanix ecosystem (AOS, AHV, Prism).

* Experience supporting VMware and/or Hyper-V environments.

* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, and switching.

* Proven experience providing Break & Fix support in enterprise environments.

* Ability to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure and networking issues.

* Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions.

* Scripting experience with PowerShell and/or Python is advantageous.

Mandatory Requirements

* Valid CCNA Certification (Cisco Certified Network Associate).

Preferred Qualifications

* Nutanix Certification (NCP or equivalent).

Soft Skills

* Strong professionalism and customer-facing skills.

* Ability to remain calm and effective during critical incidents.

* Proactive problem-solving mindset.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Ability to work collaboratively within distributed teams.

* Commitment to delivering high-quality technical support and customer satisfaction.

title: Executive Coordinator
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description

OBJECTIVES/PURPOSE


The Executive Coordinator enables assigned Global Medical senior leaders and their leadership teams to operate at a high level of effectiveness by providing comprehensive executive support, operational coordination, and administrative services.


The role serves as a trusted administrative partner who develops a strong understanding of leadership priorities, preferences, stakeholders, and operating rhythms. The Executive Coordinator proactively manages complex calendars, travel, expenses, meetings, communications, leadership-team activities, and executive priorities.


The role anticipates needs, exercises sound judgment, and coordinates work across a highly matrixed global environment while maintaining the highest standards of confidentiality, professionalism, and service.


The Executive Coordinator embraces modern ways of working and leverages AI-enabled and digital tools to strengthen executive effectiveness, administrative quality, and operational efficiency.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

A) Executive & Leadership Team Support

  • Serve as a trusted administrative partner to assigned senior leaders, developing a detailed understanding of their priorities, preferences, stakeholders, and ways of working.
  • Manage complex executive calendars, resolve conflicts, prioritize competing demands, and protect leadership time in alignment with business priorities.
  • Coordinate meetings across functions, regions, time zones, and external organizations.
  • Arrange complex domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, detailed itineraries, and contingency planning.
  • Prepare, reconcile, and track travel expense reports for assigned leaders in accordance with applicable company policies and processes.
  • Prepare leaders for key meetings by coordinating materials, stakeholder inputs, scheduling requirements, and logistical details.
  • Anticipate upcoming needs, deadlines, scheduling conflicts, and operational risks, taking proactive action or escalating issues as appropriate.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, representing the executive office with professionalism, judgment, and discretion.

B) Administrative & Operational Support

  • Provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to assigned senior leaders and their leadership teams.
  • Coordinate leadership priorities across functions and regions, ensuring meetings, materials, communications, and follow-up activities remain aligned.
  • Maintain organized systems for executive information, meeting materials, correspondence, open actions, and administrative records.
  • Manage confidential documents, executive information, correspondence, and sensitive matters while maintaining the highest standards of integrity and confidentiality.
  • Support onboarding and offboarding activities for leadership-team members, including access, equipment, introductions, organizational information, and relevant resources.
  • Maintain relevant distribution lists, team sites, shared resources, organizational charts, and leadership-team information.
  • Coordinate appropriate handoffs and continuity of critical support during planned absences or periods of competing demand.

C) Governance, Communications & Events

  • Organize and support executive meetings, leadership-team meetings, governance forums, business reviews, off-sites, town halls, and other leadership events.
  • Coordinate agendas, pre-reads, presentations, meeting materials, conference rooms, catering, technology, on-site logistics, action tracking, and follow-up activities.
  • Coordinate, proofread, format, and distribute executive communications, meeting materials, correspondence, and meeting summaries to support leadership activities.
  • Maintain governance calendars, recurring meeting schedules, action logs, and relevant leadership-team documentation.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to support effective communication and timely execution of leadership priorities.
  • Plan and coordinate meetings and events involving senior leaders, global stakeholders, and external participants.

D) Project & Process Coordination

  • Coordinate small to mid-size administrative and operational projects on behalf of assigned leaders.
  • Maintain trackers, timelines, action logs, and stakeholder follow-up for leadership priorities and recurring deliverables.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend practical improvements to executive-support workflows, templates, documentation, and ways of working.
  • Support the implementation and adoption of administrative standards, playbooks, templates, and best practices established by the Global Medical Administrative Services team.
  • Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and communicate recommendations to leadership and team management.
  • Share administrative best practices and provide informal guidance or mentorship to administrative colleagues where appropriate.

E) AI, Digital & Continuous Improvement

  • Utilize Microsoft 365 Copilot and other approved AI-enabled tools to improve productivity, organization, meeting preparation, communication drafting, and information management.
  • Use Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, OneDrive, Loop, Forms, and other approved collaboration technologies effectively to support executive and team activities.
  • Leverage established templates, tools, and administrative processes to support efficient, consistent, and high-quality service delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to improve administrative efficiency through the effective use of approved digital tools and automation capabilities.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging digital tools and features and apply them appropriately to improve individual productivity and administrative effectiveness.
  • Promote responsible AI use by protecting confidential information, exercising sound judgment, and adhering to applicable privacy, security, compliance, and data protection requirements.

F) Flexibility, Coverage & Teaming

  • Provide dedicated, comprehensive support to assigned senior leaders while operating as part of the broader Global Medical Administrative Services team.
  • Collaborate with administrative colleagues to ensure continuity during absences, peak workload periods, leadership transitions, and business-critical activities.
  • Provide backup coverage when required while preserving priority support for assigned leaders.
  • Build strong working relationships with administrative colleagues across Cambridge, Zurich, Vienna, Bengaluru, and other Global Medical locations.
  • Adapt to changes in leadership assignments, organizational priorities, and business needs while maintaining high-quality executive support.

EDUCATION, BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS

Required

  • 8+ years of progressive executive support, executive coordination, or administrative leadership experience.
  • 3+ years supporting Vice President-level leaders or equivalent senior executives.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting senior leaders within a complex global and matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated expertise in complex calendar management, international travel coordination, executive meeting management, governance support, and leadership-team operations.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, complex logistics, and confidential matters.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior leaders and stakeholders.
  • High level of judgment, discretion, professionalism, and integrity when handling sensitive information.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate needs and proactively address challenges.
  • Ability to operate independently and exercise sound judgment with minimal direction.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications and collaboration tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-enabled productivity tools to improve effectiveness and efficiency.

Preferred

  • 10+ years of executive support or executive coordination experience.
  • Experience supporting Global Leadership Team members, General Managers, Vice Presidents, or equivalent executives.
  • Experience supporting leaders in healthcare, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or life sciences organizations.
  • Experience coordinating complex global governance forums, executive meetings, off-sites, and large-scale leadership events.
  • Experience leading process improvements, administrative best practices, or operational initiatives.
  • Experience mentoring or providing guidance to administrative professionals.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Languages

  • Fluent English required.
  • Additional languages beneficial.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Percentage of travel: Minimal, typically less than 5%.
  • This role provides dedicated, comprehensive support to assigned senior leaders and directly performs the full range of applicable executive-support responsibilities.
  • Leadership assignments may change as the organization and its priorities evolve.
  • The Executive Coordinator may provide informal guidance or mentorship to other administrative team members.
  • Occasional flexibility in working hours may be required to support global leaders and activities across multiple time zones.
  • All work must be performed in accordance with company policies, procedures, compliance requirements, and applicable legal and regulatory standards.

This position is currently classified as “hybrid” in accordance with Takeda’s Hybrid and Remote Work policy.

title: Gen Tekenaar
description:
Als Gen Tekenaar zorg jij ervoor dat gegevens over kabels en leidingen nauwkeurig worden verwerkt en actueel blijven. Je beoordeelt en verwerkt meldingen, bewaakt de kwaliteit van de gegevens en draagt bij aan een veilige uitvoering van werkzaamheden binnen de ondergrondse infrastructuur. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met uitvoerders, projectleiders en technische specialisten om projecten soepel, efficiënt en volgens de geldende richtlijnen te laten verlopen. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Gen Tekenaar ben jij verantwoordelijk voor een betrouwbare registratie van de ondergrondse infrastructuur. Je verwerkt en controleert kabel- en leidinggegevens, bewaakt de kwaliteit van de assetdata en zorgt ervoor dat alle informatie volledig, correct en actueel blijft. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's en externe partijen om de kwaliteit van de gegevens continu te waarborgen.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het opstellen, beheren, verwerken en controleren van kabel-, leiding- en assetgegevens in de daarvoor bestemde systemen;
  • Het signaleren van afwijkingen en afstemmen met projectverantwoordelijken over de opvolging;
  • Het bewaken en borgen van de kwaliteit van assetdata;
  • Het coördineren en uitvoeren van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende werkstromen;
  • Het verwerken van geografische referenties, revisies, schetsen (SA en realisatie) en complexe dataopwerkingen;
  • Aansturing Landmeter-Tekenaar in combinatie met wijzigingen, planning en capaciteit;
  • Meehelpen met tekenen;
  • Het samenwerken met monteurs, uitvoerders, engineers, technisch specialisten, aannemers en andere interne en externe stakeholders om de datakwaliteit te waarborgen.

Wat krijg je van ons?

We kunnen zeggen dat je een uitdagende rol als Gen Tekenaar krijgt in een toekomstbestendige sector.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Opleiding via onze opdrachtgever;
  • Een goed bruto maandsalaris, passend bij je opleiding en ervaring
  • Ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en processen te verbeteren;
  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden via trainingen en opleidingen;
  • Auto, telefoon en laptop van de zaak;
  • Een hecht team met korte lijnen, waarin collega’s voor elkaar klaarstaan;
  • Een warm welkom met twee introductiedagen;
  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek met 38 vakantiedagen (25 vakantie en 13 ADV);
  • Een vitaliteitsprogramma en een winstdelingsregeling.

Wat breng je mee?

Voor deze functie vinden we het belangrijk dat je jezelf herkent in het volgende:

  • Affiniteit met techniek en interesse in ondergrondse infrastructuur;
  • Minimaal mbo 4 werk- en denkniveau;
  • Ervaring met het verwerken en controleren van meetgegevens;
  • Nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en in staat om onder druk te werken;
  • Kennis of affiniteit van GIS-Systemen zoals GEN en assetbeheerapplicaties.

Waarom B O Infra?

Wij zijn een familiebedrijf met korte lijnen, een nuchtere aanpak en grote ambities. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om persoonlijk te blijven. Bij ons krijg je vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de ruimte om mee te denken. Jouw ideeën en inzet maken het verschil.

Naast hard werken vinden wij werkplezier minstens zo belangrijk. Daarom investeren wij in onze mensen, vieren wij successen samen en organiseren wij regelmatig leuke uitjes en activiteiten. Een goede sfeer en samenwerken staan bij ons centraal.

Jij brengt de motivatie. Wij bieden de kansen, begeleiding en een team dat achter je staat.

Nieuwe energie begint hier én bij jou.

title: Shift Lead
description:
• Opens and closes the store in the absence of store management, including all required systems start-ups, required cash handling, and ensuring the floor and stock room are ready for the business day. Responsible for opening back door of store for deliveries.
  • Completes product returns, order voids, customer refunds, cash drops to the safe, and provides change as requested to cash registers.
  • Models and delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience.

Customer Experience
  • Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
  • Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).
Operations
  • Responsible for holding store keys to open and close without management as necessary.
  • Assists with and coaches other team members to work with warehouse and vendor ordering process as the orders are created, reviewed, and received, including opening the backdoor for vendor deliveries.
  • Responsible and accountable for registering all related sales on assigned cash register, including records of scanning errors, price verifications, items not on file, price modifications, and voids.
  • Assists manager or assistant store manager in reviewing order exceptions on order release day and assists in reverse logistics (e.g., 1506, returns, empty package).
  • Assists manager or assistant store manager in evaluating and developing displays, including promotional, seasonal, super structures, and sale merchandise. Completes resets and revisions.
  • Maintains accurate inventory counts; maintains the accuracy of on-hand quantities including, but not limited to, basic departments, stockroom, and overstock locations.

  • Responsible for basic department pricing and making daily price changes; ensures proper signage is displayed at the store to support accurate pricing of products. Ensures any additional pricing tasks related to local regulations and/or regulatory compliance programs are completed accurately and within the required time frame.
  • Assist with bookkeeping activities, including cash report, cash counts, ledgers, and bill payment as necessary or as requested.
  • Assists with exterior and interior maintenance by ensuring clean, neat, orderly store condition and appearance, including requesting store or system repairs as required in manager absence, or as requested by manager.
  • Assists with separation of food items (e.g., raw foods from pre-cooked) and product placement as specified by policies/procedures (e.g., raw and frozen meats on bottom shelves). For consumable items, assists in stock rotation, using the first in, first out method and restock outs.

  • Assist at Pharmacy out window as requested.
  • Ensures compliance with state and local laws regarding regulated products (e.g., alcoholic beverages and tobacco products).
  • Responsible for bag checks of team members before leaving the store.
  • Complies with all company policies and procedures; maintains respectful relationships with coworkers.
  • Completes special assignments and other tasks as assigned.
Training & Personal Development
  • Attends training and completes PPLs requested by Manager.
Communications
  • Serves as a liaison between management and non-management team members by communicating assigned tasks to team members when store management is not present.
  • Reports disciplinary issues and customer complaints to management.


Basic Qualifications
  • One year of prior retail work experience as a retail key carrier or shift leader.
  • Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English. (Except in Puerto Rico)


Preferred Qualifications
  • Prefer the knowledge of store inventory control.
  • Obtains and maintains valid PTCB certification or pharmacy license as required by state.

title: Neurology  PA with CA License - Fully Virtual FTE
description:
About TeleMed2U

At TeleMed2U, we believe that time is the most valuable resource in healthcare— whether it is time to diagnosis, time to treatment, or time to better health. That is why, since our founding in 2011, we have been dedicated to increasing access to care across 20 medical and behavioral health specialties nationwide. By breaking down traditional barriers to specialty care, TeleMed2U has become a leading technology-enabled healthcare services company, delivering high-quality, convenient, and easy-to-access virtual healthcare solutions. Our integrated approach to chronic disease management empowers both patients and providers, improving health outcomes through seamless care coordination. With a focus on patient-centered innovation, provider collaboration, and data-driven care delivery, TeleMed2U is redefining specialty care—making it faster, simpler, and more accessible for all.

About the Role

TeleMed2U is seeking an experienced Advanced Practitioner specializing in General Neurology to provide remote patient care.. The ideal candidate will evaluate, diagnose, and manage adult patients with neurological conditions through TeleMed2U’s established telehealth platform.

What you'll do

  • Conduct virtual evaluations and follow-up visits for adult patients with neurological conditions such as headache, migraine, neuropathy, seizure disorders and other general neurology presentations.
  • Collaborate closely with collaborating neurologists and other members of the care team to ensure continuity of care and appropriate treatment planning.
  • Order and interpret diagnostic studies as clinically appropriate.
  • Document patient encounters accurately and efficiently in the electronic health record (EHR).
  • Provide patient education and counseling on diagnoses, treatment options, and lifestyle modifications.
  • Maintain compliance with all telehealth regulations, licensure requirements, and practice standards.

Qualifications

  • CA Licensed Physician Assistant (PA) or Nurse Practitioner (NP) in good standing.
  • Minimum 2 years of Neurology experience in outpatient or telehealth settings.
  • Strong communication and clinical documentation skills.
  • Comfortable practicing autonomously in a remote care environment.
  • Reliable internet connection and familiarity with telemedicine technology.

Benefits

  • Medical malpractice insurance
  • Full administrative support provided
  • Flexible schedule options; no call or in-person requirements.
  • Enjoy the experience of telemedicine while providing access to much needed specialty care in areas where shortages exist.
  • Competitive per-encounter compensation based on experience with Bonus
  • 1099 or potential W2 Opportunity

As an EEO employer, TeleMed2U does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law or regulation.
