All employment decisions are based on merit, business needs, and individual qualifications.

title: ICT-ontwikkelaar | technisch beheerder onderwijsapplicaties
description:
Functie

Ben jij een ambitieuze ICT‑professional die impact wil maken? Als ICT-ontwikkelaar | technisch beheerder binnen het ICT-team van de Radboudumc Health Academy (RHA), zorg jij voor het ontwikkelen én het onderhoud van diverse applicaties en koppelingen die ingezet worden binnen de kerntaak onderwijs en opleiden van het Radboudumc. Een mooie kans om jouw ICT‑expertise toe te passen in een betekenisvolle rol!

In je functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vormgeven van technische oplossingen op basis van de functionele wensen vanuit het onderwijsveld. Dit doe je bijvoorbeeld door koppelingen te leggen tussen verschillende systemen of door (zelfbouw) applicaties (door) te ontwikkelen.

Hierbij stem je af met de gebruikers en proceseigenaren van de RHA en zorg je dat je binnen de Radboudumc brede architectuurkaders en security afspraken werkt. Samen met collega ICT-ontwikkelaars en functioneel beheerders vorm je een team dat verantwoordelijk is voor de digitale ondersteuning van het onderwijs binnen het Radboudumc.

Applicaties die door het team beheerd worden zijn onder andere Osiris, Scorion, Brightspace en Academy Attendance. Ook de koppelingen tussen die systemen die waarborgen dat de juiste informatie hierin is opgenomen, worden door het team beheerd en doorontwikkeld.

Wat ga je nog meer doen?

  • Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt applicaties en koppelingen, waarvan sommige door het team zelf zijn gebouwd. Dit doe je onder andere in PHP, Symfony, Doctrine-ORM,MySQL, DevOps, Git, Docker, Composer en MuleSoft. Je bent hierbij in staat om helder de behoefte van de stakeholders in kaart te brengen, en deze te vertalen naar een technische oplossing die daarbij aansluit.
  • Samen met je collega’s in het team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beheer en de ontwikkeling van de onderwijsapplicaties van de RHA. In afstemming met je teamleden verdelen jullie de applicaties qua expertiseontwikkeling, maar zorgen jullie ook voor onderlinge vervangbaarheid en bredere kennisontwikkeling.
  • Je werkt binnen de kaders van de IT-beheerprocessen van het Radboudumc, zoals change management, incident management en problem management. Je coördineert werkzaamheden die door meerdere teams uitgevoerd worden, bijvoorbeeld changes.
  • Je documenteert technische ontwerpen, configuraties en werkwijzen van het beheer.
  • Je voert testwerkzaamheden uit ter voorbereiding op het doorvoeren van wijzigingen in applicaties, of bij bijvoorbeeld infrastructurele, of werkplek wijzigingen, die een effect op de werking van de door het team beheerde applicaties kunnen hebben.
  • Je beheert de levenscycli van applicaties en zorgt dat ze actueel zijn en draaien op een actueel platform.
  • Je hebt een rol in het leverancier management, waaronder contractmanagement en licentiebeheer.
  • Je levert een actieve bijdrage aan organisatieprojecten van de RHA, zoals onderwijsontwikkeling om te waarborgen dat organisatiekeuzes passen binnen de technische mogelijkheden van de door het team geleverde applicaties.
  • Je houdt landelijke ontwikkelingen en ontwikkelingen rond de door jou beheerde producten in de gaten en vertaalt die naar impact voor jouw werkgebied.

Jouw werkplek

Team RHA-ICT is een team dat is gepositioneerd binnen de Radboudumc Health Academy (RHA). Het team wordt echter aangestuurd door een teamleider die is gepositioneerd binnen de stafdienst Informatie Management. Samen met 10 collega’s werk je aan veilige en goed functionerende applicaties voor onderwijs en opleiden, één van de drie kerntaken van het Radboudumc. Je hebt de mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken, maar bent minimaal twee dagen per week op locatie aanwezig om samen met je team, collega’s van de RHA en collega’s van IM te overleggen en af te stemmen.

De RHA is het centrum voor onderwijs, opleiden en ontwikkelen: verantwoordelijk voor kwaliteit en doelmatigheid van innovatieve en persoonsgerichte diensten ten behoeve van leren en ontwikkelen door (aanstaande) zorgprofessionals die een leven lang leren.

Technisch inhoudelijke afstemming en ontwikkeling vindt plaats binnen de stafdienst Informatie Management. Daar ontmoet je zo’n 300 IT-professionals die samen state‑of‑the‑art ICT‑oplossingen leveren voor onderzoek, onderwijs en zorg. Elk team heeft zijn eigen specialisatie en werkt nauw samen om projecten en dienstverlening tot een succes te maken. Zo draagt Informatie Management bij aan een betrouwbare, veilige en innovatieve ICT‑omgeving én aan de zorg, wetenschap en onderwijs van morgen. Of je nu netwerkbeheerder, serverbeheerder, datamanager, applicatiespecialist of developer bent: bij ons ben je nooit uitgeleerd.

Profiel

Jij bent een ICT-ontwikkelaar met een sterke mix van technische én communicatieve vaardigheden. Je vindt het leuk om met de klant te schakelen over functionele wensen en daar de best mogelijke oplossing aan te verbinden en/of te ontwikkelen. Kwaliteit staat bij jou hoog in het vaandel. Je houdt ervan om gestructureerd te werken en bent een drijvende kracht voor de lopende agile transitie. Zo lever jij een belangrijke bijdrage aan een teamcultuur waarin samenwerken, kwaliteit en onderling vertrouwen centraal staan.

We vinden het belangrijker dat je goed past binnen het team dan dat je aan alle onderstaande punten voldoet. Daarom zoeken we iemand die zich vastbijt in uitdagingen, eigenaarschap toont en met plezier verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het werk van alledag. Natuurlijk sta je daar niet alleen in: zowel technisch, procesmatig als persoonlijk ondersteunen we je waar nodig.

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van applicaties, bijvoorbeeld in PHP, Symfony, Doctrine-ORM,MySQL, DevOps, Git, Docker, Composer en MuleSoft.
  • Ervaring met het bouwen van (prototype) rapportages is een pré.
  • Een aantal jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol. Affiniteit met onderwijsprocessen is een pré.
  • Kennis over IT-beheerprocessen conform raamwerken als ITIL, ASL en BISL. Certificering is een pré.
  • Analytisch vermogen en de vaardigheid om technische keuzes helder te onderbouwen, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Ervaring met het werken in een agile organisatie, waarbij kort cyclisch leveren van resultaten, frequent afstemmen over waarde en samen leren centraal staan.

Daarnaast schakel je communicatief gemakkelijk op verschillende niveaus binnen de organisatie en beschik je over uitstekende lees-, spreek- en schrijfvaardigheid in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels.

Goed om te weten

  • Een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure.
  • De eerste sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats op 28 oktober 2026. Fijn als je hier alvast rekening mee houdt.
  • Voor deze functie is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist.

Wij werven zelf voor deze vacature. Acquisitie stellen wij niet op prijs; delen in je netwerk wél.

title: Radar Product Manager
description:
Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we’re building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements each day on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence helps protect critical assets, characterize activity in orbit, monitor emerging threats, and enable safer and more effective operations for commercial and government missions.

We’re not just building technology—we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and the operating environment becomes increasingly complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, satellite operations, and national security missions around the world.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the intersection of aerospace, national security, sensing, software, data, and AI, your impact starts here. This position is contingent upon final approval, with an anticipated hiring timeline beginning as early as January 2027. We are beginning the search in advance of the anticipated hiring timeline.

LeoLabs is seeking a Radar Product Manager to lead the continued development, commercialization, and growth of our transportable radar product, our radar-based space domain awareness product.

Our transportable radar product combines advanced radar sensing, software, data processing, and operational capabilities to provide customers with persistent, high-quality information about objects and activity in low Earth orbit. Our transportable radar product extends LeoLabs' ability to deploy sensing capability where customers need it and enables a range of commercial and government missions.

This role sits at the intersection of customers, product strategy, radar technology, engineering, operations, deployment, and business objectives. You will be responsible for understanding customer missions and market opportunities, defining where our transportable radar product should compete, shaping the capabilities and configurations customers need, and helping turn advanced radar technology into scalable products and services customers can buy, deploy, and operate.

The ideal candidate is a strong product thinker with both commercial and technical judgment. You should have experience working in the space industry or in a closely related aerospace or national-security environment, be comfortable working with complex hardware and software systems, and be able to translate customer missions and technical capabilities into clear product and business direction.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the product and business strategy for our transportable radar product, including product vision, roadmap, market positioning, prioritization, packaging, configurations, and execution
  • Develop a deep understanding of our transportable radar product customers, users, missions, workflows, operational environments, procurement considerations, and buying behavior
  • Work directly with commercial and government customers, operators, mission partners, internal stakeholders, and subject-matter experts to identify unmet needs, validate product opportunities, and determine where our transportable radar product can create differentiated value
  • Identify and prioritize market segments, mission areas, use cases, deployment models, and customer problems where our transportable radar product can create meaningful mission impact and business growth
  • Translate customer, mission, and business requirements into clear product requirements, system capabilities, configurations, interfaces, and prioritized development work
  • Partner closely with radar, hardware, software, systems, data, infrastructure, and operations teams throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery and definition through development, integration, testing, deployment, operation, and iteration
  • Make product investment decisions based on customer value, strategic differentiation, revenue potential, sensor performance, technical feasibility, operational complexity, scalability, and company priorities
  • Define how our transportable radar product capabilities, configurations, service levels, and access models are packaged and positioned so customers can clearly understand what they are buying, what mission outcomes it enables, and how it differs from other LeoLabs offerings
  • Partner with Sales, Business Development, Marketing, and Customer Success to support customer engagements, technical discussions, demonstrations, proposals, strategic pursuits, pilots, and go-to-market activities
  • Help shape pricing, packaging, service models, and commercial structures for our transportable radar product offerings in partnership with Product leadership and other business stakeholders
  • Develop a strong understanding of the tradeoffs between radar performance, deployment location, coverage, capacity, tasking, reliability, availability, maintainability, cost, and customer mission outcomes
  • Partner with Engineering and Operations to understand radar performance and identify opportunities to improve sensing capability, data quality, coverage, availability, operational efficiency, and customer value
  • Help define requirements for how customers interact with and task our transportable radar product, how measurements and data products are delivered, and how our transportable radar product integrates with customer and LeoLabs software systems
  • Maintain and communicate a clear product roadmap and ensure alignment across Product, Engineering, Radar Operations, Sales, Business Development, Customer Success, and company leadership
  • Define and monitor product, business, and operational metrics that measure customer outcomes, radar performance, availability, utilization, adoption, reliability, deployment effectiveness, revenue impact, and overall product performance
  • Lead product launches and internal enablement, ensuring that customer-facing teams can effectively explain, demonstrate, position, and sell our transportable radar product capabilities
  • Continuously evaluate competing sensing solutions, emerging radar and sensor technologies, customer acquisition trends, market developments, and evolving space and national-security requirements to identify new opportunities for our transportable radar product
  • Distinguish between one-off customer requirements and repeatable market needs, ensuring our transportable radar product evolves as a scalable product family rather than a collection of bespoke radar programs
  • Help establish and improve product management practices as LeoLabs continues to scale its product organization

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably with products involving hardware, software, data, sensing, infrastructure, or other complex technical systems
  • Professional experience working in the space industry, or in a closely related aerospace, defense, or national-security environment, with demonstrated understanding of space missions, customers, operators, or technologies
  • Demonstrated experience owning products or significant product areas from market discovery and product strategy through development, deployment, launch, adoption, and iteration
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to connect product decisions to customer mission outcomes, competitive differentiation, revenue opportunities, and company strategy
  • Strong customer orientation and experience engaging directly with customers to uncover needs, validate opportunities, and translate feedback into scalable products
  • Demonstrated ability to understand complex technical systems and translate technical capabilities, limitations, and tradeoffs into clear product direction and priorities
  • Experience working across multidisciplinary engineering teams that may include hardware, software, systems, infrastructure, data, operations, or related technical functions
  • Ability to make informed prioritization decisions across competing customer requests, market opportunities, engineering constraints, operational considerations, cost, schedule, and strategic priorities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, operators, customers, executives, and other technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to use technical performance data, customer feedback, market information, and business considerations to make product decisions
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where customer needs, technology, operational conditions, and market requirements can evolve quickly
  • Curiosity and willingness to develop deeper expertise in radar, RF systems, space surveillance, orbital operations, and related technical domains
  • Ability to operate with a high degree of ownership and independently drive product decisions while building alignment across multiple organizations
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally to engage directly with customers, partners, deployment teams, and internal stakeholders
  • LeoLabs is a global company with customers, radar sites, partners, and users around the world, and this role will require periodic travel to understand customer missions, support key engagements and deployments, and represent the product in-market

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with radar, RF systems, remote sensing, ground-based sensors, satellite sensors, or other advanced sensing technologies
  • Experience developing or commercializing products that integrate hardware, software, data, communications, infrastructure, and operational systems
  • Direct experience with Space Domain Awareness, Space Situational Awareness, Space Surveillance and Tracking, satellite operations, orbital analysis, or related space missions
  • Familiarity with missile warning, missile tracking, and integrated air and missile defense missions, including an understanding of how sensor performance, coverage, latency, tracking quality, and data delivery support operational warning and tracking architectures
  • Experience working with satellite operators, U.S. government space organizations, allied defense organizations, intelligence organizations, or commercial space companies
  • Familiarity with radar concepts such as detection, tracking, search, revisit rates, coverage, waveforms, beam scheduling, capacity, measurement quality, or sensor tasking
  • Familiarity with orbital mechanics, tracking data, state vectors, conjunction assessment, maneuver detection, object characterization, or other space-domain concepts
  • Experience with deployed products or infrastructure where reliability, availability, maintainability, logistics, site selection, and operational support are important product considerations
  • Experience supporting government acquisition processes, strategic pursuits, proposals, demonstrations, pilots, customer evaluations, or major program captures
  • Experience defining product packaging, pricing, configurations, service levels, or go-to-market strategy for complex technical products
  • Experience working with products sold through multiple ownership, operating, or service models
  • Experience working directly with government and commercial customers in complex enterprise sales environments
  • Technical degree or background in engineering, physics, computer science, aerospace, electrical engineering, systems engineering, or a related field
  • Active U.S. Government security clearance, or the ability and willingness to obtain and maintain one, is preferred

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:

  • Our transportable radar product has a clear product and market strategy aligned with LeoLabs' broader business objectives and differentiated from competing sensing solutions
  • The organization has a strong understanding of our transportable radar product's target customers, priority missions, deployment models, use cases, value propositions, and commercial opportunities
  • Our transportable radar product capabilities and configurations are packaged and positioned in ways that customers can easily understand, evaluate, purchase, deploy, and use
  • Our transportable radar product evolves from advanced radar technology into a scalable product family that can support multiple customer missions and business models without excessive customization
  • Engineering and Operations have clear product direction, well-defined priorities, and a strong understanding of the customer and business outcomes behind the work
  • Product decisions appropriately balance mission outcomes, radar performance, customer requirements, technical feasibility, deployment complexity, cost, schedule, and business value
  • Our transportable radar product continues to improve in areas such as sensing performance, data quality, coverage, capacity, availability, reliability, deployability, operational efficiency, and customer usability
  • Customers see measurable mission value from our transportable radar product and increasingly integrate its capabilities into their operational workflows
  • Our transportable radar product contributes meaningfully to LeoLabs' revenue growth through new deployments, new customers, expansion opportunities, strategic programs, and increased adoption
  • Sales and Business Development teams have clearly defined our transportable radar product offerings, compelling demonstrations, strong positioning, and supporting materials that allow them to confidently take our transportable radar product to market
  • Product, radar, engineering, operations, and customer-facing teams remain aligned around priorities, product configurations, upcoming capabilities, deployments, and customer commitments
  • Our transportable radar product continues to evolve based on customer outcomes, operational performance, market demand, competitive dynamics, technology advances, and LeoLabs' long-term strategy

Compensation

This position is benchmarked to Denver, CO with a base salary range of $171,000–$194,000 plus bonus and equity. Actual base salary will be determined based on the candidate’s work location, experience, skills, and other applicable factors

Perks and Benefits

  • 100 USD monthly wellness benefit to support your health and well-being
  • $300 USD home office setup stipend, available for use within your first six months
  • $75 USD monthly home internet allowance, paid directly through your regular paycheck
  • Individual Development Fund to support training, learning, and professional development
  • Employee Recognition Program to celebrate contributions and achievements across the team
  • Employee Referral Program so you can help us connect with great talent
  • And much more!

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. More information regarding ITAR can be found at DDTC’s website.

Vendor Notification

LeoLabs does not engage external staffing agencies or third-party recruiting firms for this role. Unsolicited candidate submissions will not be considered.

We are committed to maintaining a respectful and inclusive workplace where employees are valued for their skills, experience, and contributions. We are an equal opportunity employer and make employment decisions based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs, consistent with applicable law.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About MasterControl

MasterControl Inc. is a leading provider of cloud-based quality and compliance software for life sciences and other regulated industries. Our mission is the same as that of our customers to bring life-changing products to more people sooner. The MasterControl Platform helps organizations digitize, automate and connect quality and compliance processes across the regulated product development life cycle. Over 1,000 companies worldwide rely on MasterControl solutions to achieve new levels of operational excellence across product development, clinical trials, regulatory affairs, quality management, supply chain, manufacturing and postmarket surveillance. For more information, visit .

SUMMARY

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you will be a key driver in designing, building, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and Kubernetes-based platforms. You will work closely with development, security, and operations teams to ensure our systems are scalable, reliable, secure, and efficient.

A strong candidate will embrace AI-assisted engineering — leveraging tools like Anthropic Claude and AWS Kiro to accelerate infrastructure development, SRE operations, cost management, and software delivery lifecycle (SDLC) workflows.


RESPONSIBILITIES

AWS Infrastructure
• Design, provision, and manage scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and AWS CDK.
• Own and optimize AWS services including EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, Route 53, CloudWatch, ALB/NLB, and more.
• Design and manage robust AWS network infrastructure including VPCs, subnets, routing tables, and network ACLs for high-availability and security.
• Configure and optimize Route 53 for DNS management, failover strategies, and multi-region routing policies.
• Deploy and manage API Gateways for REST and HTTP APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, request/response transformation, and integration with backend services.
• Implement and manage AWS Load Balancers (Application Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer, and Classic Load Balancer) for traffic distribution, session management, and high availability.
• Define and enforce AWS security policies including security groups, NACLs, WAF rules, and compliance requirements across network infrastructure.

• Monitor infrastructure health, costs, and performance; continuously identify and implement optimizations.

Azure Infrastructure & Multi-Cloud
• Design and provision Azure infrastructure and services, including virtual networks, Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and managed databases.
• Manage Azure IAM, resource groups, and implement security best practices across Azure environments.
• Implement Infrastructure as Code for Azure using Terraform and Azure Resource Manager templates.
• Integrate Azure services with AWS environments for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments where applicable.

System Administration (Linux & Windows)

• Configure and maintain Linux services, systemd, and daemon processes for reliability and performance.
• Administer Windows Server environments including Active Directory integration, Group Policy, patching, and security hardening.
• Manage both Linux and Windows across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
• Implement configuration management and automation for consistent system provisioning and lifecycle management.

Amazon EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service)

• Integrate EKS with AWS services such as IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA), AWS Load Balancer Controller, EBS/EFS CSI drivers, and AWS Secrets Manager.
• Deploy, configure, and manage Istio service mesh on EKS, including traffic management, mutual TLS (mTLS), observability, and security policy enforcement.
• Oversee Kubernetes upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management across environments.

ArgoCD & GitOps
• Implement and maintain GitOps workflows using ArgoCD for continuous delivery to Kubernetes environments.
• Design and manage ArgoCD Application and ApplicationSet configurations for multi-cluster and multi-environment deployments.
• Establish GitOps best practices including environment promotion strategies (dev → staging → production), rollback procedures, and drift detection.
• Manage ArgoCD RBAC, SSO integration, and security hardening.
• Collaborate with development teams to onboard services into the GitOps delivery model.

CI/CD Pipelines (GitHub Actions & Jenkins)
• Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins for build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows.
• Configure and manage Jenkins infrastructure, including master/agent architecture, plugin management, and security hardening.
• Design Jenkins declarative and scripted pipelines for complex multi-stage deployments across environments.
• Integrate Jenkins with container registries, artifact repositories, testing frameworks, and deployment tools.
• Develop reusable GitHub Actions workflows and composite actions to standardize pipelines across teams.
• Create reusable Jenkins shared libraries and pipeline templates for consistency and maintainability.
• Integrate pipelines with container registries (Amazon ECR), security scanning tools (Trivy, Snyk, etc.), and deployment tooling.
• Implement pipeline best practices including secrets management, environment protection rules, and workflow approvals.
• Monitor pipeline performance and drive improvements in build reliability and deployment velocity.

Container Development & Registry Management
• Build, optimize, and maintain Docker containers with strong emphasis on Dockerfile best practices including multi-stage builds, minimal base images, layer optimization, and security hardening.
• Design efficient container images that minimize size, reduce startup time, and optimize resource consumption.
• Manage container image repositories using Amazon ECR, including image lifecycle policies, tagging strategies, image retention policies, vulnerability scanning, and access control.
• Integrate container building and registry management into CI/CD pipelines, automating image builds, security scanning, tagging, and registry pushes.
• Implement container security scanning and vulnerability detection to ensure image compliance and remediate security issues.
• Mentor teams on container best practices, image optimization techniques, and secure containerization patterns.

AI-Assisted DevOps (Claude & AWS Kiro)
• Leverage Anthropic Claude as an AI engineering assistant to rapidly generate, review, and refactor Terraform modules and AWS CDK stacks, reducing toil and accelerating infrastructure delivery.
• Utilize AWS Kiro to automate and streamline infrastructure provisioning, SRE workflows, and cloud operations tasks through AI-driven assistance.
• Apply AI tooling across the SDLC — from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and incident resolution — to improve team velocity and code quality.
• Use Claude and Kiro to assist with SRE work including runbook generation, automated root cause analysis drafting, postmortem write-ups, alert tuning, and on-call automation.
• Employ AI-assisted tooling to monitor and optimize AWS costs — analyzing Cost Explorer data, identifying waste, rightsizing recommendations, and generating cost reports and savings proposals.
• Establish team best practices and guardrails for responsible, secure, and effective use of AI coding and operations tools.
• Continuously evaluate emerging AI-powered DevOps tooling and champion adoption of high-value capabilities across the engineering organization.

General DevOps & Collaboration
• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on DevOps practices, tooling, cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted workflows.
• Define and enforce standards for observability including logging, metrics, and distributed tracing (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
• Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and postmortem processes.
• Champion a culture of automation, reliability, and continuous improvement across the organization.
• Collaborate with security teams to implement DevSecOps practices throughout the SDLC.


REQUIRED SKILLS

• 5+ years of experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure role.
• Deep hands-on expertise with AWS, including core services (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS) and advanced services.
• Strong expertise with AWS network infrastructure including VPCs, Route 53, API Gateways, Load Balancers (ALB/NLB), and AWS security policies.
• Hands-on experience with Linux system administration (AWS Linux and Ubuntu), including kernel management, package management, services, and security hardening.
• Hands-on experience with Windows Server administration including Active Directory, Group Policy, patching, and security configuration.
• Experience with Azure infrastructure and cloud services.
• Strong Kubernetes experience, including production EKS cluster management, networking, and storage.
• Proficiency with ArgoCD and GitOps principles for Kubernetes-based continuous delivery.
• Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Jenkins.
• Strong Docker experience including building, optimizing, and maintaining production container images with emphasis on Dockerfile best practices and security.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS

title: Leerling Begeleider (BBL) | Vierhouten
description:
Wil jij werken op een plek waar je echt de tijd en rust hebt voor mensen met intensieve zorgvragen? Op de locatie Bospad werk je in een kleinschalige woonomgeving in het bos. Een plek waar bewoners zich veilig mogen voelen en waar jij als leerling begeleider het verschil maakt in de kleine momenten.

Werken op Bospad

Bospad is in het najaar van 2024 geopend en bestaat uit 6 kleinschalige woningen en een eigen dagcentrum. Je werkt met bewoners met een ernstig meervoudige beperking en/of ouder wordende bewoners (16 tot 80 jaar). Iedere bewoner heeft een eigen ritme, manier van communiceren en zorgvraag. Jij sluit daarop aan met aandacht, rust en duidelijke begeleiding. We werken op Bospad integraal samen met de dagbesteding. Dat betekent: samen kijken wat iemand nodig heeft, zowel thuis als overdag.

Wat ga je doen?

  • We bieden jou de kans te starten al aspirant leerling om in de eerste maanden (maximaal 3) kennis te maken met het werken in de zorg. Na deze periode wordt je (na goedbevinden van beide kanten) leerling begeleider. Als leerling begeleider zorg jij voor een stabiele, veilige basis voor onze bewoners. Je biedt ondersteuning bij de dagelijkse zorg en bij de begeleiding.

In jouw werk:

  • Bied je structuur en veiligheid in de groep.
  • Kijk je goed naar signalen en behoeften van bewoners.
  • Werk je samen met collega’s en met de dagbesteding.
  • Deel je jouw observaties en ideeën in werkoverleggen, zodat we samen blijven verbeteren.
  • Werk je onregelmatige diensten: dag-, avond- en weekenddiensten. Op Bospad komen 8-uursdiensten regelmatig voor.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Je krijgt een (Aspirant) leerarbeidsovereenkomst op een kleinschalige locatie voor de duur van de opleiding.
  • Een salaris passend bij de functie van leerling begeleider volgens de CAO.
  • Een contract voor 24–32 uur per week voor de duur van de opleiding (uren in overleg).
  • Een werkbegeleider en een team die jou graag het vak willen leren en jouw ondersteunen in wat er nodig is om de opleiding te behalen.
  • Bij een goede afronding van de opleiding kijken we graag samen naar een passende werkplek.
  • 8% vakantiegeld, 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering en onregelmatigheidstoeslag (122–160%).
  • Trainingen en opleidingen via ons Leerhuis.
  • Ondersteuning voor jouw mentale en fysieke gezondheid (zoals coaching, mindfulness en fitness).
  • Korting op leuke uitjes met familie en vrienden.

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Je bent er voor bewoners, ook als ze niet met woorden communiceren. Je hebt geduld, je kijkt goed, en je bent een aanpakker die graag samenwerkt.
  • Je bent bereid een opleiding te volgen op niveau 3 of 4. Samen met jou kijken we graag naar een passend opleidingstraject.
  • Je hebt interesse voor EMB en/of ouder wordende bewoners.
  • Je bent bereid onregelmatig te werken.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met dagbesteding (of ben je nieuwsgierig om hierin mee te werken).

Interesse?

Wil je eerst even kennismaken of vragen stellen? Dat kan heel makkelijk. Bel, app of mail ons gerust, dan plannen we een moment dat past.

title: Senior Product Designer - ShareGate
description:
About ShareGate

ShareGate is the leading Microsoft 365 migration and governance platform, trusted by over 100,000 IT pros for its unmatched simplicity.

It offers the simplest, most reliable, and most affordable way to move business data to Microsoft 365.

Whether migrating from Google Workspace, file shares, Exchange Online, SharePoint On-Premises, or tenant-to-tenant, ShareGate gets the job done, without surprises. From cloud transformation to M&A integration, it keeps things just damn simple.

ShareGate also helps organizations stay in control once their data is migrated. Its powerful governance features let users assess environments, uncover issues, and apply fixes on the spot, so everything stays clean, secure, and optimized. It lays the groundwork for safe Microsoft Copilot deployment within organizations.

ShareGate is developed by Workleap Technologies, a Montréal‑based software company.

Your role

Almost every company now runs on Microsoft 365, and almost nobody has it fully under control. Work has to be moved into it and around it, through mergers, acquisitions and reorganizations that touch millions of files and can't afford to lose a single one. And once it's there it sprawls faster than anyone can track, with people sharing things they shouldn't and no clear view of what's actually going on. ShareGate is what IT professionals use to do both jobs. Taking something this complex and this consequential and making it feel simple and trustworthy is what we're here to do.

Your impact:

  • Own a whole product area end-to-end, from framing the problem with your team to shipping the solution customers actually use, and monitoring for learnings after.
  • Design AI-first flows where the product does the real work for customers while they stay fully in control.
  • Turn genuinely complicated situations into something a busy person can understand at a glance and feel confident acting on.
  • Put bold bets in front of real customers early, measure what happens, and let the result change the plan, including when it proves you wrong.
  • Bring AI into your own way of working so you can go from a question to something real and testable in days, and put it in front of customers while it's still rough.
  • Raise the bar for everyone around you through critique, through the standards you hold, and by making your thinking clear enough that the team can carry a decision without you in the room.

Your team

You'll join our design team at ShareGate and partner with a product lead and an engineering lead on every project you own, from first idea to launch. We're hiring across two sides of the product right now: one focused on moving companies into and around Microsoft 365, one focused on keeping it secure and organized once they're there. Both are big, high-stakes problems, and we'll work out together which one fits you best.

We're builders. We care a lot about craft and taste, we expect people to own their work rather than wait to be handed it, and we'd rather take a big swing on what's genuinely best for customers than ship the safe version. AI is part of how we work every day; it helps us move faster and try more ideas, not think less. Work gets shared early and often, feedback is direct, and decisions get made quickly and revisited just as quickly when we learn something new.

The people we design for run IT at their companies. They're experts who get the call when something breaks. Our job is to earn their trust and make complex, high-stakes workflows feel simple.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years designing complex software for businesses, with shipped work you owned from the first question to the last detail;
  • A systems mind: you design the whole journey and think about what happens next, not one screen at a time;
  • The judgment to make design decisions that are hard to take back: what people see first, what they confirm, what they can reverse;
  • A weekly habit of talking to real customers, and the discipline to let what they actually do change your direction;
  • Design rationale you can defend out loud to designers, engineers, and executives alike: the problem, the options you turned down, the trade-off you made;
  • Real fluency using AI in your own workflow, with the judgment to know where it helps and where it gets in the way;
  • The drive to take your work the last mile yourself: refining and polishing in the real product and pushing those changes straight to production;
  • Comfort working without a clear brief: you name the assumption, pick a direction, and learn in the open;
  • Bonus: experience designing for IT, security, data or any audience where the user is an expert and a wrong move is expensive.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

  • Base salary: $125 000 - $160 000. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
  • Annual bonus program.
  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gatherings twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

We build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy.

title: IT Infrastructure & Security Lead
description:
Do you want to work with high-caliber professionals in a dynamic and growing company? Are you entrepreneurial, hard-working, and collegial? Join us at SB Energy, a leading infrastructure company backed by SoftBank Group and Ares Infrastructure, pairing cutting-edge innovation with best-in-class execution. Our mission is to deliver reliable and secure data center and power infrastructure to strengthen America's future.

Founded in 2019, SB Energy is a SoftBank Group company headquartered in Redwood City, California. In 2026, SoftBank Group and OpenAI announced a $1 billion investment to support SB Energy as their leading development and execution partner for data center campuses, while Ares Infrastructure continues its long-standing support of the company's growth. SB Energy develops, builds, owns, and operates some of the largest and most technically advanced energy and data center infrastructure projects in the United States. Since its founding, the company has rapidly grown into a top-tier integrated platform with more than 3 gigawatts (GW) in operation and a multi-GW pipeline of energy and data center infrastructure nationwide.

SB Energy also leverages a strong culture of innovation to identify and integrate new technologies into its projects, including its AI-based digital platform, delivering energy infrastructure that is local, reliable, and matched to load. We are building the energy and infrastructure future—today.

Come join us in accelerating the energy and infrastructure transition!

Basic Function

The IT Infrastructure & Security Leader will lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of SB Energy’s enterprise IT infrastructure, cybersecurity program, and secure AI enablement capabilities. This role will be responsible for ensuring that the company’s technology environment is secure, reliable, scalable, and aligned with business needs. The successful candidate will bring a balanced combination of cybersecurity expertise, enterprise IT infrastructure experience, and practical knowledge of emerging AI technologies.

The role will partner closely with internal cross-functional stakeholders, Forward Deployment Engineers and external service providers to strengthen technology capabilities, improve infrastructure and systems, manage cybersecurity risk, and support the responsible adoption of AI and automation across the business.

The position requires strong technical judgment, hands-on experience managing enterprise technology environments, and the ability to translate business needs into practical technology, security, and AI solutions.

This position reports to the Vice President, HR & IT and will play a key role in advancing the company’s enterprise technology capabilities.

Responsibilities

Enterprise IT & Infrastructure

· Develop and execute the enterprise IT infrastructure roadmap in support of business growth and technology priorities.

· Oversee the reliability, security, and scalability of cloud services, networks, endpoints, identity platforms, collaboration tools, and enterprise applications.

· Manage IT service providers, vendors, and consultants, including service levels, performance, cost, and delivery.

· Establish standards for identity, access, device management, system administration, configuration, and technology lifecycle management.

· Support business continuity, disaster recovery, backup, and restoration planning and testing.

· Drive technology improvements that simplify the environment, improve reliability, and enhance the employee experience.

Cybersecurity & Risk

· Develop and maintain the enterprise cybersecurity program aligned with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and ISO/IEC 27001.

· Maintain security policies, standards, risk assessments, the cybersecurity risk register, and the information security management system (ISMS).

· Oversee security controls across identity, endpoint, network, cloud, SaaS, vulnerability management, monitoring, and data protection.

· Lead incident response preparedness, investigations, tabletop exercises, and post-incident reviews.

· Assess third-party and technology risks and coordinate remediation with Legal, Procurement, IT, and business stakeholders.

· Coordinate security audits, awareness training, phishing education, and reporting of key cybersecurity metrics and risks.

AI Enablement & Governance

· Partner with business teams to identify and implement practical AI and automation use cases.

· Support the secure adoption of ChatGPT Enterprise, workflow automation, AI assistants, connectors, APIs, and other emerging technologies.

· Establish governance and security standards for AI use, including data protection, access controls, third-party risk, logging, and responsible use.

· Review AI tools and integrations before deployment and help teams design workflows that preserve appropriate approvals and systems-of-record requirements.

· Develop AI policies, training, and adoption resources, and help measure business value from AI-enabled workflows.

Technology Strategy & Business Partnership

· Support enterprise technology planning, investment priorities, and roadmaps.

· Serve as a technology partner to business leaders, translating business needs into practical and scalable solutions.

· Lead cross-functional technology initiatives and evaluate emerging technologies that can strengthen enterprise capabilities.

Qualifications/Requirements

· At least 12+ years of professional experience leading or supporting enterprise IT infrastructure, technology roadmaps, business systems, and managed service providers

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology. Cybersecurity or related field required

· Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, or comparable cloud / enterprise technology certifications preferred

· Experience implementing or maturing cybersecurity programs, including NIST- or ISO-aligned controls and audit readiness preferred

· Experience with enterprise AI tools, automation, or responsible AI governance preferred

· Experience in the energy, infrastructure, power, renewable energy, or data center industry preferred, not required

Location: Redwood City, CA

Job Summary:

Piper Fire Protection is seeking a highly organized and customer-focused Inspections Coordinator to support our inspection operations team in Clearwater, FL. This role is responsible for scheduling and coordinating fire protection inspections, testing, preventative maintenance services, and related field activities for fire sprinkler systems, fire alarms, suppression systems, and fire extinguishers.

The ideal candidate has experience in scheduling, dispatching, customer service, or field service operations and excels in a fast-paced environment. This position plays a critical role in coordinating inspection scheduling, communicating with customers, optimizing technician scheduling and utilization, and ensuring services are assigned to appropriately qualified technicians. The Inspections Coordinator works closely with both office personnel and field staff to support operational goals, maintain compliance requirements, and deliver exceptional customer service.

This position is primarily office-based and involves prolonged periods of computer work, frequent communication with customers and field personnel by phone and email, and regular use of scheduling, service management, and office software systems. The role requires strong attention to detail, effective multitasking, the ability to manage competing priorities, and occasional lifting of office materials up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Schedule and coordinate fire protection inspections, testing, preventative maintenance services, and related field activities.
  • Contact customers by phone and email to schedule inspection appointments and confirm service visits.
  • Prioritize monthly inspection schedules based on contract requirements, due dates, customer needs, geographic routing, and operational efficiency.
  • Coordinate daily schedules based on customer needs, technician availability, geographic location, workload, and required licenses, certifications, and job-specific qualifications.
  • Monitor technician workloads and adjust schedules as necessary to accommodate changing customer needs and service demands.
  • Ensure technicians assigned to work orders possess the appropriate qualifications, certifications, and skill sets necessary to complete the required inspections and testing.
  • Coordinate rental equipment, materials, and parts required for scheduled inspection and service work.
  • Maintain and administer technician on-call schedules for after-hours emergency response, as needed.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for customers regarding inspection scheduling, service requests, appointment confirmations, and status updates.
  • Communicate proactively with customers, property managers, and stakeholders regarding upcoming inspections, technician arrival times, scheduling changes, and service completion status.
  • Resolve scheduling conflicts, customer concerns, and service-related inquiries in a professional and timely manner.
  • Work closely with office personnel, inspection staff, technicians, and management to support efficient workflow coordination and successful completion of scheduled inspections.
  • Create, process, and maintain work orders, inspection schedules, and customer records within the company's service management and CRM systems.
  • Learn, navigate, and effectively utilize company scheduling, inspection, and service management software platforms.
  • Review technician inspection reports for accuracy and completeness.
  • Track inspection deficiencies, document findings, and coordinate with internal sales or service teams for follow-up repair recommendations and quotations.
  • Submit required inspection and compliance documentation to customers, local authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs), or third-party reporting platforms, when applicable.
  • Maintain accurate customer records, service histories, scheduling data, and inspection documentation.
  • Support departmental goals by identifying opportunities to improve scheduling efficiency, technician utilization, customer satisfaction, and operational performance.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in scheduling, dispatching, service coordination, customer service, logistics, field service operations, or a related administrative role.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook and Excel.
  • Experience using field service management, dispatching, work order, or CRM software such as ServiceTrade, Salesforce, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new software platforms, scheduling systems, and business applications.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and multitasking skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong customer service skills with confidence communicating professionally by phone and email.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to evaluate scheduling priorities and make decisions based on due dates, technician qualifications, customer needs, and route efficiency.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with office personnel, field staff, and management in a team-oriented environment.
  • Knowledge of local geographic routing and scheduling best practices preferred.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the fire protection, fire alarm, fire sprinkler, HVAC, electrical, mechanical, construction, plumbing, or related service industries.
  • Familiarity with NFPA standards, inspection schedules, and fire protection system testing requirements.
  • Experience coordinating field technicians for commercial inspection or service operations.
  • Understanding of service dispatching, preventative maintenance scheduling, recurring inspection programs, and compliance reporting.
  • Familiarity with technician licensing requirements, certifications, and trade-specific qualifications within the fire protection industry.

This role may require extended periods of sitting or standing, movement around the office or job site, and operation of standard equipment. Physical activities can include reaching, bending, kneeling, climbing, and lifting up to 75 lbs. Field positions may involve heavy lifting, working in varying climates (including outdoor conditions), construction or low-voltage environments, and exposure to dust, noise, or confined spaces. title: AGL - Building Operator (Downtown Halifax)
description:
Building Operator at The Armour Group Limited

Excellent mechanical aptitude. Skilled problem solver.
Does this sound like you? If so, this position may be for you.

About The Armour Group Limited
The Armour Group Limited is one of the leading hospitality, development and construction companies in Atlantic Canada. With its dedicated team of professionals, The Armour Group Limited continues a proud history of creating a sense of place in Nova Scotia – carefully designing, developing, constructing and operating some of our region’s most iconic buildings and businesses including Muir Hotel, Delta by Marriott Dartmouth, The Barrington Hotel and Queens Marque District. With more than 50 years of history locally, this family-owned firm remains committed to a principled approach to development, ensuring that our work is environmentally sustainable and integrated into the communities we serve. If you share our values and would like to work with skilled professionals, Armour is presently seeking a Building Operator, for Halifax Downtown Properties.

Job Description:Reporting to the Manager of Building Operations, you will be responsible for the maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting of building systems, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and other mechanical systems. You will also manage preventative maintenance programs, liaise with tenants and contractors, and ensure compliance with all relevant standards and regulations. Additionally, you will provide mentorship and operational support to the maintenance team while contributing to capital planning and budgeting efforts. The ideal candidate will play a key role in maintaining the operational integrity, ensuring all systems run smoothly and efficiently.

What you will be doing as a Building Operator:

Perform daily mechanical rounds to monitor building systems (HVAC, pumps, fans, boilers, heat pumps, emergency generators, etc.), noting any anomalies and recording findings;
Conduct daily, weekly, and monthly preventative maintenance tasks, ensuring proper documentation in the PM tracking system;
Oversee third-party contractors during scheduled maintenance, reviewing work in progress and contractor reports upon completion;
Respond promptly to tenant requests for heating, cooling, and other mechanical issues, ensuring quick resolution;
Act as the primary point of contact for contractors performing repairs and ongoing projects, ensuring all work is completed according to specifications and timelines;
Maintain a professional, open line of communication with tenants, addressing their concerns and ensuring their needs are met in a timely manner;
Monitor utility usage and investigate any anomalies, identifying opportunities for energy savings and cost reduction;
Provide operational support and guidance to junior maintenance staff, ensuring all tasks are completed with high standards and efficiency;
Offer technical training and assistance where required to improve the team's skillset and knowledge;
Assist in the planning, execution, and tracking of preventative maintenance protocols, ensuring they align with building operational goals;
Contribute to the planning and execution of capital operations and building improvements;
Support the preparation of building condition reports and help plan maintenance budgets;
Ensure all maintenance activities comply with current legislative requirements, company policies, and best practices;
Stay informed about changes in regulations to ensure the building remains compliant at all times;
Such other related duties and responsibilities as may be required from time to time.

The person we are looking for has:

3-5 years of experience in commercial building maintenance or operations;
Relevant certification or ticket in a technical field (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, or equivalent);
Strong knowledge of building systems (HVAC, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, etc.) and building automation systems (BAS);
Experience working with contractors, building operations teams, and tenants in a professional capacity;
Excellent problem-solving skills with a proactive, hands-on approach to maintenance;
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written;
Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to team members;
A solid understanding of preventative maintenance systems and the ability to develop and execute maintenance schedules;
Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment;
A commitment to continuous learning and growth.

Why join us and what's in it for you?

Competitive salary
Comprehensive extended Health & Dental benefits
Integrated learning environment with room to grow
Access to our gym and fitness facility
50% dining discount at Freehand locations
Company RRSP contributions
Employee Assistance Program
Eligible for company referral bonus program
Working along side a collaborative team of likeminded individuals
A collaborative and dynamic work environment where your contributions are valued.

As Armour Group is a family organization, we value our employees and their well-being. If you would like to join an organization at which you can have work life balance, career growth, long term job stability, and an opportunity to positively contribute to the Maritimes, this position may be for you!

Qualified applicants are invited to apply through the job link or submit their resume and cover letter to recruitment@armourgroup.com. Please note that, while we thank all applicants for applying, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Aircraft Records Specialist
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Air Mobility Group (AIRMOB) is responsible for developing and delivering Metrea’s aerial refueling (AAR) capabilities, ensuring the readiness and operational effectiveness of the tanker fleet. AIRMOB oversees fleet management, maintenance, and airworthiness, working to sustain and enhance refueling operations. It manages the integration of new processes and technologies, ensuring that tanker aircraft remain mission-ready through effective logistics, maintenance oversight, and regulatory compliance. By coordinating across various teams, AIRMOB ensures the fleet meets both current and future operational needs, supporting a range of specialized air mobility missions.

Position Summary

In this role, you will maintain the accuracy and integrity of aircraft maintenance records for AIRMOB’s aerial refueling fleet, ensuring every maintenance event is properly documented in AMOS and compliant with FAA requirements. You will handle daily records processing, data entry, document control, and filing while supporting the Records Manager in audits and quality reviews. You will be successful if you are organized, detail-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, compliance-driven environment where accuracy directly supports fleet airworthiness.

What You'll Do

  • Enter maintenance work orders, log cards, and inspection records into AMOS on a daily basis
  • Review maintenance documentation for completeness and accuracy before system entry
  • Scan, index, and file technical records in both electronic and hard-copy filing systems
  • Verify mechanic stamps, signatures, and required data fields on all maintenance forms
  • Update aircraft and component tracking databases with current status information
  • Track and document compliance with Airworthiness Directives (ADs) and Service Bulletins (SBs)
  • Maintain deferred defect logs and MEL tracking documentation
  • Research historical records to support maintenance planning and troubleshooting
  • Generate routine AMOS reports including aircraft status and compliance summaries
  • Coordinate with maintenance technicians to resolve documentation discrepancies

What You Bring

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s degree in aviation or a related field preferred
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in aviation records management or maintenance administration
  • Working knowledge of AMOS or a comparable maintenance tracking system
  • Understanding of basic FAA regulations related to maintenance documentation
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and Word
  • Strong communication skills for coordinating with maintenance personnel

Preferred Qualifications

  • AMOS user experience
  • Aviation maintenance background or A&P license
  • Experience with military aircraft documentation
  • Knowledge of KC-135 or Boeing aircraft records
  • Familiarity with Part 91, 121, or 135 operations
  • Experience with Adobe Acrobat for PDF management

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

  • Experience with electronic document management systems preferred
  • Understanding of configuration management principles a plus
  • Knowledge of SPEC 2000 or ATA chapter system a plus
  • Ability to obtain airport security badge (SIDA) where required

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical plan options
  • HSA/FSA accounts
  • Dental and vision coverage
  • 6% employer 401(k) match
  • Fully paid parental leave for all new parents
  • Generous PTO
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Long-term and Short-term disability coverage
  • AD&D Coverage
  • Pet Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Subsidized gym membership / plans through Wellhub

Work Authorization / Security Clearance

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

AAP/EEO Statement

This Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Hours and work shifts may change in accordance with department and business needs. Exempt Employees must have the ability to be on-call and available, as business needs require. Non-Exempt employees may be required to work over 40 hours per week with approval from the department manager.

Work Environment

This position operates primarily in an office environment with occasional visits to aircraft maintenance areas for documentation verification. Work involves extensive computer use for data entry and records processing. May require lifting and moving boxes of records (up to 30 lbs). The role requires sustained concentration for detailed documentation review and the ability to work in a deadline-driven environment. Occasional overtime may be required during aircraft inspections or audit preparations.

Travel

As required (~10%)

Base Pay Range

The compensation range shown below is a good faith estimate and reflects the expected base pay for this position upon hire. This is just one component of Metrea's overall approach to total rewards and final compensation decisions, including the ultimate salary or hourly rate agreed upon, may vary depending on factors such as job location, job-specific knowledge, skills, experience, and the overall negotiated compensation package. Eligible full-time employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package designed to support their health, wellbeing, and long-term success.

Pay Range
$36—$45 USD

Our Firmware

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

dit ga je doen

title: Clinical Services Responder
description:
Career Opportunity: Clinical Services Responder in the Tri-State of Kentucky and Surrounding Regions

Are you looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful, life-changing impact through organ donation? In this role, you will use your clinical expertise to evaluate potential donors, coordinate critical care and support, guide hospital professionals through time-sensitive decisions, and help maximize opportunities for successful donation. This position is ideal for a compassionate, detail-oriented healthcare professional who thrives in fast-paced, sensitive, and highly collaborative environments.

As a Clinical Services Responder, you will respond to referred potential organ donors, review medical records and clinical information, determine donation suitability under organizational and regulatory guidelines, and provide timely information to donor-hospital professionals. You will also document required donor information, assess family and hospital support needs, identify the legal next-of-kin, and assist with specimen collection and labeling requirements. This position reports to the Manager of Recovery Services and works across hospital clinical settings.

We are committed to supporting the professional growth and development of our team members, with opportunities to expand skills, take on additional responsibilities, and advance within the organization. In this role, you will be expected to consistently perform your work safely, ethically, and in accordance with organizational policies, professional standards, and applicable laws and regulations. Your commitment to safety, integrity, and compassionate care will be essential to supporting donors, their families, healthcare partners, and our mission.

Responsibilities:

  • Respond to potential organ donor referrals and evaluate clinical suitability using Life Connection of Ohio, CMS, OPTN/UNOS, AOPO, and CDC guidelines.
  • Identify clinical triggers that support timely hospital referrals of potential donors.
  • Review medical records, including present and past medical history, malignancies, surgeries, treatments, laboratory results, diagnostics, and procedural records.
  • Recognize organ-specific behavioral risk factors and understand legal and hospital requirements for death declaration and organ donation.
  • Assess family dynamics, available hospital support, and cultural, religious, emotional, and informational needs.
  • Identify the patient’s legal next-of-kin in accordance with state law and the Uniform Anatomical Gift Act.
  • Support required blood, culture, and tissue-typing specimen collection and labeling procedures.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential donor records in compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain current knowledge of donation standards and regulatory changes and communicate relevant updates to staff and leadership.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED and healthcare experience required.
  • Associate degree in nursing, respiratory care, paramedic medicine, biological sciences, or a related field preferred.
  • Relevant credentials may include LPN, STNA, Paramedic, EMT, or Medical Assistant.
  • One to two years of hospital experience required.
  • BLS, ACLS, and PALS certifications preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail, time management, professional communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to exercise discretion, protect confidential information, and collaborate effectively in sensitive clinical situations; nonprofit experience is helpful.

Physical Requirements:

Ability to work 12-hour shifts and outside normal business hours, respond promptly to dispatches, and travel to assigned sites. The role requires work in office and hospital settings, frequent sitting and typing, occasional physical activity, lifting up to 75 pounds, and assisting with donor transfers. Reasonable accommodations may be available to perform essential functions.

What do we offer:

  • Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance options.
  • Retirement savings benefits.
  • Employer-supported professional development and training opportunities.
  • Additional employee wellness and support resources.

If you are passionate about helping others and are ready to join a diverse and inclusive team; apply online today. Be a part of our future!

EEO/M/F/D/V. No third-party applications please.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Embedded)
description:
Forj Medical designs and develops custom electromechanical devices driven by safety-critical embedded software. We work in 4 major Technology Segments: Fluid & Gas Management, Optical Systems, Surgical Energy and Stimulation/Active Wearables. Our projects typically involve ‘greenfield’, bespoke designs - giving our engineers both depth and breadth in design challenges – opportunities to learn & grow abound.
What you’ll do
As a Senior Software Engineer at Forj, you’ll do more than write code. In this role, you’ll lead software development on cross-discipline engineering teams, be trusted to translate each client’s vision into embedded software reality, shape system software architecture, make thoughtful tradeoffs across functionality, performance, cost and maintainability – all while ensuring safety and security. You will combine hands-on technical contributions with leadership and influence – including significant autonomy in design choices and the responsibility to guide your software team through the full software development lifecycle.
Core responsibilities include:

Apply the Forj Quality Management System, FDA regulations, IEC 62304, and cybersecurity standards to software system development.
Lead requirements definition, architectural design, and technical decision-making across software-intensive medical device systems.
Provide detailed estimates in support of project milestones and software deliverables; deliver low to medium complexity projects within scope, schedule, and budget constraints.
Apply a unique feature-focused method of breaking down software system functionality; you'll iteratively lead your software team through architecture, design, implementation, testing and integration of software features in an agile workflow.
Provide leadership to a team of software engineers through work planning, task delegation, and coordination of execution.
Design, implement and test project source code.
Own the technical quality of all software artifacts - ensuring architectural integrity, code quality and design robustness through technical reviews, mentoring and leading by example.
Lead and support software initiatives - including process improvements and internal library contributions.
Represent Forj’s software capabilities and technical perspective in proposals, design reviews and client discussions.

You’ll have a chance to make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients – our recent products help clinicians treat cancer, sustain life and alleviate pain.
To top it off, we think you’ll enjoy working with other smart, curious and talented engineers as you bring medical devices to life.
What you bring
We’re more interested in a balance between breadth and depth than checking every box, but helpful experience includes:

BS, MS, or equivalent degree in Computer/Software Engineering, Computer Science or similar field.
5-9 years of experience in embedded software development in medical device or other regulated industry, ideally in a lead role with a track record of leading small software teams with an inspirational and effective leadership style.
The ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and build trust with clients and peers.
Significant experience with embedded Linux development on SoMs – particularly with Yocto Project/BSP and driver configuration.
Expertise in object-oriented programming using C++, C#, and/or C. Experience developing multithreaded and multiprocess applications. Familiarity with common design patterns is a bonus.
Demonstrated proficiency in solving high-complexity software problems – including a methodical, reasoned approach to reproducing and fixing bugs.
Microcontroller programming (ideally using ThreadX or other RTOS) including device driver development and use of debuggers, emulators, communication analyzers, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: device drivers and communication protocols; Qt/QML, LVGL or other GUI frameworks; automated builds and CI/CD; static analysis; Python or other scripting languages; medical-device cybersecurity.

How we work
Project teams are led by a Program Manager / Systems Engineer; technical leads from Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Test and Quality (to name a few) collaborate on projects for clients ranging from established companies to small startups.
We foster a strong engineering culture and operate under mature software & product development processes.
We invest in tools, automation and continuous improvement.
We work at an efficient, sustainable pace – taking time for fun along the way!

Must be authorized to work in the United States
