title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
About Us

Odeko is the all-in-one operations and technology partner to more than 20,000 independent coffee shops, cafes and other food establishments.

Through the Odeko web portal and mobile app, customers can purchase supplies from hundreds of national and local brands, track ordering trends, finance equipment, and access insurance. Customers that use Odeko can increase their revenue, reduce their environmental footprint, and save significantly on their cost of goods and time spent on vendor management.

Odeko is on a mission to continuously develop technology to champion your neighborhood cafes, coffee shops, and other independent F&B establishments.

Local coffee shops and cafes are the backbone of any given community, and we’re here to help manage the day-to-day tasks with a platform so intuitive, it’s kinda like magic.

The Odeko team is diverse, passionate, and innovative. Our 400+ employees are spread across numerous departments and business lines, but are single-minded in our mission to develop technology to support the many needs of our customers. We believe that small businesses need support now more than ever, and that Odeko is uniquely positioned to provide that support.

We're hiring a Senior Product Engineer who wants to own problems end to end. You'll talk to the people who have those problems, decide what to build, build it across the front end, back end, and data layer, ship it, and measure whether it worked. You will have the autonomy and authorization to make design, product, and architecture decisions within guidelines set by design and engineering leaders.

You'll build with AI agents as your default tooling. At Odeko, AI-assisted development is a professional standard and engineers are measured on how well they direct, review, and take responsibility for that output. This role assumes you already work this way and what we're hiring for is the judgment about what to build and whether it's right.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own product outcomes, not tickets. Take a problem from a café owner, warehouse lead, or account manager through discovery, scoping, build, launch, and follow-up, with a lot of autonomy in how you get there. We value results over process.
  • Work across the full stack: React Native/Web front ends, Ruby/Rails and TypeScript services, AWS infrastructure, and the data underneath — moving to wherever the problem lives.
  • Spend real time with stakeholders: sit with operations, join customer calls, visit a warehouse. Turn what you learn into decisions about scope, sequencing, and trade-offs, and be able to explain those decisions to non-engineers.
  • Prototype fast and iterate toward the best experience for cafés and users.
  • Build with AI agents as your primary mode of development: planning and decomposing work for agents, running parallel agent workflows, reviewing generated code critically, and maintaining the tests and guardrails that make agent output safe to ship.
  • Raise the team's bar: mentor other engineers, share agent workflows and prompts that work, and contribute to our AI engineering standards.

About you:

Essential:

  • 6–10+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent), with a track record of shipping and operating production applications.
  • Demonstrated product ownership: you can point to things you've shipped where you made the calls on scope and design, not just implementation. You've worked directly with customers or operations staff and changed what you built as a result.
  • Proven expertise across our core stack — TypeScript/JavaScript, React Native/Web, Ruby/Rails, AWS, CI/CD — and distributed application architecture. You don't need to be equally deep everywhere, but you need to be comfortable everywhere.
  • AI-native development as your default practice. Concretely: you use an agentic coding tool (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor agent mode, or similar) to produce the majority of your code; you plan and decompose work so agents can execute it; you review agent output with the same rigor as a colleague's PR and own the result. We'll ask you to demonstrate this live in the interview loop.
  • Strong written and verbal communication with product, design, and operations audiences. You can explain a technical trade-off to a warehouse manager and a business trade-off to an engineer.
  • Experience in a startup or similarly fast-moving, innovative environment with a track record of delivering scalable, mission-critical production applications.

Desirable:

  • Experience building LLM-powered product features: retrieval, tool use, agent workflows, evaluation and observability of model output.
  • Familiarity with Ruby/Rails, React, Federated GraphQL, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, and NetSuite.
  • Experience in logistics, supply chain, marketplace, or other operations-heavy products.
  • Design sensibility: comfortable making reasonable UI decisions without waiting for a mockup.

Compensation for this role is £90k-£100k annually depending on experience.

What you’ll love about Odeko:

  • Fast-paced environment and growth opportunities - plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and enhance your career!
  • Competitive compensation, healthcare benefits, and opportunity for equity
  • Other great perks - Full lists of benefits available upon request

Odeko is proud to be a diverse, equitable, and inclusive employer. We encourage all to apply regardless of educational background, race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.

description:

We are looking for On-Call Archaeologists (Cultural Resources Specialists) to join our growing Cultural Resources team in Washington State. Our team supports a wide variety of infrastructure, transportation, energy, and environmental projects throughout Washington and the Pacific Northwest. title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Care Access

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care. We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.

With programs like Future of Medicine, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and Difference Makers, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access, visit .

How This Role Makes a Difference

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a pivotal role in advancing Reify Health’s data-driven solutions for clinical trials. In this position, you will drive the development of statistical models and machine learning algorithms to improve patient enrollment and trial management. You’ll work in a highly regulated healthcare data environment, ensuring compliance with privacy standards while innovating on predictive analytics. This role involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams (especially ML Engineering) to translate complex data insights into practical, impactful tools for the clinical research community.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Site Randomization Forecasting: Develop/enhance forecasting models for site randomization and enrollment trends, enabling better planning and resource allocation across trial sites.
  • Patient Matching/Ranking Algorithms: Support projects to build algorithms that intelligently match patients to (or rank patients for) appropriate clinical trials, enhancing recruitment efficiency and patient inclusion.
  • Develop Other Advanced Statistical Models: Create and refine predictive models (Bayesian inference, regression analysis, time-series forecasting) to address other key clinical trial challenges and improve decision-making.
  • AI Monitoring and Bias Detection: Implement processes to monitor machine learning models in production, detecting bias or performance drift and ensuring models remain fair, accurate, and compliant.
  • Data Pipeline & Tooling Development: Build and optimize data pipelines and analytical workflows using tools like AWS Athena, Redshift, SageMaker, and dbt, enabling scalable model training and deployment.
  • Regulatory Compliance in Data Science: Ensure all data science practices align with HIPAA, GDPR, and other privacy regulations, integrating compliance considerations into model development and data handling.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with machine learning engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to integrate models into products and clearly communicate insights and recommendations.

The Expertise Required

  • Statistical & ML Expertise: Strong foundation in statistical modeling and machine learning techniques, including experience with Bayesian methods, regression analysis, and time-series forecasting.
  • Model Monitoring & Fairness: Proficiency in evaluating model performance and bias, with the ability to implement AI monitoring tools and bias mitigation strategies to ensure ethical and reliable outcomes.
  • Technical Toolset: Advanced programming skills in Python (with libraries such as scikit-learn, PyMC, mlforecast, etc.) and SQL, as well as familiarity with data transformation tools like dbt.
  • Cloud & Data Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud-based analytics and ML services, especially AWS tools (Athena for querying, Redshift for data warehousing, SageMaker for model development/deployment).
  • Regulated Data Handling: Experience working with sensitive healthcare or clinical trial data under regulations like HIPAA and GDPR, demonstrating a deep commitment to data privacy and security best practices.
  • Collaborative Communication: Excellent teamwork and meticulous verbal/written communication abilities, with a track record of partnering with engineering and product teams to translate data science work into actionable business solutions.
  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding of clinical research or health-tech environments is highly valuable, including insight into clinical trial operations and a passion for improving patient outcomes through data.

Certifications/Licenses, Education, and Experience:

  • Minimum Education:
    • Minimum of Master’s or Ph.D. in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Minimum Experience:
    • Minimum of 5+ years of hands-on data science or analytics experience, preferably in a healthcare, clinical research, or other highly regulated data environment.

How We Work Together

  • Location: Remote within the United States. This role requires 100% of work to be performed in a remote office environment.
  • Travel: This is a remote position with less than 10% travel requirements. Occasional planned travel may be required as part of the role.
  • Physical demands associated with this position Include: The ability to use keyboards and other computer equipment.

The expected pay range for this role is $140,000 - $190,000 USD per year for full time team members.

title: Directie- en bestuursassistent
description:
Jij bent dé rots in de branding voor bestuurs- en directieleden op ons kantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch. Dankzij jouw ondersteuning kunnen zij focussen op hun werk. Of je nu mails beantwoordt of vergaderingen voorbereidt: bij waterschap Aa en Maas zorg jij dat alles op rolletjes loopt.

Daarom kies je voor waterschap Aa en Maas

  • Jij staat als mens centraal: je kunt deels vanuit huis werken en krijgt alle ruimte om je te ontwikkelen
  • Een dijk van een arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket: denk aan een mooi salaris, een individueel keuzebudget en een goede pensioenregeling
  • Je hebt een centrale rol: daardoor leer je snel veel collega’s kennen en bouw je een breed extern netwerk op

Jouw impact als directie- en bestuursassistent

Zodra je ons kantoor binnenstapt weet je al: jouw dag loopt waarschijnlijk anders dan je had verwacht. En precies daar krijg je energie van! In onze huidige werkverdeling ben jij de rechterhand van de directeur Waterveiligheid en een portefeuillehouder. Jouw doel? Hen zo goed mogelijk ondersteunen, zodat zij samen met hun medewerkers de ambities van ons waterschap kunnen waarmaken: zorgen voor veilig, schoon en voldoende water. Juist dat maakt jouw baan extra boeiend. Want je krijgt veel mee van wat er speelt binnen ons waterschap.

Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden

  • Agenda’s beheren, mailboxen bijhouden en afspraakverzoeken van collega’s en externe partijen coördineren
  • Vergaderingen organiseren, vooral de wekelijkse portefeuillehoudersoverleggen: je stelt de agenda’s op, zorgt dat de vergaderstukken volledig zijn en notuleert
  • Acties uitzetten na de overleggen en erop toezien dat alles goed wordt opgevolgd
  • Telefoontjes beantwoorden en daarbij goed inschatten welke vragen of verzoeken prioriteit hebben

Kom aan boord en krijg …

  • Een brutomaandsalaris van minimaal € 3.426,- en maximaal € 4.478,- op basis van een 36-urige werkweek en schaal 8
  • Een aanstelling voor één jaar voor 24-28 uur per week om elkaar goed te leren kennen, daarna hopen we dat je voor onbepaalde tijd blijft
  • 21 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband
  • Een individueel keuzebudget (IKB) van 21% van je brutojaarsalaris (inclusief 8% vakantiegeld), boven op je normale salaris. Je kiest zelf hoe je deze bonus inzet: standaard uit laten betalen of gedeeltelijk inruilen voor extra vakantiedagen. Zo kun je maximaal 4 weken extra vakantie opnemen met 10% van je IKB, zonder dat het effect heeft op je pensioen
  • Fijne secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een goede pensioenregeling bij ABP, waarvan wij 66% betalen, en reiskostenvergoeding volgens de cao waterschappen
  • Een tegemoetkoming tot € 15.000 bruto in maximaal 5 jaar om je studieschuld af te lossen, als je die hebt
  • Een persoonsgebonden opleidingsbudget van € 6.000 per 5 jaar, zodat jij je kunt ontwikkelen. Voor medewerkers tot 35 jaar kan het budget op aanvraag verhoogd worden tot maximaal € 12.000 per 5 jaar
  • Hulp bij jouw volgende carrièrestap

Lees alles over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Deze functie past bij jou als je …

  • Minimaal mbo+-niveau hebt
  • Ervaring hebt in een vergelijkbare functie, bij voorkeur in een politiek-bestuurlijke omgeving
  • Stevig in je schoenen staat en het belang van de agenda’s van de directie- en bestuursleden vooropstelt
  • Een vertrouwensband met de bestuurs- en directieleden kunt opbouwen en goed weet in te spelen op hun wensen en behoeften
  • Flexibel bent in je werktijden, zodat je – als het echt nodig is – ook buiten je reguliere werktijden optimale ondersteuning kunt bieden
  • Makkelijk contact legt en helder communiceert met collega’s op diverse niveaus
  • Gestructureerd werkt en het overzicht bewaart, ook als de druk oploopt

Herken je jezelf niet overal in, maar denk je wel dat deze baan echt iets voor jou is? Dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te solliciteren.

Typisch team directie- en bestuursondersteuning

Een hecht team van 5 collega-assistenten, met wie je het secretariaat vormt van de afdeling Bestuur en Bedrijfsvoering. Samen ondersteunen jullie het dagelijks bestuur, de directie en de dijkgraaf. Kenmerkend voor ons team? We zijn goed op elkaar ingespeeld en springen voor elkaar in, bijvoorbeeld tijdens vakanties of als iemand ziek is. Ook lunchen we graag samen, of dat nu op kantoor is of buiten de deur. En in overleg met de bestuurs- en directieleden die je ondersteunt kun je ook deels vanuit huis werken.

Solliciteer en word waterschapper

Enthousiast? Solliciteer dan uiterlijk 25 oktober 2026 via de button. Bekijk onder aan de vacature hoe ons sollicitatieproces verloopt.

Goed om te weten: we hechten bij Aa en Maas veel waarde aan een veilige werkomgeving. Daarom vragen we je om een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG).

title: Economic Mobility Coach
description:
Economic Mobility Coach, Mandela Homes - Boston, MA
Summary: Responsible for design and implementation of economic mobility programs at Mandela Homes including strengthening and expanding existing initiatives and building out new programs in partnership with the Mandela Residents Cooperative Association, Inc. (MRCA) and Beacon Communities staff. The Economic Mobility Coach role is multifaceted and requires the coordinator to be a mentor, networker, motivator, teacher, and coach. This role leads program design and implementation and provides one-on-one economic mobility coaching for participating families to provide them with access to financial education / literacy / empowerment / coaching programs and opportunities. The goal is to help participants acquire the knowledge, skills, and resources to make informed and effective decisions that ultimately help them and their families reach their goals and achieve self-sufficiency and financial stability.
Reports to: Area Resident Service Manager – Boston
Direct Reports: NONE
FLSA Status: Exempt
Location: On Site
Essential Functions of the Position:
Implement New & Existing Economic Mobility Programs

Lead management and expansion of existing programs and lead strategy development and implementation of new programs.
Manage existing education scholarships and driver’s license assistance program.
Design program requirements and implement school attendance incentive initiative.
Do resident outreach to market programs and recruit participants.
Establish and implement additional program structures and procedures as needed to effectively implement and expand existing programs.
Research best practices and other economic mobility program models to create additional program proposals.
Implement new programs in partnership with MRCA.

Mandela Homes Family Self-Sufficiency Program Development & Implementation

Design a Mandela Homes Family Self-Sufficiency Program (FSS) modeled after the HUD Family Self-Sufficiency program.
Create and execute an implementation plan, including enrolling participant families and providing trauma-informed, resident-centered economic mobility coaching, referrals, and programming.
Research program models and implementation best practices, learning from sources including but not limited to: HUD-funded FSS model; Beacon’s Senior FSS Coordinator and other Community Engagement department staff; and feedback from MRCA and Mandela Homes residents.
Establish strategy and policies to implement the program in partnership with the MRCA, including necessary documentation such as program eligibility requirements; policies and procedures; assessments and surveys; participant contracts and action plans; and informational materials for residents, staff, and community members.
Develop outreach materials including informational brochures and marketing materials.
Conduct outreach to market the program and interview interested residents.
Complete assessments of residents and enroll them in the program including completing participant contracts and action plans; reassess and revise goals as necessary with residents.
Provide one-on-one coaching, case management, and referrals for participants to external partners.
Ensure that the services and support included in participants' contracts are provided on a regular basis and that participants are fulfilling their responsibilities under the contracts.
Monitor the progress of participants, promote opportunities for them to increase their income and address and eliminate barriers to advancement and graduation.
Set up and manage participant escrow savings accounts through MRCA funding sources and any additional funding that may come available.

Work with MRCA and Beacon’s Accounting Department to provide needed information to create escrow accounts and ensure that they are properly maintained for eligible families.
Ensure that participating families are provided with an annual escrow account balance statement, but more often is encouraged.
Meet quarterly with Beacon’s Accounting Department to review escrow account status for participants and address any forfeited escrow funds in accordance with established policies and procedures.

Based on outcomes of the Mandela Homes FSS program and in coordination with the MRCA and Beacon Communities, develop a HUD-compliant FSS Action Plan to consider proposing to HUD.

Networking and Community Resource Coordination

Partner with community organizations as needed to effectively implement education scholarships; driver’s license assistance program; school attendance incentive initiative; Mandela Homes FSS program; and any new economic mobility programs.
Collaborate with MRCA and Resident Service Coordinator(s) to provide residents with access to supportive services either onsite or through referral in areas such as training programs, career support, GED classes or other education, and homebuyer training.
Partner with organizations that conduct financial education workshops that cover topics such as credit, debt, savings, budgeting, asset building and banking services; and/or organizations that can provide financial coaching.
Identify gaps in service and problem solve to determine how to meet the needs.

Documentation and Reporting

Prepare clear, concise reports to be submitted as required.
Communicate clearly, both in writing and orally.
Create and maintain systems to track program participation and any necessary participant information for all economic mobility programs.
Document program activities, services, and referrals through Beacon documentation platforms and other system(s) as appropriate for all economic mobility programs.
Maintain case files, including participant contracts, action plans and goal achievement documentation, and assessment and surveys, for FSS program participants.

Minimum Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in sociology, psychology, education, or related field, or equivalent.
Experience: Two years’ experience as a HUD FSS Coordinator; Resident Service Coordinator; economic mobility coach; case manager or counselor; or combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Experience working with youth and families, including one-on-one coaching and programming, on issues relating to economic mobility including workforce development, youth enrichment, education, and asset building.
Knowledge of the local organizations and programs that can assist FSS participants and help provide for the financial literacy, asset building, job development and coaching needs of the residents.
Knowledge of Yardi, Property Management databases, ResidentConnect is a plus.
Knowledge of federal, state and local policies affecting housing particularly Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher (HCV) and HUD FSS program is a plus.
Skill in performing motivational interviewing with participants in order to help participants set goals and track follow-up progress.
Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with a wide variety of stakeholders, including but not limited to, residents, senior staff, interns, and community partners.
Excellent communication, organization, problem-solving and writing skills.
Proficiency with MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook and other computer programs.
Bilingual in English and Spanish is a plus.
Ability to understand and respect values, attitudes, and beliefs that differ across cultures and to respond appropriately to these differences with residents in planning, implementing, and evaluating programs and services.
Ability to collect, track and understand data in order to assess programs and partnerships and inform strategies.

Work/Travel Requirements: The Economic Mobility Coach will work on site in the Management / Leasing Office and will need to be able to work as needed days/hours that are outside of “traditional” work hours.
Compensation: $63,000 - $67,000 annual salary
Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

title: Principal Cybersecurity Specialist, Incident Response
description:
What’s in it for you as an employee of QFG?

Health & wellbeing resources and programs

Paid vacation, personal, and sick days for work-life balance

Competitive compensation and benefits packages

Work-life balance in a hybrid environment with at least 3 days in office

Career growth and development opportunities

Opportunities to contribute to community causes

Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment

This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

We’re looking for our next Principal Cybersecurity Specialist, Incident Response. Could It Be You?
The Principal Cybersecurity Specialist, Incident Response is a critical contributor to delivering sustainable and measurable results in identifying and responding to cyber threats - safeguarding our company's infrastructure and data. You will be primarily involved in leading the alert development cycle, triaging and investigating alerts, managing the full incident response lifecycle (investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery) and collecting and tracking metrics for reporting. The Principal Cybersecurity Specialist, Incident Response works alongside internal customers and our vendor support teams to ensure we are utilizing our security tools in accordance with corporate policies and growing business needs. You will work closely with Cybersecurity and IT teams to align priorities and execute plans for new initiatives, as well as drive process improvements and establish documentation for new tools.

Need more details? Keep reading…
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Mentoring and elevating the technical capabilities of the SOC team.

Monitoring, analyzing and reporting possible cybersecurity attacks.

Investigating and performing analysis of threat indicators.

Gathering Indicators of compromise and any relevant data to use with threat hunting activities.

Leveraging security tools (Elastic, CrowdStrike and more) for analysis to identify malicious activities.

Analyzing identified malicious activity to determine Tactics, Techniques and Procedures.

Conducting research, analysis and correlating gathered data from various resources to determine the impact of the incident.

Leading containment and eradication efforts, making critical decisions during high-severity incidents.

Participating in on-call and hands-on scheduled shift rotations, including outside of business hours.

Leading Security Incident Response and serving as the escalation point for complex investigations across internal teams and third party providers.

Documenting incident timelines, evidence, and actions taken for post-incident review.

Leading post-incident reviews and driving continuous improvement from lessons learned.

Defining and continuously improving the SOC's incident response playbooks, runbooks, and detection strategy.

Designing and leading tabletop exercises and IR simulations.

Coordinating and running proactive investigations and threat hunts across corporate environments and detecting malicious activities.

Maintaining up-to-date understanding of security threats, countermeasures, security tools, cloud security and SaaS technologies.

Setting the standard for technical proficiency; evaluating and recommending tools, techniques, and methodologies for the team.

Presenting investigation, incident response findings and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

Defining, owning, and reporting on SOC operational metrics (MTTD, MTTR, alert fidelity) and using data to drive strategic improvements.

So are YOU our next Principal Cybersecurity Specialist, Incident Response? You are if you have…

8+ years of relevant experience in performing and leading Cybersecurity Incident Response and Threat Hunting activities in a complex incident management or Security Operations Center environment

Extensive experience designing, implementing and optimizing detection rules and detection-as-code frameworks

Demonstrated expertise integrating security tools via APIs for automation, and hands-on experience implementing Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) workflows

Deep expertise leading complex, multi-vector investigations and incident response using EDR tools such as CrowdStrike Falcon and SIEM tools such as Elastic Security (KQL, ESQL, Timeline analysis)

Advanced experience with forensic triage (disk, memory, network) and multiple operating systems (Mac, Linux, Windows)

Proven track record of designing and maturing SOC processes, playbooks, detection strategies, SIEM correlation rules, and incident reports

Proven ability to lead incident management for high-severity incidents, with excellent communication under pressure

Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, JavaScript and others for security automation and tooling development

Deep understanding of NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK, and ability to apply them to detection engineering and threat modeling

Comprehensive understanding of security products and device monitoring tools including Firewalls, IDS/IPS, Phishing and e-mail security, content filtering, DDoS, WAF, and more

Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing technical skills across a security team

Strong ability to translate technical findings into strategic recommendations for leadership

Experience with cloud-native security monitoring (GCP, AWS, Azure)

Additional kudos if you…

Hold GCIH, GCED, CCFR, HTB CDSA, GCFA, CHFI, GREM, OSCP, CISSP or similar relevant certifications

Additional Information…

Operating hours for this role are standard office hours, Monday to Friday with on-call scheduled rotations, including weekends and evenings

Compensation Information:

Base salary range: $120,000 - $140,000

The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

title: Manager, Anti-Cheat Engineering (Embedded Vanguard) - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
location: Los Angeles, USA; Mercer Island, USA; Redwood City, USA
description:
Riot’s Anti-Cheat team is versatile and passionate about our craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with new tech stacks and bring security to all of Riot's games; each with its own security risk profile and complex challenges. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As an Anti-Cheat Engineering Manager for Mobile Vanguard, you will lead the team responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s services on mobile. You’ll help set direction, shape priorities, and ensure the team delivers secure, reliable capabilities across Vanguard’s mobile suite in a timely manner. While your primary focus will be enabling the team and driving outcomes, your strong fluency in mobile security and cheat techniques will allow you to guide architecture, challenge technical decisions, and step directly into complex debugging or investigations when needed. You’ll help the team anticipate and analyze emerging cheat techniques, then translate those findings into effective detections, mitigations, and preventative controls. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager of the Anti-Cheat team.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage, identify, recruit, interview, and hire engineers to help the team scale effectively
  • Set direction and drive high-impact anti-cheat capabilities from ambiguity through production to prevent cheating in mobile and console environments
  • Lead the team in rapidly translating emerging threats into resilient detections and preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed at scale
  • Balance immediate threat response with proactive technical investments that anticipate adversaries’ next moves or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
  • Partner with game teams across genres to understand their specific security needs and help shape the security landscape
  • Promote secure coding standards and design that reduce vectors for cheating
  • Keep up-to-date with the state of cheats and cheating techniques across mobile titles
  • Support game teams directly in understanding cheating ecosystems and integrating Anti-Cheat

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum 4+ years of industry experience
  • Familiarity or experience with Android and/or iOS platform security models
  • Deep technical understanding of mobile platforms (Android/iOS)
  • Experience building and deploying mobile native (C/C++) SDKs and/or frameworks

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with Android and/or iOS build tools (Android SDK/NDK, Xcode, LLVM)
  • Familiarity with Android & iOS executable formats, reverse engineering, or binary exploitation
  • Experience with mobile reverse engineering tools (Frida, IDA Pro, Radare2, etc)
  • Experience with Gen9 Console (Xbox Series XS and/or PS5) development a plus
  • Experience with macOS platform and security features a plus

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and choices that focus on your fellow Rioters, who are the customers of your work. Being a dedicated fan of games is not necessary for this position!

Our Perks:

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:

  • Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data
  • Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors
  • Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks
  • Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Nell’ottica del potenziamento della nostra divisione DWIT - Business Line dedicata all’IT Consulting di eGlue – stiamo ricercando una figura di Data Engineer per la Gestione Sistemi Consumer Dati.


Sede di Lavoro: Reggio Emilia, ibrido (10 giorni di remote working al mese).


Retribuzione: Range 35.000 - 45.000€RAL, in funzione dell’esperienza reale maturata. Fino a 35.000€ RAL per 2-3 anni di esperienza, fino a 45.000€ RAL per una seniority di almeno 5 anni.


Contratto: assunzione a tempo indeterminato con contratto CCNL Metalmeccanico. L’offerta include buoni pasto da 6,50€ per giorno lavorato, 200€ Welfare, Assicurazione Sanitaria a copertura del nucleo familiare.


La persona sarà responsabile di progettare e implementare le politiche di implementazione degli strumenti end user di elaborazione di dati all’interno dell’infrastruttura IT aziendale, garantendo che gli stessi siano gestiti in modo sicuro, conforme e ottimizzato per le esigenze di business.


Responsabilità:

  • Supervisionare l’intero ciclo di vita degli applicativi di front-end, dall’installazione e configurazione iniziali, alla manutenzione continua, fino alla dismissione, con particolare attenzione alla gestione dell’obsolescenza e all’aggiornamento tecnologico.
  • Collaborare con il team di sicurezza IT per implementare soluzioni di protezione dei dati (crittografia, access control, audit logging) conformi alle normative sulla sicurezza (es. GDPR).
  • Analizzare e risolvere problemi tecnici relativi agli strumenti di front-end, garantendo la continuità operativa e la soddisfazione degli utenti.
  • Fornire supporto tecnico e funzionale agli utenti aziendali, promuovendo l’adozione efficace degli strumenti di front-end e la comprensione delle loro potenzialità.
  • Assieme ai facility manager, gestire l’infrastruttura server dedicata agli strumenti di front-end, assicurando la loro disponibilità, performance e sicurezza.
  • Collaborare con gli amministratori dei sistemi di data lake e data management per garantire che le politiche di governance siano applicate in modo efficace, con particolare attenzione all’accesso ai dati, alla loro qualità e alla loro tracciabilità.
  • Definire e implementare la roadmap evolutiva degli strumenti di front-end, in linea con le esigenze di business e le tendenze tecnologiche del mercato. Collaborare con i vendor e gli stakeholder interni per pianificare e eseguire gli upgrade e le migrazioni necessarie.
  • Definire e implementare strategie di evoluzione degli strumenti per ambienti cloud ibridi o multi-cloud, assicurando la conformità delle soluzioni cloud-native alle politiche aziendali.


Requisiti:

  • Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o campi correlati. Certificazioni in Data Governance o Data Management sono un plus.
  • 2-5 anni di esperienza nella gestione di questo tipo di sistemi in ambienti industriali strutturati, preferibilmente in ambito bancario.
  • Esperienza con tecnologie di analisi dei dati come strumenti di reportistica e dashboarding (es. Business Objects, Power BI)), strumenti di advanced data analysis (es. SPS Modeler, SAS) e piattaforme di MLOPS (es: Vertex, Dataiku).
  • Esperienza anche breve nella gestione di infrastrutture cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e nei processi di governance su ambienti cloud, con particolare riferimento alla integrazione con gli ambienti enterprise on premise.
  • Conoscenza base delle metodologie di data analisi, ivi compresi i modelli di AI.
  • Familiarità con il provisioning di ambienti Cloud sui maggiori hyperscaler.
  • Capacità di interagire con team tecnici e non tecnici, tradurre i requisiti di governance in specifiche tecniche e fornire supporto durante l’implementazione.
  • Esperienza nella gestione di progetti di evoluzione e migrazione di server.
  • Competenze in materia di networking e gestione della connettività.
  • Esperienza nello sviluppo e implementazione di piani di testing.
  • Competenze nella gestione della sicurezza informatica e delle normative di conformità.
  • Capacità di lavorare in autonomia e gestire progetti end-to-end.

title: Medewerker centrale servicedesk ICT
description:
Snel en communicatief vaardig ICT-verstoringen oplossen, zodat het treinverkeer door kan rijden.

Werk om trots op te zijn

Met 7.000 kilometer spoor en ruim 1 miljoen reizigers per dag is het een enorme opgave om alle treinen op tijd te laten rijden. Onze ICT-systemen behoren tot de top en hebben een 24x7 beschikbaarheid van het hoogste niveau.

De ICT-omgeving van ProRail is complex en bedrijfskritisch. Verstoringen willen we daarom zoveel mogelijk voorkomen, want elke verstoring heeft direct impact op reizigers en vervoerders. De afwisseling tussen acute incidenten oplossen én preventieve maatregelen nemen voor de toekomst: dat is jouw drive! ProRail heeft haar eigen netwerken en ontwikkelt een groot deel van de applicaties zelf op eigen platformen. Denk aan applicaties voor het aansturen van de seinen, wissels en voor de reisinformatieborden. Jij houd je bezig met:

  • Het eerstelijns contact met onze klanten.
  • Het oppakken en oplossen van incidenten, bewaken van de voortgang van storingen en wijzigingsverzoeken en de correcte afhandeling en vastlegging in de incidentendatabase.
  • Het veiligstellen van gegevens, zoals logfiles en het fysiek/logische toegangs- en gegevensbeheer.
  • Het functieherstel en het monitoren van systeemgedrag.

De functie medewerker centrale servicedesk ICT is binnen de ProRail organisatie onmisbaar en wordt daarom in een vroeg/laat/nacht rooster uitgevoerd (24/7). Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

Wij kozen voor een kleine selectie uit onze arbeidsvoorwaarden. Maar we bieden je meer. Voor alle arbeidsvoorwaarden en onze CAO klik op deze link.

Jouw inbreng

Bij ProRail vinden wij het belangrijk dat jij gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Daarom zijn wij benieuwd naar wie jij bent. Voor deze functie breng je sowieso mee:

Jouw sollicitatie

Wil je als medewerker centrale servicedesk ICT werken aan de toekomst van Nederland én aan die van jezelf? Solliciteer voor 22 oktober. Toch eerst nog een vraag over de werving? Stel deze gerust tot en met 15 oktober aan recruiter Lieselot Simonis via lieselot.simonis@prorail.nl. Voor inhoudelijke vragen kun je contact opnemen met de Bastiaan Onwezen, manager Operatie & Centrale servicedesk, via bastiaan.onwezen@prorail.nl.

Binnen 5 werkdagen na de sluitingsdatum krijg je onze reactie. Gesprekken met een afvaardiging van de afdeling, management en recruitment plannen we in overleg. Eventueel vragen we je enkele dagen daarvoor een online assessment te maken voor het gesprek met de manager en recruiter als aanvulling op je cv en motivatie. title: Analist Speciële Chemie | Point of Care Testing
description:
Functie

Wil je bijdragen aan hoogwaardige specialistische zorg in een academische setting en meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van state-of-the-art laboratoriumbepalingen? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Ben jij die enthousiaste en vakbekwame collega die ons team wil komen versterken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Binnen het Radboudumc Laboratorium voor Diagnostiek zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste en gedreven analist voor de sectie Speciële Chemie / Point-of-Care Testing (POCT).

Binnen onze sectie wordt gewerkt met moderne analysetechnieken, waaronder nefelometrie, Fourier-Transform-Infraroodspectroscopie (FTIR) en spectrofotometrie, uitgevoerd met geavanceerde geautomatiseerde systemen. De dienstverlening voor Point-of-Care Testing binnen ons ziekenhuis wordt verzorgd door de analisten van Speciële Chemie / POCT.

Met jouw expertise, nauwkeurige werkwijze en samenwerking met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat patiënten optimaal worden behandeld. Je komt te werken in een academisch centrum, waar je te maken krijgt met uiteenlopende en bijzondere casuïstiek. Iedere werkdag biedt nieuwe uitdagingen en de mogelijkheid om jouw expertise in te zetten voor onze persoonsgerichte zorg.

Naast patiëntenzorg houd je je samen met je directe collega's bezig met innovatie, onderzoek en de ontwikkeling van specialistische bepalingen. Door de nauwe samenwerking met de Stichting Kwaliteitsbewaking Medische Laboratoriumdiagnostiek (SKML) binnen onze sectie ben je betrokken bij de standaardisatie van klinisch-chemische testen, onder andere door het maken en targetten van monsters voor rondzendingen. Daarnaast voeren we bepalingen uit voor onderzoek dat zowel binnen als buiten de organisatie wordt geïnitieerd.

Jouw werkplek

Het Radboudumc Laboratorium voor Diagnostiek (RLD), onderdeel van de afdeling Laboratoriumgeneeskunde, heeft een veelzijdig takenpakket in patiëntenzorg, onderwijs en (wetenschappelijke) trials en relatiebeheer. Het verrichtingenpakket ten behoeve van de patiëntenzorg omvat naast routine bepalingen op het terrein van de Klinische Chemie, POCT, Hematologie en Transfusiegeneeskunde, ook specialistische bepalingen op het gebied van onder andere de Endocrinologie, Chemie en Hb-pathie.

Binnen het RLD is de frontoffice voor de afdelingen Laboratoriumgeneeskunde, Medische Microbiologie, Pathologie, Genetica en Apotheek ondergebracht. Het RLD beschikt over een geaccrediteerd kwaliteitssysteem volgens de ISO 15189 en ISO 22870 voor medische laboratoria. In totaal werken er ongeveer 130 medewerkers (112 fte).

Profiel

Wij zijn op zoek naar een gemotiveerde collega met een HLO werk- en denkniveau en interesse in specialistische chemische bepalingen. Enkele jaren aantoonbare werkervaring binnen een klinisch chemisch laboratorium zijn vereist, waarbij kennis van specialistische chemische bepalingen essentieel is. Ervaring met nefelometrie is hierbij een pré.

Zorgvuldigheid, deskundigheid en een klantgerichte instelling kenmerken jouw werkwijze. Daarnaast beschik je over goede communicatieve vaardigheden en werk je graag samen met collega's. Flexibiliteit en een zelfstandige werkhouding maken dat je breed inzetbaar bent.

Goed om te weten

  • De eerste sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats in de ochtend van 26 oktober 2026. Fijn als je hier alvast rekening mee houdt.
  • Een meeloopdag maakt onderdeel uit van deze sollicitatieprocedure.
  • Wil je meer weten over deze vacature? neem dan contact op met Stan Verweij (operationeel manager) of Miranda van Berkel (klinisch chemicus), via email of via (024) 361 76 38 (secretariaat).
  • Voor deze functie is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) vereist.

Wij werven zelf voor deze vacature. Acquisitie stellen wij niet op prijs; delen in je netwerk wél.

title: Data Science Intern

Data and AI at SageSure:

Whether you’re developing predictive models, enhancing AI-driven capabilities, strengthening data governance, or uncovering insights that influence key decisions, you’ll play a critical role in shaping how SageSure uses data and intelligence to lead the future of insurance.

About SageSure:

Named among the Best Places to Work in Insurance by Business Insurance for four years in a row (2020-2023), SageSure is one of the largest managing general underwriters (MGU) focused on catastrophe-exposed property in the US. We champion belonging and inclusion for all identities, including, but not limited to, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, ability status, gender, and country of origin, striving to create a culture where all individuals feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.

title: Implementation Project Manager (WMS & TMS)
description:
Implementation Project Manager (WMS/TMS)

Location: Remote – United States
Department: Professional Services / Implementation
Salary Range: $95,00–$115,000 annually

About ShipHawk

ShipHawk is a leading provider of warehouse and transportation management software, helping businesses streamline fulfillment operations, optimize shipping, and scale efficiently. Our technology empowers companies to simplify complex logistics processes and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

We're a growing team of passionate problem-solvers who thrive on collaboration, innovation, and delivering meaningful results for our customers.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced, highly organized, and customer-focused Implementation Project Manager to join our team.

In this role, you'll lead end-to-end implementations of ShipHawk's Warehouse Management System (WMS) and Transportation Management System (TMS) solutions, ensuring customers are set up for success from kickoff through go-live.

You'll own multiple customer implementations simultaneously, coordinating technical resources, managing timelines, and serving as the primary point of contact throughout the implementation journey.

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced SaaS environment, takes ownership of outcomes, and knows how to keep complex projects moving forward. You'll be equally comfortable leading customer conversations, managing project details, and collaborating with technical teams to deliver successful implementations.

What You'll Do

Lead Customer Implementations

  • Own and manage multiple concurrent WMS and TMS implementation projects from kickoff through successful go-live.

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.

  • Proactively manage dependencies, identify risks, and remove roadblocks to keep projects on track.

  • Ensure implementations are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with customer expectations.

Own Customer Communication & Relationships

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the implementation process.

  • Lead customer kickoff meetings, status updates, and project discussions with clear agendas, action items, and next steps.

  • Provide proactive, transparent communication regarding project progress, timelines, risks, and deliverables.

  • Set clear expectations and build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders.

  • Identify and escalate potential challenges early while maintaining a solutions-oriented approach.

Drive Project Execution & Accountability

  • Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date project documentation, task tracking, and status reports.

  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.

  • Follow up on outstanding action items and drive accountability across project teams.

  • Anticipate potential delays and develop actionable contingency plans to keep implementations moving forward.

  • Balance competing priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail across multiple projects.

Partner with Technical Teams

  • Collaborate closely with Implementation Engineers, Product, and other internal teams to support successful deployments.

  • Perform or coordinate system configuration, data setup, integrations, testing, and validation activities.

  • Develop a strong understanding of ShipHawk's WMS and TMS solutions and how they support customer operations.

  • Help troubleshoot implementation challenges by bringing together the right technical resources.

  • Ensure customers are prepared for go-live through appropriate testing, validation, and readiness activities.

Continuously Improve

  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, documentation, and customer experiences.

  • Share best practices and lessons learned across the team.

  • Contribute to scalable implementation methodologies that support ShipHawk's continued growth.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, technical project management, or customer-facing software delivery.

  • Proven experience managing multiple complex customer implementation projects simultaneously.

  • Strong project management skills, including planning, prioritization, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence leading customer-facing meetings.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a track record of meeting deadlines and driving projects to completion.

  • Comfortable working with technical concepts, software configurations, data workflows, and integrations.

  • Self-starter mentality with a high level of accountability, initiative, and ownership.

  • Ability to adapt quickly, solve problems independently, and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), ERP platforms, or other supply chain technology.

  • Understanding of warehouse operations, order fulfillment, inventory management, shipping, or logistics workflows.

  • Experience working with APIs, EDI, system integrations, or data migration processes.

  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Asana, Jira, Monday.com, or similar platforms.

  • Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

  • PMP, CSM, or other relevant project management certifications.

What Success Looks Like

  • Successful Go-Lives: Customer implementations are delivered on time, within scope, and with a smooth transition to production.

  • Strong Customer Experience: Customers feel informed, supported, and confident throughout their implementation journey.

  • Proactive Project Ownership: Risks are identified early, action items are consistently followed through, and projects continue moving forward.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Internal teams and customer stakeholders have clear expectations, responsibilities, and timelines.

  • Operational Excellence: Project documentation is accurate, deliverables are tracked, and implementation processes continuously improve.

Why Join ShipHawk?

At ShipHawk, you'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on how businesses manage their warehouse and shipping operations. You'll work alongside a collaborative team, solve meaningful operational challenges, and play an important role in delivering technology that helps our customers grow.

We value people who take initiative, communicate openly, embrace challenges, and take pride in delivering exceptional results.

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $95,000–$115,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and relevant expertise.

Equal Employment Opportunity

ShipHawk is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities throughout the hiring process and employment.

title: Coördinerend (persoonlijk) begeleider Ouderen
description:
Voor locatie Phila Rank in Gorinchem zoeken wij een Coördinerend Begeleider voor 24 uur per week, meer uren zijn bespreekbaar.

Werk jij graag met ouder wordende cliënten met een verstandelijke beperking? Zoek je een functie waarin je zowel coördineert als meewerkt op de groep? Dan voel jij je waarschijnlijk snel thuis op Phila Rank.

Jouw rol

Als Coördinerend Begeleider/ Persoonlijk Begeleider ben jij de stabiele factor binnen de woning. Je bewaart het overzicht, houdt de zorgkwaliteit scherp in de gaten en bent tegelijk zichtbaar aanwezig voor cliënten en collega’s.

Je werkt met ouder wordende cliënten (50+) met een verstandelijke beperking. Sommige bewoners worden lichamelijk kwetsbaarder, anderen hebben meer behoefte aan structuur, nabijheid of duidelijkheid. Jij ziet wat iemand nodig heeft en weet daarin rust en vertrouwen te brengen.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het zorgproces rondom cliënten en zorgt dat alles goed op elkaar aansluit. Van ondersteuningsplannen tot afstemming met familie, mentoren en behandelaren: jij houdt de lijnen kort en helder.

Daarnaast werk je gewoon mee op de groep. Juist die combinatie maakt deze functie sterk. Je staat niet op afstand te coördineren, maar weet precies wat er speelt.

Dit ga je doen:

  • Coördineren van het zorgproces rondom cliënten
  • Opstellen, bewaken en evalueren van ondersteuningsplannen
  • Ondersteunen van cliënten bij dagelijkse keuzes en zelfstandigheid
  • Afstemmen met familie, mentoren en behandelaren
  • Bewaken van kwaliteit van zorg en begeleiding
  • Collega’s ondersteunen in structuur en samenwerking
  • Meewerken op de woning en overzicht behouden
  • Organiseren, prioriteren en helder communiceren

Binnen de locatie werken jullie onder andere met Active Support en de visie “Vergroot je wereld”.

Over de locatie

Phila Rank is een moderne woonlocatie in Gorinchem, geopend in 2018. De locatie bestaat uit drie verdiepingen met ieder twaalf bewoners. In totaal wonen er 36 ouder wordende cliënten met een verstandelijke beperking.

Bewoners hebben een eigen appartement en ontvangen begeleiding en zorg passend bij hun ondersteuningsvraag. Veel cliënten gaan overdag naar werk of dagbesteding, anderen blijven op locatie. Daardoor is geen dag hetzelfde.

Je werkt in een betrokken team waar aandacht is voor elkaar én voor de bewoners. De diensten zijn onregelmatig. Denk aan korte ochtenddiensten, avonddiensten en weekenddiensten. Dat vraagt flexibiliteit, maar geeft ook vrijheid in je rooster.

Wat maakt deze locatie bijzonder?

Bij Phila Rank draait het niet alleen om goede zorg, maar ook om goed werkgeverschap. Manager Fia Hijweege staat bekend als een betrokken en mensgerichte leidinggevende. Geen management op afstand, maar iemand die meedenkt, luistert en kijkt waar jouw kracht ligt.

Collega’s omschrijven de sfeer als warm, open en eerlijk. Je krijgt hier ruimte om jezelf te zijn, mee te denken en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Daarnaast werk je met een doelgroep waarin je écht verschil maakt. Ouder wordende cliënten met een verstandelijke beperking vragen om nabijheid, geduld, overzicht en menselijke aandacht. Juist dat maakt het werk betekenisvol.

Wat wij bieden
Bij Philadelphia halen we het beste uit elkaar. Daarom zorgen wij voor:

  • Een brutosalaris volgens de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg van minimaal € 2951,- en maximaal € 3980,- FWG 40 bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur, gebaseerd op je ervaring en opleiding. En bij onregelmatige diensten krijg je een extra toeslag;
  • Ruimte om te groeien, zoals jij dat wilt: met jouw talent en ambitie, maar ook met ons Leerhuis en de vele opleidingsmogelijkheden;
  • De mogelijkheid om je vakantietoeslag en/of eindejaarsuitkering maandelijks te laten uitbetalen;
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng en het ontwikkelen van jouw talenten, je werkt mee aan projecten en activiteiten;
  • Korting op uitjes, je sportschool en een interessante laptop- en fietsregeling en voordelen als extra vrije dagen tot aan coaching. Kies wat jij wilt;
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng; Wij zijn altijd op zoek naar mogelijkheden om onze begeleiding te verbeteren. Werken mee aan projecten en activiteiten!
  • Basisrooster wat voor een jaar wordt uitgerold ( vastgesteld rooster).
  • Een contract voor bepaalde tijd, na gebleken geschiktheid onbepaalde tijd.

Bekijk al onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent iemand die overzicht houdt zonder afstandelijk te worden. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen cliëntzorg, coördinatie en samenwerken met collega’s en netwerk. Je bent praktisch ingesteld, communiceert duidelijk en voelt goed aan wat cliënten nodig hebben. Daarnaast durf je verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet je rust te brengen, ook op drukke momenten.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een afgeronde mbo niveau 4 opleiding in zorg en welzijn
  • Ervaring met of affiniteit met ouder wordende cliënten met een verstandelijke beperking
  • Ervaring met coördineren of organiseren binnen de zorg
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden
  • Organisatorisch inzicht en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel
  • Een gezonde dosis humor

Solliciteren?

Wil je bij ons aan de slag en deel uitmaken van deze warme, betrokken locatie? Solliciteer via de SOLLICITEER BUTTON met jouw cv, een motivatiebrief is welkom. We behandelen sollicitaties doorlopend, dus reageer vandaag nog. Heb je vragen of wil je eerst even sparren? Neem gerust contact op met Recruitment via recruitment@philadelphia.nl

title: Visiting Graduate Student (Academic Credit) - Department of Neurology - Per Diem (On-site)
description:
Description

About Us:

We are a leading research institution committed to advancing scientific knowledge and innovation. Our team is dedicated to conducting ground breaking research and providing meaningful learning opportunities for aspiring scientists. Join us and contribute to our mission while gaining invaluable experience in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

Dr. Paula Barreras invites you to consider this great opportunity to join her dynamic team!

We can only consider applicants who will be able to commute to our Los Angeles location a few times per week. You must reside in the commutable area.

Overview of Department & Mentor

Neuroimmunoloy and cerebrovascular disorders cross overlap with many patient presentation’s and pathologies given the similar presentations that can happen with both disorders including spinal cord infarction and inflammatory disorders such as sarcoidosis and neurosarcodiosis. Acute stroke treatment and treatment of neuroimmunology disorders has evolved greatly over the past few years. Imaging, omic’s and genetics can reveal patients’ clinical trajectory and identify novel therapeutic pathways to develop new stroke and cerebrovascular disease treatments. The goal of this project is to assist in the development of blood biomarkers, MRI, and clinical outcomes database for bioinformatics for neurologic disorders that cross both the neuroimmunology spectrum and cerebrovascular disease. Students will work on projects as part of the Dr. Barreras lab as the primary mentor and with secondary mentor Dr. Simpkins SkRIPT/CREST, which incorporates team science and career development program for trainees with an interest in stroke.

Role Summary & Objectives

This visiting appointment will provide and introduction to clinical research. The intern will be taught the importance of human subject’s protection, HIPAA, research compliance, IRB review. The intern will learn the importance of chart review, keeping accurate and detailed records and logs, data entry, basics of manuscript writing, and data analysis. The intern will also learn basic information about stroke pathophysiology, brain imaging, and neuroanatomy. The intern will work on manuscript writing and statistical analysis.

Role Activities & Timeline

Role Activities and curriculum (skills to be learned) over the course of 1 year:

  • Literature review 1 month.
  • Chart view and redcap entry 7 months.
  • Manuscript writing last 3 months.
  • Presentation development 1 month.

Career Development mentorship throughout:

  • CV building.
  • Pre-residency neurology prep lectures.
  • Presentation skills.
  • Basics of project development and critical thinking for research project development.

Qualifications

Required Education & Experience

  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Must have a HS Diploma or GED.
  • Must reside in the greater Los Angeles area or surrounding cities while conducting all activities related to the intern or visitor appointment.
  • INTERNS: Those participating for academic credit must receive academic credit for the duration of the internship.
  • VISITORS: Must be receiving funding from an eligible sponsoring institution (employer, educator, funder, etc.).

Preferred Education, Experience, and Skills

  • Graduate student currently enrolled in a graduate school (Master’s program, PhD, or Medical School).

title: Production Tunnel Operator
description:
Overview
Performs work as part of a team in an industrial laundry facility. Responsible for the safe, expeditious, and accurate handling of merchandise into and/or out of the laundry facility.
Responsibilities / Essential Functions

Prepares their work station.
Transfers hangers from hanger rack to shirt or pant hanging aid.
For shirts, flips hanger up on to hanger aid, removes shirt from tub or table and dresses shirt on hanger, pulls sleeves out (if needed).
For pants, removes pant from tub or table, grasps the zipper end while stretches the waist band with the other hand, applies one brisk shake to allow pant crease to fall in place, lays the pant over the hanger aid, advances the hanger up to the slotted area, and removes the pant from the hanging aid.
Identifies any merchandise repairs not meeting specified quality standards in terms of tears, holes, stains, ink spots, torn/worn labels/emblems, or missing buttons with the application of a twist tie to the hanger of item that needs repair.
Ensures that garment is placed on an open conveyor pick.
Maintains safe and clean work environment, and observes best practices in all production activities.
Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

Ability to understand all required training, written, and verbal instructions.
Working knowledge of basic math skills.
Good verbal and/or written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to meet attendance schedule.

Working Environment / Safety Requirements

Work is performed in a warehouse setting and regularly exposed to outside weather conditions, extreme heat and cold conditions as well as dust and noise.
Work is based on a shift schedule, and may include weekends.
Overtime required as needed.

Physical Requirements
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Position involves repetitive motions over the duration of an entire shift.
Requires bending, reaching, pulling, twisting, and lifting.
Requires the use of hands for grasping and other manipulations.
Requires standing and walking for long periods of time.

Education
High school degree or equivalent preferred.

Location: South Bend, IN

title: Professional Regulation Officer (9-Month Term)
description:
The Law Society of BC is seeking a temporary, full-time Officer in our Professional Regulation for a 9-month term. The Professional Regulation Officer works with the Professional Regulation Department in general and with the Chief Legal Officer (CLO) on special projects, initiatives, and oversees the office of the CLO. Additionally, they provide support to Staff Lawyer, Professional Regulation and Staff Lawyer, Alternative Processes Program and work closely with others within the department and the Law Society as a whole. This position also supervises the Professional Regulation Coordinator and Professional Regulation Assistant.
The duties of the position include:

Working on departmental, Law Society and national projects and initiatives.
Managing the processes for the Administrative Penalty Process, Alternative Discipline Process, Rule 10-4 files, and responses for s.87 requests. This includes opening/closing files, tracking and keeping information up-to-date, and drafting/reviewing correspondence and letters.
Preparing memos for the CLO and Professional Regulation, Staff Lawyer.
Conducting original LSIS and file research and analysis of data for the CLO on a wide variety of projects related to the Professional Regulation Department, including gathering information and data from various sources including other regulatory bodies.
Performing statistical analysis relevant to special projects and as assigned by the CLO.
Drafting guidelines and process checklists.
Preparing reports to Benchers and other groups, including producing the yearly National Discipline Standards report for the Federation of Law Societies of Canada.
Responding to inquiries from the public and legal profession.
Providing training, supervision and direction to the Professional Regulation Coordinator in the handling of judicial applications and KC nominations. Supervision includes approving timesheets, conducting performance reviews, and providing feedback.
Coordinating the Discipline Committee process, including preparing agendas, addendums, agenda summaries and orientation materials, scheduling, setting up and administering meetings, and communicating with committee members.
Providing support to the Discipline Committee chair regarding administrative penalty disputes & orders.
Assisting in the preparation of presentations, including for Benchers or external stakeholders.
Working with the CLO in planning significant events such as the Discipline Administrators Conference and Professional Regulation Management team retreats and meetings.
Additional duties as the CLO may require.

Qualifications

Completion of a recognized paralegal program or equivalent, or a university degree in a related field, and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience preferably in a legal or regulatory environment.
Advanced legal research, writing and analytical skills.
Demonstrated ability to handle and effectively prioritize a volume of work.
Project management, policy development and legal experience are strong assets.
Excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills are essential along with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
Previous supervisory experience and experience in Professional Regulation an asset.
Proficiency with computer programs including Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint and document/knowledge management systems.

The terms and conditions of the collective agreement between the Law Society of BC and the Professional Employees Association apply to this position.
The salary range for this position is $83,089.66 to $101,464.46.
The Law Society of BC is dedicated to promoting equity, diversity, and inclusion in all aspects of our work. We welcome individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to contribute to the future of our organization. In accordance with the Law Society of B.C.’s commitment to reconciliation, we seek to create a culturally safe space and to continue further improving relationships with Indigenous peoples.
The closing date for this competition is October 23, 2026. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
The Law Society of BC supports hybrid work schedules. This position is located at the Law Society of British Columbia office in the Yaletown area of Vancouver, BC.

title: Professional Learning Specialist
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Professional Learning Specialist to create and deliver engaging professional learning experiences that help K-12 educators, coaches, and administrators effectively implement Discovery Education's products, services, and instructional practices. Depending on customer needs, business priorities, and assignment, individuals in this role may primarily focus on professional learning content and instructional design, facilitation and implementation, or a blend of both. The Professional Learning Specialist serves as a trusted partner to educators and school leaders and collaborates frequently with Partner Success, Sales, Product, and Professional Learning colleagues to ensure a consistent and impactful partner experience. While the primary mix of responsibilities may vary, all individuals in this role contribute across content, facilitation, coaching, consultation, and implementation when customer or business demands require support.
In This Role You Will:
Professional Learning Facilitation and Implementation

Deliver engaging professional learning experiences in virtual and in-person environments
Facilitate learning grounded in adult learning principles and support educators in translating learning into instructional practice
Adapt delivery, content, and implementation approaches based on participant, partner, and business needs

Content and Instructional Design

Design, create, and maintain professional learning experiences and supporting resources across multiple delivery formats
Use feedback, implementation insights, and data to improve existing content and inform new offerings
Ensure professional learning resources remain aligned to Discovery Education products, quality standards, and partner needs

Coaching and Consultation

Provide coaching and consultation that supports educators and school leaders in implementing effective instructional practices
Conduct needs-analysis conversations and recommend professional learning solutions aligned with partner goals
Monitor implementation progress and recommend adjustments that support sustained impact

Partner and Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Partner Success, Sales, Product, and Professional Learning colleagues to support partner outcomes
Communicate partner needs, progress, risks, and opportunities to internal and external stakeholders
Build trusted relationships that promote a consistent and impactful partner experience

Operational Excellence and Role Flexibility

Coordinate professional learning engagements, scheduling, and implementation activities as assigned
Maintain accurate records of partner interactions, activities, and implementation progress
Flex across content development, facilitation, coaching, consultation, and implementation based on customer demand and business priorities

Core Competencies for Success:

Facilitation Excellence – Ability to deliver engaging, learner-centered experiences in virtual and in-person environments and adjust approaches based on audience and partner needs
Instructional and Learning Design – Ability to create meaningful professional learning experiences and resources grounded in adult learning principles and effective instructional practices
Coaching and Consulting – Ability to support educators and school leaders through job-embedded coaching, needs analysis, consultation, observation, and feedback
Customer Focus and Relationship Building – Ability to build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders while delivering a consistent and responsive partner experience
Communication and Cross-Functional Collaboration – Ability to communicate clearly and work across teams to connect partner goals, content, delivery, and implementation support
Data-Informed Decision Making – Ability to use feedback, implementation insights, and qualitative and quantitative data to strengthen professional learning content, delivery, and recommendations
Organization, Adaptability, and Execution – Ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, solve problems, and flex effectively as customer and business needs evolve

Credentials and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Education or a related field required; Master's degree preferred
A minimum of 5 years of teaching or relevant K-12 education experience
A minimum of 2 years of experience designing and/or delivering professional learning for K-12 educators
Knowledge of adult learning theory, effective pedagogical practices, and evidence-based professional learning
Demonstrated success creating professional learning content and/or facilitating professional learning in virtual and in-person environments
Demonstrated success coaching educators or supporting instructional implementation through observation, feedback, consultation, or related models
Ability to travel based on assignment, customer demand, and seasonal business needs; overnight travel may be required
Legal right to work in the United States.

This is a remote position based in Alabama that requires up to 80% travel throughout the state, with occasional support for additional territories as business needs require.

The hiring range for this position is between $68,600 - $76,200 annually, however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. Additionally, this position is eligible for an Annual Bonus.

title: Director of Enrollment and Family Engagement
description:
Title: Director of Enrollment and Family Engagement

Location: Cardinal Mooney Catholic High School | Sarasota, FL

Overview

Cardinal Mooney Catholic High School seeks a mission-centered, relational, and strategic professional to lead student recruitment, admissions, enrollment, retention, and family engagement. The Director manages the prospective-family journey from first inquiry through enrollment, strengthens relationships with current families and partner communities, and uses data, communications, and personal outreach to support sustainable enrollment.

  • Marketing & Storytelling: Partner with Communications & Marketing to develop compelling, consistent recruitment messaging, campaigns, materials, website content, and family communications.
