title: Technical Lead Learning Experience Designer - U.K. (30 hours/week)
description:
Since 2011, General Assembly has transformed tens of thousands of careers through pioneering, experiential education in today’s most in-demand skills. As featured in The Economist, Wired, and The New York Times, GA offers training in web development, data, design, business, and more, both online and at campuses around the world. Our global professional community boasts 60,000 full- and part-time alumni — and counting. In addition to fostering career growth for individuals, GA helps employers cultivate top tech talent and spur innovation by transforming their teams through strategic learning. More than 21,000 employees at elite companies worldwide have honed their digital fluency with our upskilling and reskilling initiatives. GA has also been recognized as one of Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500, and Fast Company has dubbed us leaders in World-Changing Ideas as well as the #1 Most Innovative Company in Education.


GA is at the leading edge of creating practical solutions to one of the most pressing challenges of our time - the future of work. As recognized by The World Economic Forum, BCG, the OECD and more, these are big challenges to which only a few companies are offering real solutions. In this role, you'll be speaking every day to corporate leaders who rely on GA to help them apply these solutions to their workforce of the future.

*We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead Learning Experience Designer with a proven track record of developing technical education and capability-building programs across domains such as Software Engineering, Data Science, DevOps, and MLOps, etc.*

As a Technical Lead Learning Experience Designer (LED), you will be responsible for designing, developing, and contextualizing high-quality GA learning programs for enterprise, technical, and professional audiences. This role requires strong learning experience design knowledge, excellent program development and project management skills, and hands-on fluency with AI tools and emerging workplace technologies.

You will create practical, outcome-driven learning experiences that help learners build relevant skills and apply them with confidence in real workplace contexts. Because AI is increasingly embedded across GA programs and client needs, you should understand how modern AI tools are actually used in the workplace and be able to translate that fluency into applied activities, labs, simulations, facilitator guides, assessments, and client-specific adaptations.

While this role will contribute significantly to GA’s AI-enabled and emerging technology portfolio, it is not a purely AI curriculum role. The core responsibility is to create scalable, high-quality GA programs that meet learner needs, client goals, market expectations, and GA’s instructional standards.

You will project manage and collaborate with subject matter experts, instructors, product managers, learning designers, assessment specialists, vendors, and client-facing teams to create learning experiences that reflect current market needs, emerging capabilities, and practical workplace application.

Terms and Details:

  • This is a flexible, contractor position on a 2 or 3 month term
  • We would expect someone to provide 30 hours per week when on a project
  • This role will be 100% remote
  • For US Candidates: Pay is between $45 and $55 USD per hour
  • For European Candidates: Pay is between €23 and €35 Euros per hour
  • For South Asian Candidates: Pay is between $15 and $25 USD per hour
  • For APAC Candidates: Pay is between $20 and $38 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities:

Program Ownership & Discovery

  • Serve as the Lead Learning Experience Designer for GA programs that may include AI, emerging technology, digital transformation, technical skills, leadership, role-based application, or workplace productivity components.
  • Own the complete Client-facing Design Process; requirements gathering, learning outcomes, project timelines, scope, resourcing, development plans, and content quality from discovery through delivery.
  • Partner with sales, product, client success, solutions, and delivery teams to identify client and learner needs and translate those needs into practical learning solutions.
  • Support pre-sales and client conversations by helping define skill needs, learner personas, program objectives, audience readiness, and recommended learning pathways.
  • Evaluate the tools, workflows, use cases, and workplace contexts most relevant to a client or learner audience, including AI tools where relevant, and determine how they should be represented in the learning experience.
  • Define clear learning outcomes that move learners from awareness to practical application, workflow improvement, productivity gains, behavior change, and responsible technology use.

Applied Learning Design & AI-Enabled Development

  • Design and develop practical, instructor-led learning experiences for learners at varying levels of expertise, including programs where AI tools, workflows, or emerging technologies are central to the learner outcome.
  • Create instructor-led training materials, including slides, hands-on labs, case studies, simulations, assessments, facilitator guides, learner workbooks, and practical workplace exercises.
  • Build learning experiences that help learners actively apply new skills in realistic workplace contexts, including the use of AI tools and platforms where relevant.
  • Design hands-on activities using current workplace and AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, Midjourney, NotebookLM, or other tools relevant to enterprise learning.
  • Translate complex or technical concepts into structured, accessible, and engaging learning experiences in partnership with subject matter experts.
  • Curate, contextualize, and update content to reflect emerging industry trends, new tool capabilities, evolving best practices, accessibility expectations, and responsible use considerations.
  • Design structured learning pathways across levels of proficiency, including AI literacy, role-based application, technical skill development, workflow redesign, responsible technology use, and advanced concepts where appropriate.
  • Develop practical, interactive exercises such as tool walkthroughs, prompt refinement activities, workflow mapping, use case development, ethical decision-making scenarios, productivity tasks, coding challenges, technical labs, or real-world business simulations.
  • Ensure learning experiences are grounded in adult learning principles, learning science, accessibility, measurable learner outcomes, and practical transfer to the workplace.
  • Follow GA’s design and development standards, best practices, templates, QA processes, and productization expectations for core and customized curriculum.
  • Create, execute, and own the quality of project and program development timelines, deliverables, and required resources.
  • Onboard and project manage all resources required for program development, including SMEs, other LEDs or instructional designers, assessment specialists, instructors, vendors, contractors, and freelancers.

Delivery & Instructor Enablement

  • Develop instructor enablement materials to support live classroom training delivery, including facilitator guides, run-of-show documents, learner workbooks, real-world case studies, tool setup instructions, troubleshooting guidance, and activity facilitation notes.
  • Provide guidance to instructors on best practices for applied, interactive learning, including live tool demonstrations, coaching, discussion facilitation, learner support, applied exercises, and technology-supported problem solving.
  • Work closely with instructors, learning facilitators, and client teams to tailor learning programs for diverse audiences, including enterprise clients, startups, government organizations, technical teams, business leaders, and cross-functional employee populations.
  • Ensure instructors are equipped to deliver learning experiences confidently, accurately, consistently, and in alignment with GA’s instructional standards.
  • Collect, synthesize, and analyze data on learning impact to support continuous improvement, content refinement, learner outcomes, and program updates.
  • Where applicable, work with translation vendors and localization partners to adapt learning experiences for global audiences.

Productization

  • Lead conversations and workflows with product management and learning systems design teams to standardize reusable GA learning patterns, components, activities, templates, and program structures.
  • Contribute to the development of a scalable library of reusable GA learning components, including program structures, activities, assessments, facilitator resources, client-ready assets, and AI-enabled learning patterns where relevant.
  • Identify which custom learning materials can be converted into reusable product components or repeatable delivery models.
  • Support the evolution of GA’s learning portfolio by identifying emerging client needs, market shifts, tool trends, and opportunities for new or improved learning products.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in instructional design, learning experience design, curriculum design, or a related field, with significant experience creating instructor-led training content.
  • Demonstrated ability to design high-quality learning experiences for enterprise, professional, technical, or workplace audiences.
  • Strong experience creating practical, outcome-driven learning materials, including slides, facilitator guides, activities, assessments, case studies, labs, simulations, and learner resources.
  • Experience managing clients, stakeholders, SMEs, instructors, vendors, or cross-functional partners through a content development process.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design methodologies, including Bloom’s Taxonomy, ADDIE, experiential learning, practice-based learning, and adult learning principles.
  • Ability to design for both technical and non-technical audiences, including leaders, business teams, functional teams, and technical practitioners.
  • Hands-on fluency with current AI tools and the ability to use those tools to design, prototype, evaluate, and improve learning experiences.
  • Demonstrated experience designing learning experiences related to AI, emerging technology, data, digital transformation, technical skills, or workplace technology adoption.
  • Strong working knowledge of AI concepts, including generative AI, large language models, prompt engineering, machine learning, AI agents, ethical AI, responsible use, and enterprise AI adoption.
  • Experience designing practical, hands-on learning activities that may include AI tools, labs, case studies, simulations, workflow exercises, or tool-based practice.
  • Experience collaborating with subject matter experts to translate complex concepts into structured, engaging, and accessible learning experiences.
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms, content management systems, and authoring tools.
  • Willingness to flex your schedule to join meetings across time zones, particularly in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments where priorities, tools, and client needs evolve quickly.
  • Passionate about helping diverse learners build practical, future-facing skills for the changing world of work.

Nice to Have:

  • Technical proficiency in AI, data science, or coding, including Python, APIs, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience using GitHub or other technical collaboration tools.
  • Experience designing AI training labs, coding exercises, model-building workshops, or real-world AI case studies.
  • Familiarity with virtual machines, cloud-based labs, sandbox environments, or technical learning environments.
  • Experience integrating AI-driven personalization, adaptive learning, or AI-supported learner practice into course design.
  • Experience designing enterprise AI adoption programs, leadership AI programs, role-based AI academies, technical academies, digital transformation programs, or role-based learning journeys.
  • Experience creating learning experiences for tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, NotebookLM, Midjourney, or similar platforms.

Unless otherwise noted, remote positions can be performed from the following approved General Assembly operating countries.

United States of America (states of operation may vary), Canada (provinces of operation may vary), United Kingdom, Australia, and Singapore.

title: Sr. Data Analyst - User Acquisition (Remote)
description:
Who We Are (Mode.Inc)

Mode is a fast-growing technology company building businesses at the intersection of AI, data, mobile apps, and digital experiences. Our portfolio of mobile apps and digital products reaches 100M+ monthly active users across a global audience. We continue to accelerate growth through product innovation, strategic acquisitions, and emerging business opportunities.

Mode was recognized by Deloitte as the #1 fastest-growing software company in North America on the 2023 Technology Fast 500. Today, we are building our next phase of growth, including expanding Mode's AI and data business and developing direct relationships with companies that can benefit from the data and capabilities we have built.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company’s success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to be the analytical partner to our User Acquisition team. You’ll own the measurement of how we acquire users across our portfolio of mobile apps and web properties — from attribution and channel performance to cohort LTV and payback — and turn that into clear recommendations on where to spend the next dollar.

The ideal candidate has exceptional analytical skills, strong SQL and Python skills, deep familiarity with mobile app marketing data, and can bring rigor to data quality, analysis and storytelling.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain common datasets and data pipelines that strengthen self-service analytics and enable data-driven decision making across the organization
  • Improve data quality, accuracy, reliability, and documentation to strengthen self-service analytics
  • Own UA performance measurement across paid channels (e.g., Meta, Google, TikTok, AppLovin, Unity), including CPI/CAC, ROAS, retention, and payback by channel, campaign, geo, and creative
  • Build and maintain predictive LTV models and cohort curves that let the UA team make bid and budget decisions on early signals
  • Reconcile and validate data across MMPs, ad networks, and internal event data, and investigate discrepancies in attribution, installs, and revenue
  • Analyze web-to-app and web funnel performance, from landing page to install to first reward or engagement, and identify where users drop off
  • Design and read incrementality tests, geo-holdouts, and creative or landing-page A/B tests to measure true lift beyond last-touch attribution
  • Monitor traffic quality and flag anomalies, including fraud, low-quality sources, and post-install behavior that doesn’t match expectations
  • Partner with the UA team on budget allocation and channel mix scenarios, and translate findings into clear spend recommendations

What You Bring to the Team

  • Analytical excellence to dissect complex, ambiguous problems and uncover actionable insights
  • Solid SQL and Python programming skills, and experience working with large-scale production data
  • Business acumen to translate data and analysis into business impact
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate in a highly cross-functional environment
  • 4+ years in analytics, with at least 2 years supporting user acquisition or performance marketing for mobile apps
  • Hands-on experience with at least one MMP (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular, or Branch) and an understanding of attribution windows, re-engagement, and postbacks
  • Experience building dashboards, LTV/payback models and cohort analyses
  • Familiarity with growth marketing concepts such as: A/B Testing, Causal analysis, Incrementality, Inferential statistics, MMM etc, iOS SKAN & incoming privacy changes
  • Nice to have: experience with Big Data tools (Redshift/Spark/Airflow), experiment design, predictive modeling, log analysis, AI, or experience in tech or startup environments

Alignment with Our Core Values:

  • ​​Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
  • Action-driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
  • Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
  • Curious: You focus on the ‘why,’ learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
  • Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.

You’ll Thrive Here If You Are

  • Analytical
  • Pragmatic

title: Staff Product Manager, Done-For-You Payroll Workflows
description:
Intuit is a global technology platform company that helps our customers and communities overcome their most important financial challenges. We help give over 50 million consumer, small business, and self-employed customers around the world the opportunity to prosper.

Mission
Build payroll where the system does the work — accurate, done-for-you payroll that Mid-Market and Enterprise teams stop having to think about.

Context
QuickBooks already runs at a scale most payroll products never reach — Intuit serves ~100M customers worldwide, and QuickBooks Online has 7M+ subscribers. We're taking the category we lead and turning it into the best payroll platform for Mid-Market and Enterprise, by automating time, pay, tax, compliance, and money movement end-to-end, with a mix of classic systems thinking and modern AI.

This is a staff-level role with real ownership over ambiguity. If you're hungry to ship, obsess over customer pain, and are passionate about simplifying complexity: this is a great role with real AI scope & real customer problems to solve.


Responsibilities

What you'll do

  • Move the product from manual entry to autopilot: systems that detect when payroll is ready to run, flag anomalies, and drive approvals proactively instead of waiting for an admin to notice a problem.
  • Build compliance that runs in the background — catching rate, deduction, and tax errors before they ship — and pair every automated change with an explanation an admin can actually audit.
  • Redesign the underlying data model and permissions where they're the reason automation isn't reliable today.
  • Design agentic workflows that act like a high-performing payroll admin, while keeping the customer able to see, override, or roll back anything the system did.
  • Partner daily with engineering, data science, design, and legal — the tradeoffs live in the modeling and the guardrails, not in a spec you hand off.
  • Set the metrics that prove this is working, and hold the roadmap accountable to them: fewer payroll exceptions, faster completion times, higher retention.

Qualifications

You might be a fit if

  • You have 5+ years in product management and you've shipped in a domain where 'mostly right' isn't good enough — payroll, tax, HR, or another high-stakes regulated workflow.
  • You've taken on more scope over time, not just more title, at companies known for technical rigor.
  • You're genuinely comfortable in the details of ML/LLM-powered automation — what a model can be trusted to do unsupervised, what an eval loop is actually telling you, where a data pipeline breaks.
  • You have a technical degree (CS, EE, Statistics, Math) or equivalent depth — you'll be partnering with engineering on system design, not just requirements.
  • You can turn customer pain into an execution plan without waiting for someone to hand you a roadmap, and you move fast in ambiguity.
  • Bonus: you've shipped an automated or agentic product and can point to what it did to trust and quality — not just what it did to velocity.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. About Us:
Big Country Equipment is a BC-based heavy equipment service and repair company that partners with resource-based industries, including construction, forestry, mining, and oil and gas sectors throughout Western Canada. Established in 2017, we’ve grown from a single-truck operation to a team of over 180 employees and a fleet of over 55 service trucks, providing 24/7, 365-day support. Job Summary:

title: Head of Medical Affairs
description:
Who We Are:

Calico (Calico Life Sciences LLC) is an Alphabet-founded research and development company whose mission is to harness advanced technologies and model systems to increase our understanding of the biology that controls human aging. Calico will use that knowledge to devise interventions that enable people to lead longer and healthier lives. Calico’s highly innovative technology labs, its commitment to curiosity-driven discovery science and, with academic and industry partners, its vibrant drug-development pipeline, together create an inspiring and exciting place to catalyze and enable medical breakthroughs.

The Opportunity:

Calico’s commitment to discovery science led us to Vanishing White Matter (VWM), a rare disease leukodystrophy where chronic dysregulation of the Integrated Stress Response drives disease pathology. Driven by rigorous research, we are dedicated to advancing potential therapies and preparing for the anticipated global launch of Calico's first commercial therapy. To achieve this, we are looking for passionate, driven individuals to build a dedicated team focused on delivering meaningful treatment options to VWM patients and families facing severe unmet medical needs.

Position Description:

Calico is seeking a highly strategic Head of Medical Affairs to establish and lead our medical affairs function, translating clinical science into a differentiated, evidence-based narrative for global markets, with an initial emphasis on VWM therapy in US markets. This role reports to the Head of Clinical Development and will be responsible for shaping medical affairs strategy, building infrastructure, hiring and leading our field medical and medical information teams, and accelerating disease-state awareness. Closely collaborating with molecule teams in R&D, they will be serving as a key leader on launch teams as molecules approach approval and a key voice of medicine across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategy & Leadership

  • Lead, develop and execute the global medical affairs strategy in alignment with Clinical, Regulatory, and Commercial priorities
  • Serve as the Medical Affairs lead on the cross-functional launch team
  • Build out core Medical Affairs capabilities to support the launch, including medical communications, field medical team, and post-marketing support functions as needed
  • Establish and oversee the external Medical Communications and Medical Information functions, including leading publication planning and execution, developing standard response letters, building global FAQs, and building the infrastructure to efficiently handle unsolicited medical inquiries post-launch

Scientific Engagement

  • Cultivate and maintain trusted relationships with global leading Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), clinical investigators, and expert centers in the rare disease space
  • Understand areas of scientific interests and gaps - Design and execute medical education initiatives, advisory boards, and scientific exchange programs
  • Lead the development of scientific messaging platform, publication strategy and scientific communication plans
  • Develop and implement, in partnership with Commercial colleagues, initiatives aimed at reducing the diagnostic journey, including physician education, screening initiatives, genetic testing efforts, and partnerships with diagnostic specialists and labs
  • Partner closely with rare disease patient advocacy organizations to ensure the patient voice is deeply embedded in our medical strategy

Evidence Generation and Compliance

  • Oversee early access programs, investigator-sponsored research, and real-world evidence initiatives to support the full product lifecycle
  • Design and execute post-marketing requirements and commitments while establishing medical information capabilities and standard response documents
  • Collaborate cross-functionally on data interpretation and label optimization
  • Ensure all Medical Affairs activities comply with applicable regulations, industry codes, and internal policies

Position Requirements:

  • Advanced degree required: MD or MD/PhD, PharmD, or PhD in a relevant scientific or clinical discipline
  • 10+ years of pharmaceutical/biotech industry experience, with 5+ years leadership in medical affairs; prior experience in clinical practice preferred
  • Demonstrated experience leading or building medical affairs functions in a launch setting, including overseeing medical communications
  • Deep expertise launching first-in-disease therapies for rare genetic diseases, including orphan drug dynamics, small addressable markets, patient finding, and advocacy engagement
  • A commitment to designing strategies around the patient journey and experience
  • The capability to comprehend complex clinical data, mechanism of action (MoA), and endpoints, and translate them into clear, compelling, compliant medical affairs strategy
  • Experience operating in US health care system, with knowledge of global/international markets also preferred
  • Strong understanding of healthcare systems (especially US), compliance guidelines, and the distinct diagnostic and regulatory unique to rare diseases
  • Exceptional communication and cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence without authority
  • Strong ability to work seamlessly across multiple disciplinary experts to achieve shared launch milestones
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a hands-on willingness to build a team, create processes, and engage within a larger organization with experienced senior leadership and backing
  • Must be willing to work onsite at least 4 days a week
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally (up to ~25%)

The estimated base salary range for this role is $310,000 - $420,000. Actual pay will be based on a number of factors including experience and qualifications. This position is also eligible for two annual cash bonuses.

title: Begeleider EMB/Ouderen | Sneek | 24 – 32 uur
description:
Kun jij rust brengen wanneer een cliënt de wereld even niet begrijpt? Zie jij wat iemand nodig heeft, ook als diegene dit niet met woorden kan vertellen? En combineer je persoonlijke verzorging graag met begeleiding en een betekenisvolle daginvulling? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Jouw werkplek

Op het Plevierenpad in Sneek wonen 19 mensen in ruime appartementen, verdeeld over drie kleinschalige woningen. Je ondersteunt hier cliënten met een ernstig meervoudige beperking (EMB), waarbij ook moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag (MVG) kan voorkomen. Een deel van de bewoners wordt ouder, waardoor de zorgvraag in de loop van de tijd verandert.

Dat maakt jouw werk afwisselend. Het ene moment ondersteun je bij ADL en lichamelijke verzorging en werk je met hulpmiddelen zoals een tillift. Het volgende moment probeer je te begrijpen wat een bewoner met gedrag of een klein non-verbaal signaal duidelijk wil maken. Ook epilepsie, slikproblemen, veranderingen in mobiliteit of zicht en palliatieve zorg kunnen onderdeel zijn van de ondersteuning.

We werken belevingsgericht vanuit LACCS, waarbij het gedachtegoed van Triple-C ondersteunend kan zijn. Een voorspelbaar dagritme geeft bewoners veiligheid, maar we kijken altijd naar wat iemand zelf kan. Misschien is dat helpen met groenten snijden, een kopje in de vaatwasser zetten, muziek luisteren of naar buiten gaan.

Op Plevierenpad horen wonen en een betekenisvolle daginvulling bij elkaar. Er is interne dagbesteding en we besteden veel aandacht aan muziek, bewegen en een gezonde leefstijl. Ook beschikt de locatie over een belevingstuin met dierenverblijf.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Begeleider combineer je zorg, begeleiding en activering. Je leert bewoners goed kennen en merkt daardoor ook kleine veranderingen in gedrag of welzijn op.

Je:

  • Ondersteunt bewoners bij ADL en lichamelijke verzorging;
  • Biedt rust, structuur en duidelijkheid;
  • Observeert gedrag en non-verbale communicatie en probeert te achterhalen wat een bewoner nodig heeft;
  • Stimuleert bewoners om zoveel mogelijk zelf te doen en mee te doen;
  • Zorgt samen met collega's voor passende activiteiten en belevingsmomenten;
  • Werkt methodisch vanuit LACCS en draagt bij aan een veilige en prettige leefomgeving;
  • Werkt samen met collega's, verwanten en andere betrokken disciplines.

Je werkt onregelmatig in dag-, avond- en weekenddiensten. Een voordeel is dat je voornamelijk langere diensten van 7 tot 8 uur draait. Hierdoor heb je minder overdrachtsmomenten, meer continuïteit met bewoners en kun je je werkweek met relatief weinig diensten invullen.

Wie ben jij?

Je hoeft niet alles al te kunnen. Belangrijker is dat je oprecht geïnteresseerd bent in deze doelgroep en begrijpt dat goede begeleiding verder gaat dan alleen verzorgen.

Je:

  • Hebt een afgeronde mbo-opleiding niveau 3 of 4 richting Zorg & Welzijn;
  • Hebt ervaring met of duidelijke affiniteit voor EMB en kunt omgaan met een eventuele MVG-component;
  • Vindt het leuk om zorg en begeleiding te combineren met dagbesteding en beleving;
  • Kunt goed observeren en kleine signalen herkennen bij bewoners die zich niet of nauwelijks verbaal kunnen uiten;
  • Brengt rust en structuur en kunt tegelijkertijd meebewegen met wat een bewoner nodig heeft;
  • Bent bereid om LACCS en waar relevant Triple-C verder te leren kennen;
  • Bent beschikbaar voor onregelmatige diensten en weekenden.

Ervaring met ouder wordende cliënten, intensieve ADL-zorg of moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag is mooi meegenomen.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Philadelphia krijg je de ruimte om je vak verder te ontwikkelen en samen met je collega's te kijken naar wat bewoners nodig hebben voor een zo goed mogelijk leven.

Je krijgt onder andere:

  • Een salaris volgens FWG 35 (€2.649 - €3.708 bij 36 uur) van de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en opleiding;
  • Onregelmatigheidstoeslag boven op je salaris;
  • Aantal uur per week: 24 tot 32 uur
  • Lange diensten van voornamelijk 7 tot 8 uur;
  • Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen, bijvoorbeeld rondom EMB, LACCS en belevingsgerichte ondersteuning;
  • Faciliteiten rondom vitaliteit, coaching en ontwikkeling;
  • Aantrekkelijke extra's zoals een fietsregeling en korting op verschillende uitjes.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij werken op een kleinschalige locatie waar je bewoners écht leert kennen en waar verzorgen, begeleiden en samen beleven bij elkaar horen? Solliciteer dan als Begeleider EMB/Ouderen bij Plevierenpad in Sneek.

Heb je vragen over de functie? Neem contact op met Cem Canan (Corporate Recruiter bij Philadelphia) op 06 27 25 40 36.

Solliciteer direct. We nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

title: Controller
description:
BOWA is looking for a Controller to join our finance team, reporting to the President & CFO. You’ll take ownership of the full accounting function (GL, AP, AR, Billing, and Payroll) and lead the finance team from day one. The first 60-90 days focus on learning our close process, billing cycle, and Sage 300 CRE, and on getting to know our people and project teams, so you can lead from a place of understanding rather than imposing change.

BOWA recently became an ESOP company, and this role is central to how we operate in that structure. You’ll work closely with the CFO on ESOP accounting, trustee and lender relationships, and the financial transparency an employee-owned company depends on. Deep ESOP expertise isn’t required on day one, but curiosity and a willingness to build it are. Whether you’re a licensed CPA or on the path to one, you’ll have real ownership, a seat at the leadership table, and the opportunity to shape the finance function as we scale.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Accounting Function & Finance Team
  • Own Month-End Close & Financial Reporting
  • Oversee Client Billing & Revenue Cycle
  • Strengthen Accounting Systems, Controls & Processes
  • Serve as Principal Financial Partner to Division Leaders
  • Support ESOP, Audit & CFO-Level Financial Needs

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Lead the Accounting Function & Finance Team

  • Manage the Finance Department (GL, AP, AR, Billing, and Payroll), setting expectations, developing team members, and building a culture of accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a thought partner and backup to the President & CFO, with the ability to step in on CFO-level responsibilities as needed.

Own Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

  • Own the month-end close end-to-end (journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, close checklist), delivering to deadline each month and continually working to shorten the close cycle.
  • Review and approve financial statements prior to CFO review, ensure the integrity of the GL and chart of accounts in Sage 300 CRE, and resolve reconciliation variances proactively.
  • Oversee WIP schedules, over/under billing analysis, and revenue recognition to ensure accuracy for percentage-of-completion reporting.

Oversee Client Billing & Revenue Cycle

  • Ensure client billing accuracy and timeliness, partnering with project teams to confirm alignment with contract terms and job status.
  • Monitor AR aging and cash flow to keep DSO on target, and streamline the billing cycle as the business scales.

Strengthen Accounting Systems, Controls & Processes

  • Serve as the team’s expert on Sage 300 CRE, documenting key workflows (close checklist, billing steps, payroll inputs) and driving system improvements.
  • Design, implement, and maintain internal controls that protect the company and support clean audits.
  • Oversee payroll review (commission, bonus, salary, 401(k)) and identify automation opportunities that reduce manual work, including through AI-assisted tools.

Serve as Principal Financial Partner to Division Leaders

  • Act as the primary contact for division leaders on job costing, budget-to-actual, forecasting, and financial reporting, building trust so accounting is viewed as a strategic partner, not just a back-office function.

Support ESOP, Audit & CFO-Level Financial Needs

  • Manage ESOP-related accounting mechanics (e.g., debt service flows between BOWA and the ESOP Trust) under the CFO’s direction.
  • Coordinate annual audit/review, tax, and year-end processes with outside CPAs, and manage requests from auditors, lenders, bonding companies, and the ESOP Trustee’s advisors.
  • Prepare ad hoc analysis, budgets, and forecasts for the CFO and leadership team.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Direct supervision of the Finance team, including hiring, performance management, and professional development.

Requirements for the Position:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting and 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including prior supervisory or management experience; construction or project-based industry experience strongly preferred.
  • CPA license preferred; candidates actively pursuing licensure with strong relevant experience are encouraged to apply.
  • Experience with Sage 300 CRE (or similar project accounting software) strongly preferred; ramp-up time provided for strong candidates from other systems.
  • Working knowledge of WIP reporting, job costing, and percentage-of-completion revenue recognition.
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort with (or interest in) AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Cowork, ChatGPT).
  • Detail-oriented, strong communicator, discreet with sensitive information, and a genuine fit with BOWA’s ownership-minded ESOP culture.

title: Begeleider Gehandicaptenzorg (EMB/Ouderen) | IJsselmuiden | 24-28 uur | FWG 35
description:
Werk jij graag met mensen met een ernstige meervoudige beperking (EMB) en ouder wordende bewoners met een intensieve zorgvraag? Zie jij wat iemand nodig heeft, ook als dit vooral via gedrag, lichaamstaal of kleine signalen wordt duidelijk gemaakt? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Voor Oosterlandenhof in IJsselmuiden zoeken wij een Begeleider voor 24 tot 28 uur per week.

Jouw werkplek

Oosterlandenhof is een 24-uurs woonlocatie met zes woningen voor mensen met EMB en ouder wordende mensen met een verstandelijke beperking. De zorgvragen verschillen per bewoner en kunnen veranderen naarmate iemand ouder wordt. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan dementie, epilepsie en lichamelijke of zintuiglijke beperkingen.

Je werkt binnen een kleinschalig woningteam en leert de bewoners daardoor goed kennen. Dat is belangrijk, want niet iedere bewoner kan met woorden vertellen wat er aan de hand is. Jij leert kijken naar gedrag, lichaamstaal en kleine veranderingen.

Binnen Oosterlandenhof werken we volgens LACCS en belevingsgerichte zorg. Familie en vrijwilligers spelen eveneens een belangrijke rol in het leven van bewoners.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Begeleider combineer je begeleiding met intensieve lichamelijke zorg. Je helpt bewoners bij hun dagelijkse leven en zorgt voor rust, veiligheid en een fijne dag.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Ondersteunen bij intensieve ADL en persoonlijke verzorging;
  • Begeleiden van bewoners met EMB en ouder wordende bewoners;
  • Observeren van gedrag, lichaamstaal en veranderingen in gezondheid;
  • Medicatie toedienen en rapporteren in het cliëntdossier;
  • Bieden van structuur, nabijheid en een voorspelbare omgeving;
  • Samenwerken met collega's, behandelaren, familie en vrijwilligers.

Je werkt onregelmatige diensten, waaronder weekenden. De diensten zijn globaal van 07.00 tot 15.00 uur en van 15.00 tot 23.00 uur. De exacte tijden kunnen in de praktijk verschillen.

Waarom werken bij Oosterlandenhof?

Juist de combinatie van zorg en begeleiding maakt je werk hier afwisselend. De ene bewoner heeft veel lichamelijke verzorging nodig, terwijl een ander meer vraagt van jouw observatie- en begeleidingsvaardigheden.

Daarnaast:

  • Werk je in een kleinschalig team binnen een grotere locatie;
  • Leer je bewoners goed kennen en herken je steeds beter hun kleine signalen;
  • Werk je volgens LACCS en belevingsgerichte zorg;
  • Is er dagbesteding en ruimte voor activiteiten die passen bij de bewoners;
  • Krijg je ondersteuning van verschillende behandelaren en specialisten.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent geduldig, betrokken en vindt het vanzelfsprekend om zowel te begeleiden als te verzorgen. Je kunt omgaan met verschillen in zorgzwaarte en past jouw ondersteuning aan op wat een bewoner nodig heeft.

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je minimaal een afgeronde mbo-niveau 3-opleiding in Zorg & Welzijn, bijvoorbeeld MMZ of Verzorgende IG;
  • Heb je ervaring met of sterke affiniteit voor EMB en/of ouder wordende cliënten met een intensieve zorgvraag;
  • Heb je affiniteit met intensieve ADL-zorg;
  • Kun je kleine en non-verbale signalen herkennen;
  • Ben je bereid onregelmatig te werken.

Ervaring met LACCS, belevingsgerichte zorg, dementie, epilepsie of zintuiglijke beperkingen is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een salaris van € 2.597,- tot € 3.635,- bruto per maand (FWG 35) op basis van 36 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en opleiding;
  • Een dienstverband van 24 tot 28 uur per week;
  • Onregelmatigheidstoeslag, vakantietoeslag en een eindejaarsuitkering;
  • Direct een contract voor onbepaalde tijd;
  • Trainingen en scholing, waaronder mogelijkheden rondom verpleegtechnische handelingen;
  • Faciliteiten en coaching die bijdragen aan jouw ontwikkeling en werkplezier.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij werken met bewoners voor wie jouw aandacht, zorg en het herkennen van kleine signalen écht verschil maken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Heb je vragen over de functie? Neem contact op met Cem Canan (Corporate Recruiter bij Philadelphia) op 06 27 25 40 36.

Solliciteer direct. We nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

title: Machine Learning Engineer - AI for 2D & 3D data
description:
ABOUT DYNAMIC OPTICS

Dynamic Optics is a CNR-IFN spin-off and technology leader in adaptive optics, specialising in measuring, analysing, and correcting the optical behaviour of real-world lenses. Based in Padova and backed by Officina Stellare SpA — an Italian leader in advanced optical instrumentation for space — Dynamic Optics combines academic novelty with industrial-grade engineering and real-world deployment.

We are at the centre of a pioneering deep-tech project, co-funded by the European Union, at the intersection of cinematography, optical engineering, imaging science, and machine learning. Its mission is to digitise the optical behaviour of real professional cinema lenses, enabling precise measurement, simulation, and creative manipulation of characteristics such as distortion, aberration, flare, bokeh, and depth of field. By combining advanced optical engineering, computational imaging, and AI-driven modelling, the project creates high-accuracy digital lens twins — bridging physical cinematography with digital image generation and unlocking new capabilities for VFX, virtual production, CGI rendering, and generative AI.

With EU funding now secured, we are moving from a funded research action towards commercial deployment, and are building the team that will take this technology to the global audiovisual market.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a Machine Learning Research Scientist to drive the project’s foundational research into physics-guided, optical-system machine learning.

We are looking for a Machine Learning Research Scientist with a strong background in Computer Vision, 3D data processing, and AI for scientific imaging. The ideal candidate has experience developing deep learning models for image understanding, 3D representations, or computational imaging, and is interested in combining data-driven approaches with physics-based optical modelling.

Your work will focus on developing new ML formulations, models, and experimental approaches for modelling optical behaviour — including PSF fields, aberrations, flare and ghosting behaviour, wave-optics approximations, and other lens-driven effects. You will work at the research core of the optical modelling pipeline, designing algorithms that push the boundaries of optical ML and computational imaging.


KEY RESPONSABILITIES

Foundational research and model development

● Investigate and develop new cutting-edge ML models for optical behaviour estimation and simulation.

● Design deep learning models for computer vision and 3D optical data.

● Develop AI methods for learning from high-dimensional imaging and 3D measurement data.

● Develop novel techniques for modelling PSFs, vignetting, Zernike fields, flare and ghost behaviour, scatter, and chromatic effects.

Experimentation and prototyping

● Build research prototypes to test new algorithms, architectures, and loss functions.

● Evaluate performance using scientific benchmarks, simulation outputs, and rendering-based validation.

● Maintain rigorous experiment tracking and reproducibility.

Data and measurement interpretation

● Analyse complex optical datasets (PSF stacks, Zernike maps, spectral captures, flare and ghost imagery).

● Build data pipelines tailored to research experimentation.

Collaboration and scientific contribution

● Work closely with rendering, simulation, and software teams to transition research into production ML systems.

● Develop technical documentation, research notes, and internal publications.

Keep abreast of research in computational imaging, scientific ML, neural optics, and physics-guided modelling, and contribute to internal R&D strategy and long-term modelling direction.


SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Required

● PhD (or MSc with equivalent experience) in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Computational Imaging, 3D Vision, Computer Graphics, or a closely related field.

● Strong knowledge of deep learning architectures for image analysis and visual data (CNNs, Vision Transformers, diffusion models or related approaches).

● Proven experience developing deep learning models for computer vision applications.

● Experience working with 3D data (point clouds, meshes, volumetric data, multi-view imagery, neural representations, or scientific imaging).

● Strong mathematical grounding in optimisation, linear algebra, and Fourier optics.

● Proficiency with PyTorch and OpenCV.

● Strong mathematical grounding: Fourier optics, PDEs, optimisation.

● Experience working with scientific or imaging data.

● Fluent English, written and spoken (B2 or above).

Bonus

● Publications in ML, computational imaging, optics, or graphics.

● Experience with 3D computer vision, neural rendering, NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting, differentiable rendering, or geometric deep learning.

● Experience modelling PSFs, wave-optics, or image-formation physics.

● GPU compute or high-performance ML skills.

● Prior experience in optics, geometric optics and ray propagation.

● Experience collaborating with teams in R&D-heavy or deep-tech environments.


WHAT WE OFFER

﻿● A research-driven role at the heart of the project’s modelling science.

● Direct collaboration with optical scientists, ML researchers, and rendering engineers.

● A fully remote, flexible working environment across Europe or the UK.

● Competitive compensation commensurate with experience 30-50k€.

Overview:

If you're looking for the stability of a profitable, growing company with the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup, we’re hiring. SageSure, a leader in catastrophe-exposed property insurance, is seeking a DataOps Engineer Intern to join our Rising Pioneer Program and support the Product Development team. Over the course of this 10-week program, interns will gain hands-on experience, learn from knowledgeable professionals, and contribute to projects that support real business needs.

In this role, you will help update and validate data queries, compare results between legacy and updated processes, and assist with documentation that makes actuarial data workflows easier to understand and maintain.

This internship is a good fit for a student interested in data, analytics, insurance, or technology who is eager to learn, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with business and technical partners.

What you’d be doing:

  • Learn how actuarial data is gathered, prepared, validated, and used to support business decisions.
  • Assist with rewriting, updating, and testing existing SQL queries as data sources and platforms evolve.
  • Compare results from updated queries to prior outputs and help identify differences in counts, premiums, exposures, losses, or other key measures.
  • Support basic data quality checks, including missing values, duplicate records, unexpected results, and changes over time.
  • Document data sources, business rules, query logic, and recurring processes in a clear and organized way.
  • Partner with actuaries, data scientists, and data professionals on ad hoc projects and process improvements.
  • Receive coaching, mentoring, and feedback while building practical technical and business communication skills.

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • An anticipated graduation date in 2027 or 2028.
  • Coursework or project experience using SQL.
  • Exposure to R, Python, or another data analysis tool.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reasoning skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to ask questions when results do not look right.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Authorization to work in the United States.

Highly preferred candidates also have:

  • Prior internship, class project, or work experience involving data, analytics, reporting, or databases.
  • GPA of 3.0 or higher.
  • Familiarity with relational databases or data quality concepts.
  • Interest in property and casualty insurance, actuarial analytics, finance, risk analytics, or data operations.
  • Exposure to Git, cloud data platforms, or modern data warehouse environments.

Named among the Best Places to Work in Insurance by Business Insurance for four years in a row (2020-2023), SageSure is one of the largest managing general underwriters (MGU) focused on catastrophe-exposed property in the US. Since its founding in 2009, SageSure has experienced exceptional growth while generating underwriting profits for carrier partners through hurricanes, wildfires, and hail. Available in 16 states, SageSure offers more than 110 home, flood, and commercial products on behalf of its highly rated carrier partners. Today, SageSure manages more than $3.2 billion of inforce premium and helps protect more than 970,000 policyholders.

We have more than 1,000 employees in a distributed workforce environment across 12 offices—Fairfield, CA; Mountain View, CA; Cheshire, CT; Jacksonville, FL; Tallahassee, FL; Tampa, FL; Chicago, IL; Jersey City, NJ; Marlton, NJ; Cincinnati, OH; Houston, TX; Sheboygan, WI—who are tackling the industry’s toughest challenges.

title: PER DIEM - School-Based Therapist
description:
PER DIEM School-Based Therapist - Santa Maria, CA Area

Transforming student mental health in schools.

About Effective School Solutions

Effective School Solutions (ESS) is a leading provider of school-based mental health services, serving 6,000+ K–12 students across 12 states.

We deliver the level of clinical care typically found in private practice, out-of-district placements, or higher levels of care directly within public schools- providing a full continuum of clinical programming, professional development, and district consultation.

Position Type: Per Diem

Hourly Rate: $55.00-$62.00/hour

This is a per diem position and is not eligible for benefits. Per diem therapist support ESS on an as-needed basis, including coverage for leave assignments (e.g., medical or maternity leave).

Therapist in this role have flexibility in their level of commitment. They may choose to pick up occasional shifts, work a few days per week on an ongoing basis, or take on a temporary full-time schedule when covering a longer-term leave assignment. Per diem clinicians can accept or decline assignments based on their availability.

This role does not follow a consistent full-time schedule; however, full-time hours may be required on a temporary basis when covering extended leave assignments.

Why This Role Matters

You’ll provide critical mental health support to students who may not otherwise have access to care—helping them succeed academically, build resilience, and thrive.

At ESS, clinicians are trusted partners in shaping supportive school environments.

Responsibilities

Direct Clinical Care & Family Support

  • Provide comprehensive, school-based mental health services, including individual, group, and family therapy, as well as intake, diagnostic, and clinical assessments
  • Partner with families and facilitate parent support programming
  • Conduct risk assessments and crisis intervention, ensuring student safety and coordinating referrals to appropriate levels of care when needed
  • Develop and implement individualized, evidence-based treatment plans that support students’ emotional, behavioral, and academic success

Supervision, Training & Collaboration

  • Oversee the day-to-day clinical operations of the assigned school-based program
  • Serve as the primary clinical point of contact for school partners, providing expert guidance, ensuring alignment on student support strategies, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships.
  • Facilitate weekly consultation sessions to ensure alignment on student goals and documentation standards
  • Collaborate with families, school staff, and interdisciplinary teams to deliver coordinated care, and provide consultation, coaching, and training on mental health and trauma-informed practices
  • Participate in team meetings, supervision, and ongoing professional development

Documentation, Compliance & Professional Expectations

  • Maintain timely, accurate clinical documentation in accordance with regulatory, ethical, and organizational standards
  • Uphold professional standards by maintaining active licensure, ethical practice, reliability, and a strong professional presence
  • Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with ESS clinical and operational standards
  • Support clinician performance through feedback, coaching, and evaluations

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field
  • Active associate number or clinical license (e.g., AMFT, APCC, ACSW or LMFT, LPCC, LCSW) in the state of California
  • 2+ years of experience working with children and/or adolescents with behavioral and emotional needs
  • Experience providing training and coaching to educational professionals and parents/caregivers on student mental health issues.
  • Experience working with schools, families, and community-based services (school-based experience preferred)
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain trusting relationships with students, families, and school staff
  • Commitment to delivering high-quality, evidence-based care and advocating for best practices
  • Proven ability to positively influence, motivate, and elevate team members and stakeholders
  • Ability to make confident, sound decisions in ambiguous or evolving situations
  • Proficient in clinical documentation and use of electronic systems (e.g., EMR, Microsoft Office), with the ability to maintain accurate and timely records

Why Clinicians Choose ESS

✔ School-day schedule — No weekends; occasional evening hours as needed to support family engagement
✔ Light summers
✔ Small caseloads
✔ Ongoing clinical support, and free CEUs
✔ Competitive Pay
✔ Clinical leadership at the heart of our company

Make a meaningful impact on student mental health.
Join Effective School Solutions

ESS is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

title: Vuorovastaava / kassa-myyjä, Rauma (vakituinen 30 h/vko)
description:
Oletko kokenut kaupan alan ammattilainen ja haluat ottaa seuraavan askeleen urallasi? Oletko asiakaspalveluhenkinen, organisointikykyinen ja kaupallisesti ajatteleva energinen osaaja? Etsimme nyt myymäläämme kassa-myyjää yhdistettynä vuorovastaavan rooliin vakituiseen työsuhteeseen!

Haemme nyt uuteen rooliin vuorovastaavaksi asiakaspalveluhenkistä, kaupallisesti ajattelevaa ja organisointikykyistä kaupan ammattilaista. Vuorovastaavavuorossa huolehdit, että myymälässä suoritettavat työt sujuvat suunnitellusti ja aikataulussa. Monipuolinen työpäiväsi sisältää asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja myymälässä, tuotteiden hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Vastaat laadukkaan asiakaspalvelun toteutumisesta ja hoidat mahdolliset asiakasreklamaatiot palvelulupauksemme mukaisesti. Tärkeä osa tehtävääsi on huolehtia myymäläkuntoisuudesta, hyllysaatavuudesta sekä hävikistä. Vuoroihisi voi sisältyä myymälän avaamiseen ja sulkemiseen liittyvät toimet sekä esimerkiksi sairaslomituksien hoitaminen. Pääset lisäksi toteuttamaan myymäläkonseptin ja markkinointisuunnitelman mukaisia esillepanoja ja hintanäyttöjä.

Vuorovastaavana toimitaan erikseen määritellyissä vuoroissa silloin, kun vuorossa ei ole palveluvastaavaa tai myymäläpäällikköä. Muissa vuoroissa vuorovastaava toimii normaaleissa kassa-myyjän päivittäisissä myymälätehtävissä.

Voisit olla uusi vuorovastaavamme, jos…

  • Olet aidosti kiinnostunut työyhteisöstä ja asiakkaista
  • Sinulla on vankka kokemus asiakaspalvelu- ja vähittäiskauppatyöskentelystä
  • Olet oma-aloitteinen, ratkaisukeskeinen ja nautit vastuunkannosta
  • Innostat ja ohjaat myös muita onnistumaan työssään ja olet yhteistyökykyinen tiimipelaaja
  • Hallitset perustason tietojärjestelmien käytön, ja sinulla on kyky oppia uusia järjestelmiä ja prosesseja sekä opastaa niitä muille
  • Olet valmis ottamaan lisää vastuuta ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi eteenpäin, kenties tulevaisuuden palveluvastaavaksi?

Aiempi kokemus esihenkilö- tai vastuutehtävistä on hyödyksi tässä tehtävässä.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Vuorovastaavan tehtävä tarjoaa loistavan mahdollisuuden ottaa lisää vastuuta ja saada uusia haasteita myyjän tehtävän ohelle. Vuorovastaavan vuoroissa työnkuvasi monipuolistuu ja saat vaihtelua työhösi. Pääset vahvistamaan kaupan alan taitojasi ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi erityisesti organisoinnin, ohjaamisen ja päätöksenteon saralla. Pääset työskentelemään kannustavassa ja mukavassa työyhteisössä, jossa kehittyminen ja menestyminen tapahtuvat yhdessä. Mikäli osastovastaavan tehtävä kiinnostaa tulevaisuudessa, vuorovastaavana toimiminen voi olla loistava askel osastovastaavaksi kehittymistä!

Vuorovastaavaroolissa tehdyistä tunneista maksetaan korkeampi palkkio. Etuna roolissa on lähiesihenkilötyön ammattitutkinto tai sen osasuoritus, mutta rooli ei edellytä tätä.

title: Begeleider Gehandicaptenzorg | LVB/VB | Wateringen | 24–32 uur
description:
Wil jij werken op een plek waar volwassenen met een lichte tot matige verstandelijke beperking zoveel mogelijk hun eigen leven leiden? Waar jij niet vóór bewoners denkt, maar mét hen kijkt naar wat wél mogelijk is? Dan voel jij je waarschijnlijk snel thuis op De Zonneberg in Wateringen.

Iedere bewoner heeft een eigen appartement, een eigen verhaal en eigen doelen. Jij helpt bewoners stap voor stap zelfstandiger te worden, biedt rust wanneer dat nodig is en geniet van de kleine successen die soms een wereld van verschil maken.

Jouw rol

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene bewoner gaat zelfstandig naar zijn werk en heeft vooral behoefte aan een luisterend oor. Een andere bewoner vindt het spannend om boodschappen te doen of wil leren koken. Jij kijkt steeds naar wat iemand zelf kan en ondersteunt alleen waar dat nodig is.

Je bent een vertrouwd gezicht voor bewoners. Je brengt structuur, geeft vertrouwen en helpt mensen groeien in zelfstandigheid. Juist die afwisseling maakt jouw werk iedere dag weer bijzonder.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Je begeleidt bewoners bij hun dagelijks leven, zoals koken, boodschappen doen, plannen en het onderhouden van sociale contacten.
  • Je stimuleert bewoners om zoveel mogelijk zelf te doen en ondersteunt waar nodig bij lichte ADL.
  • Je kijkt achter gedrag, signaleert veranderingen en vertaalt deze naar passende begeleiding.
  • Je biedt rust, duidelijkheid en veiligheid wanneer bewoners spanning of onzekerheid ervaren.
  • Je werkt samen met verwanten, collega's en andere betrokken professionals om bewoners de best mogelijke ondersteuning te bieden.
  • Je denkt actief mee over hoe de begeleiding nóg beter kan en draagt bij aan een positieve sfeer binnen het team.

Natuurlijk leg je belangrijke afspraken, observaties en ontwikkelingen zorgvuldig vast in het ECD, zodat de continuïteit van zorg gewaarborgd blijft.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een brutosalaris volgens de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg van minimaal € 2.649,- en maximaal € 3.708,- (FWG 35) bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur. Bij onregelmatige diensten krijg je een toeslag van 122 tot 160%
  • Direct een vast contract (tenzij er redenen zijn om hiervan af te wijken);
  • Ruimte om te groeien, zoals jij dat wilt: met jouw talent en ambitie, maar ook met ons Leerhuis en de vele opleidingsmogelijkheden;
  • Mogelijkheid om jouw vakantietoeslag en/of eindejaarsuitkering elke maand laat uitbetalen;
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng en het ontwikkelen van jouw talenten, je werkt mee aan projecten en activiteiten;
  • Korting op uitjes, je sportschool en een interessante laptop- en fietsregeling en voordelen als extra vrije dagen tot aan coaching. Kies wat jij wilt;
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng; Wij zijn altijd op zoek naar mogelijkheden om onze begeleiding te verbeteren. Werken mee aan projecten en activiteiten!
  • Basisrooster wat voor een jaar wordt uitgerold ( vastgesteld rooster).

Bekijk al onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Over de locatie

De Zonneberg ligt in Wateringen, vlak bij Den Haag en Rijswijk. Op deze moderne woonlocatie wonen 31 volwassenen met een lichte tot matige verstandelijke beperking in hun eigen tweekamerappartement, verdeeld over vier verdiepingen.

Bewoners wonen zo zelfstandig mogelijk en kunnen 24 uur per dag terugvallen op de begeleiding wanneer dat nodig is. Hierdoor ontstaat een mooie balans tussen vrijheid en nabijheid.

Wat maakt De Zonneberg bijzonder?

De Zonneberg voelt niet als een grote instelling, maar als een plek waar bewoners écht thuis zijn.

Dat merk je aan:

  • Iedere bewoner beschikt over een eigen appartement.
  • De rustige en huiselijke sfeer waarin bewoners en collega's elkaar goed kennen.
  • Twee gezellige steunpunten waar bewoners elkaar ontmoeten.
  • De grote tuin met uitzicht op het Hofpark.
  • De methodieken Leerbaar Weerbaar en Active Support, waarmee bewoners worden gestimuleerd om zoveel mogelijk zelf te doen.
  • De korte lijnen binnen het team en de ruimte om mee te denken over verbeteringen.
  • De mogelijkheid om écht een langdurige band op te bouwen met bewoners.

Wie ben jij?

Jij ziet niet de beperking, maar de mens. Je blijft rustig wanneer situaties spannend worden, bent duidelijk in je communicatie en krijgt energie van de kleine stappen die bewoners iedere dag zetten.

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je een relevant mbo-diploma niveau 3 of 4, zoals MMZ, Persoonlijk Begeleider, Verzorgende IG of SPW.
  • Heb je affiniteit met of ervaring in de gehandicaptenzorg en het begeleiden van volwassenen met een lichte tot matige verstandelijke beperking.
  • Ben je positief, zelfstandig en weet je humor op het juiste moment in te zetten.
  • Vind je onregelmatige diensten, waaronder slaap- en weekenddiensten, geen probleem.
  • Kun je goed overweg met digitale systemen en ben je bereid een VOG aan te vragen.
  • Wil je jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en bijdragen aan de kwaliteit van begeleiding.

Solliciteer snel!

title: Engagement Specialist
description:
Join Girl Scouts of Wisconsin Southeast as an Engagement Specialist and help create a welcoming, well-supported experience for girls, families, and volunteers. This is a customer-focused role, that connects directly with members to strengthen troops so more girls can participate in Girl Scouting. If you are organized, adaptable, and passionate about helping others while advancing a meaningful mission, we encourage you to apply!



Position Title: Engagement Specialist

Locations: Milwaukee, WI

Operating Unit: Membership Experience

Report To: Vice President of Membership Experience

FSLA: Non-Exempt

FTE: Full-Time (37.5 hours a week)

Pay Grade: 5


Who We Are

Girl Scouts create the world they want to live in and strive to make it better every single day. They explore their strengths, take on new challenges, and can always be themselves, regardless of background or ability. Working for Girl Scouts of Wisconsin Southeast (GSWISE) is much more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to bring your talent, passion, and perspective to a girl-centric, mission driven organization. We are seeking individuals committed to making a difference who are enthusiastic team players who want to join an organization with a proud history and a growing future. Joining our staff means working to your full potential in a dynamic and diverse environment that strives for equity for all.


Position Summary

The Engagement Specialist helps create a welcoming, well-supported Girl Scout experience by connecting girls and adults with troops and volunteer opportunities as part of the Membership Experience Team. Reporting to the Vice President of Membership Experience, this role is vital to guiding volunteers through registration, background checks, training, approval requirements, accurate troop and account records, and identifying volunteer leadership needs. The Engagement Specialist provides timely support and works collaboratively to help strengthen troops and expand opportunities for girls to participate in Girl Scouting.


What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for placement of registered girls and adults into troops and volunteer roles.
  • Assist and answer questions for registered adult members regarding Criminal Background checks, onboarding requirements, and training needs.
  • Work collaboratively with Membership Experience Specialist to support new leaders through the onboarding process.
  • Maintain timely and detailed records of troop level statistics such as location, dates, membership records to ensure volunteers and families receive accurate information.
  • Monitor girl and adult volunteer participation by troop and community, identify gaps that may affect troop viability or growth, and communicate recruitment needs to the appropriate team members.
  • Create a sense of belonging for members and model behavior consistent with the mission and purpose of Girl Scouting.
  • Work collaboratively with all Council departments to ensure council program and initiatives are shared with girl and adult membership.
  • Provide prospective members with timely follow-up information to help them complete the membership process.
  • Provide back-up support in the retail store assisting customers and serving as a cashier.
  • Assist other council departments during peak seasons on council wide projects, events, and activities to provide back-up support.

EEO & Anti-Racist Statement

The Girl Scouts of Wisconsin Southeast (GSWISE) has a vision for a deeply inclusive membership, staff, and volunteers. To foster a culture of belonging while providing equitable service delivery above and beyond Equal Opportunity requirements, GSWISE candidates must be committed to cultural competency growth and work within diverse teams. Our Girl Scout Law encourages us to seek racial equity for everyone and do our part to dismantle systemic racism. GSWISE is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
