title: Palveluvastaava, Kauhava (vakituinen 30 h/vko)
description:
Viihdytkö vauhdikkaassa myymäläarjessa ja otat luontevasti vetovastuun tilanteen sitä vaatiessa? Palveluvastaavana olet siellä, missä tapahtuu: asiakkaiden, työkavereiden ja myymälän sujuvan arjen keskellä.

Palveluvastaavana yhdistät käytännön myymälätyön, asiakaspalvelun ja työvuoron operatiivisen johtamisen. Työskentelet aktiivisesti myymäläarjessa, kuten kassalla ja muissa myymälätehtävissä, ja varmistat samalla, että työvuorossa työ sujuu suunnitellusti ja Tokmannin toimintamallien mukaisesti.

Tehtävässäsi vastaat

Vuoron operatiivisesta johtamisesta 💡

  • Vastaat työvuoron kokonaisuudesta silloin, kun myymäläpäällikkö tai apulaismyymäläpäällikkö ei ole paikalla.
  • Johdat vuoron tekemistä sekä jaat ja priorisoit työtehtäviä.
  • Huolehdit resurssien, taukojen ja työmäärän sujuvasta toteutumisesta.
  • Vastaat myymälän avaamiseen ja sulkemiseen liittyvistä tehtävistä.
  • Ratkaiset vuoron aikana eteen tulevia arjen tilanteita ja huolehdit myymälän turvallisuudesta ja toimintavalmiudesta.

Asiakaspalvelusta ja kassatyöstä ⭐

  • Työskentelet monipuolisesti myymälätehtävissä ja palvelet asiakkaita Tokmannin asiakaslupauksen mukaisesti.
  • Varmistat omalta osaltasi sujuvan ja asiakaslähtöisen palvelukokemuksen.
  • Ratkaiset asiakastilanteita ja käsittelet asiakasreklamaatioita työvuorosi aikana.
  • Toimit omalla esimerkilläsi mallina hyvästä palvelusta, myynnistä ja työotteesta.
  • Huolehdit kassatyöskentelyn sujuvuudesta ja asiakasvirran hallinnasta sekä osallistut tarvittaessa itse kassatyöhön.

Myymälän päivittäisestä toiminnasta 👏🏽

  • Koordinoit tavarakuormien purkua ja huolehdit työn sujuvasta etenemisestä.
  • Pidät myymälän palavereita Tokmannin toimintamallien mukaisesti.
  • Huolehdit tavaran vastaanoton ja hyllyttämisen sujuvuudesta työvuorosi aikana.
  • Varmistat myymäläkonseptin ja markkinointiohjeiden mukaisten esillepanojen ja hinnannäyttöjen toteutumisen.
  • Huolehdit myymälän siisteydestä, myymäläkuntoisuudesta, hyllysaatavuudesta ja päivittäisestä hävikin hallinnasta.
  • Hyödynnät Tokmannin järjestelmiä ja toimintamalleja osana päivittäistä työtäsi.

Tiimin ohjaamisesta ❤️

  • Toimit myyjien lähiesihenkilönä omassa työvuorossasi myymäläpäällikön (tai apulaismyymäläpäällikön) poissa ollessa.
  • Ohjaat, neuvot ja tuet myymälähenkilöstöä päivittäisessä työssä.
  • Annat palautetta arjen tilanteissa ja huolehdit yhteisten toimintatapojen noudattamisesta ja yhteistyöstä.
  • Osallistut uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämiseen.
  • Edistät omalla esimerkilläsi avointa, kannustavaa ja vastuullista työilmapiiriä.

Yhteistyöstä myymälän johdon kanssa 🫱🏽‍🫲🏽

  • Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myymäläpäällikön kanssa (ja apulaismyymäläpäällikön sekä palveluvastaavien, mikäli myymälässä on nämä roolit)
  • Huolehdit tarvittaessa työvuoron henkilöstöjärjestelyistä yhteistyössä myymälän johdon kanssa.
  • Huolehdit muista työvuoron sujuvuuden kannalta tarpeellisista myymälätehtävistä.

Työ on vakituinen ja alkaa heti sopimuksen mukaan. Viikkotyöaika on 30 h/vko.

Odotamme sinulta

  • Soveltuvaa kaupallista koulutusta tai aiempaa kokemusta vähittäiskaupasta.
  • Hyvää myymälä-, kassa- ja asiakaspalvelutyöskentelyn osaamista.
  • Hyviä valmiuksia erilaisten järjestelmien käyttöön sekä kykyä omaksua nopeasti uusia toimintamalleja.
  • Kykyä johtaa ja ohjata tiimin päivittäistä tekemistä sekä priorisoida tehtäviä muuttuvissa tilanteissa.
  • Hyviä yhteistyö-, vuorovaikutus-, päätöksenteko- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja.
  • Itsenäistä, vastuullista ja jämäkkää työotetta sekä rohkeutta tarttua tilanteisiin.
  • Palveluhenkisyyttä sekä kykyä toimia yhteisten ohjeiden ja toimintamallien mukaisesti ja käyttää hyvää pelisilmää erilaisissa asiakastilanteissa.
  • Mahdollisuutta työskennellä myymälän aukioloaikojen mukaisesti eri työvuoroissa.

Myymälätyö on liikkuvaa ja fyysistä. Työpäivään kuuluu muun muassa tuotepakkausten nostamista ja siirtämistä sekä työskentelyä erilaisissa työasennoissa.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän, hyvän perehdytyksen sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi myymälätyössä ja tiimin ohjaamisessa. Saat ympärillesi osaavan työyhteisön ja tuen tehtävässä onnistumiseen.

Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muistathan kurkata myös roskapostikansion. Joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.

title: Instructional Aide
description:
About the Team

ACCEL Schools is seeking an Instructional Aide at Mount Auburn Preparatory Academy in Cincinnati, Ohio.

Be part of the difference at Mount Auburn Preparatory Academy! Founded in 2018, Mount Auburn Preparatory Academy is a public charter school serving Cincinnati with a continuous EK-12th grade education. Offering a college prep education with an emphasis on social-emotional development, the school features small class sizes, expansive student and family support services, and a wide range of extracurricular and sports opportunities. Mount Auburn Preparatory Academy is part of ACCEL Schools, an established network of public charter schools serving K-12 students throughout the United States since 2014.

About the Opportunity:

The Instructional Aide assists the Teacher with classroom activities and helps to promote positive student behaviors in both academics and extra-curricular activities. The Instructional Aide provides oversight to ensure student safety and a positive school climate. The Instructional Aide assists the School Leader and Teachers by administering the assigned duties in conformity with the philosophy and policies of ACCEL Schools, the assigned school, the school’s governing board, the State Board of Education, and all applicable laws.

Duties:

  • Supports lessons taught by the teacher to individual students or groups of students and follows instructional plans as assigned by the Teacher or School Leader
  • Helps plan classroom activities as directed by the Teacher and supports the Teacher in all student and parent relations
  • Assists with school activities, including, but not limited to, parent-faculty nights, faculty meetings, assemblies, commencement exercises, fundraiser, chaperoning student activities, providing guidance for students, participating on faculty committees, etc.
  • Performs clerical duties, including, but not limited to, grading papers and making copies
  • Assists the Teacher in the use of classroom technology
  • Helps maintain the cleanliness of the classroom, lunchroom and other school areas
  • Understands, accepts, abides by, and implements the school’s philosophy and mission statement in all school activities
  • Other duties as assigned, including, but not limited to, field trips, morning duty, dismissal duty, and lunch duty

Performance Expectations:

  • Works cooperatively with the Teacher and others
  • Acts in accordance with directives from the Administrator (or designee) and teacher
  • Contributes to a positive climate and culture by exhibiting high professional standard

About You:

  • Associate degree, two years of college coursework, or the passage of the Paraprofessional’s Exam
  • Proficiency in MS Office
  • Successful completion of BCI/FBI check
  • Ability to meet educational standards as applicable
  • Ability to work well under pressure, and effectively prioritize and execute tasks to meet deadlines consistently
  • Understanding and ability to manage confidential information
  • High quality written and verbal communication skills
  • Physical ability to lift 25-40 lbs.
  • Experience in a school or social services setting is a plus

About Us

“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” – Ron Packard, CEO & Founder

ACCEL Schools is a network of 80+ high-performing, public charter schools serving PK-12 students. We proudly advocate for school choice and work to address educational inequities throughout the United States. Our schools are inclusive and widely differ to reflect the unique values of the many urban, suburban, and rural communities we serve. Our brick and mortar, and virtual schools specialize in closing educational gaps and offer innovative models such as career-technical education, sports training, bilingual programming, and more. We have been recognized and praised by legislators, authorizers, and researchers for providing exceptional education options to students in historically under-resourced communities.

We offer the following benefits:

Compensation

The starting hourly rate for this position is $16.25/hour. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Life benefits – time & peace of mind

  • Paid time off
  • Retirement contributions
  • Optional Basic Life and AD&D insurance
  • Voluntary life insurance (employee, spouse, child)
  • Discounted childcare at Early Learning Academies locations

Health benefits – stay well & thrive

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Voluntary short-term disability insurance
  • Voluntary long-term disability insurance

Career benefits – keep growing

  • Career advancement opportunities throughout Accel Schools and our strong network of 4,000+ instructors and education professionals

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

It is our policy to abide by all federal, state and local laws prohibiting employment discrimination based solely on a person’s race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, pregnancy, childbirth, physical disability, mental and/or intellectual disability, age, military status, veteran status (including protected veterans), marital status, registered domestic partner or civil union status, familial status, gender (including sex stereotyping and gender identity or expression), medical condition, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any other protected status except where a reasonable, bona fide occupational qualification exists.

title: Contract Services – Pricing Specialist
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and innovative Contract Services – Pricing Specialist to support our Business Development team in Saint John, NB.

Summary:
Reporting to the Contract Services Manager, the Contract Services – Pricing Specialist supports strategic growth initiatives by coordinating pricing, quoting, and contract administration activities across a diverse portfolio of products and suppliers. This role combines analytical thinking, attention to detail, and strong collaboration skills to deliver competitive customer solutions and support successful contract outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

Prepare accurate and competitive quotes, bids, tenders, and pricing submissions in support of business development and customer contract opportunities.
Gather, analyze, and validate pricing, product, and vendor information to ensure submissions meet customer requirements and company standards.
Manage quote requests through completion, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to established deadlines.
Maintain accurate records and documentation related to quoting activities, pricing decisions, contracts, and vendor communications.
Liaise with vendors and internal stakeholders to obtain information, resolve discrepancies, and support the successful execution of customer contracts.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Business Development, Procurement, Customer Service, and Operations, to support customer and organizational objectives.
Assist in the administration and maintenance of customer contracts, pricing agreements, and related business documentation.
Monitor and maintain pricing data within company systems to support consistency, accuracy, and operational effectiveness.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance quoting processes, contract administration, data quality, and customer service.
Provide administrative support, reporting, and other duties as required.

Qualifications:

2+ years of experience in quoting, pricing, contract administration, procurement support, RFQs, tenders, vendor quotations, or a related business support role
Experience in wholesale distribution, manufacturing, industrial supply, or a related industry is considered an asset
Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Commerce, or a related field is preferred
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with the ability to gather and interpret pricing and vendor information
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in pricing, documentation, and data management
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and with vendors
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint
Comfortable using multiple systems, vendor portals, and AI-enabled tools

In accordance with the provincial wage transparency requirements, the expected base compensation for this position is between $50,000 - $65,000 (or more), depending on relevant experience, technical competencies, certifications, etc.

In addition, all permanent & full-time associates are eligible for additional benefits, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, Vision, STD/LTD/AD&D, Life Insurance, RRSP Matching, Pro-rated Vacation Entitlement, Paid Statutory Holidays, Employee Assistance, etc.

title: Complaints Handler
description:
Complaints Handler

About People’s Partnership:

At the heart of our not-for-profit organisation is a commitment and a motivation to make the future-saving experience a simple one for our members. We champion fairness and simplicity, not profit-chasing. Imagine a financial adventure where everyone's a winner, fuelled by our exceptional service and brought to life by the fantastic individuals who work for us. We're a diverse employer with a flexible, hybrid working approach, ensuring everyone gets the opportunity to come to work and be the best version of themselves.

What you'll be doing:

You'll take ownership of a portfolio of customer complaints, ensuring each one is handled with care, professionalism, and in line with both company and industry standards. Your role will involve investigating the root cause of each issue, working towards a fair and reasonable resolution, and clearly communicating outcomes to customers via phone and email. You’ll be the key point of contact for complainants, but also collaborate closely with internal teams to gather insights and ensure a joined-up approach to resolving concerns. Your ability to balance empathy with objectivity will be crucial in delivering a positive experience, even in challenging situations.

Key Responsibilities:

Investigate and understand the customer’s complaint, recommending and providing appropriate resolutions, ensuring that all reactive or preventative work is carried out whilst maintaining a full and thorough audit trail.
Produce relevant client and internal correspondence materials as required.
Log complaints accurately and in timely manner.
Calculate and recommend redress, distress and inconvenience payments.
Handle complex and challenging calls.
Provide feedback to team leaders and managers, as appropriate, where employee development needs are identified via complaint information.
Support all business areas with complaint queries and guidance.
Identify and recognise vulnerable customers – and respond appropriately.
Participate in internal team coaching, training and knowledge-sharing.
Take responsibility for own learning and development keeping up to date with pension, product, policy, process, procedural, regulatory, compliance and legislative developments together with a wider industry awareness and an understanding of all activities undertaken by the Customer Services department.
Support the FCA Treating Customers Fairly guidelines and maintain quality framework standards to minimise risk to People’s Partnership and customers.
Uphold People’s Partnership values.
Adhere to Company Risk Management policy and procedures, including reporting of incidents or breaches.
Apply and promote Treating Customers Fairly (TCF) culture and principles, together with the organisation’s behaviours and values.
Adhere to Company Diversity & Inclusion policy.

What we’re looking for:

Be able to make sound, fair and compliant judgments to ensure the desired outcome for both the Company and customer.
Be confident and experienced in dealing with challenging customer interactions and be able to handle conflict constructively.
Handle cases to the highest standard of customer care and resolve them satisfactorily and in accordance with FCA and TCF principles.
Be able to work effectively and quickly despite ambiguity.
Question existing working practices and help evolve better ways of working that produce better outcomes for customers.
Have an ability to build and establish a prompt rapport with the complainant.
Be able to negotiate successfully with customers and resolve matters to their satisfaction.
Be able to handle a varying and demanding workload that, often, requires bespoke solutions.
Be effective in creating strong connections and networks throughout the business.
Be clear in your communications, both written and verbally.
Have great attention to detail.

Desirable Qualifications:

Certificate in Financial Administration CF1
Certificate in Financial Administration FA2
Certificate in Regulated Complaints Handling (CeRCH)
Have previous experience in dealing with complaints.
Have previously worked in the pensions industry.
Possess a strong knowledge of our products both current and historic.

What you can expect from us:

Generous pension contributions with an employer contribution of up to 14%
Real living wage
Income protection, critical illness cover & death in service insurance
Employee healthcare
Parental and adoption leave
Learning & development opportunities and study support
Travel season ticket loans
Grab & Go Deli Café in Crawley
Volunteering days and charity payroll giving
Onsite gym
Ride-to-Work scheme
Social clubs and events

Disability Statement

People's Partnership is an equal opportunities employer. We believe everyone has the right to be treated fairly, with dignity and respect. We are committed to treating all our people (and all who apply for a role at People's Partnership) equally and enabling them to perform at their best and demonstrate what they have to offer. We are a disability committed employer, please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments made to our recruitment process (application, selection assessments where relevant, and interview) to enable you to show us the best “you”.

title: Inventory Specialist
description:
Responsible for maintaining accuracy of all inventory (ingredients, packaging, WIP, finished goods) in Michigan City in MB1, MB2 and storage trailers. Identify root causes of inventory discrepancies and work cross functionally to resolve. Proactively work to prevent unnecessary aging of materials to prevent loss. Lead by example, train material handlers on cycle counting effectively and educate on the importance of inventory accuracy. Conduct regular cycle counts and update perpetual inventory. Reconcile production orders for accurate Finished good production and material consumption.
Schedule
1st Shift: Monday - Friday from 6:00am - 2:00pm.
Job Duties:

Point person for day-to-day inventory issues supporting assigned shift.
Perform daily cycle counting as assigned and enter cycle count corrections as directed.
Root cause analysis of inventory discrepancies, look for solutions to recurring problems.
Account for all production usages for each production run, check for variances/errors during reconciliation.
Respond to count requests from various departments promptly depending on priority.
Resolve blocked quants in a timely manner.
Attend drumbeats to discuss any Inventory Control issues that are being caused by other departments not following correct processes.
Investigate and resolve any negative quantities showing in all systems.
Conduct 3PL warehouse reconciliation on a weekly basis (if applicable).
Provide backup support in tracking and maintaining inventory accuracy for cycle count and HTL (High Traffic Location) accuracy.
Provide backup support in completing daily/weekly reporting when other personnel are absent.
Assist with ensuring accuracy of cycle count transactions.
Provide backup support for execution of dispositions after material(s) have been physically removed from warehouse, removing material from SAP. May have to produce AoD(Affidavit of Destruction).
Provide backup support to monitor HTL (High Traffic Location) areas and send out daily emails to departments that need to follow up on pallets sitting longer than 24 hours.
Provide backup support in performing CHEP/PECO weekly/monthly reconciliation.
Provide backup support in performing KANBAN, TANK and MISC reconciliation.
Attend drumbeats to discuss any Inventory Control issues that are being caused by other departments not following correct processes.
May include additional duties assigned by Manager.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four-year college or university preferred or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

title: PER DIEM - School-Based Therapist
description:
PER DIEM School-Based Therapist - Salinas, CA Area

Transforming student mental health in schools.

About Effective School Solutions

Effective School Solutions (ESS) is a leading provider of school-based mental health services, serving 6,000+ K–12 students across 12 states.

We deliver the level of clinical care typically found in private practice, out-of-district placements, or higher levels of care directly within public schools- providing a full continuum of clinical programming, professional development, and district consultation.

Position Type: Per Diem

Hourly Rate: $55.00-$62.00/hour

This is a per diem position and is not eligible for benefits. Per diem therapist support ESS on an as-needed basis, including coverage for leave assignments (e.g., medical or maternity leave).

Therapist in this role have flexibility in their level of commitment. They may choose to pick up occasional shifts, work a few days per week on an ongoing basis, or take on a temporary full-time schedule when covering a longer-term leave assignment. Per diem clinicians can accept or decline assignments based on their availability.

This role does not follow a consistent full-time schedule; however, full-time hours may be required on a temporary basis when covering extended leave assignments.

Why This Role Matters

You’ll provide critical mental health support to students who may not otherwise have access to care—helping them succeed academically, build resilience, and thrive.

At ESS, clinicians are trusted partners in shaping supportive school environments.

Responsibilities

Direct Clinical Care & Family Support

  • Provide comprehensive, school-based mental health services, including individual, group, and family therapy, as well as intake, diagnostic, and clinical assessments
  • Partner with families and facilitate parent support programming
  • Conduct risk assessments and crisis intervention, ensuring student safety and coordinating referrals to appropriate levels of care when needed
  • Develop and implement individualized, evidence-based treatment plans that support students’ emotional, behavioral, and academic success

Supervision, Training & Collaboration

  • Oversee the day-to-day clinical operations of the assigned school-based program
  • Serve as the primary clinical point of contact for school partners, providing expert guidance, ensuring alignment on student support strategies, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships.
  • Facilitate weekly consultation sessions to ensure alignment on student goals and documentation standards
  • Collaborate with families, school staff, and interdisciplinary teams to deliver coordinated care, and provide consultation, coaching, and training on mental health and trauma-informed practices
  • Participate in team meetings, supervision, and ongoing professional development

Documentation, Compliance & Professional Expectations

  • Maintain timely, accurate clinical documentation in accordance with regulatory, ethical, and organizational standards
  • Uphold professional standards by maintaining active licensure, ethical practice, reliability, and a strong professional presence
  • Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with ESS clinical and operational standards
  • Support clinician performance through feedback, coaching, and evaluations

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field
  • Active associate number or clinical license (e.g., AMFT, APCC, ACSW or LMFT, LPCC, LCSW) in the state of California
  • 2+ years of experience working with children and/or adolescents with behavioral and emotional needs
  • Experience providing training and coaching to educational professionals and parents/caregivers on student mental health issues.
  • Experience working with schools, families, and community-based services (school-based experience preferred)
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain trusting relationships with students, families, and school staff
  • Commitment to delivering high-quality, evidence-based care and advocating for best practices
  • Proven ability to positively influence, motivate, and elevate team members and stakeholders
  • Ability to make confident, sound decisions in ambiguous or evolving situations
  • Proficient in clinical documentation and use of electronic systems (e.g., EMR, Microsoft Office), with the ability to maintain accurate and timely records

Why Clinicians Choose ESS

✔ School-day schedule — No weekends; occasional evening hours as needed to support family engagement
✔ Light summers
✔ Small caseloads
✔ Ongoing clinical support, and free CEUs
✔ Competitive Pay
✔ Clinical leadership at the heart of our company

Make a meaningful impact on student mental health.
Join Effective School Solutions

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Food and Beverage Attendant -Hampton Inn Mission Valley
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
The Lounge Attendant is responsible for maintaining a welcoming, clean, and well-stocked lounge environment for guests. This role ensures guests receive attentive service while enjoying the lounge space by assisting with food and beverage service, maintaining cleanliness, and supporting overall lounge operations.
PRIMARY JOB DUTIES:

title: Security Architect
description:
This role is based in our Newton, MA office.

We are seeking a strategic Security Architect to define and drive our cloud and enterprise security architecture. You will own the security architecture vision, establish governance frameworks, and partner with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to embed security throughout our technology ecosystem.

Core Responsibilities

  • Strategic Architecture & Governance
  • Own and evolve the enterprise security architecture, including long-term roadmap and reference architectures for cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments
  • Define organizational security principles, frameworks, and standards that align with business objectives and regulatory requirements
  • Develop and present security strategy, roadmaps, and strategic initiatives to executive leadership and stakeholders
  • Establish security metrics and KPIs to measure architecture effectiveness and communicate security posture to senior leadership
  • Ensure compliance with industry regulations and standards including ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and SOX
  • Lead security audits and assessments, driving remediation plans and continuous improvement initiative

Cloud & Infrastructure Security

  • Own cloud security architecture across AWS and GCP, including Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management (CIEM), and Wiz remediation strategies
  • Design and implement Identity and Access Management (IAM) architecture based on least privilege principles and Zero Trust security models
  • Architect secure network segmentation strategies and defense-in-depth controls across all infrastructure layers
  • Own the architecture and strategic direction for key security platforms including SIEM, vulnerability management, endpoint security, and threat detection systems
  • Manage and optimize internal security platforms to ensure robust protection of organizational assets
  • Design secure cloud infrastructures and hybrid environment protections that scale with business growth
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk analyses to identify infrastructure vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies

Application & Development Security

  • Lead Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and DevSecOps initiatives across the organization
  • Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, championing shift-left security practices in collaboration with DevOps leadership
  • Ensure software architecture and applications are designed to mitigate vulnerabilities and prevent exploits
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development and DevOps teams on secure coding practices and emerging threats
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed security throughout the system development lifecycle
  • Define security requirements and controls that support agile development while maintaining strong security posture

Innovation & Technical Leadership

  • Lead security architecture for emerging technologies including AI/LLM initiatives, ensuring responsible and secure implementation
  • Serve as the technical authority on security architecture, advising on security-related technologies and assessing risks associated with proposed changes
  • Stay current with emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, and technologies to drive continuous innovation in security practices
  • Inspire and influence engineering teams to execute security principles and adopt security-first mindsets
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to DevOps, operations, and development teams on security best practices
  • Partner strategically with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure leaders to align security architecture with business innovation
  • Drive thought leadership through security documentation, architecture diagrams, design specifications, and security control matrices

Additional Responsibilities

  • Lead incident response management and develop security policies that protect organizational assets from cyber threats
  • Identify organizational vulnerabilities and weaknesses through systematic security assessments
  • Recommend and implement security controls and solutions that balance security requirements with business enablement

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, information technology or a related field
  • 7+ years of cybersecurity experience with deep cloud security expertise
  • Proven track record leading enterprise security architecture in multi-cloud environments
  • Deep understanding of cloud service provider security best practices around (AWS, GCP)
    • Organization Policies
    • Automated threat detection tools
    • Central logging/Siem practices
    • Lest privilege architecture
    • VPC design/perimeter controls
    • Data Exfiltration prevention
    • Encryption/Key Management design
    • Identity and Access Management (IAM) best practices.
  • Web application security testing: Expertise in identifying and mitigating vulnerabilities in web applications, leveraging tools and methodologies like OWASP.
  • Network vulnerability scanning: Skilled in detecting and addressing vulnerabilities in network configurations and infrastructure.
  • Container and Kubernetes security: Proficiency in securing containerized environments, including Docker and Kubernetes, using best practices and tools like Trivy or Aqua Security.
  • Experience with security testing tools and platforms: Familiarity with industry-standard tools for vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and security auditing.
  • Ability to lead security discussions with system architects and business leaders.
  • Strong analytical and computer skills

Expert level understanding of cybersecurity and how it affects the modern business world.

  • Thorough understanding of Unix operation systems
  • Awareness of frameworks such as NIST, COBIT, ISO and Soc2
  • Certifications: CISSP, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer

description:

Keriton is a healthcare SaaS company focused on improving the safety and efficiency of infant feeding in hospitals. Our platform helps NICU and PICU teams safely prepare, track, and deliver infant feedings while integrating with hospital systems and supporting clinicians nationwide.

Keriton is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure to help build and support the core software and cloud infrastructure that powers our products.
This is a highly collaborative role that combines backend software engineering with cloud infrastructure, DevOps, automation, and operational support. You’ll develop APIs, build cloud environments using Infrastructure as Code, improve deployment pipelines, automate operational processes, and help ensure our platform is secure, reliable, and scalable.
As a cross-functional engineer, you’ll work across multiple areas of the technology stack, partnering closely with software engineers, mobile developers, QA, product management, and implementation teams to deliver reliable software and cloud infrastructure.
This role is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, lead technical initiatives, influence architecture decisions, and mentor other engineers through technical leadership and collaboration.

Backend Development

Participate in architecture discussions and technical planning.
Collaborate with engineers to improve development workflows and tooling.

Participate in an engineering on-call rotation and production incident response process.

Expand test coverage across backend services and infrastructure components.
Help improve engineering quality through automated testing and validation.

Identify systemic risks and proactively recommend long-term solutions.
Influence engineering best practices across development, testing, deployment, and operations.
Lead technical investigations and root-cause analysis for complex production issues.
Help mentor engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and collaboration.

Consider system reliability, data integrity, and patient safety implications when designing software and infrastructure.
Support compliance, security, and audit requirements associated with healthcare technology.

TypeScript / Node.js 22 / Fastify

Terraform
GitLab CI/CD

Python
Vitest

Required

Strong SQL skills and experience working with PostgreSQL.
Experience designing and managing cloud infrastructure in Azure using Terraform.

Experience writing automation and deployment tooling using Python.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple technical priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

Experience with React Native mobile application development.
Experience with Angular and/or React web application development.
Experience with Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms.

Job Description

Job Title: Senior Instrumentation & Metrology Technician
Location: Lexington, Massachusetts (On-Site)


About the role:

As a Senior Instrumentation & Metrology Technician, you will support the safe, compliant, and reliable performance of critical instrumentation, measurement, and control systems supporting good manufacturing practice (GMP) manufacturing operations at Takeda’s Lexington site. You will perform advanced calibration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and diagnostic activities to maintain the accuracy, integrity, and functionality of process equipment and utility systems. Working within the Site Engineering organization, you will help maintain continuous plant readiness, minimize production risks, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve equipment reliability through precise measurement and control. This on-site role is essential to supporting GMP manufacturing operations, product quality, and reliable plant performance.


How you will contribute:

  • Execute calibration, maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, and diagnostic activities for instrumentation, measurement, and control systems to ensure safe, compliant, and reliable equipment performance.
  • Execute and maintain site metrology programs in accordance with approved procedures, quality systems, and regulatory requirements, ensuring measurement and test equipment remains accurate, traceable, within tolerance, and fit for intended use.
  • Respond to alarms, abnormal conditions, and non-routine equipment or utility events by assessing priorities, communicating potential impacts, coordinating resources, escalating issues, and documenting actions to minimize operational disruptions.
  • Monitor, maintain, and support instrumentation, control systems, process equipment, and critical utilities to ensure reliable performance, continuous plant readiness, and timely resolution of equipment deviations.
  • Perform all work in accordance with site safety requirements, current GMP (cGMP) standards, and regulatory expectations, including completing hazard assessments, using appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), and following approved procedures.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely documentation, including calibration records, work orders, logbooks, maintenance activities, alarm and event reports, investigations, and other GMP records required to support data integrity, product quality, and audit readiness.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Validation, contractors, vendors, and equipment manufacturers to troubleshoot issues, improve reliability, and support commissioning and qualification activities, ensuring work is completed safely, compliantly, and right-first-time.
  • Oversee contractor activities within assigned areas, ensuring compliance with site procedures, safety requirements, and quality expectations.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource for instrumentation and metrology, providing technical guidance, mentoring, training, and knowledge transfer to technicians, contractors, and cross-functional teams while promoting accountability and high standards of workmanship.
  • Identify and support reliability and continuous improvement initiatives using equipment history, calibration data, and operational performance trends to improve measurement accuracy, strengthen compliance, optimize maintenance strategies, reduce risk, and enhance equipment reliability.

What you bring to Takeda:

  • High school diploma or equivalent with 4–8 years of relevant experience required. A technical certification, associate degree, military technical training, or equivalent technical education in a related field is preferred, with 3 or more years of relevant experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of instrumentation and metrology principles, including calibration techniques, measurement accuracy, and system reliability within GMP manufacturing environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills, with the ability to independently resolve complex instrumentation, electrical, and control system issues with minimal supervision.
  • Proficiency with control systems, including programmable logic controllers (PLCs) and associated instrumentation, as well as preventive and corrective maintenance practices and computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS).
  • Ability to interpret technical documentation, including P&IDs, equipment drawings, technical manuals, and related engineering documents, while maintaining strict adherence to cGMP, data integrity, and documentation requirements.
  • Strong digital literacy, attention to detail, ownership, and accountability, with the ability to use electronic business systems supporting procurement, safety, maintenance, and quality management activities.
  • Effective communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills, with the ability to guide peers and contractors, support knowledge transfer, and influence cross-functional stakeholders. Ability to meet physical requirements, including wearing PPE and gowning for pharmaceutical manufacturing areas, lifting, pushing, or pulling up to 50 pounds, standing for extended periods, climbing ladders, working from platforms, bending or stooping, handling approved site chemicals, and traveling or working across Massachusetts Bio Ops facilities as required.

Important Considerations

At Takeda, our patients rely on us to deliver quality products. As a result, we must follow strict rules in our manufacturing facilities to ensure we are not endangering the quality of the product. In this role, you may:

  • Work in a controlled environment requiring special gowning and wear protective clothing over the head, face, hands, feet and body. This may include additional hearing protection for loud areas.
  • Need to remove all make-up, jewelry, contact lenses, nail polish and/or artificial fingernails while in the manufacturing environment.
  • Work in a cold, wet environment.
  • Work multiple shifts, including weekends, or be asked to work supplemental hours, as necessary.
  • Work around chemicals such as alcohol, acids, buffers and Celite that may require respiratory protection.

This is an on-site role in Lexington, Massachusetts, required to support GMP manufacturing operations, plant readiness, and shift coverage needs.


More about us:

At Takeda, we are transforming patient care through the development of novel specialty pharmaceuticals and best in class patient support programs. Takeda is a patient-focused company that will inspire and empower you to grow through life-changing work.

Certified as a Global Top Employer, Takeda offers stimulating careers, encourages innovation, and strives for excellence in everything we do. title: Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist

With our rich history of providing psychological services since 1992, Deer Oaks is a nationally recognized leader in the Long-Term Care (LTC) geriatric field. title: Senior Frontend Engineer I - eCommerce
description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer I to join our eCommerce team, building the online booking experience patients use to choose a scan, find a clinic, pay, and schedule their appointment. You'll lead complex features in a Next.js and TypeScript application that serves customers in multiple countries, on flows where every screen directly affects conversion, revenue, and patient trust: product selection, checkout and payments, appointment scheduling across timezones, and our sales-assisted and partner booking paths. This is a high-impact role for someone who cares about the craft of the UI and about whether it actually works in production for every customer. If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems and owning outcomes rather than tickets, we'd love to hear from you.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Own features and components within an area of the booking experience, such as checkout and payments, scheduling, or the sales-assisted and partner flows, growing toward owning the area end to end.
  • Work with Product and Marketing on growth: ship experiments on the booking funnel, then read the results honestly, including sample size, guardrail metrics, and whether a change is a real win or just noise.
  • Build fast, accessible, customer-facing features with React, Next.js (App Router), and TypeScript.
  • Contribute to frontend architecture and design, writing proposals you review with senior engineers: sensible server and client component boundaries, server state with TanStack Query, client state with Zustand, and type-safe forms with React Hook Form and Zod.
  • Integrate the booking experience with our commerce APIs and third-party services, including Stripe, Affirm, commercetools, Voucherify, Salesforce, Auth0, and Google Maps.
  • Instrument what you ship: Datadog RUM for errors and performance, PostHog for product analytics, feature flags, and experiments, and Google Tag Manager for marketing measurement, all respecting each customer's consent choices.
  • Improve Core Web Vitals, bundle size, and rendering performance on a high-traffic, revenue-critical funnel.
  • Make accessibility a default: semantic markup, keyboard and screen reader support, and automated accessibility checks in CI.
  • Write automated tests at the right level: Vitest and Testing Library for components, MSW for API mocking, and Playwright for end-to-end booking flows.
  • Own outcomes in production: ship behind feature flags, watch the dashboards after release, and follow through when something breaks. You are accountable for whether a feature works for customers, not just whether it merged.
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, and Backend engineers, contributing to our shared component library and agreeing the API contracts the frontend depends on.
  • Provide technical guidance through design discussions and high-quality code review, and mentor junior engineers.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully as part of a structured build, review, and test workflow.

What You’ll Bring

  • Typically 4+ years of professional frontend engineering experience, including at least 3 years building production applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Strong experience with Next.js or a comparable React framework, including server-side rendering, routing, and the tradeoffs between server and client rendering.
  • Deep understanding of browser fundamentals: semantic HTML, modern CSS and responsive layout, the event loop, network and caching behavior, and the rendering pipeline.
  • Experience with modern data-fetching and state management patterns (TanStack Query, Zustand, Redux, or similar) and with complex, validated, multi-step forms.
  • Strong testing practices across unit, component, and end-to-end layers, using tools such as Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, and Playwright or Cypress.
  • Experience building checkout, payment, or other transactional flows where correctness and reliability matter.
  • Working knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and web performance (Core Web Vitals).
  • Experience with frontend observability and product analytics tools such as Datadog RUM, Sentry, PostHog, or Google Analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with modern CI/CD practices and cloud hosting (for example GitHub Actions and AWS).
  • A track record of leading complex features from design through production.
  • A startup mindset: comfortable taking on ambiguous work, knowing when to pull in a second opinion on an approach, and able to balance speed with quality.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, design, and business teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Stripe.js and payment method integrations, including buy now, pay later providers such as Affirm.
  • Experience with headless commerce platforms such as commercetools, or promotion engines such as Voucherify.
  • Experience with Tailwind CSS and building on top of a design system or component library.
  • Experience with consent management platforms (such as OneTrust), Google Tag Manager, and privacy-aware analytics.
  • Experience with multi-region products: multiple currencies and locales, and correct date, time, and timezone handling.
  • Growth engineering experience: working on a team that owns acquisition, activation, or conversion metrics, and shipping many small experiments quickly.
  • Experience with funnel analytics and marketing attribution: event tracking plans, UTM and referral attribution, and conversion tracking into ad platforms such as Google Ads and Meta.
  • Experience building growth surfaces such as landing pages, email capture, referral programs, promo codes, and abandoned-cart recovery.
  • Experience with authentication and identity providers such as Auth0.
  • Experience with scheduling, booking, or consumer healthcare applications, or working in highly regulated industries.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • We now offer the Prenuvo’s Commuter Benefits Plan to help cover your transit and parking costs. Whether you ride, drive, or park, we’ve got you covered—making your commute easier and more affordable!
  • Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role is $145,000 to $170,000 in local currency, depending on experience and geographic location

title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Team:

Video team builds the systems that power video creation, delivery, relevance, and integrity at scale.
As a Sr. Software Engineer on the Video team, you’ll work on high‑impact backend services that shape how millions of members discover, consume, and trust video content across the platform.

This role offers end‑to‑end ownership, meaningful technical scope, and close collaboration with product, infra, and ranking partners. You’ll help define backend architecture, improve platform foundations, and ship features that directly influence engagement and creator experiences.

If you enjoy working on large‑scale systems, ambiguous problem spaces, and products with visible user impact, this is a place to do deep technical work while shaping the future of video.

Responsibilities

  • You will scale distributed applications, make architectural trade-offs applying synchronous and asynchronous design patterns, write code, and deliver with speediness and quality.
  • You will develop multi-tier scalable, high-volume performing, and reliable user-centric applications that operate 24x7.
  • You will produce high quality software that is unit tested, code reviewed, and checked in regularly for continuous integration.
  • You will provide technical leadership, driving and performing best engineering practices to initiate, plan, and execute large-scale, cross functional, and company-wide critical programs. Identify, leverage, and successfully evangelize opportunities to improve engineering productivity.
  • You will lead the technical execution of complex features and mid-sized initiatives, breaking down ambiguous requirements into clear, actionable engineering milestones.
  • You will design component-level architectures and data models that are highly scalable, fault-tolerant, and easily maintainable by the broader team.
  • You are expected to raise the bar for code quality and engineering excellence through rigorous code reviews, comprehensive technical design documents, and proactive technical debt reduction.
  • You will utilize AI tools throughout the SDLC to boost design, coding, and review productivity, and contribute to shared skills and best practices for the overall team
  • You will work with product managers and dependent engineering teams to negotiate technical trade-offs, define service boundaries, and ensure on-time delivery.

title: Construction Estimator
description:
About Us
BUILD IT is a full-service general construction company with offices in Mississauga, ON and Calgary, AB.


We’ve helped hundreds of world-class brands and businesses build iconic destinations that reflect their vision and purpose — from storefronts that invite customers in, to workplaces that inspire teams to perform, to cultural spaces that truly stand apart.


Our team combines strategic thinking, construction expertise, and exceptional execution to bring bold concepts to life with precision and impact.


Learn more at .


The Role
This is a full-time, on-site Estimator role created to support our growth and rising project volume. You’ll own estimates from tender drawings to final bid: analyzing drawings and specs, building accurate pricing, managing subcontractor quotes, and presenting bids to management. You’ll work closely with our project management team, and your estimates will directly shape what we win and how profitably we build it.


What you’ll do

  • Prepare detailed, accurate estimates for material, labour, equipment, subcontracts, and general conditions.
  • Analyze tender drawings and specifications, and flag design issues, scheduling concerns, cost-saving opportunities, and constructability risks.
  • Identify qualified subcontractors, solicit competitive pricing, and review and level quotes for best value.
  • Develop and review subcontractor scopes of work.
  • Prepare quotes and proposals for new projects and service calls.
  • Attend pre-bid meetings, tender walks, and site visits.
  • Coordinate and present bids to management on time and organized.
  • Maintain the Master Tender List and keep growing our trade network.
  • Prepare bid status reports and make sure bids comply with specifications, contract terms, and bid invitations.


What we’re looking for

  • 5–8 years of estimating experience in construction, including bidding general contract work.
  • Experience estimating ground-up construction.
  • Strong knowledge of construction materials, methods, and techniques.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications.
  • Proficiency in estimating software (e.g., PlanSwift, Procore) and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Sharp attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple bids and deadlines at once.
  • Ownership mindset: you take responsibility for results and find solutions when others get stuck.
  • Legally authorized to work in Canada.


Compensation & benefits

  • Base annual salary range: $75,000–$100,000 per year.
  • Benefits summary provided during the hiring process.


This posting is for a current vacancy. Our organization uses automated tools, including artificial intelligence (AI) or algorithm-assisted systems, to support the initial review of applications. These tools are used only to assist our recruiters and hiring managers; all hiring decisions include meaningful human involvement and final review.


BUILD IT is an equal opportunity employer. We actively encourage applicants from all backgrounds, including those with disabilities. Accommodations will be provided upon request for candidates participating in all phases of the hiring process.

title: Senior UX / Product Strategist - Sightline
location: Charleston, SC, Nashville, TN, Covington, KY, Denver, CO  or Remote (United States)
description:
We are a global digital agency comprised of strategists, creatives, media experts, data scientists, and engineers driven by one common purpose — accelerate business growth through marketing and digital transformation. Named a top 3% Google Premier Partner and recognized by Inc. 5000 and Adweek’s 75 Fastest Growing Companies, we’re constantly looking for “A” players to join our team.

The rapid growth is attributed to our strongest asset — our people. Our teams are highly collaborative and work closely with each client to set clear goals and objectives so that we can deliver exceptional results. Mindgruve is a place where every opinion is valued. Not only will you be empowered to contribute ideas, but you will also play a key role in the execution and driving success for brands across a variety of industries. Sound fun? Perfect — you’ll fit right in.

Mindgruve is seeking a Senior UX / Product Strategist to help define and build the next generation of Sightline, our proprietary predictive marketing and business intelligence platform. Sightline connects customer, marketing, media, commerce, and business data to help organizations understand performance, anticipate what’s next, optimize investment, and make smarter decisions.

In this role, you’ll own the user experience and product strategy of Sightline, translating complex data, predictive models, analytics, and business intelligence into intuitive, actionable, and visually compelling experiences. This is a hands-on product strategy/ design role for someone who can think strategically while also diving into the details—from complex enterprise workflows and data visualizations to interactive prototypes and production-ready interfaces. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, marketers, and business leaders to shape not only how Sightline looks, but how it works and how users turn intelligence into better decisions.

What You’ll Do Here

  • Own the Sightline UX and product strategy and design experience across the platform, from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity interfaces and production-ready designs.
  • Translate predictive models, advanced analytics, marketing performance, customer intelligence, commerce data, and business signals into actionable user experiences.
  • Create dashboards, data visualizations, workflows, planning tools, forecasts, alerts, and recommendations designed to enable faster, more informed decision-making.
  • Simplify complex, sophisticated datasets into intuitive exploration paths while preserving deep flexibility for advanced users.
  • Map and develop user journeys around specific goals, tasks, and decision-making processes for diverse user roles.
  • Rapidly prototype ideas into wireframes, interactive user flows, and high-fidelity concepts for testing and refinement prior to development.
  • Partner with client stakeholders and internal teams to facilitate design workshops and present design rationale to executive audiences.
  • Work closely with product management and engineering to ensure design intent translates into a high-quality production experience.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to determine the most intuitive ways to surface predictive insights and complex analytical outputs.
  • Build and evolve the design system by establishing scalable design patterns, UI components, interaction standards, and visual guidelines.
  • Conduct user research and testing with clients, marketers, analysts, and leaders to validate concepts, fix friction points, and improve the platform.
  • Help shape the product roadmap by bringing a user-centered perspective to strategy and identifying key opportunities for value creation.

We Need a Person With

  • 7+ years of experience in UX, product, or interaction design, with a strong portfolio of end-to-end digital products.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise SaaS and data-intensive platforms, especially in BI, analytics, MarTech, AdTech, FinTech, or commerce.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping, design systems, and modern product design workflows.
  • Strong ability to simplify complex workflows, datasets, and technical concepts into intuitive experiences.
  • Expertise in dashboards, data visualization, reporting, forecasting, and analytical interfaces, particularly marketing/media analytics such as attribution, funnels, channel performance, and ROI.
  • Experience influencing product strategy and prioritization, balancing tradeoffs with product and engineering teams.
  • Deep knowledge of information architecture, interaction design, user flows, usability, and responsive web design.
  • Experience with user research and usability testing, turning insights into measurable product improvements.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration with PMs, engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including explaining the rationale behind design decisions.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing, media, commerce, marketing measurement, or business intelligence.
  • Experience with AI-powered products, recommendations, predictive experiences, or conversational interfaces is a plus.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office suite.
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Detail-oriented with strong attention to follow-through and deadline management.
  • Excellent communication skills, including verbal and written
  • Professional demeanor with the ability to interface with poise and confidence with leadership and clients

Compensation will be commensurate with experience. Additionally, for eligible full-time employees, we offer a competitive benefits package including medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance; a flexible spending account; voluntary life and accident plans; and a 401(k) retirement plan with matching. We have six office locations in the US: San Diego, California, Los Angeles, California, Covington, Kentucky, Denver, Colorado, Nashville, Tennessee and Charleston, South Carolina. We're seeking local candidates (or those open to relocation) who are able to work collaboratively with us in one of our office's; however, based on business needs and unique job functions, some roles may be eligible for remote work. (Bonus points if you’re bilingual in Spanish and/or Portuguese.)

Mindgruve is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Director of Student Engagement at Boston University Hillel
description:
Director of Student Engagement

Boston University Hillel

Role Overview

Make your mark on Jewish student life by joining Boston University Hillel as its Director of Student Engagement. This is a big, exciting job for BU Hillel, working at the largest private university for Jewish students in the world. This position will work on major aspects of undergraduate student engagement, serving 4,000 Jewish undergraduate students. We welcome candidates who are thirsty for being in relationship with Jewish people – from students to alumni, parents, donors, and other partners. If you’re team-oriented, never give up, and truly believe that you must “be the change you wish to see in the world,” then this is the position for you! This position reports to the Executive Director and works closely with the CEO, Campus Rabbi, and COO.

What You’ll Do

Undergraduate Student Life Work

The role brings a professional with talent, passion, and skills to Boston University to imagine and implement Jewish undergraduate student life. As the Director, you will serve as both the architect of a comprehensive, strategic, and robust undergraduate engagement plan and the primary practitioner implementing this plan with 4,000 Jewish undergraduate students. You’ll have the opportunity to impact thousands of students—Boston University is home to over 17,000 undergraduate students across 10 undergraduate schools and colleges thirsty for resources, engagement, and care from BU Hillel.

This position has significant responsibility overseeing key student engagement areas for BU Hillel, including: student engagement outreach strategies, mentoring projects, advising student leaders, leading cohorts around Boston and trips to Israel, and more. You also contribute to religious activities such as Shabbat services/dinner, holiday programs, Israel events, and more. You will teach in our award-winning Jewish learning seminars with Jewish text at the center of each class. You will partner with BU Hillel’s senior rabbinic leadership on strategy and content for each of these programs, and receive guidance.

You’ll receive training from BU Hillel and Hillel International professionals, and learn from Jewish leaders on how to seamlessly weave Judaism into your work as a Hillel engagement professional. Each day you will be charged with empowering students to engage in meaningful and joyous Jewish lives, weaving in Jewish values, texts, and history.

Student Engagement and Outreach

  • Manage Hillel’s marketing and outreach to all undergraduate colleges and residence halls—working with individual college partners and student groups.
  • Director strategies for outreach and relationships with undergraduate students, conducting daily 1x1 initial and follow-up meetings.
  • Strengthen and support student leadership cohorts ranging from engagement interns, to marketing interns, and career focused fellowships.
  • Mentor various students in their desire to bring passion projects to campus.
  • Grow Hillel’s capacity to meet engagement goals through detailed management and analysis of the CRM Database.
  • Drive key insights on undergraduate student engagement and population for further growth of the program.
  • Works with Hillel’s staff and student leaders to identify micro-communities and opportunities for students to engage within those micro-communities. These include but are not limited to: class years, majors, Jewish Greek life, Jewish residence hall life, arts and culture, volunteerism, and social justice.

Jewish Life and Learning

  • Develop, lead, and recruit 1-2 Jewish learning fellowship classes and 1-2 experience groups in Boston per semester
  • Weave Jewish education into social and cultural programs across campus.
  • Co-lead immersive travel trips to Israel or community service trips to international destinations weaving Jewish content, text, and learning into each day of travel.
  • Co-lead experience groups around Boston that have 3-5 parts to each group focused on fun, friendship, Jewish identity, and exploration. These cohorts attend fun events like Celtics games, fitness studios, best restaurants of Boston, musical concerts, theater shows, and more.

On a day to day basis you will

  • Meeting with a group of students or individual students over coffee or a meal to understand which issues are most important to them and developing a plan of action together.
  • Designing and executing a strategic engagement plan for undergraduate students, including planning educational, social, cultural, holiday, or Shabbat programs across a wide variety of undergraduate schools, students, and disciplines.
  • Participating in a conversation with student leaders of all types of faith, ethnic, and racial backgrounds to build key relationships and partnerships.
  • Developing key insights through 1x1 conversations on how to create an engagement program with high levels of reach and depth.
  • Working Shabbat, holidays, and otherwise supporting the rest of your Hillel team—sometimes on nights and weekends.
  • Participating in a professional development webinar.
  • Teaching and facilitating Jewish learning through an undergraduate student lens.

What You’ve Accomplished

  • 3–5 years of experience
  • Bachelor's degree required; master's or advanced degree preferred (could be rabbinic, Jewish education, business, social work, or other relevant fields to this work).
  • Significant computer skills, including Microsoft Office, Google Docs, CRM, and social media
  • Must be willing to work nights and occasional weekends
  • Requires discretion and independent judgement in performing all aspects of the position.
  • An entrepreneurial spirit, willingness to take risks and the ability to learn from efforts that don’t work out as planned

What You’ll Bring to the Job

We are most interested in someone who is organized, driven, and mission-focused. The most important experience we are looking for is the ability to be a Jewish leader, organize people and projects, and inspire commitment and action. In terms of prerequisite requirements, we are open to candidates with the following:

  • We are interested in people with backgrounds in PR, Communications, Marketing, Communal Engagement, For Profit Business, Customer Service and/or
  • Significant Jewish communal life experience in any of the following: Hillel, Jewish nonprofit, Jewish camping, Jewish education, or Rabbinic leadership. and/or
  • Significant experience with relationship-based work in areas such as: student engagement, community partnerships, nonprofit management, corporate social responsibility, or arts management. and/or
  • Significant experience in for-profit environments that is relatable to this work, alongside a very strong Jewish lay leadership background.

What You’ll Receive

  • High-level professional development to help develop core skills and gain expertise from changemakers, engagers, and Jewish life experts.
  • Mentoring and career coaching to help you during and after your position.
  • A network of terrific colleagues from across the Hillel movement.
  • Travel opportunities, both domestically and internationally, multiple times per year.
  • A comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, Tax Deferred Retirement Plan, Life, AD&D, and Long-Term Disability insurances, Flexible Spending Plan, generous vacation/sick time, and parental leave.
  • A salary of $55,000–$65,000 depending on level of experience.

About Boston University Hillel

Boston University Hillel is at the hub of a world-class university, in the thriving city of Boston, right near Fenway Park. Home to 4,000 Jewish undergraduates and 2,000 Jewish graduate students, BU Hillel’s mission is to inspire, educate, and empower BU students to lead meaningful and joyous Jewish lives. We engage 4,000 students per year, 600 of whom qualify as in-depth relationships. 200 students travel with BU Hillel each year. We have 160+ student leaders and 120+ lay leaders.

Boston University Hillel is affiliated with Hillel International. Hillel International enriches the lives of Jewish students so they may enrich the Jewish people and the world, and envisions a world where every student is inspired to make an enduring commitment to Jewish life, learning and Israel.

About Hillel International

In 1923, Rabbi Benjamin Frankel started Hillel with humble means, a noble mission and a breathtaking vision: to convey Jewish civilization to a new generation. Today, Hillel International continues to enrich the lives of Jewish students and is the largest Jewish campus organization in the world at nearly 1,000 colleges and universities across North America and around the world. As Hillel evolves as an organization, the mission remains steadfast: to create lasting connections with every Jewish student that foster an enduring commitment to Jewish life, learning, and Israel and train them to become the next Jewish leaders.

Hillel is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an accepting and inclusive environment for all.
