title: Project Manager
description:
PADNOS is a full-service recycling company handling paper, plastic, metals and electronic recycling. We tailor recycling programs for consumer and industrial clients throughout the United States. PADNOS was founded over a century ago and continues to transform the recycling industry. The company has thrived as a family business through four generations and has grown to be a market leader and best in class innovator.
Position Summary
The Sales Engineer is the technical bridge between PADNOS's engineering, machining, and fabrication capabilities and the industrial and manufacturing customers who need them. This role combines hands-on mechanical and process knowledge with consultative selling to grow external sales of precision machining, fabrication, repair, and engineered equipment solutions out of the PLI machine shop. The Sales Engineer manages and grows an existing external customer base of approximately $2M annually, supports internal ordering and processing of $500K+ in vendor parts, and helps evaluate and integrate external sales growth through M&A opportunities.
Because many of these customers also generate scrap, the Sales Engineer partners with PADNOS Metals Recycling sales to identify where equipment, material handling, and service solutions strengthen the overall customer relationship. The role works closely with Engineering, Production, Purchasing, and Operations so that commitments made in the field are delivered on time, on budget, and to specification.
Key Responsibilities
1. Sales and Business Development

Identify and win new business in industries that require machining, fabrication, and heavy equipment repair (e.g., industrial equipment, recycling and scrap processing, automotive, energy, and general manufacturing).
Develop and grow a portfolio of accounts through prospecting, referrals, and proactive account management, with a focus on West Michigan.
Prepare and present proposals, quotations, and contracts tailored to customer requirements.
Negotiate pricing and terms that achieve sales targets while protecting margin.
Partner with Metals Recycling sales on shared accounts, bringing equipment and service opportunities forward from scrap-generating customers.

2. Technical Consultation and Solution Design

Interpret customer specifications, drawings, and blueprints to define scope and deliver accurate, manufacturable solutions.
Conduct on-site assessments of customer facilities and equipment to identify repair, rebuild, fabrication, and material handling needs (e.g., balers, compactors, shears, conveyors, containers).
Provide technical guidance on materials, machining processes (CNC milling, turning, boring, grinding), and fabrication methods (cutting, welding, forming, assembly).
Work with Engineering and Production to confirm feasibility, cost, and lead time before commitments are made.
Address technical questions, troubleshoot customer problems, and recommend improvements that reduce customer downtime and cost.

3. Quoting, Estimating, and Contracts

Build cost estimates with shop leadership covering labor, materials, outside services, and freight.
Deliver timely, accurate quotes and maintain a disciplined quote follow-up process.
Prepare service agreements and contracts in line with PADNOS pricing guidelines and margin targets.

4. Project Handoff and Execution Coordination

Own the transition of sold work from sales to production, ensuring customer requirements, drawings, and due dates are clearly communicated.
Coordinate with Production, Purchasing, and Logistics to support on-time delivery and quality of finished parts and equipment.
Monitor job progress against customer expectations and resolve issues before they affect the customer.
Support internal ordering and processing of vendor parts for PADNOS operations.

5. Market Research and Strategy

Stay current on machining and fabrication technologies, customer industry trends, and the competitive landscape to identify growth opportunities.
Use customer feedback and win/loss data to refine sales strategy and service offerings.
Support evaluation of acquisition and partnership opportunities that expand external sales capability.
Represent PADNOS at trade shows, customer events, and industry networking functions.

6. Documentation and Reporting

Maintain accurate records of accounts, opportunities, quotes, and customer interactions in the CRM system.
Provide regular reports on sales performance, pipeline, forecasts, and market insights to leadership.

7. Safety and Compliance

Ensure customer-site visits, recommendations, and delivered work comply with PADNOS and customer safety standards and applicable regulations.

Accountabilities

Revenue Growth: Grow external sales of machining, fabrication, repair, and engineered solutions against annual targets while protecting gross margin.
Customer Relationships: Build and retain long-term customer relationships through responsive service, technical credibility, and follow-through on commitments.
Technical Solutions: Translate customer needs into accurate, manufacturable, and cost-effective solutions in partnership with Engineering and Production.
Quoting and Pricing: Deliver timely, accurate quotes and contracts that reflect true cost and meet margin targets.
Sales-to-Production Handoff: Ensure every sold job reaches production with complete requirements, and that delivery and quality meet customer expectations.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work with Engineering, Production, Purchasing, Logistics, and Metals Recycling sales so that commitments made in the field are delivered.
Pipeline and Reporting: Maintain accurate CRM, pipeline, and forecast, and report sales performance to leadership.
Safety: Follow and promote PADNOS and customer safety requirements on every site visit and job.
Continuous Improvement: Use win/loss reviews and customer feedback to improve sales processes and service offerings.

Outcomes

Completion of Rock Goals.
Growth of the existing ~$2M external customer base against annual targets set with the Director of Engineering and Maintenance.
A qualified, documented sales pipeline with new accounts added each quarter.
Standardized quoting and estimating process with consistent turnaround times.
Clean sales-to-production handoffs with no missed requirements on sold work.
Reliable support of internal vendor-part ordering for PADNOS operations.
Identification and assessment of external sales growth and M&A opportunities.

Qualifications
Required

Bachelor's degree in mechanical, manufacturing, or industrial engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
3 to 7 years of experience in technical or industrial B2B sales, applications engineering, or engineering/project management in a manufacturing environment.
Strong mechanical aptitude and working knowledge of machining and fabrication processes.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and specifications.
Proven negotiation and consultative-selling skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
Valid driver's license and ability to travel regularly within the territory.

Preferred

Experience selling machine shop, fabrication, or heavy equipment repair services.
SolidWorks and AutoCAD experience.
Experience in metals recycling, scrap processing, or heavy industrial equipment.
Cost estimating experience and familiarity with ERP or job-shop software.
Existing network of industrial and manufacturing contacts in West Michigan.

Competencies

Building relationships
Technical capacity
Communication
Analysis and problem solving
Strategic and critical thinking
Negotiation and influence
Judgment and decision making
Teamwork and collaboration
Planning and organization
Time management
Personal motivation
Flexibility and adaptability
Stress management and composure

Accountabilities and KPI’s

External sales revenue versus target
Gross margin on sold work
Quote turnaround time and quote win rate
New accounts and qualified pipeline value
On-time delivery of sold work
Customer retention and satisfaction
CRM accuracy and forecast reliability
Adheres to all PADNOS Policies and Procedures.
Always conducts self in a manner consistent with PADNOS Values.
Consistently reports to work on time and prepared to perform the duties of the position.
Maintains the privacy of all company proprietary information.
Can safely perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodations.

Work Environment and Physical Demands
Work is split between office time at the Turner PLI Building (quoting, CRM, coordination) and time on the shop floor, at customer plants, and at PADNOS yard locations, primarily in West Michigan. These environments involve noise, dust, heavy equipment, overhead cranes, and moving vehicles. Required PPE (safety glasses, steel-toed boots, hi-vis clothing, and hearing protection where required) must be worn per PADNOS and customer safety policies. The role requires the ability to walk plant floors and scrap yards for extended periods, climb stairs or ladders to inspect equipment, and occasionally lift up to 25 lbs. A valid driver's license and reliable transportation are required.

PADNOS has a rich history of taking care of our Team Members, their families and the multiple communities we serve. We invest in our Team Members and offer the following benefits:

Competitive Wage
Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
100% Tuition reimbursement for Team Members
75% Tuition Reimbursement for dependents
First Time Home Buying Assistance
401K Match and Profit Sharing
Performance Driven Bonuses

Be a part of the green movement and join PADNOS today!
PADNOS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, weight, height, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, genetic medical information, protected veteran status, or disability status.

title: Sales Engineer - DACH
description:
About GreyNoise

GreyNoise Intelligence is a mission driven security startup focused on helping organizations understand and mitigate risks from Internet scanning and exploitation. GreyNoise provides real-time, verifiable intelligence on all actors scanning the Internet and how some of them are attempting to exploit vulnerabilities on assets connected to corporate networks. The intelligence is highly trusted because it’s generated from a global fleet of thousands of purpose built sensors observing the Internet. Advanced data science techniques and AI are used to process millions of observed events into real-time intelligence for customers.

The GreyNoise Global Observation Grid observes and analyzes unique threat data at-scale that no one else can. GreyNoise provides the most actionable threat intelligence against perimeter threats, so that no attack works twice.

All US based positions are fully remote within the US, with optional office attendance at our DC area headquarters, unless otherwise specified. Applicants must have US work authorization.

Please see the specific job description for all international position locations.

The Role

As a Sales Engineer at GreyNoise, you will support the technical components of the sales process for our DACH enterprise and government accounts. You will partner closely with Account Executives to understand customer needs, demonstrate product value, lead Proof of Values, and address any technical requirements or concerns. This role is instrumental in driving technical validation and accelerating deal cycles.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as the technical lead during the sales process.
  • Lead technical discovery and deliver customized product demos and workshops
  • Design, execute, and support successful PoVs and pilots.
  • Demonstrate workflows for security operations, threat intelligence, threat hunting and vulnerability prioritization
  • Validate integrations and automation using APIs, scripting and supported security platforms
  • Work with customers to understand their environment, challenges, and desired outcomes.
  • Respond to RFIs/RFPs and assist in crafting technical proposals.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Experience to ensure feedback is captured and incorporated.
  • Represent GreyNoise at industry events, webinars, and customer briefings.

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Engineering or Solutions Architecture roles in the cybersecurity or enterprise SaaS space.
  • An understanding of network security and internet-facing threats
  • Deep familiarity with threat intelligence, SIEM/SOAR/TIP, and incident response workflows.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise security architectures and technical decision-making.\
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience with API integrations, scripting (eg. Python) and tools like curl, JSON, etc.
  • Ability to present technical content to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Professional fluency in English and availability for customer and partner travel across EMEA

Benefits

💵 Equity in a Growing Startup. Every employee has the opportunity to share in GreyNoise's success through equity.

👩‍⚕️ Health & Wellness Benefits. US employees receive 100% company-covered health, dental, vision, and life insurance. Benefits for international employees vary by country and local requirements.

6️⃣ Retirement Benefits. US employees receive a competitive 6% employer 401(k) match, 100% fully vested from day one. International employees receive applicable statutory pension benefits in accordance with local regulations.

🏖 Flexible Paid Time Off. We believe taking time away from work is essential to staying healthy and doing your best work. We take this very seriously and even include scheduled all-company shutdowns throughout the year. Employees also receive any additional leave required by local laws.

🌎 Remote-First, Globally Connected. Headquartered in the Washington, DC area, GreyNoise is a distributed team working remotely across the US and Europe. We value flexibility, trust, and meaningful connections, no matter where you work.

💻 Equipment Budget. Every new employee receives a GreyNoise Apple Mac laptop and a $500 stipend (or local currency equivalent) for equipment and accessories to create a comfortable and productive workspace.

👼 Paid Parental Leave. Growing your family is a big milestone, and we're here to support you. We offer four months of paid parental leave for birth or adoption, plus up to two additional months of optional unpaid leave, coordinated with applicable statutory leave entitlements and local requirements.

📚 Learning & Development Budget. Every employee receives $1,500 annually (or local currency equivalent) to invest in professional development. Use it for courses, books, conferences, certifications, and other learning opportunities related to your role.

🌴 Team Connection & Company Offsites. We bring our distributed team together through multiple company and team offsites, virtual events, and local meetups to build relationships and stay connected beyond our day-to-day work.

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on country of employment, local regulations, and applicable employment arrangements.

GreyNoise Culture

The hallmark of any great company is a palpable and viscous culture. The most important pillars of our culture are:
  • Be transparent, honest, and objective. This is what it means to be “clinical”
  • Empathize with customers, partners, and each other
  • Learn from mistakes and share the knowledge
  • The way feedback is delivered to one another matters as much as the feedback itself
  • Good work-life balance is the key to sustained productivity
  • The measure of a team member’s effectiveness is how well the rest of the team operates in their unexpected absence
  • No such thing as a million dollar idea, only million dollar execution
  • Out-innovate our previous selves
Check out our (work-in-progress) longform culture document.

Explainability

Any security product that is a “black box” that asks you to blindly trust it should raise red flags - we believe the same is true of your place of work. We obviously think GreyNoise is doing something unique, but don’t take our word for it - ask any of our 150+ enterprise customers, investors, thousands of happy users, or dozens of journalists who have cited GreyNoise over the past few years.

Why You Should Work at GreyNoise

  • You enjoy identifying and solving hard problems
  • You are comfortable taking an idea from concept to customer
  • You are open to both explaining your stance and questioning others in a clinical, open-minded, and respectful manner
  • You want to directly impact users
  • You want to grow beyond your current skill set

Apply for the job

Do you want to join our team? Then we'd love to hear about you!

title: IT Operations Engineer

Equal Opportunity

title: Begeleider Gehandicaptenzorg
description:
Vacature gehandicaptenzorg: Begeleider Gehandicaptenzorg (28–32 uur per week) – FWG 35 (€ 2.649 tot € 3.708) – IJmuiden

Werken op een plek waar je gewoon jezelf kunt zijn

Zoek jij een team waar je niet eerst drie vergaderingen nodig hebt voordat er iets gebeurt? Waar collega's zeggen waar het op staat, voor elkaar klaarstaan en vooral veel plezier hebben?

Dan kan De Regenboog in IJmuiden jouw plek zijn.

Werken bij De Regenboog

De Regenboog ligt in IJmuiden, vlak bij het strand en met de supermarkt praktisch om de hoek. Samen boodschappen doen, wandelen of bij goed weer richting het strand: vanuit de locatie is er genoeg te ondernemen.

Er wonen bewoners met een verstandelijke beperking, onder andere met het syndroom van Down, autisme en bijkomende psychische problematiek. Iedereen heeft een eigen karakter, gewoontes en manier van communiceren. De één heeft vooral behoefte aan duidelijkheid en structuur, terwijl een ander juist graag samen iets onderneemt of even zijn verhaal kwijt wil.

Je stapt hier bijna een familie binnen

Als Begeleider Gehandicaptenzorg werk je in een hecht team van zes collega's. Sommigen werken hier al 20 tot 25 jaar. Ze kennen de bewoners, de locatie én elkaar goed.

Er wordt hard gewerkt, maar ook veel gelachen. Collega's zijn open en eerlijk tegen elkaar. Als er iets speelt, wordt het uitgesproken. We zoeken daarom iemand die nuchter en down-to-earth is, initiatief neemt en ziet wat er moet gebeuren. Je hoeft hier niet op je tenen te lopen: wees jezelf, doe wat je belooft en draag bij aan de gezelligheid.

Jouw uitdaging

Als Begeleider Gehandicaptenzorg ondersteun je bewoners in hun dagelijks leven. Je zorgt voor structuur en duidelijkheid wanneer dat nodig is, maar geeft ook ruimte voor eigen keuzes en zelfstandigheid. Je kookt samen, doet boodschappen, onderneemt activiteiten en trekt er regelmatig op uit. Soms richting het strand, soms gewoon de buurt in.

Je werkt vooral in de avond en tijdens slaapdiensten. De avonddienst loopt van 15.30 tot 22.00 uur. Een slaapdienst loopt van 15.30 tot 09.00 uur de volgende ochtend. Tijdens de nacht slaap je op de locatie; het is dus geen wakende nachtdienst.

Je leert bewoners goed kennen en merkt daardoor sneller wanneer iets anders is dan normaal. Je past je begeleiding aan op wat iemand nodig heeft en stemt veranderingen af met je collega's. Juist daarin komen liefde, lef en meesterschap samen. Liefde zit in aandacht en weten wat iemand belangrijk vindt. Lef in duidelijk zijn en handelen wanneer dat nodig is. Meesterschap in begrijpen welke begeleiding past.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Bij Philadelphia krijg je de ruimte om het beste uit jezelf en uit je werk te halen. Daarom bieden wij naast alles uit de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg ook extra's.

  • Een contract voor onbepaalde tijd van 28 tot 32 uur per week, met een salaris van € 2.649 tot € 3.708 bruto per maand bij 36 uur (FWG 35).
  • Toeslagen voor onregelmatige diensten, 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering. Je kunt deze laatste twee ook maandelijks laten uitbetalen.
  • Trainingen en opleidingen die aansluiten bij jouw werk en ontwikkeling.
  • Een klein en ervaren team waarin collega's voor elkaar klaarstaan.

Wie ben jij?

title: Associate Insurance Specialist
description:
Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact.
The Associate Insurance Strategist supports Senior Insurance Strategists in the development, placement, and management of insurance solutions for advisors and clients. This role is responsible for assisting with case design, carrier analysis, product positioning, underwriting coordination, and relationship management while building the knowledge and skills necessary to progress into a Senior Insurance Strategist role.
The Associate Insurance Strategist serves as a trusted internal resource for advisors and teammates by providing timely support, market intelligence, and administrative coordination throughout the sales and implementation process. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, a commitment to learning, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do:
Insurance Case Support

Partner with Senior Insurance Strategists to support new business opportunities and advisor cases.
Assist with case design, illustrations, product comparisons, and sales concepts.
Prepare and organize proposals, presentations, and client-facing materials.
Coordinate requirements and follow-up activities to help move cases through the sales process.

Carrier & Product Management

Develop working knowledge of insurance carriers, products, underwriting processes, and competitive positioning.
Maintain relationships with carrier representatives and internal stakeholders.
Research product updates, underwriting guidelines, and market changes.
Assist in evaluating product fit and competitive solutions for advisors and clients.

Advisor & Internal Team Support

Respond to advisor inquiries regarding product features, carrier requirements, and case status.
Provide timely and accurate follow-up on pending business.
Collaborate with operations, underwriting, licensing, and new business teams to ensure efficient case management.
Support advisor education initiatives and product training opportunities.

Business Development Support

Assist in identifying sales opportunities within existing advisor relationships.
Support strategic initiatives designed to increase insurance production and advisor engagement.
Participate in advisor meetings, carrier meetings, and sales planning discussions as appropriate.

Professional Development

Continuously develop insurance product expertise and industry knowledge.
Participate in training and mentoring provided by Senior Insurance Strategists.
Progressively assume greater responsibility for advisor relationships and case ownership.
Demonstrate readiness to transition into a Senior Insurance Strategist role through increased technical knowledge, sales acumen, and independent case management.

What You Bring:

Required:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
1-3 years of experience in insurance, financial services, sales support, underwriting, new business, or a related field.
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred:

Life and Health Insurance License or ability to obtain licensure.
Experience with life insurance, annuities, long-term care, disability income, or related products.
Familiarity with insurance illustrations, underwriting, and carrier operations.
Experience supporting advisors, agents, or producers.

Career Progression

The Associate Insurance Strategist role is designed as a developmental position that prepares team members for advancement into a Senior Insurance Strategist role. Through mentoring, hands-on case experience, carrier interaction, and advisor support responsibilities, incumbents will build the technical expertise, sales skills, and strategic thinking necessary to independently manage advisor relationships and complex insurance opportunities.
Measures of Success

Consistently delivers accurate and timely support for advisor cases.
Demonstrates growing knowledge of insurance products and carrier solutions.
Builds strong relationships with advisors, carriers, and internal partners.
Increases ownership of case management and advisor interactions.
Successfully develops toward independent management of insurance opportunities and advisor relationships.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
Optum Insight is improving the flow of health data and information to create a more connected system. We remove friction and drive alignment between care providers and payers, and ultimately consumers. Our deep expertise in the industry and innovative technology empower us to help organizations reduce costs while improving risk management, quality and revenue growth. Ready to help us deliver results that improve lives? Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities.

As an AI/ML Engineer at Optum AI, you'll be designing and developing AI systems to improve patient care.

About the AI Platform Team
We often deliver the entire solution, from healthcare data ingest, generative agents and AI models deployment, data extraction, agent/model results and analytics, to the applications used for reviewing clinical data and AI results. Our current projects involve both leveraging and building cutting edge Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies from scratch.
We have the data and resources to make an impact on a scale. When our solutions are deployed, they benefit millions of people.
We are a globally distributed and diverse team with the shared passion to improve patient outcomes, improve healthcare operations, and streamline payments.
We pay attention to the details to make sure we deliver quality, the first time.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office for a minimum of four days per week.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the design and hands-on implementation of the AI/ML platform that enables Optum to derive information from patient data in a scalable, reliable, and cost-effective manner
  • Partner with product managers, data scientists, prompt designers, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable AI systems
  • Leverage AI assisted tools for design, implementation, code reviews, and testing
  • Ensure the delivery of high-quality, maintainable, and efficient code and specifications.
  • Help drive architectural decisions and contribute to our long-term technical strategy for AI/ML systems
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define scope, success criteria, and delivery milestones, then execute with solid engineering rigor through CI/CD, environment readiness, and quality gates to deliver on schedule without compromising reliability or maintainability
  • Stay ahead of the curve on emerging AI/ML technologies, tools, and research, and evaluate their applicability to business problems. Embrace and promote a culture of innovation through rapid iteration, experimentation and data driven decision-making
  • Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with emphasis on responsible use of AI

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of AI/ML experience
  • 3+ years of experience in Python programming
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in modern cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure or Google. GCP is a plus)
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience of CI/CD principles
  • 1+ years of experience leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or 2+ years of equivalent experience
  • Proven track record of engaging with customers to design and deliver at least one complete AI product, from ideation to product release
  • Proven solid knowledge and hands-on experience of CI/CD principles
  • Proficient with GitHub and GitHub Actions, artifact and dependency management, containerization using Docker, and infrastructure‑as‑code using Terraform to enable reliable, repeatable, and secure deployments
  • Experience with the challenges of delivering and monitoring LLM based cloud systems into production
  • Experience in Healthcare
  • Proven solid communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
  • Demonstrated bias for action
  • Demonstrated passion for innovation and staying current with emerging AI/ML trends

*All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $98,500 to $176,000 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location, and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups, and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

UnitedHealth Group is a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.

title: Coördinerend begeleider Dagbesteding | Amsterdam
description:
Amsterdam Noord | 24-36 uur | FWG 45

Op de Hardwareweg in Amsterdam Noord openen we een nieuwe, ontwikkelingsgerichte dagbestedingslocatie voor jongeren van 15 tot 23 jaar met een verstandelijke beperking (LVB/MVG). De locatie bevindt zich boven een werk- en opleidingsomgeving waar jongeren praktijkervaring kunnen opdoen, bijvoorbeeld binnen een pakketdienst, fietsendienst of keuken. En we hebben de intentie om in verbinding met het VSO samen te werken.

De setting is arbeidsmatig en gericht op ontwikkeling en doorstroom. We werken met meerdere groepen van ongeveer 8 cliënten.

Het team is nieuw en in opbouw. Dat vraagt om mensen die willen meedenken, structuur neerzetten en samen bouwen aan een sterke basis.

Jouw rol

Als coördinerend begeleider ben jij de spil rondom de jongeren én binnen het team.

Je:

  • Bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor ouders, scholen en samenwerkingspartners;
  • Stelt ontwikkeldoelen op en bewaakt de voortgang;
  • Zorgt voor samenhang en kwaliteit in de begeleiding;
  • Werkt zelf actief mee in de dagelijkse begeleiding van jongeren;
  • Stuurt en coacht collega’s in de uitvoering van de begeleiding;
  • Denkt mee over werkafspraken, structuur en de verdere opbouw van de locatie;
  • Draagt bij aan het neerzetten van een ontwikkelingsgerichte en veilige omgeving.

Wat breng je mee?

  • HBO Social Work, SPH, Pedagogiek of Orthopedagogiek;
  • SKJ-registratie of bereidheid deze te behalen;
  • Ervaring met jongeren met een verstandelijke beperking (LVB/MVG);
  • Ervaring met gedragsproblematiek en prikkelregulatie;
  • Ervaring met coördineren en samenwerken in een netwerk van betrokkenen;
  • Ervaring met ECD en rapportage;
  • BHV of bereidheid dit te behalen.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent iemand die overzicht houdt, verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen en anderen meeneemt. Je weet rust en structuur te brengen én tegelijkertijd ruimte te geven aan ontwikkeling — zowel bij jongeren als binnen het team.

Wat bieden we?

  • Een nieuwe, unieke locatie waar je vanaf de start mee bouwt;
  • Een brutosalaris conform de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg (FWG 45) van minimaal €3113,- en maximaal €4347,- bij een fulltime dienstverband (36 uur);
  • Werken in dagdiensten (maandag t/m vrijdag);
  • Ruimte voor ontwikkeling en eigen inbreng;
  • Samenwerken in een nieuw en groeiend team;
  • Veel ruimte voor creativiteit, structuur opbouwen en pionieren.

Bij Philadelphia ondersteunen we als het nodig is en laten we los als het kan. Met liefde, lef en meesterschap werken we aan een zo volwaardig mogelijk leven voor onze cliënten. Spreekt deze manier van werken je aan? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Meer weten of solliciteren?

Heb je nog vragen? Neem dan contact op met Shirley Zwier- Wijker (Managementassistent) op 06 - 27 41 59 79 of per mail via: shirley.zwier-wijker@philadelphia.nl.

title: Coördinerend (persoonlijk) begeleider Ouderen | Leusden
description:
Vacature gehandicaptenzorg: Coördinerend (persoonlijk) begeleider Ouderen (24-28 uur) – FWG 40 (€ 2.951,- tot € 3.980,-) – Leusden

Jouw werkplek

Wil jij als Coördinerend (persoonlijk) begeleider werken met ouder wordende mensen met een verstandelijke beperking? Bij Groot Schutterhoef in Leusden combineer je persoonlijke begeleiding met coördinatie van de zorg en ondersteuning.

Groot Schutterhoef is een groene, landelijke woonlocatie met 40 bewoners, verdeeld over vier woongroepen. De bewoners hebben verschillende zorgvragen, waarbij ouder worden, lichamelijke beperkingen en behoud van vaardigheden een steeds grotere rol kunnen spelen.

Jouw team

Als Persoonlijk Begeleider (Coördinerend Begeleider) werk je in een vast team op een van de woongroepen. Je bent zowel coördinerend als meewerkend op de groep en staat dus midden in de dagelijkse begeleiding. Je werkt nauw samen met begeleiders, collega's van de dagbesteding en verschillende disciplines. Samen stem je af wat bewoners nodig hebben en zorg je voor herkenbaarheid en continuïteit in de begeleiding. De eigen dagbesteding op het erf, met onder andere muziek, snoezelen en buitenactiviteiten, is een vast onderdeel van het dagelijks leven.

Jouw uitdaging

Als Persoonlijk Begeleider combineer je dagelijkse begeleiding met een coördinerende rol. Je werkt actief mee op de groep en ondersteunt bewoners bij ADL, verzorging en dagelijkse activiteiten. Je kijkt steeds wat iemand zelf kan en waar ondersteuning nodig is. Bij ouder wordende bewoners kunnen zorgvragen veranderen. Jij signaleert die veranderingen en weet wanneer het nodig is om begeleiding of afspraken bij te stellen.

Voor een aantal bewoners ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen en actueel houden van ondersteuningsplannen en het bewaken van de voortgang. Je stemt af met verwanten, collega's en betrokken disciplines en vertaalt afspraken naar de dagelijkse begeleiding. Tegelijkertijd blijf je zelf onderdeel van het dagelijkse werk op de groep: je begeleidt bewoners, werkt samen met collega's en laat in de praktijk zien hoe je aansluit bij hun behoeften. Ook help je collega's om eenduidig te werken. Juist daarin komen liefde, lef en meesterschap samen: je kent de bewoner, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en gebruikt je vakkennis om passende ondersteuning te bieden.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je werkt mee op de groep en biedt dagelijkse begeleiding en ondersteuning bij ADL, verzorging en activiteiten;
  • Je coördineert de ondersteuning rondom een aantal bewoners en bewaakt de voortgang;
  • Je stelt ondersteuningsplannen op, houdt deze actueel en vertaalt doelen naar de dagelijkse praktijk;
  • Je signaleert veranderingen in gedrag, welzijn en zorgbehoefte en onderneemt waar nodig actie;
  • Je stemt af met verwanten, collega's en betrokken disciplines;
  • Je ondersteunt collega's bij zorginhoudelijke vragen en draagt bij aan een eenduidige manier van werken.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent rustig, betrokken en duidelijk. Je ziet wat ouder wordende bewoners nodig hebben, houdt rekening met veranderende zorgvragen en vindt het vanzelfsprekend om naast je coördinerende taken ook mee te werken op de groep.

  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde mbo-opleiding niveau 4 binnen Zorg & Welzijn;
  • Je hebt ervaring met of affiniteit voor ouder wordende mensen met een verstandelijke beperking;
  • Je kunt methodisch werken en begeleidingsdoelen vertalen naar de dagelijkse praktijk;
  • Je bent sterk in observeren, coördineren en samenwerken.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Bij Philadelphia krijg je de ruimte om het beste uit jezelf en uit je werk te halen. Daarom bieden wij naast alles uit de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg ook extra’s.

  • Een salaris van € 2.951,- tot € 3.980,- bruto per maand (FWG 40) bij een dienstverband van 36 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring en opleiding;

title: Senior Engineering Technician I, Equipment Engineering
description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

Join ASM as a Technician II, Equipment Engineering and become a key contributor at the forefront of semiconductor innovation! In this hands‑on, technology‑rich role, you’ll work directly with our advanced thermal and plasma ALD systems, ensuring the tools that enable next‑generation chip manufacturing perform at their best every day. You’ll be part of an expert R&D and engineering environment - digging into complex mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and vacuum systems; troubleshooting precision tools; and supporting engineers on high‑impact hardware and process challenges. Whether you’re investigating alarms, performing preventive maintenance, helping install new equipment, or driving root‑cause analysis, your work directly supports ASM’s reputation for world‑class reliability and performance.

If you love solving problems, working with sophisticated high‑tech equipment, and contributing to innovations that power phones, cars, data centers, and more, this role puts you at the heart of it. You’ll grow your skills, collaborate with highly skilled engineers, and make a measurable impact on technology used around the world - all while learning from the best in the industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on thermal and plasma ALD equipment.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and vacuum‑related issues on R&D tools.
  • Assist equipment and process engineers in resolving hardware and process-related problems.
  • Conduct basic root cause analysis and implement corrective actions under engineer guidance.
  • Support installation, modification, and qualification of new equipment and facility upgrades.
  • Monitor tool status, alarms, and performance; escalate issues appropriately.
  • Assist in spare parts, consumables, and chemical inventory management.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of maintenance activities, tool status, and repair actions.
  • Follow all required cleanroom, safety, and chemical handling protocols.

Skills & Qualifications

Ideally, we’re looking for someone with:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electronics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, automation, chemical engineering or a related field.
  • 1+ years of hands‑on experience working with complex equipment, high‑precision tools, or automation systems.
  • Basic understanding of vacuum systems, pumps, gas lines, heaters, valves, and related mechanical assemblies.
  • Experience working with chemicals or in a semiconductor cleanroom is considered an advantage.
  • Familiarity with thin‑film deposition techniques (ALD, PECVD) is a plus.
  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical schematics, wiring diagrams, and P&IDs.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem‑solving skills.
  • Good communication skills and fluency in English (written and verbal).

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We work remotely from numerous states across the country and are always looking for exceptional individuals to join us.

We are continually innovating with modern tools and technologies, and we welcome new perspectives. An ideal candidate will have a passion for some of our key technologies and advocate pragmatic industry practices around availability, scalability, security, and automation. A cloud-based infrastructure, continuous integration and delivery, and a quality-first approach help us to better deliver software. Named among the Best Places to Work in Insurance by Business Insurance for four years in a row (2020-2023), SageSure is one of the largest managing general underwriters (MGU) focused on catastrophe-exposed property in the US. Since its founding in 2009, SageSure has experienced exceptional growth while generating underwriting profits for carrier partners through hurricanes, wildfires, and hail. title: Houseperson
description:
Minneapolis DoubleTree MN Downtown

SECTION ONE: MCR Universal Role Standards

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CLEANLINESS and FRIENDLINESS!
The MCR standard is to provide clean, friendly, well-organized and safe hotels for our guests.

AREAS OF EXCELLENCE

Happy Guests
Spotless Cleanliness
Product Consistency & Quality
Teamwork

Duties and Expectations
1. Happy Guests

Guest Relations: Greet guests happily upon arrival and throughout their stay with a smile.
Name Use: Use the guests’ names whenever possible, ensuring they feel properly welcomed.
Guest Satisfaction: All Team Members work together to contribute to great guest satisfaction scores.
Recovery: Ability to handle challenging guest situations with hospitality and a sense of urgency.
Hotel Knowledge: Strong knowledge of all features of the hotel facility and amenities.
Events: Awareness and support for all groups and events at the hotel.
Technology: Understanding of relevant technology for each role.
Phone Etiquette: Answer all incoming calls with friendly service using the approved greeting.

2. Spotless Cleanliness

Sparkling Clean Workspaces: All areas, both front and back of the house, should be kept clean and well-organized.
Pitching In: Cleanliness is a team effort! Everyone may expect to pitch in to clean guest rooms and public spaces as needed, to ensure the hotel is well-organized and safe.
Hospitality While Cleaning: Always greet every guest happily with a smile, by name if possible, while cleaning.

3. Product Consistency & Quality

Checklists to 100% Accuracy: All operational checklists are completed accurately and at the designated times, every shift.
Shift Handover Reports: Handover reports must be accurate and on time, for effective shift-to-shift communication.
Flawless Uniform: All Team Members must wear a clean, approved uniform and be well-groomed per the Team Member Handbook, while wearing a nametag and smiling at all times.

4. Teamwork

Communication: Communication between Team Members should be clear, honest, and professional.
Can Do Attitude: Willing to stretch beyond traditional role to meet the needs of the business and MCR’s guests.
Collaboration: All Team Members at all levels must be committed to working together to create a welcoming environment for guests and an effective, positive workplace.

SECTION TWO: Houseperson, Role Specific Duties and Expectations

Other Duties and Expectations

Luggage Handling: Store and retrieve luggage or packages for guests in storage areas, as needed.
Cleaning and Trash Management: Clean and maintain the guest hallways, stairwells, service areas and ice rooms. Collect trash from all exterior garbage receptacles, as well as picking up trash and debris from the parking lot, swimming pool area and common grounds. All front and back of house areas should be well-organized and clean. Collect trash and soiled linen from the housekeepers and deliver to laundry room.
Furniture Upkeep: Monitor placement and condition of public space furniture, report issues to management.
Restocking: Maintain stock levels in guest floor linen closets and guest amenities. Replenish amenities and supplies in assigned guestrooms. Stock and maintain housekeeping cart.

SECTION THREE: Success Metrics

Happy Guests

Management Performance Ratings
Guest Satisfaction Scores/Intent to Return

Spotless Cleanliness

GM/AGM Spot Checks
Leadership Walk-throughs (RVP, etc.)
Guest Ratings/Reviews

Product Consistency & Quality

Checklist Tracking
Management Performance Ratings
Guest Ratings

Teamwork

Management Performance Ratings

SECTION FOUR: Qualifications & Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements:

Experience in a hospitality, service, consumer-facing franchise or related field preferred.
Can-Do Attitude: Must have a positive attitude and willingness to learn.
Ability to Follow Guidelines: Must be able to understand and follow established guidelines and procedures.
Handle Pace and Pressure: Must work well in stressful, high-pressure situations.
Listening, Conflict Resolution: Must be effective at listening to, understanding, clarifying, and resolving the concerns and issues raised by co-workers and guests.
Communication Skills: Must be able to convey information and ideas clearly.
Hospitality and Guest Service: Must have a desire to serve all guests.
Age Requirement: Must be 18 years of age or older to perform this job.
Schedule and Travel: Must be willing to work a varied schedule that may include evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays based upon the demands of the hotel.
Clock-in/Out: Arrive and clock in on time for every shift worked and clock out at the scheduled shift ending time, unless otherwise directed by your immediate supervisor. Never work while off the clock.
Breaks: Clock in/out for breaks at the designated time on your schedule.
Call Outs: Provide sufficient notice as directed by your supervisor when calling out for a scheduled shift.

Physical Working Demands & Working Environment:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to carry out physical working demands such as:

Stooping: Bending body downward and forward by bending spine at waist. Requires full use of the lower extremities and back muscles.
Climbing: Ascending or descending ladders, stairs, scaffolding, ramps, poles, and the like, using feet and legs and/or hands and arms.
Balancing: Maintaining body equilibrium to prevent falling when walking, standing or crouching on narrow, slippery or erratically moving surfaces.
Kneeling: Bending legs at knee to come to rest on one or both knees.
Crawling: Moving about on hands and knees or hands and feet.
Standing: Remaining upright on the feet, particularly for sustained periods of time.
Walking: Moving about on foot to accomplish tasks, particularly for long distances or moving from one work site to another.
Repetitive Motions: Making substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
Lifting: Carrying certain housekeeping items such as linens, trash, or vacuums.

Note:
This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) of this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. Employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily and, if requested, reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. The Employer retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an at-will relationship.

title: Director, Brand Design
description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

Reporting to the VP, Design & Experience, the Director, Creative will lead Prenuvo’s Creative function and oversee a multidisciplinary team of contributors. This leadership role is responsible for the Creative function as a whole; its people, capabilities, priorities, creative vision, quality, and effectiveness. The Director, Creative will oversee Prenuvo's creative expression across brand, campaigns, paid media, social, web, content, motion, physical environments, events, partnerships, and emerging experiences.

Your role is both directive and integrative. You'll set the creative vision and quality bar while leading through your team, giving them the clarity, ownership, and autonomy to independently direct programs, disciplines, and bodies of work. You'll partner closely with Marketing, Growth, Product Design, Clinical, Commercial, CX, and other subject-matter experts to ensure creative work is compelling, accurate, and responsive to the needs of a healthcare environment.

You'll combine a strong creative point of view with organizational leadership—building the team and capabilities we need, establishing scalable creative practices, and partnering across the company to turn brand and business strategy into exceptional creative work. This is a fully remote position open to candidates authorized to work in the United States. Occasional travel may be required for team gatherings, productions, events, and other business needs.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

  • Vision & creative direction
    • Own and evolve Prenuvo's creative expression, translating brand and business strategy into a distinctive experience across channels.
    • Set the creative vision, principles, and quality standards that guide the brand design team and its partners.
    • Provide senior creative direction for major campaigns, launches, partnerships, and brand initiatives while empowering Creative Leads to direct individual programs and bodies of work.
    • Ensure the brand remains cohesive while continuing to evolve as Prenuvo, its audiences, and its offerings grow.
  • Organizational leadership
    • Own the structure, capabilities, performance, and development of Prenuvo's Creative function, building a multidisciplinary team capable of supporting the company's evolving brand and business needs.
    • Lead and develop team members, establishing clear accountability and empowering them to lead their teams and work independently.
    • Identify capability and talent gaps and determine where to build internally versus leverage agencies, freelancers, and production partners.
    • Create an environment of high standards, collaboration, accountability, creative ambition, and professional growth.
  • Portfolio, priorities, and resources
    • Own creative portfolio planning and resourcing, partnering with the VP of Design & Experience and cross-functional leaders to prioritize creative investment against the company's highest-value opportunities.
    • Balance business demand, team capacity, strategic importance, and creative opportunity when establishing priorities.
    • Ensure the Creative organization has the right talent, partners, processes, and resources to deliver against company priorities.
    • Provide visibility into creative priorities, capacity, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership.
  • Cross-functional leadership
    • Serving as the senior creative authority to the local brand design and creative team while taking broader direction from the VP, Design and Experience and partnering with leaders across Marketing, Growth, Product, Clinical, Commercial, CX, and other functions.
    • Translate business objectives, audience insights, and channel strategies into creative opportunities and direction.
    • Present and advocate for creative strategy and work with senior and executive stakeholders.
    • Partner closely with Product Design where brand and product experiences intersect, creating continuity while maintaining clear ownership between the two functions.
  • Creative systems and effectiveness
    • Establish scalable approaches to creative intake, prioritization, briefing, review, production, and delivery.
    • Oversee agencies, freelancers, production partners, and other external creative resources.
    • Partner with Marketing and Growth to understand creative performance and translate learnings into stronger creative strategy.
    • Balance brand-building and performance objectives, ensuring short-term optimization doesn't come at the expense of long-term brand equity.
    • Identify opportunities for AI and emerging technologies to improve creative exploration, production, scalability, and efficiency.
    • Remain connected to the work and step directly into creative development when the scale, complexity, or strategic importance of an initiative warrants it.

What You’ll Bring

  • 15+ years of experience in creative, brand, design, or related disciplines, including significant creative leadership experience.
  • 5+ years managing and developing creative teams and senior creative talent, with demonstrated success building high-performing multidisciplinary organizations.
  • An exceptional portfolio demonstrating brand thinking and creative direction across multiple channels and experiences.
  • Deep experience across brand, digital, web, paid advertising, social, video/motion, and integrated campaigns.
  • Experience with physical or experiential design—including retail, clinics, hospitality, or events—is highly valued.
  • Strong understanding of both brand building and performance marketing.
  • Demonstrated experience with portfolio prioritization, resource planning, team building, and organizational development.
  • Experience managing agencies, production partners, freelancers, budgets, and complex creative programs.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and articulate the thinking behind creative decisions.
  • Familiarity with product and UX design and the ability to partner effectively with Product Design leadership.
  • Strong understanding of contemporary creative tools and emerging AI-enabled creative technologies.
  • Consumer marketing experience in healthcare, HealthTech, MedTech, wellness, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role ranges from $180,000-$210,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain []. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.

title: Partnerships Associate, AI Labs
description:
Via is the global leader in transportation technology, powering modern, data-driven transit networks for hundreds of agency partners worldwide. Now, we are building our next frontier: AI Labs. This new, high-growth vertical combines Via’s global scale with cutting-edge artificial intelligence to build next-generation software for cities, automate complex systems, and unlock massive revenue opportunities.

As a Partnerships Associate, you will operate at the intersection of marketing and sales to support the growth of AI Labs. You will own the research and outreach strategies to generate meaningful engagement with top prospects and customers, facilitating the partnerships that bring equitable and affordable transit to communities worldwide and supercharging the public sector with AI solutions.

This is an exciting role, tasked with building a book of business for a fast-growing new vertical. You’ll play a key role in shaping the team’s approach and helping cities develop new AI solutions.

About the Role:

  • Build pipeline for AI Labs, a new vertical dedicated to improving how cities function.
  • Perform deep-dive research on accounts and individuals to create comprehensive buying committee maps and informed account plans.
  • Lead multi-channel outreach campaigns across email, phone, and LinkedIn to articulate the value of Via’s AI solutions.
  • Facilitate meetings, provide demos, qualify leads, and close deals as appropriate.
  • Maintain and optimize sales tools within our CRM and marketing tech stack to ensure data accuracy and process scalability.
  • Collaborate with commercial teams to align outreach efforts with broader sales goals and regional growth strategies.

About You:

  • Minimum of 1–3 years of experience in B2B marketing, account-based marketing, or a sales development (BDR/SDR) role.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to use campaign data to identify what’s working and where to pivot strategy.
  • Proficiency in CRM and marketing automation tools to manage high volumes of outreach and research effectively.
  • Clear, concise communicator capable of writing professional outreach and explaining complex AI solutions simply.
  • Hungry to learn about AI, automation opportunities in the Public Sector, and the Via buying audience, with a proven ability to implement feedback quickly.
  • Resilient and team player who enjoys building relationships over time and remains undeterred by setbacks.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • All final pay rates and levels will be determined by candidates experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data
  • Salary Range: $70,000-$80,000 + $5k bonus target
  • Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans
  • A 401(k) with company match and vesting
  • Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options
  • Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks)

There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
location: Birmingham, Alabama, United States; Nashville; Remote
description:
About Us: Wettermark Keith is a rapidly growing national personal injury firm. We pride ourselves on our integrity, professionalism, and commitment to excellence. At Wettermark Keith, we understand that our work extends far beyond the courtroom. We engage with people during some of the most challenging times of their lives – moments filled with uncertainty, fear, and stress. Our clients come to us in the aftermath of tragic accidents, seeking not just legal representation, but a beacon of hope for their future.

Purpose:

Wettermark Keith is seeking a highly organized and technically skilled Senior Salesforce Administrator to support and optimize our Salesforce platform while serving as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the technology team.

This role is critical to ensuring the day-to-day success of firm operations by maintaining system health, driving enhancements, managing project requests/execution, and coordinating releases with Product Management. The ideal candidate will combine strong Salesforce administrative expertise with project management discipline and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.

This is a full-time role and may be remote. Candidates near our Birmingham, Alabama, or Nashville, Tennessee, office are strongly preferred. Compensation for the role includes a competitive base salary commensurate with experience, a discretionary year-end bonus, and benefits.

Key Responsibilities:

Salesforce Administration & Support

  • Manage daily Salesforce operations, ensuring system reliability and performance
  • Create, maintain, and optimize reports and dashboards for business stakeholders
  • Troubleshoot bugs, user issues, and system errors; escalate when appropriate
  • Administer users, profiles, permission sets, and permission set groups
  • Monitor data quality and implement data governance best practices

Project Management & Intake

  • Serve as the primary intake point for new business requests and enhancements
  • Gather, document, and refine business requirements into actionable solutions
  • Prioritize backlog in alignment with firm leadership and operational needs
  • Coordinate with Salesforce developers, admins, and cross-functional teams
  • Track project progress, timelines, and deliverables using project management tools

Workflow & Process Development

  • Design and implement workflow enhancements using Flows and declarative tools
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automation
  • Partner with business units to streamline processes and reduce manual work

Documentation & Communication

  • Document business processes, system configurations, and workflow logic
  • Maintain clear and organized documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Provide regular status updates to stakeholders and leadership

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of Salesforce Administration experience
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Salesforce data model and security model
    • Reports & dashboards
    • Flow Builder and automation tools
  • Experience working with managed packages (e.g., Litify or similar legal tech platforms)
  • Familiarity with Salesforce DevOps strategies, including:
    • Sandboxes and environment management
    • CI/CD tools (e.g., Gearset, Copado, Azure DevOps)
  • Experience managing projects or coordinating cross-functional initiatives
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator Certification
  • Familiar with Agile or Scrum methodologies
  • Exposure to integrations (CTI, document management, or e-signature platforms)
  • Experience supporting the following products: Litify, Eve Legal AI, SMS Magic, Case Status

Key Competencies:

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
  • High attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Self-starter with the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Collaborative mindset with a focus on continuous improvement

What Success Looks Like:

  • Salesforce runs smoothly with minimal disruption to daily operations
  • Business stakeholders receive timely, accurate reporting and insights
  • Project requests are clearly defined, prioritized, and delivered efficiently
  • Workflows are continuously improved to drive operational efficiency
  • Documentation is clear, accessible, and up-to-date

title: Leasing Specialist
description:
Leasing Specialist

Job Title: Leasing Specialist

Division: Multifamily

Status: Non-Exempt

JOB SUMMARY: The Leasing Specialist is responsible for driving occupancy and resident satisfaction in a multi-family community. This role includes showing and leasing apartments to prospective residents, coordinating marketing initiatives, assisting in resident retention efforts, and supporting the Property Manager in daily operations to ensure a positive living experience and strong financial performance.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: include the following but are not limited to the job specifications contained herein. Additional duties or job functions that can be performed safely may be required as deemed necessary by Harbor Group Management Company.

Greet prospective residents, conduct property tours, and showcase available apartments and amenities.

Qualify leads, process rental applications, run background and credit checks, and prepare lease documents.

Ensure units are move-in ready by inspecting them before occupancy and coordinating outstanding items with maintenance.

Execute lease agreements and move-in packages, ensuring a smooth onboarding process for new residents.

Design and implement short- and long-term marketing plans to generate traffic and maintain occupancy.

Promote the community via digital platforms such as Craigslist, Facebook, and email campaigns.

Coordinate resident referral programs, employer outreach, and participate in local networking efforts.

Maintain up-to-date knowledge of market conditions, competitor properties, rental rates, and trends.

Support resident retention through excellent customer service and timely response to questions, complaints, and maintenance needs.

Conduct follow-up communication with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction.

Participate in lease renewal efforts by preparing renewal documents, engaging with residents, and finalizing lease extensions.

Maintain accurate records of prospect and resident interactions using property management software (e.g., Yardi, OneSite).

Keep guest cards updated and perform follow-ups on all leads.

Assist with rent collection, manage delinquent accounts, and support administrative tasks as assigned by the Property Manager.

Ensure leasing office and tour path are presentable and meet show standards at all times.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

High School Diploma or equivalent.

Minimum one year of experience in leasing, sales, or customer service; property management experience preferred.

Proficient with Microsoft Office and Property Management software experience is a must.

Experience utilizing social media (Facebook, Instagram, etc.) is preferred.

Excellent organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.

Must be customer-service oriented with the ability to interact professionally with residents and vendors.

Flexibility to work weekends if required by the property.

Valid driver’s license required (for operating golf carts if applicable).
