title: Sr. Data Engineer (Remote)
description:
Who We Are (Mode.Inc)

Mode is a fast-growing technology company building businesses at the intersection of AI, data, mobile apps, and digital experiences. Our portfolio of mobile apps and digital products reaches 100M+ monthly active users across a global audience. We continue to accelerate growth through product innovation, strategic acquisitions, and emerging business opportunities.

Mode was recognized by Deloitte as the #1 fastest-growing software company in North America on the 2023 Technology Fast 500. Today, we are building our next phase of growth, including expanding Mode's AI and data business and developing direct relationships with companies that can benefit from the data and capabilities we have built.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company’s success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help architect, build, and operate Mode Mobile’s data platform. You will lead the development of large-scale data systems that process billions of events daily, enabling both real-time and batch use cases across product, growth, analytics, AI and data monetization. You’ll work closely with engineering, data science, analytics teams, and business leaders to ensure our data is reliable, secure, scalable, and actionable.

This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in production environments, takes accountability seriously, and wants to shape how data works across a fast-growing, multi-product company.

What You’ll Do

Build & Scale (Action-Driven, Thorough)

  • Architect and lead the development of large-scale data pipelines, streaming systems, and data lakes handling billions of daily events.
  • Design and implement robust solutions supporting both real-time and batch processing.
  • Make thoughtful architectural decisions around performance, cost, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Ensure high data quality through strong ETL/ELT patterns, testing, monitoring, and observability.

Own Production (Accountable)

  • Own data systems running in live production environments with a strong focus on uptime, reliability, and correctness.
  • Proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and failure modes—and address them before they impact the business.
  • Partner with infrastructure and engineering teams to ensure data platforms are secure, compliant, and resilient.

Collaborate & Enable (Caring)

  • Work closely with product engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists, growth, and business teams to understand data needs and deliver high-impact solutions.
  • Build tools, frameworks, and datasets that empower others to move faster and make better decisions.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, raising the bar for technical excellence and ownership across teams.

Think Ahead (Curious)

  • Continuously explore new tools, patterns, and technologies that improve our data platform.
  • Evaluate build vs. buy decisions with a pragmatic mindset, balancing speed, scalability, and long-term value.
  • Help shape the technical roadmap for Mode Mobile’s data platform as we grow through both organic expansion and acquisitions.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of experience designing, operating, and owning live production data systems, ideally in high-scale or data-intensive environments.
  • Expert-level SQL skills.
  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as Spark, Kafka, and modern data processing frameworks.
  • Experience with AWS services for running data infrastructure.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
  • Proficiency in at least one data engineering language: Python (preferred), Scala, or Java.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT design patterns, and scalable data architectures.

How You Work (Values Alignment)

  • Accountable: You take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. When something breaks, you lean in and see it through.
  • Action-Driven: You are biased toward execution, ship meaningful improvements, and don’t get stuck in analysis paralysis.
  • Caring: You collaborate with empathy, communicate clearly, and care about the impact your work has on teammates and users.
  • Curious: You ask thoughtful questions, seek to understand the “why,” and continuously look for better ways to build and scale.
  • Thorough: You value quality, correctness, and long-term maintainability—especially when working with data that drives critical decisions.

Leveling Note

This role is scoped at a Senior Data Engineer level with Staff-level impact expectations. We strongly prefer candidates with deep experience at scale, but we are open to Senior-level engineers who have demonstrated ownership of complex systems and are ready to operate with broader influence and responsibility.

We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms

  • Allow OKRs to Guide Us
  • Assume Positive Intent
  • Agree to Disagree & Commit
  • Set New Precedents
  • Accomplish More with Less
  • Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
  • Speak Up
  • Be Resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 Rule

What We Are Offering

  • We are a 100% remote-first, global company.
  • A competitive compensation package.
  • We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
  • Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full-time team members).
  • We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results-driven people.
  • Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
  • Bonus.ly - We use Bonus.ly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
  • Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
  • Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full-time team members).

If we just described you and your perfect role, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to making headway and creating success together!

Mode.Inc does not accept/pay fees for unsolicited resumes from third-party agencies/vendors.

Our company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Nuclear Facility Mechanical Cognizant Systems Engineer
description:
We have an opening for a Nuclear Facility Mechanical Cognizant Systems Engineer to provide engineering expertise to ensure continued operational readiness of DOE Hazard Category 2 and 3 nuclear facility building structures by: maintaining overall cognizance of the integrity of Hazard Category 2 and 3 assigned systems; providing system engineering support for Operations and Maintenance activities, such as facility modifications and equipment installations; and, technical support of line management safety responsibilities. You will often be involved in significant research and development (R&D) projects, applying your expertise and creating innovative solutions. This position will report programmatically to the Superblock and administratively to the Defense Technologies Engineering Division (DTED), within the Engineering Directorate.

This position may offer a hybrid schedule, which includes the flexibility to work from home up to one day per week, after a probationary period. The specifics of the hybrid schedule, including the exact number of days required in the office and virtual work options, may vary based on the needs of the team and the organization.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

  • Assist in monitoring the integrity and configuration of mechanical systems to anticipate the need for maintenance, repair, or replacement of components due to aging and degradation.
  • Prepare system logs, surveillance reports, and detailed assessment reports and brief facility management on the results.
  • Identify, monitor, and provide recommendations for the timely procurement and assurance of adequate inventory of spare parts and materials.
  • Utilize comprehensive technical engineering skills and mechanical engineering experience to provide engineering technical support for sustainment, repair, and modification of safety structures, systems, and components.
  • Support significant R&D projects by applying comprehensive level knowledge, skills, and innovation to create mechanical solutions that are safe and compliant with DOE orders and specifications.
  • Develop and implement solutions and approaches for problems and issues of moderate complexity in support of facility operations and maintenance using independent engineering judgment, in determining methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria, in-depth analysis, ingenuity, and creativity.
  • Identify and assess the potential impacts to assigned structures, systems, components from new construction, modifications, and repairs related to other systems, such HVAC and building structures.
  • Assist in developing and performing technical reviews of facility related procedures, work instructions, and proposed modifications to ensure technical adequacy and feasibility of implementation.
  • Assist in preparing and reviewing mechanical design calculations, drawings, and other documents to describe and provide solutions for complex design requirements and engineering problems, while ensuring compliance with technical criteria, schedules, and deliverables using comprehensive knowledge.
  • Conduct reviews and provide technical input and advice to mid-level internal management, customers, and colleagues on moderately complex system related design, operation, and maintenance issues.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional job responsibilities, at the SES.3 level

  • Monitor the integrity and configuration of mechanical systems to anticipate the need for maintenance, repair, or replacement of components due to aging and degradation.
  • Identify, monitor, and provide recommendations for the timely procurement and assurance of adequate inventory of spare parts and materials.
  • Provide engineering technical support for sustainment, repair, and modification of safety structures, systems, and components.
  • Develop and implement solutions and approaches for complex problems and issues in support of facility operations and maintenance using independent engineering judgment, in determining methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria, in-depth analysis, ingenuity, and creativity. Support R&D projects by contributing mechanical solutions that are safe and compliant with DOE orders and specifications.
  • Perform technical reviews of facility related procedures, work instructions, and proposed modifications to ensure technical adequacy and feasibility of implementation. Prepare and review mechanical design calculations, drawings, and other documents to describe and provide solutions for complex design requirements and engineering problems, while ensuring compliance with technical criteria, schedules, and deliverables.
  • Conduct reviews and provide technical input and advice to mid-level internal management, customers, and colleagues on complex system related design, operation, and maintenance issues.
  • Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent level of education and related technical experience.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of mechanical engineering standards and practices, such as ASME, ANSI, NFPA, etc.
  • Broad experience with and comprehensive knowledge and skills in the design, modification, and evaluation of mechanical systems for buildings and facilities, such as piping, heating, ventilation, and conditioning.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of and demonstrated proficiency and experience in developing or reviewing calculations, specifications, drawings, and sketches; determining design criteria for modifications, renovations, and upgrades on small projects and on occasional larger projects.
  • Proficient verbal and written communication skills necessary to effectively interact and collaborate in a team environment, including the ability to identify, develop and effectively communicate recommendations to facility and senior management regarding facility and safety equipment modifications.
  • Proficiency and experience with effectively developing work process documents and safety documentation.
  • Experience working in a multi-disciplinary team environment which includes scientists, engineers, and technicians with demonstrated ability to effectively manage, oversee, and deliver multiple projects on budget and schedule, often with multiple parallel tasks that require the resolution of conflicting work requirements and prioritization of tasks toward predetermined long-range targets.

Additional qualifications at the SES.3 level

  • Significant experience in mechanical systems for buildings and facilities and industry code compliance, including Department of Energy requirements for nuclear facilities.
  • Advanced knowledge of mechanical engineering standards and practices, such as ASME, ANSI, NFPA, etc.
  • Significant experience with and advanced knowledge and skills in the design, modification, and evaluation of mechanical systems for buildings and facilities, such as piping, heating, ventilation, and conditioning.
  • Advanced knowledge of and demonstrated significant experience in developing or reviewing calculations, specifications, drawings, and sketches; determining design criteria for modifications, renovations, and upgrades on small projects and on occasional larger projects.
  • Significant experience with and demonstrated ability to successfully lead and motivate a team in achieving project objectives which include solving highly complex problems, defining and verifying requirements and resources, and applying project management expertise.
  • Advanced communication, facilitation, and collaboration, interpersonal, and negotiation skills necessary to effectively present, explain, provide strategic technical advice, build consensus, and influence senior management, external sponsors, regulators, reviewers, and stakeholders.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Master’s degree in in mechanical engineering or related field.
  • Professional Engineering Registration in Mechanical or Nuclear Engineering in California or reciprocity from another state within twelve months.
  • Significant experience working with mechanical structures, systems, and components in a nuclear environment. Significant experience preparing project estimates.
  • Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, Creo).

Pay Range

$146,340 - $222,564 Annually

$146,340 - $185,544 Annually for the SES.2 level
$175,530 - $222,564 Annually for the SES.3 level

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

At Autism Behavioral Center, our clinical work is grounded in compassion, collaboration, and respect for the individuals and families we serve. We are committed to delivering high quality, ethical ABA services that prioritize dignity, autonomy, and meaningful outcomes.

  • Assent based, client centered care that respects individual preferences and promotes trust

Autism Behavioral Center's mission is to improve independence and social awareness for individuals diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder while supporting and empowering their families. title: Mission Lead - Computer Vision
description:
At Expedition Technology (EXP), we turn advanced technology into operational capability for national security missions. Our Mission Areas bring together related customers, programs, technologies, and growth opportunities. As a Mission Lead, you will act as the lead of a substantial business portfolio—setting its strategy, guiding investment and technical direction, developing customer relationships, and taking responsibility for its long-term growth and health. This role is for a leader who wants to build a business, shape technology, and create lasting mission impact.

What You'll Own


Strategy and Growth

  • Define the long-term vision, strategy, and growth trajectory for your Mission Area.
  • Identify emerging mission needs, market shifts, and technology trends before they become requirements.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with government customers, mission stakeholders, and industry partners.
  • Shape opportunities from early concept through capture and award.
  • Partner with the business development team and executive leadership to develop growth strategies, pursue new work, and expand customer relationships.
  • Lead or contribute to white papers, proposals, strategic captures, and business development activities.
  • Ensure EXP’s investments align with future customer needs and mission priorities.

Portfolio Leadership

  • Guide the overall health and direction of a substantial portfolio of programs, customers, and investments.
  • Maintain accountability for the financial health and growth of the Mission Area.
  • Balance near-term execution with long-term capability development.
  • Evaluate investments in new technologies, products, and internal research efforts.
  • Monitor portfolio performance, customer satisfaction, pipeline health, backlog growth, and strategic positioning.
  • Make informed decisions about where EXP should focus its time, talent, and resources.

Technical and Mission Direction

  • Help define the technical roadmap for the Mission Area.
  • Connect customer mission challenges with EXP’s capabilities in AI, machine learning, computer vision, signal processing, software, data platforms, and advanced analytics.
  • Partner with technical leaders to ensure our solutions remain differentiated and mission relevant.
  • Drive the transition of new ideas into deployed operational capabilities.
  • Represent EXP's technical vision and mission expertise to senior government and industry audiences.

Building Leaders and Organizations

  • Partner closely with Operations Leads who are responsible for program execution, delivery excellence, and people leadership.
  • Provide strategic direction and context that enables teams to make effective decisions.
  • Help develop the next generation of leaders across the Mission Area.
  • Contribute to a culture of learning, collaboration, autonomy, and continuous improvement.
  • Foster alignment across customers, technology investments, operations, and company strategy.

What We're Looking For


Required

  • Active TS/SCI clearance.
  • Demonstrated success leading significant technology, mission, or business portfolios.
  • Experience supporting defense, intelligence, or national security customers.
  • Proven ability to build trusted customer relationships and grow business opportunities.
  • Experience shaping and pursuing strategic opportunities, including business development, capture, proposals, or customer engagement.
  • Strong understanding of advanced technology domains such as AI, machine learning, computer vision, signal processing, software systems, data platforms, or related fields.
  • Ability to connect mission needs, technical capabilities, and business objectives.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort engaging with senior government, industry, and internal stakeholders.
  • Track record of developing leaders and building high-performing organizations.

Preferred

  • Experience owning or influencing the performance of a significant portfolio, business line, or mission area.
  • Experience with AI/ML, computer vision, autonomous systems, advanced analytics, or other emerging technologies.
  • Experience transitioning technology from research into operational deployment.
  • Experience leading major strategic captures and proposal efforts.
  • Master's degree or higher in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.
  • Deep familiarity with one or more defense or intelligence mission communities.

title: Myyjiä, Hämeenlinna (tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttava)
description:
Onko parhaan asiakaskohtaamisen tarjoaminen sinulle hyvää fiilistä tuova onnistuminen? Kiinnostaako sinua joustava työ, jonka voi hyvin sovittaa elämän muihin menoihin?

Etsimme nyt uusia työkavereita osaksi Hämeenlinnan myyntitiimiämme. Haemme avoimia ja aktiivisia kollegoita tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttaviin vuoroihin. Tarjolla on joustava ja sinun ehdoillasi tehtävä työ, jossa vuoroja voi tulla tarjolle lyhyelläkin varoajalla. Toivoisimme, että innostut työskentelemään useammassa myymälässämme Tampereella.

Palvelukonseptiimme kuuluu asiakkaan henkilökohtainen huomiointi, uusien elämysten tarjoaminen sekä Suomen Parhaan Asiakaskohtaamisen mukainen myyntityö. Suomalaisen Kirjakaupan myyjänä tehtäviisi kuuluu aktiivisen myyntityön lisäksi myös myymäläilmeestä huolehtiminen sekä muut myymälän päivittäiset tehtävät.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja kiinnostavan myyntityön, jossa toimit osana innostavaa työyhteisöä rohkeasti omana itsenäsi. Olemme työpaikka, missä pääset kehittymään vahvuuksiesi kautta ja tuemme polkuasi erikoiskaupan tulevaisuuden ammattilaisena. Osana suomalaista Otava-konsernia kehitämme toimintaamme pitkäjänteisesti toteuttamalla arvojamme vastuullisuus, laatu, rohkeus ja läheisyys.

Palkkaus perustuu kaupan työehtosopimuksen vaativuusluokkaan B ja määräytyy kokemusvuosien mukaan 13,33 €/t - 14,93 €/t. Ilta- ja viikonlopputyöstä maksamme seuraavat lisät:

  • Iltalisä klo 18 jälkeen 4 €/t
  • Lauantailisä klo 13 jälkeen 5,18 €/t
  • Sunnuntaina tehdystä työstä palkka maksetaan tuplana

Haemme ensisijaisesti aikaisempaa kokemusta myymälä- ja kassatyöskentelystä omaavia henkilöitä ja ennen kaikkea arvostamme aktiivista, reipasta ja innostunutta asennetta myyjän työhön. Tartut uusiin työtehtäviin avoimin mielin ja myyntityössä teet parhaasi asiakkaan palvelemiseksi, myös kiireen keskellä.

Odotamme, että pystyt palvelemaan asiakkaitamme sujuvasti suomen kielellä ja englannin kielitaito katsotaan eduksi. Työvuorosi sijoittuvat myymälöiden aukioloaikojen mukaisesti arkipäiville ja viikonlopuille. Työvuoroja tehdään sekä työkavereiden kanssa että itsenäisesti työskennellen.

Mikäli sinulta löytyy edellä mainittujen lisäksi halua ja innokkuutta varmistaa koko tiimisi onnistuminen niin työtehtävien kuin tiimihengenkin osalta, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian hakulinkin kautta, kuitenkin viimeistään 15.10.2026. Kerro, mikä innostaa sinua juuri tässä tehtävässä ja millaista osaamista, kokemusta tai energiaa tuot mukanasi tiimiimme. Hakemusten suuren määrän vuoksi videotervehdys on erinomainen tapa erottua ja tuoda persoonasi esiin.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja etenemme rekrytoinnissa sopivien hakijoiden löytyessä. Toimi siis mahdollisimman pian!

title: Associate, Project Development
description:
Overview
Tract Capital adopts a unique approach to digital infrastructure investment. Leveraging experience and strategic insights honed over three decades of creating successful companies in the space, we excel in nurturing and advancing leading-edge digital infrastructure enterprises. Our team of specialized experts are united by a singular purpose: to support the growth of digital infrastructure. Tract Capital goes beyond simple investment by acting as a strategic partner and catalyst for innovation within the sector. We ensure our engagements not only generate strong financial results but also develop essential digital infrastructure to meet growing demands. Tract Capital has introduced multiple digital infrastructure strategies including horizontal powered land, vertical development, and product development.

Position Overview

The position is a high-impact, execution-oriented role within Tract Capital's Project Development team, a subset of the Investments & Strategy team that holds end-to-end responsibility for Tract Capital's data center assets. The Associate will be a core execution member of this team, driving active progress across large-scale data center development projects throughout their full lifecycle, from site acquisition or joint venture through master planning, entitlements, permitting, leasing, development, power, construction, equipment procurement, financing, and ultimately the disposition of those assets. Data center development is inherently multidisciplinary; the Associate operates as a critical contributor and coordinator across all of its key workstreams, ensuring each advances on schedule and in alignment with the broader project. The Associate works closely alongside senior members of the organization, operates with direct visibility into firm-level investment decisions, and engages a broad network of internal functions and external project partners.

Job Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for the following key areas:

  • Advance full-lifecycle data center development workstreams, from site acquisition or joint venture through master planning, entitlements, permitting, leasing, development, power, construction, equipment procurement, financing, and asset disposition, tracking critical-path milestones, surfacing issues early, and driving resolution across internal and external stakeholders
  • Serve as a critical execution member of the permitting team across federal, state, and local jurisdictions; monitor permit timelines, coordinate with permitting consultants and internal stakeholders, and ensure open items are actively moving forward
  • Support power and energy infrastructure workstreams, including utility interconnection, behind-the-meter power solutions, and battery energy storage systems, coordinating with internal power teams, external consultants, and utility counterparties to monitor progress, flag risks, and keep deliverables aligned with the data center development schedule
  • Actively support the structuring and execution of project-level financing, preparing diligence materials, excel models, tracking and responding to lender requests, and coordinating inputs across internal and external parties
  • Participate in the procurement of long-lead data center equipment in coordination with the procurement lead
  • Critically evaluate deliverables from engineers, consultants, legal counsel, investors, and contractors; identify gaps, escalate issues, and work across teams to hold parties accountable to scope, schedule, and cost
  • Prepare and maintain integrated project risk registers, development schedules, budgets, and executive-level project status reports
  • Assist in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating project agreements (including site control documents, construction contracts, power contracts, engineering and consultant contracts, equipment procurement agreements, and utility interconnection agreements) in coordination with internal legal and outside counsel
  • Support assessment of project-level legal and regulatory risk across jurisdictions, coordinating with outside counsel and internal legal on deal structuring and contract terms
  • Serve as a central coordination point across internal functions (investments, legal, capital markets, engineering, procurement, leasing, and construction) and the full roster of external project partners, ensuring alignment and preventing workstream drift
  • Support investment committee processes, including financial models, project narratives, and transaction diligence materials

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (JD, MBA, or MSRE/MSRED) strongly preferred.

  • 2-4 years of direct, hands-on experience in data center, energy, infrastructure, or industrial development, with demonstrated exposure to complex, multi-stakeholder project environments. Attorneys with relevant experience at a top-tier firm or developer are encouraged to apply.

Core Skills & Competencies

  • Working knowledge of real estate development fundamentals, including real property ownership structures, land use frameworks, and entitlement processes applicable to large-scale infrastructure or commercial development
  • Working knowledge of project capital structures, including debt, equity, and construction financing dynamics applicable to large-scale infrastructure or real estate development
  • Familiarity with federal, state, and local permitting pathways for large-scale development projects; ability to engage substantively with permitting consultants, track regulatory timelines, and identify risks across multi-jurisdictional processes
  • Working knowledge of power and energy infrastructure as it relates to data center development — including utility interconnection, behind-the-meter power solutions, and battery energy storage systems — sufficient to engage constructively with power consultants, utility counterparties, and turnkey power providers, and monitor deliverables against project schedule
  • Ability to critically evaluate engineering and legal deliverables, identify gaps, and escalate or drive resolution — without waiting to be directed
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across external consultants, contractors, and counsel, advancing workstreams toward defined milestones without serving as the primary functional owner of each discipline

Location: New York, NY, Morristown, NJ, or remote

Travel Requirement: 25% This position requires the ability and willingness to travel to project sites, major stakeholder meetings, and Tract Capital offices.

Bonus

description:

title: Marketing Project Coordinator
description:
Now Hiring: Marketing Project Coordinator
Location: Houston, TX | Mustang Cat | Marketing Department

Mustang Cat is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Marketing Project Coordinator to join our Houston-based Marketing team!

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent college graduate or early-career professional looking to gain hands-on experience in marketing, event planning, digital communications, and project coordination.

In this role, you'll work alongside our Marketing Specialists to support exciting projects, coordinate company events, assist with marketing campaigns, and help keep our department running smoothly.

Why Join Mustang Cat?
We offer:

Great Work-Life Balance
Job Stability + Career Growth Opportunities
Comprehensive Benefits Package – Medical, Dental, Vision
401(k) with Employer Match
Tuition Reimbursement & Professional Development Opportunities
Paid Time Off & Holidays
Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment

You'll play an important role in supporting our Marketing team with a variety of projects, events, and daily activities.

Marketing Projects & Campaigns: Assist with coordinating marketing campaigns, promotional activities, and department initiatives.
Digital Marketing & Social Media: Support digital marketing, social media, communications, and retail marketing efforts.

title: Teamleider Particuliere Verzekeringen
description:
Ben jij een ervaren professional binnen de verzekeringsbranche die energie krijgt van het aansturen, coachen én meewerken binnen een team? Voor een groeiende en onafhankelijke financiële dienstverlener zoeken wij een Teamleider Particuliere Verzekeringen. In deze veelzijdige rol combineer je jouw commerciële inzicht met leiderschap en krijg je volop ruimte om jouw team én de dienstverlening naar een hoger niveau te tillen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Teamleider Particuliere Verzekeringen geef je dagelijks leiding aan het particuliere verzekeringsteam. Je staat midden in de praktijk, werkt actief mee en zorgt ervoor dat jouw collega's optimaal kunnen presteren. Met jouw ervaring, commerciële blik en coachende manier van leidinggeven weet je het beste uit het team te halen.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de resultaten van de afdeling en weet commerciële kansen te vertalen naar concrete acties, zonder het klantbelang uit het oog te verliezen.

Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden zijn:

  • Je geeft op een betrokken en coachende manier leiding aan het particuliere verzekeringsteam;
  • Je werkt actief mee op de afdeling en ondersteunt collega's bij inhoudelijke en commerciële vraagstukken;
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het behalen van de commerciële doelstellingen en de resultaten van het team;
  • Je signaleert kansen in de markt en vertaalt ontwikkelingen naar verbeteringen in de dienstverlening;
  • Je bewaakt de balans tussen klanttevredenheid, commerciële resultaten en organisatiebelangen;
  • Je stimuleert eigenaarschap, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling binnen het team;
  • Je denkt actief mee over de verdere professionalisering en groei van de afdeling.

Een mooie combinatie van leidinggeven, commercie en inhoudelijke betrokkenheid, waarbij je daadwerkelijk invloed hebt op de ontwikkeling van jouw team en de organisatie.

Wat bieden ze jou?

Je komt terecht bij een groeiende financiële dienstverlener waar persoonlijke aandacht, samenwerking en ontwikkeling centraal staan. Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw leiderschapskwaliteiten verder te ontwikkelen en actief bij te dragen aan het succes van de organisatie.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Een marktconform salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring;
  • Een 13e maand;
  • Een werkweek vanaf 24 uur;
  • 26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen;
  • Een persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget voor opleidingen en verdere professionele groei;
  • Een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding;
  • Deelname aan collectieve verzekeringen en aantrekkelijke kortingsregelingen;
  • Een informele werkomgeving met korte lijnen en betrokken collega's;
  • Gezellige teamactiviteiten, vrijdagmiddagborrels en uitjes via de personeelsvereniging.

Waar kom je terecht?

Onze opdrachtgever is een snelgroeiende en onafhankelijke financiële dienstverlener met vestigingen in Den Helder en Schagen. De organisatie is gespecialiseerd in verzekeringen, hypotheken en bancaire producten en richt zich op zowel particuliere als zakelijke klanten.

De organisatie maakt deel uit van een grotere financiële groep met ruim 200 medewerkers, verspreid over 11 vestigingen in Nederland. Hierdoor profiteer je van de professionaliteit en mogelijkheden van een grotere organisatie, terwijl je dagelijks werkt in een betrokken team met korte communicatielijnen.

De bedrijfscultuur kenmerkt zich door een persoonlijke aanpak, ondernemerschap en een sterke focus op klanttevredenheid. Collega's werken nauw samen, delen hun kennis en krijgen de ruimte om initiatief te nemen.

Als Teamleider Particuliere Verzekeringen krijg je een belangrijke rol binnen de organisatie en de mogelijkheid om actief mee te bouwen aan de verdere groei en ontwikkeling van de particuliere afdeling.

Wat verwachten ze?

We zoeken een betrokken en resultaatgerichte teamleider die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat en gemakkelijk schakelt tussen leidinggeven en zelf meewerken. Je weet collega's te motiveren, durft beslissingen te nemen en hebt oog voor zowel commerciële kansen als de belangen van klanten.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau;
  • Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring in een commerciële functie, bij voorkeur binnen de verzekeringsbranche;
  • Aantoonbare managementkennis en leidinggevende ervaring;
  • De diploma's Wft Schadeverzekeringen Zakelijk, Wft Inkomen en Wft Vermogen;
  • Een commerciële en resultaatgerichte instelling;
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een coachende leiderschapsstijl;
  • Het vermogen om ontwikkelingen in de markt te signaleren en te vertalen naar concrete acties;
  • Een proactieve, besluitvaardige en hands-on werkhouding.

Ben jij klaar voor een volgende stap waarin je jouw kennis van verzekeringen combineert met leiderschap en commerciële verantwoordelijkheid? Dan komen we graag met je in contact!

title: Clinical Field Scheduling & Logistics Specialist
description:
This role is remote, though we're prioritizing candidates based in New Jersey.

The Clover Home Care team is responsible for ensuring patients have access to the right care at the right time, in the right setting. We are a group of caring and passionate professionals dedicated to improving the lives of our most vulnerable members by providing in-home primary care, annual wellness visits, supportive care services, behavioral health and community services coordination.

The Clinical Field Scheduling & Logistics Specialist supports the daily scheduling and logistics of our growing field-based clinical workforce. This role manages provider availability, assignments, routes, and real-time schedule changes to ensure patients receive timely care and field teams operate efficiently.

As a Clinical Field Scheduling & Logistics Specialist, you will:

  • Manage clinician schedules, profiles, availability, and service areas in CareLink.
  • Coordinate scheduling and logistics across New Jersey.
  • Optimize clinician routes based on geography, availability, and operational priorities.
  • Identify and resolve scheduling errors, overbooking, unused capacity, and coverage gaps.
  • Manage last-minute schedule changes caused by callouts, urgent requests, and field needs.
  • Coordinate daily assignments for Nurse Practitioners and Medical Assistants.
  • Support the PTO approval and schedule-update process in partnership with clinical managers.
  • Respond to real-time scheduling questions and resolve scheduling-related concerns.
  • Train new clinical team members and operational partners on CareLink workflows.
  • Use approved AI and automation tools to streamline repetitive workflows, improve accuracy, and reduce manual work.
  • Document processes and maintain cross-training to ensure consistent operational coverage.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have experience in scheduling, workforce coordination, field logistics, or healthcare operations.
  • You currently live in New Jersey, previously lived there, or can demonstrate extensive knowledge of New Jersey geography, travel patterns, and regional differences.
  • You have experience using AI or automation tools to improve business workflows.
  • You are highly organized and can manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • You have strong attention to detail and can quickly identify and resolve operational issues.
  • You communicate effectively with clinical, administrative, and leadership teams.
  • You are comfortable learning new systems and working in an evolving environment.
  • Experience with CareLink, healthcare scheduling, Google Workspace, or Excel is preferred.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Identity Development
description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Our vision is to ensure that every human and resource at LinkedIn is provided a non-repudiable identity that is used for secure communication, every access to data at LinkedIn is safe and all secret material is cryptographically protected. Our mission is to make this security infrastructure intuitive, performant, and secure. We build highly reliable and scalable services and developer-friendly infrastructure that enable engineering teams across the company to create and integrate secure features and proactively protect our members’ data.

The Identity Development (IDD) team builds the identity services and developer tools that help keep LinkedIn’s people, systems, and data secure. We make secure identity and access capabilities usable across LinkedIn’s engineering ecosystem—from single sign-on and authentication tooling to host access and directory services.

Our work includes services and libraries that support SSO, certificate-based host access, and identity and directory lookups. These capabilities serve internal engineering teams and operate at LinkedIn scale, where reliability, security, and a thoughtful developer experience are essential. You’ll join a collaborative team working across security, infrastructure, and product engineering to make secure access the straightforward path.

Role overview

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and operate identity platforms and tools used by engineering teams across LinkedIn. You’ll take ownership of significant projects from problem definition through production, make sound technical decisions, and partner with teams across the company to deliver secure, reliable, and intuitive solutions. You’ll also help raise the technical bar through design and code reviews, operational excellence, and mentorship.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and operate scalable identity and access services, libraries, and developer tools.

  • Lead technical projects end to end: clarify requirements, evaluate trade-offs, produce designs, deliver implementation, and measure results.

  • Build secure authentication and authorization experiences, including capabilities such as SSO, identity lifecycle integrations, certificate-based access, or directory services.

  • Develop reliable distributed systems and APIs that meet demanding availability, performance, and security requirements.

  • Partner with infrastructure, security, and product engineering teams to understand integration needs and deliver solutions that are easy to adopt.

  • Apply security and privacy principles throughout the software lifecycle, including threat-aware design, least privilege, and secure handling of credentials and identity data.

  • Improve service health through monitoring, testing, incident response, and operational practices; participate in the team’s on-call rotation as needed.

  • Contribute to technical direction through design reviews, code reviews, and clear engineering documentation.

  • Mentor engineers and share practices that improve code quality, team effectiveness, and developer experience.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production software.

  • 4+ years of programming experience in one or more languages such as Java, Go, or Python.

  • Experience with identity and access management, authentication, authorization, SSO, directory services, or identity lifecycle management.

  • Experience building backend services, APIs, or distributed systems.

  • Experience taking software changes through development, testing, code review, deployment, and production support.

  • Experience working effectively with technical partners across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or operating large-scale, highly available distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with security protocols and concepts such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, TLS/mTLS, public key infrastructure, SSH, or certificate-based authentication.

  • Experience with infrastructure automation, CI/CD, containers, or Kubernetes.

  • Experience improving the security, reliability, observability, or usability of internal developer platforms.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects, mentor peers, and influence decisions beyond an individual assignment.

  • Experience leveraging AI for production-grade code development.

  • Interest in building secure systems that are intuitive for developers and operate reliably at significant scale.

Suggested Skills

  • Distributed Systems

  • Identity and Access Management

  • Authentication and Authorization

  • Java/Go/Python

  • Production Operations

You will Benefit from our Culture:

We strongly believe in the well-being of our employees and their families. That is why we offer generous health and wellness programs and time away for employees of all levels.

LinkedIn is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The pay range for this role is $175,000 to $236,000. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. For more information, visit https://careers.linkedin.com/benefits.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We seek candidates with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. LinkedIn considers qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

LinkedIn is committed to offering an inclusive and accessible experience for all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. Our goal is to foster an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone has the opportunity to be successful.

  • Documents in alternate formats or read aloud to you

title: Associate Scientist I - Histotechnician
description:
Associate Scientist I – Histotechnician
Hourly Rate: $33 - $36/hr with medical benefits available at a cost
Contract Length: Initial contract through 7/25/27
Location: Onsite in Irvine, CA
Work Schedule: Monday – Friday 9 am to 5 pm

Position Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced histotechnician for an 8-month contract position supporting routine histology and immunohistochemistry (IHC) operations within the histology laboratory for Skincare R&D and Clinical Development.

This is a hands-on, lab-based role responsible for the processing, sectioning, and staining of formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissues, as well as performing special stains, IHC assays, and associated imaging/documentation. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment, maintains rigorous attention to quality and consistency, and has solid foundational histology bench skills.

Key Responsibilities
  • Perform routine processing of FFPE tissue specimens, including trimming, embedding, and block preparation
  • Section FFPE tissue blocks using a microtome to produce high-quality, consistent slides for downstream analysis
  • Perform routine histology staining (e.g., H&E) and special stains (e.g., Fontana-Masson, Resorcin Fuchsin, Herovici, etc.) per established SOPs
  • Perform manual and/or automated immunohistochemistry (IHC) staining, including antigen retrieval, antibody optimization support, and chromogenic/fluorescent detection
  • Operate and maintain histology laboratory equipment (microtomes, tissue processors, embedding stations, autostainers, coverslippers)
  • Perform slide imaging/scanning and organize digital image files for study team review
  • Maintain accurate, detailed records of samples, staining runs, and quality control checks in line with lab documentation practices
  • Troubleshoot staining and tissue quality issues, escalating as appropriate
  • Ensure proper labeling, tracking, and chain-of-custody for tissue specimens and slides
  • Maintain lab supplies, reagents, and equipment calibration/maintenance logs
  • Adhere to all laboratory safety protocols, including handling of chemicals (formalin, xylene, etc.) and biohazardous materials
  • Support general lab organization, inventory management, and cleanliness standards
  • Collaborate with scientists and lab management within Skincare R&D and Clinical Development to meet study timelines and quality expectations
Required Qualifications
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Biology, Medical Laboratory Science, Histotechnology)
  • Minimum of 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a histology laboratory, including FFPE tissue processing, microtome sectioning, and routine/special staining
  • Strong attention to detail and consistency in a high-throughput lab environment
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while following established SOPs
  • Good documentation and record-keeping habits
  • Ability to safely handle laboratory chemicals and biological specimens
Preferred Qualifications
  • HT or HTL certification (ASCP) or eligibility
  • Demonstrated experience performing IHC staining (manual and/or automated platforms)
  • Familiarity with slide imaging/digital scanning workflows
  • Experience with automated IHC/special stain platforms (e.g., Leica Bond, Ventana/Roche Discovery, Dako Autostainer)
  • Experience with whole-slide imaging/scanning systems
  • Prior experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO research lab setting (as opposed to clinical diagnostics)
  • Familiarity with GLP or GxP laboratory documentation practices
  • Experience in skincare/dermatology-focused research or clinical development studies is a plus

title: PER DIEM - School-Based Therapist

PER DIEM School-Based Therapist - Milpitas, CA Area

Transforming student mental health in schools.

About Effective School Solutions

Effective School Solutions (ESS) is a leading provider of school-based mental health services, serving 6,000+ K–12 students across 12 states.

We deliver the level of clinical care typically found in private practice, out-of-district placements, or higher levels of care directly within public schools- providing a full continuum of clinical programming, professional development, and district consultation.

Therapist in this role have flexibility in their level of commitment. They may choose to pick up occasional shifts, work a few days per week on an ongoing basis, or take on a temporary full-time schedule when covering a longer-term leave assignment. Per diem clinicians can accept or decline assignments based on their availability.

This role does not follow a consistent full-time schedule; however, full-time hours may be required on a temporary basis when covering extended leave assignments.

Why This Role Matters

You’ll provide critical mental health support to students who may not otherwise have access to care—helping them succeed academically, build resilience, and thrive.

At ESS, clinicians are trusted partners in shaping supportive school environments.

Responsibilities

Direct Clinical Care & Family Support

  • Provide comprehensive, school-based mental health services, including individual, group, and family therapy, as well as intake, diagnostic, and clinical assessments
  • Partner with families and facilitate parent support programming
  • Conduct risk assessments and crisis intervention, ensuring student safety and coordinating referrals to appropriate levels of care when needed
  • Develop and implement individualized, evidence-based treatment plans that support students’ emotional, behavioral, and academic success

Supervision, Training & Collaboration

  • Oversee the day-to-day clinical operations of the assigned school-based program

  • Participate in team meetings, supervision, and ongoing professional development

Documentation, Compliance & Professional Expectations

  • Maintain timely, accurate clinical documentation in accordance with regulatory, ethical, and organizational standards
  • Uphold professional standards by maintaining active licensure, ethical practice, reliability, and a strong professional presence
  • Monitor program performance and ensure alignment with ESS clinical and operational standards
  • Support clinician performance through feedback, coaching, and evaluations

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field
  • Active associate number or clinical license (e.g., AMFT, APCC, ACSW or LMFT, LPCC, LCSW) in the state of California
  • 2+ years of experience working with children and/or adolescents with behavioral and emotional needs
  • Experience providing training and coaching to educational professionals and parents/caregivers on student mental health issues.
  • Experience working with schools, families, and community-based services (school-based experience preferred)
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain trusting relationships with students, families, and school staff
  • Commitment to delivering high-quality, evidence-based care and advocating for best practices
  • Proven ability to positively influence, motivate, and elevate team members and stakeholders
  • Ability to make confident, sound decisions in ambiguous or evolving situations
  • Proficient in clinical documentation and use of electronic systems (e.g., EMR, Microsoft Office), with the ability to maintain accurate and timely records

Why Clinicians Choose ESS

✔ School-day schedule — No weekends; occasional evening hours as needed to support family engagement

title: Cultivation Associate
description:
Job Title: Cultivation Associate

Department: Cultivation

Work Location: Zanesville, OH

Who We Are

Grow Ohio is an Ohio-based company headquartered in Zanesville, Ohio. We are a Level 1 Cultivator, Processor & Retail operator licensed by the State of Ohio's Division of Cannabis Control (DCC). Grow Ohio has a state-of-the-art medical marijuana facility which houses our cultivation and processing operations in Newton Township, OH. Grow Ohio is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Cultivation Associate Laborer is primarily responsible for cleaning, upkeep, and sanitation of the cultivation facility. Including, but not limited to, breaking down and setting up rooms as well as washing and sanitizing all equipment for pests, viruses, and disease. At times, the Cultivation Associate – Laborer is responsible for quality and efficient cannabis plant trimming in preparation for sale. Duties include, but are not limited to, washing pots, cleaning rooms, moving plants and all other cleaning duties. Performing all duties in accordance with company best practices at the cultivation facility is the most important aspect of the Cultivation Associate – Laborer position

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The following represents a non-exhaustive list of the duties and responsibilities of this position.

  • Responsible for helping the Cultivation Team meet production demands and quality expectations.

  • Adhere to all policies and standard operating procedures (SOPS).

  • Adhere to company mission statement and core values, while maintaining high ethical standards and professionalism.
  • Perform other tasks as required.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma
  • At least 21 years of age.
  • Effective time management skills.
  • Detail oriented, highly organized, and motivated by accomplishment.
  • Ability to present ideas effectively and communicate well with all levels of management.
  • Ability to work in a team environment on a variety of programs and projects.
  • Advanced computer knowledge (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
  • Ability to work independently and in a continually changing environment.
  • Ability to multi-task effectively in a busy, high stress environment.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to work long hours.
  • The ability to lift 50 pounds regularly.
  • The ability to respond quickly to sounds.
  • The ability to move safely over uneven terrain or in confined spaces.
  • The ability to see and respond to dangerous situations.
  • The ability to wear personal protective gear correctly most of the day.
  • The ability to sit or stand for up to 12 hours at a time.
  • The ability to work in bright/hot/humid conditions.
  • The ability to work in high CO2 environments.
  • The ability to use a half face respirator.
  • The ability to complete fine motor functions.
  • The ability to work in low light situations.
  • Lifting, standing, sitting, walking, bending, reaching, push/pull, repetitive use of hands, grasping use of hands, visual activity.
  • Exposure to limited hazardous chemicals.
  • Capable of working in dark or bright environments.
  • Able to work in low oxygen areas.
  • Must be able to sit, stand, stoop, crouch, reach and lift for long periods of time.
  • Capable of working with or around caustic and potentially harmful chemicals.

  • Must be able to handle labor centric work.
  • Must be able to work in manufacturing or production facilities with moderate to loud noise level and changing working conditions. May require use of safety equipment or personal protective equipment, as needed.

title: EFP - Quality Assurance Technician
description:
QUALITY TECHNICIAN
EFP, LLC, La Vergne, TN
1st Shift: 6:30 am to 3:00 pm
Starting at $22 - $25 / hour
JOB SUMMARY
Reporting to the Director of Quality, the Quality Technician is responsible for supporting and maintaining product quality throughout the manufacturing process to ensure that all materials, components, and finished products meet established customer specifications, engineering and design requirements, internal quality standards, and applicable regulatory and quality system requirements. This position performs a variety of quality assurance and quality control activities, including incoming and outgoing inspections, in-process inspections, first-piece approvals, dock audits, material disposition support, and the identification and documentation of nonconforming materials and products.

DUTIES & ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Shipping / receiving inspection
Assist with PPAP process
Dock audits
Sort damaged material and repack if necessary
Track scrap from area
Maintain MRB area
Perform ISO9001 audits
Assist with production as needed
Maintain 5S activities
Performs other duties assigned
Reports to Director of Quality
Assist in creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s)
Conduct first piece approval audits
All other duties as assigned

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent
Strong knowledge of PPAP for manufacturing processes
Basic computer skills including Microsoft Office
Must be able to read a ruler, tape measure and other measuring devices
Ability to effectively communicate in English (Read, write and speak)
Two years of prior quality control experience preferred
ISO9001 certified auditor (preferred)
Detail oriented/organized

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Ability to stand or walk for extended periods of time
Occasional squatting, kneeling, bending and stooping
Lifting, carrying, pulling and pushing up to 40lbs

COMPANY OVERVIEW
An industry leader in providing practical solutions to foam molding and fabrication, EFP has a diversified product offering and serves the pharmaceutical, biotech, medical, automotive, recreational vehicle, appliance, plumbing, consumer goods, and building and construction industries. The company is headquartered in Elkhart, Indiana and has manufacturing locations in Elkhart, Indiana, Evansville, Indiana, Decatur, Alabama, La Vergne, Tennessee, Casa Grande, Arizona, and Bishopville, South Carolina.
EFP can design, mold, fabricate and provide fulfillment capabilities, kitting, assembly, custom systems, and inventory management. La Vergne is also home to the company’s Temperature Solutions Center of Excellence.
For more than 30 years, EFP LLC has been owned by J.B. Poindexter & Co., Inc., a privately held, diversified manufacturing company with operating subsidiaries throughout North America. In addition to expanded foam products, these companies produce commercial van bodies, step vans, funeral coaches, limousines, pick-up truck bed enclosures and tonneau covers, and precision machined components. The size and strength of the Poindexter companies provide EFP with leadership and resources to stay on the leading edge in today’s marketplace. Because of this, EFP can provide our customers with groundbreaking packaging and component solutions.
For more information about our company, access EFP's web site at www.efppackaging.com.
EFP offers a competitive wage and comprehensive benefits. EFP’s benefits package includes Health, Dental, Vision, Life, STD, LTD, FSA, HSA, 401(k) Plan with company contributions and others. We celebrate 10 paid holidays each year (starting day one) and our Team Member's enjoy accrued PTO in addition to their vacation time.

title: Patient Financial Counselor - Self Pay (Full-time)
description: The Patient Financial Representative (PFR) is the main financial contact for patients with self pay balances and/or without adequate financial resources. The PFR looks after the financial interests of the organization by securing sponsorship for patients unable to pay and collecting from patients able to pay. The PFR interacts with patients prior to service through financial counseling at the time of pre-registration and pre- certification, at the time of service through bedside financial counseling, point of service collections, and after service collections through tracking of Medicaid, SSI, SSDI, MCP, VA, Crime Victims, CHIP, liens, estates, financial assistance applications, bank loan program, and telephone collections. Essential Job Functions • Supports and models behaviors consistent with Billings Clinic’s mission, vision, values, code of business conduct and service expectations. Meets all mandatory organizational and departmental requirements. Maintains competency in all organizational, departmental and outside agency standards as it relates to the environment, employee, patient safety or job performance. • Performs financial counseling for self pay, MVA, and commercial insurance patients with deductibles greater than established guidelines, resolves any issue that the patient presents from areas in the hospital, clinics, nursing home, and other areas of Billings Clinic. Duties include interviews with patient and family members, identification of potential eligibility for SSI, SSDI, Medicaid, MCP, VA, Crime Victims, CHIP, liens, estates, financial assistance program and promotion of bank loan program. As each patient’s needs differ, assesses the situation and initiates the appropriate method to recommend/resolve the patient’s concern/dispute/issue. • Completes daily follow-up on outstanding self-pay balances. Daily performance includes but is not limited to speaking with patients in person, making and receiving telephone calls, establishes and monitors payment plans per policy and procedures and renegotiates payment plan arrangements when new accounts are combined into the payment plan or when patient’s circumstances change. Negotiates within established guidelines discounts with customers, including patients, attorneys and collection agencies. Dispute resolutions coordinating/working with Risk Management, Department Managers, Coding and Compliance, Insurance, Physicians, and any other area necessary to resolve the patient issues. Obtains HIPAA authorization forms, reviews and resolves issues identified in daily correspondence/ interoffice mail and replies to patient either by return mail or by phone. Performs customer service by providing assistance to customer inquiries including account information, insurance billing issues, and quality of care issues as appropriate. Coordinates with other departments as appropriate and advises patients about the outcome. • Coordinates financial counseling efforts with entities of Billings Clinic, other physician’s offices, other community health care providers and patients regarding insurance related information, procedures cost and charge estimates, coverage issues, and options for patients without insurance. Provides itemized statements needed by patients for their flex plans and other insurance coverage requiring a statement from the patient. • Accepts over the counter cash, check, credit /debit card payments, check by phone, completes employee payroll deduction forms, and finalizes bank loan paperwork with patients. Monitors, posts and adjusts on all collection agency payments. • Evaluates self-pay account balances for transfer to bad debt and assignment to outside collection agencies. Handles all functions required under bankruptcy discharges and requirements. • Utilizes performance improvement principles to assess and improve quality. • Provide Financial Counseling as a Certified Application Counselor for the Health Insurance Market Place • Identifies needs and sets goals for own growth and development; meets mandatory organizational and departmental requirements. • Maintains competency in all organizational, departmental and outside agency environmental, employee or patient safety standards relevant to job performance. • Performs other duties as assigned or needed to meet the needs of the department/organization.

title: Verpleegkundige ouderen - 24-36 uur - Dordrecht
description:
Ben jij verpleegkundige en wil je jouw vak uitoefenen op een plek waar je cliënten écht leert kennen? Waar verpleegkundige zorg, begeleiding en kwaliteit van leven samenkomen? Dan voel jij je waarschijnlijk thuis op onze nieuwbouw locatie Betje Wolff in Dordrecht. Deze opent januari 2027 , eerder starten kan maar dan op een locatie in Zwijndrecht.

Wij zoeken jou, of je nu 24 of 32 uur wilt werken!

Jouw rol

Als verpleegkundige in de gehandicaptenzorg ben je veel meer dan degene die verpleegtechnische handelingen uitvoert. Jij bent de medische spil van de locatie en zorgt ervoor dat medische zorg, begeleiding en welzijn naadloos op elkaar aansluiten.

Je werkt met ouder wordende cliënten met een verstandelijke beperking. Door het ouder worden zien we steeds vaker dementie, lichamelijke achteruitgang en complexere medische zorgvragen. Hierdoor combineer je ouderenzorg, verpleegkundige zorg en begeleiding in één veelzijdige functie.

Je werkt met een vaste groep bewoners waardoor je mensen, hun familie en hun levensverhaal echt leert kennen. Juist daardoor signaleer je veranderingen vroeg, kun je preventief handelen en draag je direct bij aan het welzijn van bewoners.

  • uitvoeren en coördineren van verpleegkundige zorg;
  • uitvoeren van verpleegtechnische handelingen zoals diabeteszorg, katheterzorg en sondevoeding;
  • bewaken van medicatieveiligheid, hygiëne en infectiepreventie;
  • afstemmen met huisarts, Arts-VG-, fysiotherapie, apotheek en andere disciplines;
  • ondersteunen en coachen van collega’s bij complexe lichamelijke zorg;
  • signaleren van veranderingen in gezondheid, gedrag of welzijn.

Je kijkt verder dan alleen de handeling. Je helpt bewoners zoveel mogelijk regie over hun eigen leven te houden, ook wanneer de zorg intensiever wordt. Je krijgt te maken met uiteenlopende zorgvragen zoals dementie, diabetes, epilepsie, mobiliteitsproblemen, palliatieve zorg en complexe medicatievraagstukken. Hierdoor blijf je jouw verpleegkundige kennis dagelijks inzetten én verder ontwikkelen.

Een collega-verpleegkundige vertelt hierover:

"Vijf jaar geleden heb ik de overstap gemaakt van de VVT naar de gehandicaptenzorg en dat is de beste keuze geweest die ik ooit heb gemaakt. In de gehandicaptenzorg heb ik meer ruimte om cliënten echt te leren kennen, hen te begeleiden in hun ontwikkeling en persoonsgerichte zorg te bieden. De afwisseling, uitdaging en het opbouwen van langdurige contacten geven mij veel werkplezier en voldoening."

Jouw werkplek

Januari 2027 opent Betje Wolff haar deuren in Dordrecht. Een volledig nieuwe woonlocatie voor ouderen met een verstandelijke beperking. Jij bouwt mee aan deze overgang, letterlijk en figuurlijk. Wat de locatie zo bijzonder maakt, is de balans tussen zelfstandigheid en nabijheid. Bewoners hebben hun eigen plek, maar weten dat er altijd iemand is die hen ziet, begrijpt en ondersteunt.

Wat bieden wij

Een leuke baan waar je met plezier naar toe gaat. Wij investeren in onze medewerkers en daarom krijg je de ruimte om te groeien, zoals jij dat wilt: met jouw talent en ambitie, maar ook met ons Leerhuis en de vele opleidingsmogelijkheden. Verder vinden we belangrijk dat er rust in een rooster zit zodat je weet waar je aan toe bent. Wij werken met een basisrooster wat voor een jaar wordt uitgerold ( vastgesteld rooster).Daarnaast krijg je:

  • een brutosalaris volgens de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg van minimaal € 3.113,- en maximaal € 4347,- in FWG 45 bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur, gebaseerd op je ervaring en opleiding. En bij onregelmatige diensten krijg je een extra toeslag;
  • Direct een contract voor onbepaalde tijd; tenzij er redenen zijn om hiervan af te wijken;
  • Mogelijkheid om jouw vakantietoeslag en/of eindejaarsuitkering elke maand laat uitbetalen.
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng en het ontwikkelen van jouw talenten, je werkt mee aan projecten en activiteiten;
  • Korting op uitjes, je sportschool en een interessante laptop- en fietsregeling en voordelen als extra vrije dagen tot aan coaching. Kies wat jij wilt;
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng; Wij zijn altijd op zoek naar mogelijkheden om onze begeleiding te verbeteren. Werken mee aan projecten en activiteiten!

Bekijk al onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een verpleegkundige die verder kijkt dan alleen medische handelingen. Je ziet de mens achter de zorgvraag en begrijpt dat begeleiding, ouderenzorg en verpleegkundige zorg hier samenkomen.

Je hebt:

  • een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-verpleegkunde opleiding (niveau 4 of 5);
  • een geldige BIG-registratie;
  • ervaring met ouderenzorg, dementie of complexe lichamelijke zorg;
  • affiniteit met mensen met een verstandelijke beperking;
  • het vermogen om overzicht te houden en collega’s te ondersteunen.

Solliciteren?

Wil je deel uitmaken van deze warme en betrokken omgeving? Solliciteer dan eenvoudig met je cv + een motivatiebrief is van harte welkom.
We bekijken sollicitaties doorlopend, dus reageer gerust meteen, heb je nog vragen neem dan even contact op met recruitment: Recruitment@philadelphia.nl

title: Vi ser etter en engasjert befrakter til vår avdeling i Harstad
description:
Trives du med å ha oversikten, ta raske beslutninger og få logistikken til å flyte?

PostNord søker nå en befrakter med arbeidssted i Harstad, som vil få ansvar for transportplanlegging og oppfølging i området Harstad og Stokmarknes.

Vi ser etter deg som trives med høyt tempo, smarte løsninger og tett samarbeid med både sjåfører, kunder og leverandører. Hos oss får du en operativ nøkkelrolle hvor du bidrar til å sikre effektiv transport, god kapasitetsutnyttelse og høy kvalitet i leveransene våre. Du blir en del av et godt sammensveiset team, hvor mange har jobbet i flere år. Her samarbeider vi tett, har et godt arbeidsmiljø og høy trivsel blant de ansatte.

Hva går rollen ut på?

Som befrakter får du ansvar for den daglige planleggingen og koordineringen av transporter i Harstad og Stokmarknes. Du følger opp sjåfører, har tett dialog med kunder og leverandører, samt sørger for at transportene gjennomføres på en trygg, effektiv og kostnadsbevisst måte.

Du blir en viktig del av laget som får logistikken til å fungere, også når planene må endres underveis.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil blant annet være å:

  • Planlegge og følge opp daglige ruter og sjåfører i Harstad og Stokmarknes
  • Sikre effektive transporter med høy servicegrad og god kapasitetsutnyttelse
  • Bidra til godt samarbeid mellom terminal, sjåfører og øvrige avdelinger
  • Ha løpende dialog med kunder og leverandører og følge opp avtaler og retningslinjer
  • Registrere og følge opp avvik, samt bidra til forbedring av rutiner og arbeidsprosesser
  • Bidra til god HMS og en trygg arbeidshverdag for medarbeidere og leverandører

Vi ser etter deg som har god forståelse for transport og logistikk, og som liker å finne løsninger i en hverdag der mye skjer samtidig.

Vi tror du har:

  • Utdanning innen logistikk eller transport, eller relevant erfaring som kan kompensere
  • Erfaring fra transportbransjen, gjerne innen befraktning, transportplanlegging eller tilsvarende
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å følge opp sjåfører og leverandører
  • God forståelse for effektiv ressursutnyttelse og kostnadsbevisst drift
  • Behersker norsk og engelsk godt, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter og evne til å sette deg inn i nye systemer

Hvem er du som person?

Du er strukturert, løsningsorientert og trives med å ha mange baller i luften. Du klarer å holde oversikten når tempoet øker, tar gode beslutninger og finner løsninger når uforutsette situasjoner oppstår.

Du kommuniserer tydelig, bygger gode relasjoner og samarbeider godt med menneskene rundt deg. Samtidig tar du eierskap til oppgavene dine og motiveres av å skape gode resultater sammen med andre.

Dette får du hos oss:

  • En variert og selvstendig rolle med ansvar for transportområdet Harstad og Stokmarknes
  • Mulighet til å påvirke og forbedre den daglige transport-driften
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer
  • En trygg arbeidsplass med gode HMS-rutiner
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling i PostNord

Høres dette ut som en mulighet for deg? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

Arbeidssted er Harstad, med ansvar for transportområdet Harstad og Stokmarknes.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen eller ønsker å vite mer, er du hjertelig velkommen til å ta kontakt med Bjørnar Johansen (Avdelingsleder), for en uforpliktende prat.

Vi ser frem til å motta søknaden din!
