title: Staff Software Engineer, Operations
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

About the Team

Fanatics Collectibles is the home of sports cards, trading cards, and collectibles for over 100 million fans worldwide. As part of the global Fanatics platform, we're rebuilding how collectors discover, buy, sell, and experience their hobby with world class technology and product experiences.

As part of Fanatics Collectibles’ continued global growth, we are establishing a new technology hub in Mexico City focused on operational excellence, platform scalability, trust, and customer experience. This team partners closely with Customer Experience (CX), Trust & Safety, Fraud Prevention, Payments, and Financial Operations organizations to build scalable systems and operational tooling that support millions of users and transactions globally.

Role Summary

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of scalable operational systems that support Customer Experience, Trust & Safety, Fraud Prevention, and Financial Operations across Fanatics Collectibles’ global platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with frontend engineers to define and expose clean, performant APIs and data contracts.
  • Work with DevOps/SRE to design robust CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Lead the design and implementation of microservices, event-driven workflows, and data pipelines.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and security for core backend systems.
  • Establish best practices for code quality, testing, performance tuning, and documentation.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, mentor peers, and promote continuous improvement.
  • Spearhead major initiatives—from feature conception through production rollout—across payments, inventory, search, and real-time notification services.
  • Identify technical risks, propose solutions, and coordinate cross-team deliveries.
  • Stay current on emerging backend technologies, cloud services, and industry trends.
  • Lead brown-bag sessions, hackathons, or tech talks to share knowledge across teams.

Basic Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field required.
  • 8+ years building backend services in high-traffic, distributed environments.
  • Deep knowledge of at least one major backend language (e.g., Java, Go, Python, Node.js) and its ecosystem.
  • Solid understanding of microservices, REST/GraphQL, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and relational/NoSQL databases.
  • Experience in AWS/GCP.
  • Hands-on with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CircleCI) and monitoring/logging stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Proven ability to work seamlessly with frontend, design, QA, and DevOps teams.
  • Strong verbal and written communication; experience running design discussions and writing technical specs.
  • Track record of guiding and growing other engineers—pair programming, code reviews, career coaching.
  • Ability to influence technical direction and drive consensus in a fast-paced environmen.

Code-Writing Contribution
Staff Software Engineers are expected to design and implement complex backend systems, influence architectural direction through hands-on technical leadership, and deliver scalable, maintainable production code.

title: Utility Line Technician
description:
Pay Range: $22.90 - $28.62/hr.

Job Posting Closing on: Friday, October 23, 2026 📅

Workdays & Hours: Field Operations is a 24/7 Operation - weekend work may be required. This position is a first responder in severe weather conditions/emergencies which will be subject to work after hours, emergency call back hours, nights, weekends, holidays and will participate in an on-call rotation schedule. This role requires proactive and dependable individuals who can quickly adapt to changing conditions and respond efficiently to urgent situations. Ensuring the smooth and safe operation of the water distribution and wastewater collection systems, maintaining the success of our operations team and the satisfaction of our customers during critical times.

Benefits for this position include: 11 Paid Holidays, Medical, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off, Pension Plan, Professional Development Opportunities. Find Out More!

The City of Fort Worth is one of the fastest growing large cities in the U.S. Our employees serve the needs of nearly 1,000,000 residents, promoting our values of exceptional customer experience, mutual respect, embracing our diversity, continuous improvement, ethical behavior, and accountability.

Water Distribution Maintenance • Utility locates, flushing and water quality

A Utility Line Technician position is available with the City of Fort Worth Water Department / Field Operations Division Locates/Water Quality section. The Field Operations Division is a 24/7 operation and is the largest division of the Water Department and an integral function of the maintenance of the City of Fort Worth’s infrastructure. This position is essential to the daily operations of the division and an integral role in the department's success. The ideal candidate will be responsible for responding to 811 utility locate tickets, communicating effectively with contractors, customers, and internal stakeholders; accurately locating and marking underground water and wastewater infrastructure; and interpreting utility records, including GIS data, engineering drawings, as-built plans, and other utility documentation. Responsibilities include conducting utility damage investigations, maintaining accurate records and documentation, and operating specialized utility locating equipment to ensure the protection of critical underground infrastructure.

In addition, the position will perform a variety of water quality-related duties, including investigating customer water quality concerns such as low chlorine residuals, taste and odor complaints, cloudy or discolored water, and other distribution system issues. The successful candidate will conduct routine and corrective flushing of water mains to maintain water quality, operate and optimize automatic flushing devices, evaluate water quality data to adjust flushing schedules, and ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and utility operating procedures.

Looking for a hands-on job that keeps your city flowing? Fort Worth Water is hiring Utility Line Technicians – Water Distribution Systems to help maintain and repair critical infrastructure beneath our streets.

You’ll operate advanced inspection tools, perform smoke testing, monitor sewer flow, and respond to service calls that keep Fort Worth’s wastewater collection system working safely and efficiently. This role is outdoors, physical, and essential—and it comes with opportunities to grow your skills and build a long-term career in public service.

If you’ve worked in utilities, field operations, or wastewater before—or want to learn from the ground up—this is your chance to join a dependable team doing important work that benefits the entire community.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED certification
  • Two (2) years of water/sewer utilities experience
  • Possess a valid driver's license and acceptable driving record
  • Ability to obtain a TCEQ Water Distribution D license is required within twelve months of hire. To obtain this license, you must be able to pass a written test and criminal background check
  • Must be able to pass a physical and drug screen testing

Preferred Qualifications:

  • At least one year of previous supervisory experience
  • Knowledge of work order management software
  • Possess a TCEQ Water Distribution C license or higher
  • Previous experience working with a large water utility
  • Possess a Class A CDL
  • PACP, LACP, and MACP certified

Utility Line Technician responsibilities include:

As a Utility Line Technician, you’ll be part of a team dedicated to maintaining and repairing our city’s vital water and sewer systems. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Maintaining and Repairing Water and Sewer Systems: You’ll be on the front lines ensuring our water and sewer systems are running smoothly, conducting everything from routine maintenance to more complex repairs
  • CCTV Video Assessments: Using state-of-the-art technology, you’ll conduct detailed inspections of the wastewater collection system to identify issues and keep everything flowing properly
  • Smoke Testing & Inspections: Play a key role in identifying system issues through smoke testing and manhole inspections—critical tasks that help prevent future problems and keep our systems working efficiently
  • Flow Monitoring & Equipment Maintenance: Install, monitor, and maintain flow monitoring equipment, providing essential data to help us improve our systems and track performance
  • Customer Support & Troubleshooting: You’ll be the go-to person for solving problems and answering questions from residents, contractors, engineers, and other stakeholders
  • Hands-on, Physical Work: This job involves manual labor—whether it’s installing new systems, repairing pipes, or maintaining infrastructure, you’ll be doing meaningful work that directly impacts the community
  • Reporting & Documentation: Stay on top of important paperwork by completing city-specific forms, surveys, and reports, ensuring we maintain the highest standards of operation

Working Conditions and Physical Demand:

Depending on assignment, positions in this class typically require touching, talking, hearing, seeing, grasping, standing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, walking, repetitive motions, climbing, balancing, pushing, pulling and lifting; depending on assignment. Incumbents may be exposed to moving mechanical parts, odors, dusts, poor ventilation, chemicals, oils, extreme temperatures, inadequate lighting, intense noises, gases, vibrations, chemicals, oils and workspace restrictions.

Heavy Work – Depending on assignment, positions in this class typically exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of force constantly having to move objects.

title: Day Program Manager
description:
Salary: $35,568/yr.

SUMMARY
The Day Program Manager is responsible to manage the services delivered to a designated program or set of programs, and the operation of programs including organization and implementation of direct supports, person-centered planning and implementation, health care, advocacy, stakeholder relations, regulatory compliance, staffing, training, financial management and maintenance of the physical environment.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function listed below.
Staff Management: Oversees implementation of human resource practices including recruitment, retention, training, scheduling, processing, record keeping, and management of program employees;
1. Recruitment & Hiring:

  • Participates in the recruitment and interviewing of all staff;
  • Hires direct staff members in consultation with the PM’s manager; and approves the hiring of direct support professionals and other indirect staff members.

2. Meetings & Training:

  • Organizes and implements on-site orientation and training for assigned programs; and monitors training compliance and documentation.
  • Conducts monthly staff meetings; attends monthly regional meetings.

3. Employee Scheduling:

  • Designs and monitors schedules to assure that all shifts are covered;
  • Monitors and minimizes overtime.

4. Performance Evaluation:

  • Conducts annual performance evaluations for direct reports in consultation with the PM’s manager;
  • Reviews and approves annual Direct Support Professional and other staff member’s performance evaluations.

5. Coaching, Discipline and Termination:

  • Coaches employees, correcting or directing employee behavior where required;
  • May remove employees in the event of emergency;
  • May recommend and participate in decisions regarding discipline and termination in consultation with the PM’s manager and Human Resources;
  • Manages the termination of Direct Support Professionals or other staff members as necessary;

6. Employee Safety:

  • Responsible for employee safety and workers’ compensation programs;
  • Monitors compliance; and assists in returning employees to work;
  • Implements, oversees, and trains employees about safety.

Program Management: Manages the implementation of program planning; monitors delivery of services and supports; ensures services are consistent, engaging and relevant to the individuals served.
1. Program Planning:

  • Writes and approves individual program plans (as appropriate);
  • Trains and assists appropriate staff members with implementation of plans across all shifts.

2. Records:

  • Periodically audits individual records and other program documentation for accuracy and completion.

3. Program Team Meetings:

  • Conducts progress meetings and (quarterly, annual and/or other) reviews as appropriate or determined by the interdisciplinary team;
  • Provides and approves written and progress reviews.

4. Compliance:

  • Oversees licensing compliance for program services and supports;
  • Ensures timely and accurate program documentation;
  • Implements the Network compliance plan; and manages individual rights implementation.

5. Management of Individuals’ Assets:

  • Implements system and oversees management of individual’s funds and property, assuring safety and accuracy; audits, monitors and reviews individual’s financial accounts (as applicable)

6. Stakeholder Relations:

  • Maintains productive and professional relations with individuals, families, case managers and other stakeholders;
  • Provides regular communication to stakeholders; and acts as point of contact for all stakeholders;
  • Implements satisfaction improvement plans.

7. Incidents:

  • Implements proactive strategies to reduce or eliminate serious incidents;
  • Takes immediate steps to correct potential safety concerns and limit the potential for continued concern or incident;
  • Reviews all incidents and directs appropriate response; ensures timely incident reporting; and signs and submits all incident reports as required.

Health Care: Oversees implementation of individual health care while in Day Program’s care; implements strategies to limit illness or serious incident; oversees and reviews health care documentation.
1. Medications:

  • Oversees system for medication administration, documentation and security;
  • Reviews documentation for accuracy and completeness;
  • Assures all applicable employees are certified or trained in medication administration.

2. Medical Supplies and Equipment:

  • Approves purchases of medical supplies and equipment; and ensures training on proper use to all employees.

3. Dietary planning:

  • Monitors food service in accordance with dietary plans and to meet regulatory compliance;
  • Ensures consideration for special needs, occasions and individual choice.

Finance: Responsible for the financial performance of the program, from billing to staff budgets, as well as reviewing and approving purchases
1. Purchasing:

  • Approves purchase of food, supplies and equipment; and reviews and monitors monthly invoices for accuracy and budgetary compliance.
  • Attests to company credit card statements and monthly invoices in accordance with company policy.

2. Billing and utilization:

  • Oversees census, attendance information or other required documentation to assure accurate billing;
  • Monitors utilization between authorization and provision of services and supports.

3. Staffing:

  • Monitors staffing hours for budgetary compliance.

4. Growth:

  • Maximizes census, average daily attendance and utilization.

Maintenance: Oversees the maintenance and cleanliness of the program’s facilities and vehicles.
1. Vehicles:

  • Ensures vehicles are properly maintained, clean, and safe by consulting with maintenance personnel;
  • Implements training procedures for maintenance and safe operation of company-owned vehicles;
  • Addresses known safety concerns with employee vehicles or other means of transportation, for the safe transport of individuals.

2. Housekeeping:

  • Monitors and implements strategies to assure neat, clean, and safe program environments (internal and external);
  • Ensures age appropriate and esthetic decoration.

3. Maintenance and Repair:

  • Oversees environmental safety program; establishes preventive maintenance schedule; maintains furnishings, equipment and facilities in good repair and compliant with regulatory standards.

Other:

  • Attends monthly regional meetings and additional meetings as needed
  • Performs other related duties and activities as required.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manages the direct or indirect staff members of the program including performance evaluations, scheduling, orientation, and training. Makes recommendations and/or decisions on employee hires, transfers, promotions, salary changes, discipline, terminations, and similar actions. Resolves employee problems within position responsibilities.

Minimum Knowledge and Skills required by the Job
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities required to perform the job.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree and two to three years of related experience in the Human Services Industry preferred.
  • An equivalent combination of education and experience which provides proficiency in the areas of responsibility listed above may be substituted for the above education and experience requirements.
  • Other education and experience as required by applicable regulations.

Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations:

  • Current driver's license, car registration and auto insurance if driving on the behalf of the Company or providing transportation to individuals receiving services.
  • Licensure as required by state.
  • Medication Management Certificate issued with the completion of Company provided training.
  • Mandatory Reporter Certificate issued with the completion of Company provided training
  • Other training and/or certification per state requirements and/or service line.

Other Skills and Abilities:

Other Requirements:

  • Travel as needed

Physical Requirements:

  • Medium Work. Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 30 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES STATEMENT
External and internal applicants, as well as position incumbents who become disabled, must be able to perform the essential job functions either unaided or with assistance of a reasonable accommodations to be determined on a case by case basis via the interactive process.

description:

Temporary Transportation Analyst, 3 Month Assignment

PURPOSE OF POSITION

The Temporary Transportation Analyst supports SMA America’s Transportation team for a defined assignment of approximately three months. This role keeps freight analysis, carrier performance reporting, and shipment data accurate and on schedule, helping the team move inverters and components to customers across the United States reliably and cost effectively.

PRIMARY DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Analyze freight costs, carrier rates, and shipment data to identify savings and trends.
  • Audit and reconcile carrier invoices against quotes, contracts, and shipment records.
  • Maintain accurate shipment and freight data in SAP and the transportation management system.
  • Prepare weekly and month end reports on freight spend, carrier performance, and on time delivery.
  • Support Transportation Coordinators with rate quotes, carrier selection, and shipment issue resolution.
  • Track open shipments and escalate delays or exceptions to the appropriate teams.
  • Collaborate with Logistics, Customer Service, Finance, and carrier partners to resolve billing and delivery issues.
  • Other duties as may be required or assigned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in transportation, freight, or logistics analysis.
  • Experience with freight invoice auditing, carrier rates, and LTL and FTL shipping.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and lookups, plus Word and Outlook.
  • Experience with SAP or a comparable ERP system, and a transportation management system.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage month end deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with internal teams and carrier partners.
  • Availability to work core business hours, Pacific time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in manufacturing, energy, or industrial equipment shipping.
  • Familiarity with customs documentation and cross border shipments.

WE OFFER

  • Pay: $40.00 to $42.00 per hour, dependent on experience and qualifications.
  • Assignment: Temporary, full time, approximately three months from the start date.
  • Employment: This assignment is through our staffing partner, AppleOne, which serves as the employer of record.
  • Work Model: Remote within the United States.
  • A collaborative Transportation team and hands on experience with a global leader in solar technology.

title: Bijbaan Gehandicaptenzorg  | Heerde | Kanaalstraat
description:
Volg jij een zorg gerelateerde opleiding en wil je naast je studie waardevolle praktijkervaring opdoen? Op de Kanaalstraat in Heerde werk je met ouder wordende mensen met een verstandelijke beperking. Je draait echt mee in de zorg, leert bewoners goed kennen en maakt met jouw aandacht iedere dag verschil.

Jouw werkplek

Op de Kanaalstraat wonen 24 ouder wordende mensen met een verstandelijke beperking, ieder in een eigen appartement. De locatie heeft vier gezamenlijke huiskamers, verdeeld over drie verdiepingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Lichte ADL-taken en persoonlijke verzorging zijn een belangrijk onderdeel van deze bijbaan. Je draait mee in de dagelijkse zorg en krijgt de kans om veel praktijkervaring op te doen.

Je:

  • Ondersteunt bewoners bij de lichte ADL en persoonlijke verzorging;
  • Activiteiten zoals samen wandelen, muziek luisteren, of gewoon even zitten in stilte, eten geven
  • Werkt samen met ervaren collega's en leert van hun kennis en ervaring;
  • En bovenal: je bent er als mens. Jij bent degene die het verschil maakt, gewoon omdat je oprecht aanwezig bent, de handen uit de mouwen weet te steken.

Je hoeft nog niet alles te kunnen. We kijken naar wat je vanuit je opleiding al beheerst en begeleiden je bij de werkzaamheden die je verder wilt leren.

Wie ben jij?

Jij volgt een zorg gerelateerde opleiding op mbo- of hbo-niveau en wilt jouw kennis graag in de praktijk brengen.

Daarnaast:

  • Ben je leergierig en durf je vragen te stellen;
  • Sta je open voor lichte ADL en persoonlijke verzorging;
  • Kun je rustig werken en heb je oog voor verbale en non-verbale signalen;
  • Ben je betrokken en betrouwbaar;
  • Je zoekt geen 'zorgbaan', maar een plek waar je leert over het leven en waar je bij kan dragen aan de missie de wereld te vergroten voor de bewoners.

Werktijden

We stemmen je werkdagen en uren zoveel mogelijk af op jouw studie en beschikbaarheid. Je kunt worden ingezet van maandag tot en met zondag, waarbij ook avond-, weekend- en feestdagendiensten kunnen voorkomen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een bijbaan waar je je vak écht leert in de praktijk.
  • Salaris volgens CAO Gehandicaptenzorg, tussen de € 14 en € 20 per uur – passend bij je opleiding en ervaring.
  • Fijne (weekend)diensten in overleg (ochtend, avond of beide).
  • Begeleiding op maat – je staat er nooit alleen voor.
  • Een warm team dat jouw ontwikkeling serieus neemt.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij naast je opleiding praktijkervaring opdoen én iets betekenen voor ouder wordende mensen met een verstandelijke beperking? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Een cv of motivatiebrief is niet nodig. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar jou.

title: Provider Data Coordinator
description:
NOT A REMOTE POSITION

A new opportunity awaits an Provider Data Coordinator at Santé Health System in Fresno, CA. Supporting the Provider Credentialing department, this full-time position is directly responsible for coordinating provider demographic data and ensuring demographic changes are processed timely and accurately along with ensuring accuracy of data as well as meeting all regulatory requirements as applicable.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School diploma/GED equivalent required.
  • Three years' experience in data analytics to include at least one year of experience in a healthcare setting preferred.
  • Experience and working knowledge of clinic operations.
  • Proficient user of MS Office Suite primarily Microsoft Excel.
  • Working knowledge of managed care environment and associated lines of business such as HMO/Commercial/Medicare/Medicaid.
  • Knowledge of database software applications is a plus.

CRITICAL SUCCESS FACTORS

Success will require well-developed competencies in these areas:

  • Working knowledge of MD Staff platform and related systems and software technologies.
  • Ability to exercise initiative, judgment and decision-making.
  • Knowledge of local provider market.
  • Ability to work independently and as a team member.
  • Excellent time management, multi-tasking, and prioritization skills required.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with varied professional audiences.
  • Ability to assimilate and present information logically.
  • Ability to read, analyze and interpret provider demographic data.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Serves as a key liaison between health plans, providers and internal staff to process, review and communicate provider demographic data
  2. Maintains provider database and demographic data for health plan rosters/directories, ensuring that data accurately reflects provider participation on various panels.
  3. Responsible for communicating demographic changes to health plans and internal staff via template report.
  4. Generates reports, both routine and ad hoc to appropriate staff or delegated groups
  5. Assists health plans with quarterly data validation queries
  6. Responds to health plan inquiries related to provider demographic data
  7. Accountable for optimal usage of the existing data systems and applications
  8. Data mining, summarizing, validation and integrity of provider demographic data
  9. Responsible for supporting Provider Credentialing initiatives including data entry, roster audits and overall provider roster.
  10. Actively participate in health plan meetings, serving as the IPA's representative
  11. Actively participate in cross-functional projects having an impact on Provider Credentialing
  12. In the spirit of teamwork, employees are expected to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties as requested.

ABOUT SANTE HEALTH SYSTEM

Sante Health System is a Management Services Organization that serves multiple clients. "Sante" is the French word for health. Our name symbolizes our commitment to good health, progressive care, and leadership in our community.

Sante is one of the largest healthcare claims and billing management companies in Central California. The strength of Sante is the extraordinary network of physicians, health plans, and other health service providers it offers the people of our valley. Sante coordinates with physicians, health plans, hospitals, and ancillary providers to ultimately benefit the patient in a managed care environment. Sante Health System provides numerous client services such as billing, claims processing, contracting, credentialing, finance, human resources, information services, marketing/communications, physician services, practice management, provider relations, quality improvement, and utilization management.

Sante is celebrating over 25 years of dedicated service to the community. We deeply understand that we would not be successful in enhancing the quality of life of our patients without our incredible team. This is why we have created a work culture that is comprised of talented, driven, dedicated, innovative, and service-driven professionals. We provide competitive pay, excellent benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, 401k retirement plan, paid time off, and opportunities for advancement. Being part of our team is like being part of a big family. Join our team and make Sante Health System your home away from home.

ARE YOU READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM?

If you feel that you are right for this position, apply now! We look forward to meeting you!

title: ITGRC Analyst
description:
Job Description

As an IT Governance, Risk and Compliance Analyst, you will apply your subject matter expertise in IT risk management and compliance to enhance and implement policies and standards, maintain control assurance activities, support IT audits, evaluate and improve IT controls, execute security and risk assessments, provide insights and guidance to IT and business stakeholders, and assess and document compliance with laws, regulations, directives, and contracts. You will also support the governance, risk and compliance tooling, and the vendor risk management program.

You will report to the Manager of IT Governance, Risk and Compliance and work closely with various stakeholders across the organization. You will also have strong communication and collaboration skills, as well as the ability to recommend risk treatment or mitigation strategies that align with the tactical and strategic priorities of the company. If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding role in a dynamic and innovative organization, this is the opportunity for you.

The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge and work experience in IT general controls, ISO27001 and SOC2 frameworks, and can work with local and global IT and business partners to provide guidance and support to the company.

Key Responsibilities

Under the direction of the Manager of IT Governance, Risk and Compliance, the successful candidate will:

Support the ITGRC program and the global ISMS initiative ensuring sustainable compliance practices across the organization
Evaluate and monitor compliance to D&D’s IT controls, policies and standards and perform gap assessments.
Review and support stakeholders in responding to customer due diligence questionnaires.
Facilitate and coordinate ad hoc and periodic internal/external assessments, audits, and certifications, such as vendor assessments by key customers, ITGC and SOC 2 audits, and ISO 27001 certification, including evidence gathering, walkthrough coordination and management response to identified findings.
Assist in driving the vendor security risk assessment program using D&D’s 3rd-party risk assessment tool and support the vendor due diligence process.
Assist in updating and maintaining policies, guidelines, and documentation that support the organization's IT GRC strategy. Work closely with other departments to ensure policies are communicated, understood, and followed.
Support the development and maintenance of D&D’s global risk register and support risk treatment planning, monitoring, and reporting processes.
Document and report control failures and gaps to stakeholders / control owners. Provide remediation guidance and prepare stakeholders' reports to track remediation activities.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Information Security, Risk Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Experience: At least 1-3 years of experience in governance, risk management, compliance, or audit roles.

Technical Skills:

Knowledge of applicable regulatory frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS).
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) tracking and reporting tools.
Security+, ISO 27001 Foundation, or any other IT Security or GRC certificate

Soft Skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
Effective communication skills, with the ability to present complex information to various stakeholders.
Ability to collaborate across teams and drive compliance initiatives.
Strong time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.

Benefits

At Dye & Durham we strive to be visionaries! As a leader in our field, we ensure our employees are ready for the next challenge in their journey with us by offering internal and external training opportunities. We offer competitive salaries and a whole host of benefits including healthcare, pension, company discounts, wellness programs, and paid days off to move house or volunteer for your favourite charity.

Do you share our DNA?

We ask how tomorrow can be better than today
We are passionate about solving our customer's challenges
Our ideas break boundaries
We value different perspectives and encourage dialogue
We take ownership and celebrate together

In line with the amended Employment Standards Act 2000, the salary range for this role is: $65K - 85K, dependent on assessment of skills during the interview process.

At Dye & Durham, we are fortunate to connect with exceptional talent across our business. While we carefully evaluate every submission, if you do not hear from our Talent team within 14 days of applying, it indicates that we are moving forward with other candidates for this role. Due to volume, we are unable to provide personalized feedback on initial applictaions, but we encourage you to stay connectedfor future opportunities.

title: Software Product Manager
description:
Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we’re building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements each day on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence helps protect critical assets, characterize activity in orbit, monitor emerging threats, and enable safer and more effective operations for commercial and government missions.

We’re not just building technology—we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and the operating environment becomes increasingly complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, satellite operations, and national security missions around the world.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the intersection of aerospace, national security, software, data, and AI, your impact starts here. This position is contingent upon final approval, with an anticipated hiring timeline beginning as early as January 2027. We are beginning the search in advance of the anticipated hiring timeline.

LeoLabs is seeking a Software Product Manager to join our Product organization and lead the continued development, commercialization, and growth of our SDA software product , one of LeoLabs’ core software products.

Our SDA software product transforms LeoLabs’ radar data and space-domain information into operational intelligence, analytics, alerts, and mission workflows that help customers understand what is happening in orbit and act with greater speed and confidence.

This role sits at the intersection of customers, market needs, product strategy, engineering, and business objectives. You will be responsible for understanding customer missions and market opportunities, defining where our SDA software product should compete, translating those needs into differentiated product capabilities, and helping turn those capabilities into products customers can adopt and buy.

The ideal candidate is a strong product thinker with both commercial and technical judgment. You should have experience working in the space industry or in a closely related aerospace or national-security environment, be comfortable engaging directly with sophisticated commercial and government customers, and be able to translate complex mission problems into clear product and business direction.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the product and business strategy for our SDA software product, including product vision, roadmap, market positioning, prioritization, packaging, and execution
  • Develop a deep understanding of our SDA software product customers, users, missions, workflows, operational challenges, and buying behavior
  • Work directly with commercial and government customers, operators, analysts, internal stakeholders, and subject-matter experts to identify unmet needs, validate product opportunities, and understand where LeoLabs can create differentiated value
  • Identify and prioritize market segments, use cases, and customer problems where Our SDA software product can create meaningful mission impact and business growth
  • Translate customer, mission, and business requirements into clear product requirements, capabilities, user experiences, and prioritized development work
  • Partner closely with Engineering throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery and definition through development, testing, release, and iteration
  • Make product investment decisions based on customer value, strategic differentiation, revenue potential, technical feasibility, scalability, and company priorities
  • Define how our SDA software product capabilities are packaged and positioned so customers can clearly understand what they are buying, why it matters, and how it supports their mission
  • Partner with Sales, Business Development, Marketing, and Customer Success to support customer engagements, product demonstrations, proposals, strategic pursuits, pilots, and go-to-market activities
  • Help shape pricing, packaging, and commercial models for our SDA software product offerings in partnership with Product leadership and other business stakeholders
  • Maintain and communicate a clear product roadmap and ensure alignment across Product, Engineering, Sales, Business Development, Customer Success, Operations, and company leadership
  • Define and monitor product and business metrics that measure adoption, usage, customer outcomes, time-to-value, retention, expansion, revenue impact, and overall product performance
  • Lead product launches and internal enablement, ensuring that Sales, Customer Success, and other customer-facing teams can effectively communicate and sell new our SDA software product capabilities
  • Continuously evaluate competitors, adjacent markets, customer acquisition trends, emerging technologies, and changes in the space and national-security environment to identify new opportunities for our SDA software product
  • Distinguish between individual customer requests and repeatable market needs, ensuring our SDA software product evolves as a scalable product rather than a collection of one-off solutions
  • Help establish and improve product management practices as LeoLabs continues to scale its product organization

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably with software, data, analytics, enterprise, or other highly technical products
  • Professional experience working in the space industry, or in a closely related aerospace, defense, or national-security environment, with demonstrated understanding of space missions, customers, operators, or technologies
  • Demonstrated experience owning products or major product areas from market discovery and product strategy through development, launch, adoption, and iteration
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to connect product decisions to customer outcomes, competitive differentiation, revenue opportunities, and company strategy
  • Strong customer orientation and experience engaging directly with customers to uncover needs, validate opportunities, and translate feedback into scalable products
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical, operational, or customer problems into clear product direction and priorities
  • Experience working closely with software engineering teams and technical leaders throughout the product development lifecycle
  • Ability to make informed prioritization decisions across competing customer requests, business opportunities, strategic priorities, and technical constraints
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, customers, executives, operators, and other technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to use both quantitative and qualitative information to make product decisions
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where customer needs, technology, and market conditions can evolve quickly
  • Curiosity and willingness to develop deeper expertise in complex space, technical, and mission domains
  • Ability to operate with a high degree of ownership and independently drive product decisions while building alignment across multiple organizations
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally to engage directly with customers, partners, and internal teams. LeoLabs is a global company with customers and users around the world, and this role will require periodic travel to understand customer missions, support key engagements, and represent the product in-market

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building and commercializing products for government, aerospace, defense, intelligence, or other highly technical markets
  • Direct experience with Space Domain Awareness, Space Situational Awareness, Space Traffic Management, satellite operations, orbital analysis, command and control, or related space missions
  • Experience working with satellite operators, space mission operators, U.S. government space organizations, allied defense organizations, or commercial space companies
  • Familiarity with orbital mechanics, tracking data, conjunction assessment, maneuver detection, satellite behaviors, or other space-domain concepts
  • Experience supporting government acquisition processes, strategic pursuits, proposals, demonstrations, pilots, or customer evaluations
  • Experience working with data-intensive products, APIs, analytics platforms, event detection, visualization tools, or operational decision-support systems
  • Experience defining product packaging, pricing, positioning, or go-to-market strategy
  • Experience working directly with government and commercial customers in complex enterprise sales environments
  • Technical background or demonstrated experience working closely with highly technical engineering, data science, scientific, or aerospace teams
  • Experience working in markets where customer requirements may be ambiguous, procurement cycles are complex, and product managers must identify common product needs across multiple customer missions
  • Active U.S. Government security clearance, or the ability and willingness to obtain and maintain one, is preferred

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:

  • Our SDA software product has a clear product and market strategy that is aligned with LeoLabs’ broader business objectives and differentiated from competing offerings
  • The organization has a strong understanding of our SDA software product ’s target customers, priority missions, use cases, value propositions, and commercial opportunities
  • Our SDA software product capabilities are packaged and positioned in ways that are easy for customers to understand, evaluate, purchase, and adopt
  • Engineering has clear product direction, well-defined priorities, and a strong understanding of the customer and business outcomes behind the work
  • Customer and market feedback consistently inform product decisions without allowing one-off customer requests to derail the broader product strategy
  • Our SDA software product delivers measurable improvements in customer mission outcomes, adoption, usage, retention, and overall customer value
  • Our SDA software product contributes meaningfully to LeoLabs’ revenue growth through new customer acquisition, expansion, strategic programs, and increased product adoption
  • Sales and Business Development teams have compelling products, demonstrations, messaging, and supporting materials that allow them to confidently take our SDA software product to market
  • Cross-functional teams have clear visibility into product priorities, upcoming capabilities, market positioning, and product launches
  • Our SDA software product continues to evolve based on customer outcomes, market demand, competitive dynamics, product data, and LeoLabs’ long-term strategy

Compensation

This position is benchmarked to Denver, CO with a base salary range of $171,000–$194,000, plus bonus and equity. Actual base salary will be determined based on the candidate’s work location, experience, skills, and other applicable factors

Perks and Benefits

  • 100 USD monthly wellness benefit to support your health and well-being
  • $300 USD home office setup stipend, available for use within your first six months
  • $75 USD monthly home internet allowance, paid directly through your regular paycheck
  • Individual Development Fund to support training, learning, and professional development
  • Employee Recognition Program to celebrate contributions and achievements across the team
  • Employee Referral Program so you can help us connect with great talent
  • And much more!

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. More information regarding ITAR can be found at DDTC’s website.

title: Myyntineuvottelija
description:
Avain Asunnot etsii Lahteen myyntityöstä ja asumisesta innostunutta myyntineuvottelijaa – olisitko se sinä?


Tehtävänkuvaus

Myyntineuvottelijana tärkein tehtäväsi on löytää asiakkaillemme heidän tarpeitaan vastaava koti. Asumisoikeusasuntojen myynnin ja asiakaspalvelun lisäksi vastaat muun muassa sopimusneuvotteluista, asuntoesittelyjen järjestämisestä, asiakkaiden kontaktoinnista puhelimitse ja sähköpostitse sekä asuntojen markkinointiin liittyvien tietojen päivittämisestä eri järjestelmissä.

Lahden toimipisteeltä käsin vastaat laajasta maantieteellisestä alueesta, johon kuuluvat tällä hetkellä Lahden lisäksi muun muassa Hollola, Mäntsälä, Porvoo, Kotka ja Hamina. Sinulla on päävastuu alueesi myyntityön suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta. Lahden toimipisteellä työskentelee lisäksesi kaksi myyntikoordinaattoria, ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myös muiden alueiden myyntineuvottelijoiden, markkinoinnin kanssa sekä erityisesti kiinteistöyksikön kanssa.

Työssäsi tavoitteena on kehittää alueen asuntokannan käyttöastetta, tarjota laadukasta asiakaspalvelua ja edistää aktiivisesti asuntojen myyntiä. Pääset vaikuttamaan tuloksiin omalla tekemiselläsi, mutta työskentelet samalla osana valtakunnallista myynnin organisaatiota yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamiseksi.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?

Avain Asuntojen myyntineuvottelijaksi sopii energinen, myynnillinen ja oma-aloitteinen tekijä, joka innostuu asiakaskohtaamisista ja tavoitteellisesta työstä. Laaja toimialue edellyttää sinulta valmiutta liikkua alueella asuntoesittelyjen ja muiden asiakastapaamisten mukaan sekä työskennellä lähityössä Lahden toimipisteellä.

Vastaat itse työsi ja kalenterisi suunnittelusta, joten tehtävässä menestyminen vaatii hyvää organisointikykyä ja taitoa priorisoida tekemistä muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Pystyt pitämään langat käsissäsi laajassakin kokonaisuudessa ja työskentelemään samalla huolellisesti yksityiskohtien, kuten sopimusasioiden, parissa.

Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen ja tueksesi joukon kokeneita alan osaajia. Arvostamme aktiivisen ja itsenäisen työotteen rinnalla joustavuutta, yhteistyökykyä ja halua työskennellä yhteisten tavoitteiden eteen.

Sinulta odotamme:

  • Aiempaa kokemusta tavoitteellisesta myynti- ja asiakaspalvelutyöstä
  • Oma-aloitteista ja tavoitteellista työotetta sekä kykyä organisoida ja priorisoida omaa tekemistäsi
  • Asiakaslähtöistä palveluasennetta, huolellisuutta sekä joustavuutta työaikoihin ja liikkumiseen laajalla toimialueella
  • Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa sekä MS Office -ohjelmien käyttökokemusta
  • B-ajokorttia ja valmiutta toimia virkavastuulla asumisoikeusasuntojen asukasvalinnoissa

Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:

  • Aiempi kokemus kiinteistöalalta, erityisesti asuntojen myynnin tai vuokrauksen tehtävistä
  • LVV- tai LKV-tutkinto

Avain Asunnot tarjoaa sinulle:

  • Monipuolisen, itsenäisen ja vaihtelevan tehtävänkuvan, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi asumisoikeusasuntojen maailmassa. Avain Asunnot tarjoaa myös mahdollisuuden suorittaa esim. LKV-tutkinnon työn ohessa
  • Kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten lounas-, liikunta-, ja työmatkaedun, kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä erilaiset henkilökunnan yhteiset tilaisuudet ja virkistystapahtumat. Lisäksi mahdollisuuden hyödyntää Tahkon loma-osaketta viikoksi vuosittain
  • Kiinteän kuukausipalkan rinnalla kuukausittain maksettavan myyntiprovision
  • Lämminhenkisen, yhteen hiileen puhaltavan ja avoimeen keskusteluun kannustavan työkulttuurin ja työyhteisön, jossa otetaan aidosti huomioon erilaiset kehitysideat!

Käytännön asiat:
Tässä vakituisessa ja kokoaikaisessa tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksemme Avain Asumisoikeus Oy:n palvelukseen. Tehtävässä aloitus on mahdollisimman pian, tarkempi aloituspäivämäärä sovitaan erikseen valitun henkilön kanssa. Palkka tehtävässä koostuu kiinteästä kuukausipalkasta sekä myynnin provisioista.

Tehtävässä työskentelet Avain Asuntojen Lahden toimistolla lähityössä sekä asuntoesittelyissä liikkuen, joten tehtävä edellyttää B-ajokorttia. Liikkumiseen voi hyödyntää omaa ajoneuvoa tai toimipisteen yhteiskäyttöautoa. Huomioithan lisäksi, että tehtävässä työskentely edellyttää joustavuutta myös ajoittaiseen ilta- ja viikonlopputyöhön esimerkiksi asuntoesittelyiden järjestämisen vuoksi.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä ansioluettelosi sekä vastaa hakulomakkeella kysyttyihin kysymyksiin viimeistään tiistaina 20.10. aTalentin hakujärjestelmän kautta. Halutessasi voit lisäksi jättää enintään kahden minuutin videotervehdyksen ja kertoa meille tarkemmin siitä, millaisen vahvistuksen Avaimen tiimi sinusta saisi?

Huomioithan, että emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse, vaan käsittelemme ainoastaan hakujärjestelmän kautta saapuneet hakemukset. Haluamme varmistaa, että kaikki hakijat voivat osallistua prosessiin tasavertaisesti ja huomioimme tarvittaessa yksilölliset esteettömyys tarpeet.

Avain Asunnoista voit lukea lisää osoitteessa: https://avainasunnot.fi/. Hakuprosessia ja aikatauluja koskeviin kysymyksiin vastaa aTalentin Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist@atalent.fi). Jos en heti pääse vastaamaan puhelimeen, jätäthän tekstiviestin, niin soitan sinulle takaisin.

title: Director, Strategic Communications
description:
Director, Strategic Communications

Dalio Family Office

Dalio Family Office Overview:

The Dalio Family Office (DFO) supports Barbara and Ray Dalio and their family in their ventures, investments, and philanthropic efforts under Dalio Philanthropies, which includes OceanX, Dalio Education, Endless Network, and the Beijing Dalio Foundation. The core of the DFO’s culture is built around meaningful work and meaningful relationships and the family’s commitment to giving back. The office is headquartered in Westport, CT with regional offices in New York City, Singapore, and Abu Dhabi.

Position Summary:

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
Why LeoLabs?

At LeoLabs, we’re building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO). Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions.

We’re not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space. As orbital activity accelerates and threats grow more complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, and Satellite Operations for top-tier space operators and allied defense organizations.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI, your impact starts here.

LeoLabs is seeking a skilled Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between development and operations, ensuring that our systems are scalable, reliable, and efficient. You will be responsible for automating processes, monitoring system performance, and resolving incidents to enhance our service reliability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable and reliable systems
  • Set up monitoring tools and create incident response plans to quickly identify and resolve issues, as well as implementing preventative measures
  • Develop and maintain scripts and automation tools for deployment, monitoring, and system health checks
  • Analyze system capacity and performance metrics to forecast future needs and implement scaling solutions
  • Work closely with development teams to enhance product reliability and streamline the deployment process
  • Create and maintain documentation for system architecture, processes, and incident reports
  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support for critical systems
  • Implement and enforce security best practices across all systems, ensuring compliance with industry standards

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in a Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or related role
  • Proficiency in scripting or programming language (e.g., Python, Go)
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure)
  • Proficiency with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS)
  • Proficiency in configuration management tools (Terraform, Atlantis, Terragrunt)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, AWS CodeBuild, CircleCI)
  • Experience with monitoring tools (Grafana, Datadog)
  • Familiarity with database technologies (RDS, Aurora, PostgreSQL)
  • Experience with large-scale distributed systems and microservices architecture
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex systems
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Ability to obtain a security clearance

Preferred qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance

What Success Looks Like

Within 1 month, you’ll:

  • Complete onboarding to understand our business, vision, and team structure
  • Get familiar with LeoLabs' engineering stack, security posture, and key initiatives
  • Gain an understanding about how your role fits into LeoLabs broader organization

Within 3 months, you’ll:

  • Independently deploy infrastructure changes using Infrastructure as Code
  • Identify key reliability risks and recommend improvements
  • Improve dashboards, alerts, and operational runbooks

Within 6 months, you’ll:

  • Improve deployment pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, or self-service capabilities
  • Optimize infrastructure utilization and cloud costs without compromising reliability
  • Drive automation that reduces operational toil and improves deployment reliability

Within 12 months, you’ll:

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to improve availability, scalability, and operational efficiency
  • Be a key advisor for site reliability in new product developments and platform evolution
  • Mentor junior engineers and foster the development culture

Compensation

This position is benchmarked to San Francisco, CA with a base salary range of $171,000 to $192,000 plus bonus and equity. Actual base salary will be determined based on the candidate’s work location, experience, skills, and other applicable factors

Perks and Benefits

  • 100 USD monthly wellness benefit to support your health and well-being

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. More information regarding ITAR can be found at DDTC’s website.

title: Associate Therapist (NJ LMSW)
description:
About Marble

Marble makes it possible for kids to get real therapy. School social workers can see which students need care, and too often have nowhere to send them: waitlists are long, and clinicians who take insurance and work with children are hard to find. Marble is where those referrals go. We provide individual, family, and group therapy to children, adolescents, and families across New York City and New York State.

Marble was founded by an experienced team, including two co-founders of Headway. Our clinical leadership includes LCSWs and child psychiatrists with decades of experience in youth mental health, and our therapists work closely with them to shape both how we deliver care and how the company runs.

About the role

Marble’s clinical team is committed to delivering high-quality care to children, adolescents, and families referred by school social workers throughout New Jersey. Our therapists provide support in various settings, including individual, family, and group therapy, tailoring interventions to meet the unique needs of each client.

Therapists at Marble work on a flexible, part-time basis. Many start with just a few hours per week, and have the opportunity to increase their hours as their availability and interest in taking on more clients grow. This model allows therapists to maintain flexibility in their schedules while benefiting from a supportive, collaborative environment that fosters professional growth.

Our LSWs benefit from supervision by highly skilled LCSWs, who offer not only clinical guidance but also opportunities to provide input into Marble’s evolving model of care. In this collaborative environment, our therapists play a key role in shaping both clinical and operational processes and ensuring continuous improvement.

Marble was founded by an experienced team, including two co-founders of Headway, and our clinicians work closely with Marble’s clinical leadership, including LCSWs and child psychiatrists with decades of experience. Together, we are building an innovative, supportive environment where therapists can thrive and make a meaningful impact.

How the role works

  • Supervision toward your LCSW. Supervision from an experienced LCSW at no cost to you, counting toward your licensure hours.
  • See students from home, on hours you set. Fully remote. You set your availability and we schedule inside it.
  • A caseload we send you. Referrals come from school social workers who already know the student. No marketing, panel-building, or waiting to fill a schedule.
  • No admin. We handle credentialing and billing, and an AI scribe drafts your notes so you review and sign rather than write from scratch.

All Marble therapists work on a contract basis, and the commitment is yours to set. Some carry as few as 10 students; for others Marble is their primary role, with caseloads up to 25. Most clinicians start small and add students as their availability grows.

Ideal Traits

  • NJ License. You must be licensed in the state of NJ to work with Marble in this role.
  • Clinical Excellence: You have a strong foundation in evidence-based practices and are committed to ongoing professional development to enhance your therapeutic skills.
  • Passion for Serving Children and Families: You are driven by a deep desire to make a difference in the lives of children, adolescents, and their families, offering compassionate care and support during challenging times.
  • Growth mindset: You welcome feedback as an opportunity to grow and improve, and you actively engage in supervision to refine your practice.
  • Cultural Competence: You are adept at working with diverse populations and are sensitive to the unique experiences and backgrounds of the clients and families you serve.
  • Empathy and Compassion: You approach each client and family with deep understanding and care.


Clinical Responsibilities

  • Conduct clinical social work assessments during intake appointments, which includes: a) Gathering information about a client’s psychosocial history, chief complaint(s), current symptoms, adverse childhood experiences, and more, b) Conducting a mental status examination, c) Conducting assessments including the CSSR-S screener, PHQ-9, and GAD-7, d) Establishing a treatment plan and objectives for the client’s psychotherapeutic counseling
  • Provide psychotherapeutic counseling through ongoing individual, family, and/or psychotherapy group appointments; provide psychoeducation and evidence-based interventions to promote emotional and mental wellness, relieve stress, and build coping skills for the clients’ environments
  • Consult with your supervisor regarding your clients and their progress towards treatment plan objectives


How to Apply

If you’re passionate about making a meaningful difference in the lives of children and families, we’d love to hear from you! Reach out at careers@marblehealth.com with your resume and a brief introduction.

title: Persoonlijk Begeleider Gehandicaptenzorg LVB/MVB | Brakel | 26 uur
description:
Bij Philadelphia heet deze functie officieel Coördinerend Begeleider.

Wil jij verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor goede begeleiding én zelf dichtbij bewoners blijven? Op De Regenboog in Brakel werk je met volwassenen met een lichte of matige verstandelijke beperking. Geen bewoner is hetzelfde: de één heeft vooral behoefte aan coaching en structuur, terwijl een ander meer nabijheid of ondersteuning bij ADL nodig heeft.

Voor deze bijzondere woonlocatie zoeken wij een Persoonlijk Begeleider voor 26 uur per week.

Jouw rol

Als Persoonlijk Begeleider combineer je de dagelijkse begeleiding van bewoners met de coördinatie van hun ondersteuning. Je staat dus niet op afstand plannen te maken. Juist doordat je meewerkt op de groep, weet je wat er speelt en kun je goed beoordelen wat een bewoner nodig heeft.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ondersteuningsproces rondom een aantal bewoners. Je stelt ondersteuningsplannen op, bewaakt doelen en bespreekt de voortgang met bewoners, verwanten, collega's en betrokken disciplines. Daarbij help je collega's om vanuit dezelfde afspraken en begeleidingslijn te werken.

De verschillen tussen bewoners maken je werk afwisselend. Bij de ene bewoner stimuleer je zelfstandigheid met vooral verbale ondersteuning. Een ander help je intensiever bij dagelijkse vaardigheden of ADL. Steeds kijk je naar wat iemand zelf kan en waar ondersteuning nodig is.

Je:

  • coördineert de ondersteuning rondom een aantal bewoners;
  • stelt ondersteuningsplannen op, bewaakt doelen en evalueert deze;
  • signaleert veranderingen in gedrag, gezondheid en welzijn;
  • stemt af met familie, het sociale netwerk, gedragsdeskundige en andere disciplines;
  • ondersteunt bij dagelijkse begeleiding, ADL en medicatie;
  • rapporteert zorgvuldig in het ECD;
  • stimuleert eigen regie, zelfstandigheid en het behouden van vaardigheden.

Over de locatie

De Regenboog ligt aan de Molenkamp in Brakel, in de regio Zaltbommel. Hier wonen 20 volwassenen van ongeveer 20 tot 65 jaar met voornamelijk een lichte of matige verstandelijke beperking (LVB/MVB). Soms is daarnaast sprake van een lichamelijke beperking of psychiatrische problematiek.

De bewoners wonen verdeeld over drie groepen: De Rots, De Duif en De Ark. Iedere groep heeft een eigen gezamenlijke woonkamer en keuken en iedere bewoner beschikt over een eigen studio met badkamer en toilet.

Overdag gaan bewoners waar mogelijk naar werk of dagbesteding. Op enkele doordeweekse dagen is daarom tussen ongeveer 10.00 en 15.00 uur geen begeleiding op de locatie aanwezig.

Wat de locatie zo bijzonder maakt

De Regenboog is ontstaan vanuit een ouderinitiatief. Die betrokkenheid voel je nog steeds. Ouders, verwanten en een grote groep vrijwilligers spelen een actieve rol in het leven van de bewoners en werken samen met het team aan een fijne en vertrouwde woonomgeving.

De locatie heeft een duidelijke protestants-christelijke identiteit. Het geloof is hier niet alleen iets op papier, maar maakt op een natuurlijke manier deel uit van het dagelijks leven. Zo wordt er bij de maaltijd gebeden en uit de Bijbel gelezen en gaan bewoners samen naar de kerk.

Ook als medewerker heb je hierin een rol. Daarom zoeken we iemand die zich thuis voelt bij deze identiteit en de christelijke waarden vanuit overtuiging kan uitdragen in de begeleiding van bewoners. Daarin staan we niet alleen. De Regenboog werkt nauw samen met Stichting Op Weg met de Ander, die de locatie ondersteunt en inspireert bij het vormgeven van de protestants-christelijke identiteit.

Tegelijkertijd is geen bewoner hetzelfde. De één heeft vooral behoefte aan een luisterend oor en een beetje sturing, terwijl een ander meer nabijheid of praktische ondersteuning nodig heeft. Juist die combinatie van persoonlijke begeleiding, geloof, familie en een sterk betrokken netwerk geeft De Regenboog zijn eigen karakter.

Wat wij bieden

Bij Philadelphia halen we het beste uit elkaar. Daarom zorgen wij voor:

  • Een brutosalaris volgens de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg van minimaal € 2951,- en maximaal € 3980,- FWG 40 bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur, gebaseerd op je ervaring en opleiding. En bij onregelmatige diensten krijg je een extra toeslag;
  • Ruimte om te groeien, zoals jij dat wilt: met jouw talent en ambitie, maar ook met ons Leerhuis en de vele opleidingsmogelijkheden;
  • De mogelijkheid om je vakantietoeslag en/of eindejaarsuitkering maandelijks te laten uitbetalen
  • Korting op uitjes, je sportschool en een interessante laptop- en fietsregeling en voordelen als extra vrije dagen tot aan coaching. Kies wat jij wilt;
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng; Wij zijn altijd op zoek naar mogelijkheden om onze begeleiding te verbeteren. Werken mee aan projecten en activiteiten!
  • Een contract voor bepaalde tijd, na gebleken geschiktheid onbepaalde tijd.

Bekijk al onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Wie ben jij?

Jij vindt het prettig om verantwoordelijkheid te dragen, maar wilt tegelijkertijd gewoon onderdeel zijn van het dagelijks leven op de groep. Je houdt overzicht, durft beslissingen te nemen en kunt makkelijk schakelen tussen verschillende bewoners en ondersteuningsvragen.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je een relevant mbo-4- of hbo-diploma Zorg & Welzijn;
  • heb je affiniteit met mensen met een verstandelijke beperking;
  • kun je methodisch werken en een ondersteuningsproces coördineren;
  • ben je bereid bewoners waar nodig te ondersteunen bij ADL;
  • communiceer je makkelijk met familie, collega's en andere disciplines;
  • stimuleer je bewoners om zoveel mogelijk zelf te doen en eigen keuzes te maken;
  • voel je je verbonden met de protestants-christelijke identiteit en kun je deze uitdragen in je werk.

Ervaring met LVB/MVB, psychiatrische problematiek, autisme, epilepsie of diabetes is mooi meegenomen, maar we kijken vooral naar wat jij meebrengt en hoe jij aansluit bij onze bewoners.

Solliciteren?

Wil je deel uitmaken van deze warme en betrokken omgeving? Solliciteer dan eenvoudig met je cv; een motivatiebrief is erg welkom. We bekijken sollicitaties doorlopend, dus je kunt meteen reageren.

Heb je vragen of wil je eerst even sparren? Neem gerust contact op met recruitment@philadelphia.nl

title: Environmental Project Manager
description:
Terraphase offers cost-effective solutions to complex environmental and engineering challenges. We listen to our clients and focus on their needs. We apply technical expertise and keen awareness of the regulatory framework to achieve our clients'​ project goals and objectives. The combined talent and experience of Terraphase's engineers, geologists, and scientists form the foundation for a comprehensive environmental management approach.

Description

Terraphase Engineering is seeking a well-rounded environmental professional with 4 to 6 years of experience in environmental site investigation and remediation to join our team in our Portland, OR office. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced environmental consultant looking to take the next step in their career by gaining additional project management responsibilities while continuing to develop their technical expertise.

The successful candidate will support a variety of environmental investigation and remediation projects, coordinate field activities, contribute to technical deliverables, and work closely with senior project managers and technical experts to address complex environmental challenges.

The Role

  • Support the planning and execution of environmental site investigations, site characterization, and remediation projects involving soil, groundwater, and soil vapor.

  • Coordinate and oversee field activities, including soil and groundwater sampling, monitoring well installation, and remediation system operation and maintenance.

  • Assist with project management responsibilities, including scheduling, budgeting, subcontractor coordination, and tracking project deliverables.

  • Prepare and review technical reports, work plans, proposals, and regulatory documentation.

  • Coordinate with subcontractors, laboratories, and internal technical teams to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

  • Support the evaluation and implementation of remedial alternatives, including in situ and ex situ remediation technologies.

  • Communicate with clients, regulatory agencies, and project stakeholders under the guidance of senior project managers.

  • Assist with project financial management, including tracking budgets, reviewing invoices, and identifying potential changes in project scope.

  • Provide technical guidance and oversight to junior staff during field investigations and reporting activities.

  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high quality environmental consulting services.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Geology, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related field.

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in environmental consulting, with an emphasis on site investigation, characterization, and remediation.

  • Experience coordinating environmental field investigations and managing multiple project tasks simultaneously.

  • Strong understanding of soil, groundwater, and soil vapor investigation methods and environmental remediation practices.

  • Familiarity with Oregon environmental regulations and experience working with the Oregon Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) preferred.

  • OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER certification with current refresher training preferred.

  • Experience preparing technical reports, work plans, and regulatory documentation.

  • Exposure to project management responsibilities, including budgeting, scheduling, subcontractor coordination, and client communication.

  • Strong technical writing, organizational, and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently in the field while collaborating effectively with project managers and technical teams.

Compensation for this position is based on years of experience, technical expertise, technical education, and geographic location.

Pay Range
$80,000—$120,000 USD

Who We Are

We are an environmental consulting company that offers cost-effective solutions to complex environmental and engineering challenges. We apply technical expertise and keen awareness of the regulatory framework to achieve our clients' project goals and objectives. The combined talent and experience of Terraphase's engineers, geologists, and scientists form the foundation for a comprehensive environmental management approach.

Terraphase was founded with the goal of developing a full-service engineering and consulting firm that provides high-quality services to clients with regional and nationwide operations. We are driven by creating valuable work products for our company and clients, and a rewarding environment for our employees. Our staff is comprised of registered professionals in civil engineering, geology, hydrogeology, and geotechnical engineering.

Our unique company culture philosophy of appreciating and recognizing individuals for their work, leadership, and mentoring, while supporting and encouraging a healthy personal and professional lifestyle help to make Terraphase one of the best places to work.

Benefits

Terraphase offers an extensive benefits package including; Medical, Dental, Vision, Employer Paid Life Insurance, Long-Term Disability, a generous 401(k) match, Commuter Benefits, TerraLunches, TerraTalks, Tuition/Licensing/Professional Development Reimbursement, Flexible Work Schedule, ongoing company-sponsored events.

EOE STATEMENT

Terraphase is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive & diverse work environment where individual strengths and diverse viewpoints are respected and complement each other to achieve common goals. (EOE M/V/F/D)

Review our Privacy policy here.

Vi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att växa och utvecklas i en inkluderande och inspirerande kultur. title: Intervention Specialist
description:

“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” – Ron Packard, CEO & Founder

We offer the following benefits:

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
