title: Verzorgende IG Gehandicaptenzorg | Ouderen Verstandelijk Beperkt | Voorburg
description:
Wil jij als Verzorgende IG goede zorg bieden én tijd hebben om iemand echt te leren kennen? Bij Phila Heeswijk in Voorburg combineer je ouderenzorg met gehandicaptenzorg. Je verzorgt en begeleidt ouder wordende mensen met een verstandelijke beperking en kijkt daarbij verder dan alleen de medische zorgvraag.

Voor Phila Heeswijk in Voorburg zoeken we een Verzorgende IG voor 24 tot 36 uur per week.

Jouw rol

Als Verzorgende IG werk je binnen Philadelphia in de functie van Begeleider Gehandicaptenzorg. Jouw kennis van verzorging is belangrijk, maar hier draait je werk om méér dan zorg alleen.

Je leert bewoners echt kennen. Je weet hoe iemand zijn koffie drinkt, merkt wanneer iemand stiller is dan normaal en herkent kleine veranderingen die iets kunnen zeggen over iemands gezondheid of welzijn.

De bewoners worden ouder en hun zorgvraag verandert mee. Sommige bewoners zijn nog behoorlijk zelfstandig, terwijl anderen steeds meer ondersteuning nodig hebben door bijvoorbeeld dementie, epilepsie, diabetes of lichamelijke achteruitgang. Je werkt afwisselend ochtend-, dag-, avond-, weekend- en slaapdiensten.

Je:

  • ondersteunt bewoners bij ADL, persoonlijke verzorging en mobiliteit;
  • dient medicatie toe en signaleert veranderingen in gezondheid, gedrag en welzijn;
  • begeleidt bewoners in hun dagelijks leven en biedt structuur, rust en veiligheid;
  • herkent signalen die samenhangen met onder andere dementie, epilepsie en diabetes en handelt hier passend op;
  • stimuleert bewoners om zoveel mogelijk zelf te blijven doen;
  • draagt bij aan welzijn, activiteiten, uitstapjes en kleine momenten die een dag bijzonder maken;
  • rapporteert in ONS Nedap en werkt volgens de ondersteunings- en behandelplannen.

Bij Philadelphia neem je dus niet automatisch alles over wat iemand niet meer kan. Je kijkt juist steeds: wat kan iemand nog wél en hoe kan ik daarbij ondersteunen?

Over de locatie

Phila Heeswijk ligt in Voorburg en is een woonlocatie voor 24 ouder wordende mensen met een lichte tot matige verstandelijke beperking.

De locatie bestaat uit drie woongroepen: Parkzicht, Pleinzicht en Zonzicht. Iedere bewoner heeft een eigen studio met badkamer, kitchenette en balkon. Bewoners hebben daardoor hun eigen vertrouwde plek, terwijl begeleiding en zorg altijd dichtbij zijn.

We werken vanuit belevingsgerichte zorg. Dat betekent dat we aansluiten bij de leefwereld, mogelijkheden en behoeften van iedere bewoner.

Wat de locatie zo bijzonder maakt

Phila Heeswijk combineert de zorgkennis uit de ouderenzorg met de persoonlijke begeleiding uit de gehandicaptenzorg.

Je vindt hier onder andere:

  • een eigen dagbestedingsruimte op de locatie;
  • een vaste kok die dagelijks verse maaltijden verzorgt;
  • een eigen bus voor activiteiten en uitstapjes;
  • een betrokken team van ongeveer 19 collega's;
  • korte lijnen tussen wonen, begeleiding, zorg en dagbesteding;
  • veel ruimte om bewoners echt te leren kennen.

Werk je nu in een verpleeghuis of de thuiszorg? Dan kan deze functie juist interessant voor je zijn.

Je gebruikt nog steeds jouw kennis als Verzorgende IG, maar combineert die met begeleiding. Je bent niet alleen bezig met wat iemand lichamelijk nodig heeft, maar ook met hoe iemand woont, leeft, contact maakt, activiteiten beleeft en zoveel mogelijk zelf de regie houdt.

Ervaring in de gehandicaptenzorg is daarom niet noodzakelijk. We kunnen je helpen om deze nieuwe doelgroep te leren kennen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een leuke baan waar je met plezier naar toe gaat. Wij investeren in onze medewerkers en daarom krijg je de ruimte om te groeien, zoals jij dat wilt: met jouw talent en ambitie, maar ook met ons Leerhuis en de vele opleidingsmogelijkheden. Verder vinden we belanrijk dat er rust in een rooster zit zodat je weet waar je aan toe bent. Wij werken met een basisrooster wat voor een jaar wordt uitgerold ( vastgesteld rooster).Daarnaast krijg je:

  • Een brutosalaris volgens de CAO Gehandicaptenzorg van min. € 2.597,- en max. € 3.635,- (FWG 35) bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur. Bij onregelmatige diensten krijg je een toeslag van 122 tot 160%
  • Direct een contract voor onbepaalde tijd; tenzij er redenen zijn om hiervan af te wijken;
  • De mogelijkheid om je vakantietoeslag en/of eindejaarsuitkering maandelijks te laten uitbetalen;
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng en het ontwikkelen van jouw talenten, je werkt mee aan projecten en activiteiten;
  • Korting op uitjes, je sportschool en een interessante laptop- en fietsregeling en voordelen als extra vrije dagen tot aan coaching. Kies wat jij wilt; ;
  • Volop ruimte voor eigen inbreng; Wij zijn altijd op zoek naar mogelijkheden om onze begeleiding te verbeteren. Werken mee aan projecten en activiteiten!

Bekijk al onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een Verzorgende IG die niet alleen ziet dat iemand hulp nodig heeft bij het aankleden, maar ook ziet wie die persoon is.

Je kunt verzorgen wanneer dat nodig is en juist een stap terugdoen wanneer een bewoner iets nog zelf kan. Je hebt geduld, kunt goed observeren en blijft rustig wanneer een situatie verandert.

Verder:

  • heb je een afgerond mbo-diploma Verzorgende IG niveau 3;
  • ben je bekwaam in ADL en medicatieveilig werken;
  • heb je affiniteit met ouder wordende mensen en mensen met een verstandelijke beperking;
  • ben je bereid om ochtend-, dag-, avond-, weekend- en slaapdiensten te werken;
  • wil je je verder ontwikkelen in bijvoorbeeld dementie, epilepsie en diabetes;
  • werk je zelfstandig én prettig samen met collega's;
  • kun je duidelijk communiceren en zorgvuldig rapporteren.

Nog nooit in de gehandicaptenzorg gewerkt? Geen probleem. Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar jouw zorgkennis, houding en bereidheid om de bewoners en deze manier van begeleiden te leren kennen vinden we belangrijker.

Solliciteren?

Wil je als Verzorgende IG ontdekken hoe het is om ouderenzorg en gehandicaptenzorg te combineren? Solliciteer dan eenvoudig met je cv; een motivatiebrief is erg welkom. We bekijken sollicitaties doorlopend, dus je kunt meteen reageren.

Heb je vragen of wil je eerst even sparren? Neem gerust contact op met recruitment via recruitment@philadelphia.nl.

Iedereen is welkom om te reageren. Diversiteit maakt ons sterker.

Echt iets voor jou?

title: Senior Tax Analyst
description:
Summary

Topstep is seeking a hands-on Senior Tax Analyst to support its growing U.S. and international tax function. This individual contributor role will be a key member of the Finance team and will help build a scalable, well-controlled in-house tax compliance function. The role will initially focus on recurring indirect tax compliance across U.S. sales and use tax, Canada GST/HST, EU VAT/OSS, Australia GST, and New Zealand GST, with responsibility expanding as Topstep registers and becomes compliant in additional jurisdictions. The Senior Tax Analyst will work closely with the Tax Director, Accounting, Treasury, People/Payroll, Legal, Operations, Avalara, and external tax advisors to ensure accurate filings, timely payments, complete journal entries and reconciliations, and strong supporting documentation. A key near-term objective is to support the transition of recurring indirect tax compliance in-house beginning with the January 2027 compliance cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and support recurring indirect tax compliance across U.S. sales and use tax, Canada GST/HST, EU VAT/OSS, Australia GST, New Zealand GST, and additional jurisdictions as the compliance footprint expands.
  • Support the transition of recurring indirect tax compliance from external providers to the internal tax function beginning with the January 2027 compliance cycle.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly tax returns and supporting workpapers; ensure filings and related tax payments are completed accurately and on time.
  • Extract, validate, and reconcile tax data from NetSuite, Avalara, payment processors, and other source systems, and investigate differences between tax collected, reported, paid, and general ledger balances.
  • Prepare indirect tax journal entries, accruals, true-ups, and balance sheet account reconciliations, and maintain complete filing and payment support.
  • Maintain the tax compliance calendar, registrations, filing frequencies, portal access, tax IDs, deadlines, and filing/payment confirmations.
  • Coordinate with Avalara and external advisors on filings, data requests, notices, registrations, taxability matters, and open compliance issues.
  • Assist with responses to state, federal, and international tax notices, audits, and information requests, including maintaining an organized record of correspondence and resolutions.
  • Coordinate data gathering and workpaper support for federal, state, and international direct tax compliance, including returns, extensions, estimated payments, and tax provision support performed with external advisors.
  • Provide support to People/Payroll on state tax registrations, payroll tax notices, withholding compliance, and related filings as needed.
  • Research taxability, nexus, filing requirements, and new jurisdiction obligations and support implementation of new registrations and compliance processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve tax processes, documentation, controls, and automation, including effective use of Avalara, NetSuite, and other tax technology.
  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, People/Payroll, and Operations on tax-related matters and support forecasting, exposure analyses, and other ad hoc tax projects.

Required Qualifications and Key Competencies

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field.
  • 4-7 years of progressive tax experience in a corporate, public accounting, or advisory environment.
  • Strong hands-on tax compliance, reconciliation, and Excel skills, with the ability to manage recurring monthly and quarterly deadlines across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience with U.S. sales and use tax and/or international VAT/GST compliance strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Avalara and NetSuite, including tax data extraction, reconciliation, or compliance workflows, strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting corporate income tax compliance and coordinating with external tax advisors preferred.
  • CPA, EA, MST, or similar tax/accounting credential preferred but not required.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with high attention to detail and accountability for personal deliverables.
  • Ability to operate as a hands-on individual contributor, prioritize competing deadlines, document processes, and collaborate effectively across Finance, Accounting, Legal, Treasury, People/Payroll, Operations, and external advisors.

Company Culture & Perks

  • Topstep is an engaging working environment that ranges from fully remote to hybrid. We foster a culture of collaboration by keeping cameras on during meetings and maintaining a robust Slack environment for communication.
  • Seven Company-paid Holidays and generous Family Leave. Paid time off is front-loaded.
  • Competitive 401(k) matching, health, dental, and vision insurance are offered for full-time employees.
  • Vacations are encouraged with a bonus for taking 5 consecutive days. Topstep offers a food and groceries budget and contributes towards health and wellness.

New Hire Base Salary Range

  • $95,000.00 - $120,000.00 annually.
  • The compensation offered will take into account the internal compensation structure and may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, among other factors.
  • This position is eligible for a performance-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Topstep is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees and applicants are valued. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

title: Associate Advisor

Allworth Financial (www.allworthfinancial.com) is an independent investment advisory firm providing full-context wealth planning solutions. The firm brings together investment, tax, retirement, estate, and other financial considerations to help clients evaluate decisions in the context of their whole financial lives.

Founded in Sacramento, California, in 1993, Allworth Financial is a high-growth, private equity-backed, multibranch registered investment adviser. Allworth is primarily a fee-based fiduciary advisory firm that emphasizes client well-being and education. The firm continues to expand through acquisitions and organic growth.

Allworth is a great place to work and build a career. The firm ranks among the top 15 on Barron’s Top 100 RIA Firms list, has a historical client retention rate of 97%, and is a National Business Research Institute (NBRI) Circle of Excellence Award winner. Learn more at AllworthFinancial.com.

SUMMARY:

As an Associate Advisor, you will support the end-to-end planning process — from preparing and refining financial plans, to conducting research and case analysis, to participating in client meetings and follow-up. You will collaborate across departments, develop a strong understanding of our integrated service model, and play an important role in ensuring clients feel informed, cared for, and confident in their financial future.

title: Human Resource Business Partner
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

As a member of the Hunter Douglas family of brands, LEVOLOR, Inc. is a leading manufacturer and marketer of custom and sizable window covering products including blinds and shades. LEVOLOR is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Founded in 1911, we are committed to delivering innovative, high quality products to consumers under the most recognized brand in our industry today.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

We're seeking an experienced HR Business Partner to serve as a strategic advisor to our leadership team. We need a seasoned HR professional who can independently own core people processes end-to-end, influence senior leaders, and drive accountability across the organization.

What you'll do

Partner with leaders to enable business outcomes. Embed with business leaders to understand their goals, then translate those into talent strategies: org design, succession planning, capability gaps, and retention risks. Bring data and a point of view to leadership conversations.

Own and elevate core HR processes. Take full ownership of performance and bonus management, engagement scores and action plan development, compensation cycles, employee relations, and workforce planning. Design, document, and continuously improve these processes rather than simply administering them.

Drive leader accountability. Hold leaders accountable to people commitments — performance conversations, development plans, engagement follow-through, and timely decisions. Challenge with the best outcome in mind for both the employee and employer.

Handle employee relations with judgment and rigor. Independently manage investigations, performance issues, and sensitive situations from intake through resolution, balancing risk, fairness, and business needs.

Use data to drive decisions. Track and report on people metrics (turnover, engagement, performance distribution, time-to-fill) and use them to identify problems early and hold the business accountable to outcomes.

Who you are

  • 5 years of HR experience in a true business partner capacity supporting director-level or above stakeholders
  • Demonstrated track record of building or overhauling HR processes — not just executing someone else's playbook
  • Deep employee relations experience, including independently leading investigations and managing complex performance situations
  • Working knowledge of employment law and compliance requirements
  • Comfort with data and data tools and demonstrated ability to build a narrative from data
  • Experience in a lean HR environment where you've had to be both strategic and hands-on.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience supporting an organization through growth, restructuring, or significant change
  • Background in coaching or facilitation
  • Experience working with Oracle and or implementing performance management tools and processes

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • Leaders proactively engage you on org and people decisions rather than after the fact
  • Core HR processes (performance, comp, talent review) are documented, calendared, and running on time with full leader participation
  • Employee relations issues are resolved consistently, fairly, and with appropriate documentation

What's in it for you?

  • Annual base salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
  • Bonus target range: 10% - 20%
  • Generous benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development and professional growth
  • Time off with pay
  • 401(k) plan with a degree of employer matching
  • Paid parental leave
  • Wellness programs and product discounts

title: Vascular Surgeon
description:
Job Title: Vascular Surgeon
Location: San Jose, CA
Employment Type: Full-time or Part-time

Vascular Surgeon Jobs in San Jose, CA: Your Wound Expertise, a Better Way to Practice

Few specialists understand chronic wounds like a Vascular Surgeon. You’ve spent your career treating the arterial and venous disease behind non-healing ulcers and fighting for limb salvage. But with a nationwide shortage of vascular surgeons, many carry heavy call schedules, get pulled in overnight for ruptured aneurysms and acute limb ischemia, and spend long hours in lead aprons during endovascular cases. Skilled Wound Care, a premier national physician group, is hiring Vascular Surgeons in San Jose, CA to work as wound care physicians and lead wound care initiatives in skilled nursing facilities across the area.

Maybe you’re a Vascular Surgeon ready to step away from emergency call, long OR days and the physical strain of the procedure suite. Maybe you want a part-time role alongside your current practice. Either way, this no-call Vascular Surgeon job offers a high-impact career without the corporate red tape.

Why Vascular Surgeons in San Jose, CA Choose Wound Care

In a specialty where being on call can mean a 2 a.m. ruptured aneurysm or an emergency limb salvage case, we offer a refreshing alternative:

  • The “No-Call” Lifestyle: No nights, no weekends and no pagers. No middle-of-the-night vascular emergencies. This is a true Monday–Friday surgeon job, so your evenings and weekends belong to you and your family.
  • Put Your Wound Expertise to Work: Arterial ulcers, venous ulcers and diabetic foot wounds are already part of your world. Your vascular training makes you a natural fit for wound care.
  • Keep Your Surgical Skills: Surgical debridement and bedside procedures stay part of your daily practice.
  • A Sustainable Surgical Career: Leave behind long cases and hours in heavy lead aprons. Bedside procedures are far easier on your back, neck and shoulders, so you can keep practicing for years to come.
  • Clinical Autonomy: Direct patient outcomes based on your surgical expertise, not a hospital committee or department hierarchy.
  • Smarter Documentation: Our custom software is designed to slash admin time, so you’re not stuck charting at midnight when you could be home at a reasonable hour.

Vascular Surgeon Responsibilities

Use the latest advancements in wound healing to change lives in communities across San Jose, CA:

  • Surgical and sharp debridement and other bedside procedures
  • Evaluation and treatment of chronic, non-healing and complex wounds, including arterial, venous and diabetic ulcers
  • Advanced dressings and specialized wound protocols
  • Collaborative care in skilled nursing facilities and the post-acute setting, where you follow patients through healing

Vascular Surgeon Salary & Compensation

  • Average Annual Earnings: 200,000–250,000 (no earning cap as an independent contractor)
  • High Achievers: Top performers earn $300,000+ through performance bonuses
  • Pay Structure: Per-patient and per-procedure pay, plus quarterly bonus programs

Vascular Surgeon Requirements

  • Medical Degree: MD or DO from an accredited institution
  • Medical License: Unrestricted/clear medical license in the state of practice (or eligibility to obtain one)
  • DEA License: Or eligibility to obtain one
  • Open Background: We welcome Vascular Surgeons and surgeons of all backgrounds, as well as Family Medicine and Internal Medicine physicians. No previous wound care experience is required; we provide comprehensive wound care training

Great Place to Work® Certified!

Skilled Wound Care is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place to Work® for the 5th year in a row. The prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Skilled Wound Care. This year, 95% of employees said it’s a great place to work – 39% higher than the average U.S. company.

Apply for This Vascular Surgeon Job in San Jose, CA

You’ve spent your career saving limbs. Now do it on your terms. If you’re a Vascular Surgeon in San Jose, CA looking for a no-call, Monday–Friday career, or a part-time role alongside your current practice, apply today.

title: Director of Academics
description:

Be part of the difference at Montgomery Preparatory Academy! The school offers a well-rounded program emphasizing character education & Social-Emotional Learning (SEL). Montgomery Preparatory Academy is part of ACCEL Schools, an established network of public charter schools serving K-12 students throughout the United States since 2014.

description:

The Client Management Associate will play an essential role on Orchestra’s Client Management team in identifying and advancing growth opportunities across existing clients. The ideal candidate can understand a client challenge, see how earned, owned, paid, creative, experiential, and other capabilities can work together to solve it, and quickly connect the right people across Orchestra to turn that thinking into a compelling commercial opportunity.

  • Work with client leads to identify potential opportunities based on client needs, business priorities, relationship context, and existing work, and develop those opportunities into client-ready recommendations and strategies

  • Assess the urgency behind commercial opportunities and facilitate the process to move quickly from a client need to a recommendation, team, scope and pricing
  • Conduct client, industry and competitive research to strengthen recommendations and present potential growth opportunities
  • Manage pricing and scoping requests and help ensure recommendations are commercially sound
  • Manage and route Client Desk requests, quickly connecting client leads with the right resources and expertise
  • Facilitate account planning, renewal planning and other initiatives focused on proactively growing existing client relationships
  • Use AI and emerging tools to strengthen research, writing and Client Management workflows

Essential skills

  • 3–5 years of experience in communications, marketing, business development, client strategy or a related field, with client-facing experience required. Direct experience working within an agency strongly preferred
  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to recognize where an existing client need could become a broader opportunity
  • A commercial mindset with the ability to recognize an opportunity, know when an existing need could become a broader partnership, and understand what is needed to move it forward
  • Strong relationship-building instincts and the ability to connect people and expertise across teams
  • A strong sense of urgency and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where client and commercial needs can shift quickly
  • Strong research, project management, and organizational skills
  • Excellent writing skills and the ability to turn complex ideas into clear, persuasive, and client-ready materials
  • Ability to coordinate multiple subject matter experts and priorities under tight deadlines
  • Comfort using AI tools, including ChatGPT, to improve research, writing, and workflows
  • Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working across different teams and areas of expertise

WORKING AT ORCHESTRA

description:

This position will be responsible for performing non-research biological science work utilizing microbiological and molecular techniques, including, but not limited to, DNA extraction and real-time polymerase chain reaction (real-time PCR) to rapidly identify and characterize potential pathogenic bacterial and viral threat agents.

Responsibilities:

  • Handling, receipt, and processing of operational, Quality Assurance (QA), and proficiency test (PT) samples potentially containing biological threat agents.
  • Preparing reagents and samples.
  • Familiarity with Good Laboratory Practice (GLP).
  • Decontamination of workspaces, including Biological Safety Cabinets (BSCs), hoods/air boxes, equipment, and other items associated with processing and analysis activities.
  • Maintaining chain-of-custody (CoC).
  • Interpretation of results.
  • Data entry utilizing computerized or computer-linked systems.
  • Performing routine equipment calibration, cleaning, assembly, and maintenance.
  • Collecting, processing, and analyzing internal laboratory swipes/swabs for Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) and contamination monitoring.
  • Proper disposal of biohazardous waste.
  • Restocking and maintaining proper inventory of necessary supplies.
  • Supporting BW Program logistics in conducting and documenting annual inventory of DHS-procured durable equipment and property.
  • QA/QC and acceptance testing of reagents in accordance with applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and the Laboratory Operations Quality Assurance Program Plan (QAPP).
  • Adhering to QA/QC requirements in accordance with the Public Health Laboratory quality management systems and the QAPP.
  • Maintaining documentation of records demonstrating compliance with applicable training/retraining, competencies, and document reviews.
  • Analyzing routine external QA samples in accordance with the BW SOP’s and QA Program guidance.
  • Proper archiving, storage, and shipping of samples.
  • Follow and adhere to written procedures and accepted practices in accordance with federal, state, and local regulations, safety, security and dress code policies, procedures, and guidelines, including DHS Safeguarding Sensitive but Unclassified (For Official Use Only) Information (January 2005) when visiting or working at Government facilities.
  • Preparing written and oral technical reports, answering questions, and making recommendations to the Lead Biological Scientist for inclusion in comprehensive reports.
  • Accurately performing work with confidence.
  • Demonstrate competency in various testing methodologies (e.g., multi-center studies), evaluate potential products and processes against unique environmental backgrounds, and meet established deadlines.
  • Must be present for all hours of the workday and be available 24/7/365 to respond in case of emergency. Rotating weekends and some holidays are required.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Master’s degree or Ph.D. from an accredited university in microbiology, molecular biology or related course work in biological sciences, and REQUIRES at least one (1) year of laboratory bench experience utilizing polymerase chain reaction (PCR), aseptic techniques and biological assays, and at least one (1) year of experience serving as a Senior Scientist or Team Leader of a laboratory team/project.

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university requires four (4) years of laboratory bench experience to include 4 (4) years of utilizing polymerase chain reaction (PCR), aseptic techniques and biological assays, including at least one year of experience as a Team Leader/Senior Scientist. Laboratory training that is assigned or accompanies an associated course is not considered applicable training.

We're hiring a Senior Helpdesk Engineer to be the bridge between the T1 queue and Helpdesk's project work: own escalations that go past Tier 1, and take Helpdesk-driven projects, especially the AI-and-automation-first initiatives that keep getting pulled off track by day-to-day capacity, from kickoff to finish without needing someone else to close the loop. You'll be the person asking "should a human even be doing this one?" for every recurring request, and then actually building the answer, freeing Helpdesk leadership to set direction instead of getting pulled back into the queue to keep projects moving.

This is a builder's role, not a ticket-taker's role. We're looking for someone who is genuinely self-learning: comfortable researching an unfamiliar problem from scratch, forming a hypothesis, testing it, and proposing a fix, rather than waiting to be told the answer or escalating everything that isn't already documented. You'll be expected to bring solutions to the table, not just tickets, and to own a project through to completion, not just start it.

How You Will Contribute

AI & Automation: Owning the Pivot

  • Identify recurring ticket patterns and turn them into automated or AI-assisted resolutions: self-service, agentic triage, workflow automation (e.g., Workato), rather than solving the same request by hand every time.
  • Propose and prototype new automation or AI approaches to Helpdesk work; bring ideas forward rather than waiting for direction.
  • Continuously evaluate what should move from "a human resolves this" to "a system resolves this, with a human as backstop," and help build that system.
  • Document what you automate so it survives past you. Future teammates shouldn't have to reverse-engineer a workflow to trust it.

Senior Escalation & Technical Ownership

  • Be the escalation point for tickets that exceed Tier 1 scope: deeper troubleshooting, ambiguous root causes, cross-system issues.
  • Research unfamiliar problems independently. Read the docs, test a hypothesis, consult the right internal owner when genuinely stuck, and drive the ticket to a real resolution rather than a workaround.
  • Keep resolutions durable: document fixes so the same hard problem doesn't get re-solved from scratch next time.

Project Ownership, Start to Finish

  • Own Helpdesk-driven projects end to end: scope, plan, execute, and close, without needing someone else to carry it over the finish line. New tooling rollouts, fleet or identity initiatives, cross-team asks.
  • Flex between queue support and project work based on where Helpdesk needs capacity that week, without either one silently dropping.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of IT support experience, including meaningful time past Tier 1. You've already handled escalations and carried at least one real project from kickoff to done, not just followed a runbook.
  • A genuinely self-learning mindset: given an unfamiliar problem, you research it, form a hypothesis, and test it. You don't wait for someone to hand you the answer, and you proactively propose solutions rather than just surfacing problems.
  • Real curiosity about AI and automation tooling. You don't need to have shipped a production agent or workflow yet, but you should already be experimenting, or clearly want to.
  • Comfortable owning ambiguity and moving between queue work and project work without losing track of either.
  • Hands-on with a modern endpoint/identity stack (JAMF, Intune, Okta, or comparable) and a modern ITSM (Freshservice, Zendesk, Jira Service Management).
  • Strong macOS and Windows troubleshooting fundamentals plus working knowledge of networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi) at the endpoint level.
  • Senior peer presence: comfortable driving a project without close supervision, and giving/receiving direct feedback with teammates and stakeholders.
  • Clear communicator, comfortable working async with distributed teammates across the US, India, Mexico, and Spain.
  • Comfortable in a Google Workspace-first environment, with working familiarity with Confluence for documentation.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with workflow automation platforms (Workato, Zapier, n8n, or similar).
  • Experience building or supporting AI-assisted support tooling: ticket triage, auto-response drafting, internal copilots, agentic workflows.
  • Scripting fundamentals (Bash, Python, PowerShell).
  • Background in fintech, banking, or another regulated industry (SOX, SOC 2).
  • Experience supporting a multi-region, distributed workforce.

Compensation:

  • Base Salary Range: $90,000 to $106,000 (This applies to full time hires. Final offer determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to function, level, geographic location, job related knowledge, skills, and experience.)
  • Bonus: Eligibility is contingent upon both company performance against established goals and achievement of individual performance objectives.
  • Equity: Meaningful Restricted Stock Units in public company stock (NYSE: BLND) so you share in Blend’s long-term growth and success.

Our Benefits at a Glance

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health and work-life balance.

Health & Wellbeing

  • We offer medical, dental, and vision benefits, with a generous employer contribution that helps keep your medical insurance costs low.
  • Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability coverage
  • Generous PTO, holidays, and maternity/parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): mental health, legal, childcare & eldercare, financial planning, college search, and more
  • Voluntary benefits: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, identity theft, and legal insurance
  • Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, mental health, and well-being
  • Additional perks: Milk Stork, pet insurance, and paid volunteer time off

Growth & Future

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Pre-tax savings: healthcare & dependent care FSAs, Limited Purpose FSA, and HSA

title: Sairaanhoitaja, Jyväskylä
description:
Me Terveystalossa teemme työksemme tärkeintä, terveyttä. Työllämme on suuri merkitys, ei vain asiakkaillemme, vaan koko yhteiskunnalle. Meitä tärkeimmän tekijöitä on Terveystalossa jo yli 14 000 lähes 400 toimipaikassa eri puolilla Suomea. Siellä, missä ihmiset elävät arkeaan ja missä kotimaista työtämme tarvitaan.

Etsimme nyt osaavaan ja motivoituneeseen joukkoomme tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavaa sairaanhoitajaa Jyväskylään. Tutustu tehtävään ja hae!

Mitä työ sairaanhoitajana Jyväskylässä pitää sisällään?

Terveystalon sairaanhoitajat ovat hoitotyön asiantuntijoita, joiden tehtävänä on terveyden edistäminen ja ylläpitäminen sekä sairauksien ehkäiseminen ja hoitaminen. Sairaanhoitajat ovat yksi Terveystalon suurimmista ammattiryhmistä, ja kollegojasi työskentelee niin yksityisillä lääkäriasemillamme kuin julkisen puolen kumppanuuksissamme.

Tehtävässä työskentelet sairaanhoitajana itsenäisessä vastaanottotyössä ajanvarauksella ja päivystysluonteisesti, moniammatillisessa tiimissä tapaturmaklinikalla sekä avustajana pienkirurgisissa toimenpiteissä lääkäreiden työparina. Etäpalvelut ovat myös yksi osa hoitajan jokapäiväistä työtä. Tässä työtehtävässä sinulla on mahdollisuus toteuttaa jo sinulla olemassa olevaa erikoisalaosaamista tai perehtyä erikoisaloihin mm. skopia-, silmä-, iho-, uro- ja/tai plastiikkakirurgia.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat

  • sairaanhoitajan itsenäinen vastaanottotyö
  • lääkäreiden avustaminen toimenpiteissä eri erikoisaloilla
  • päivystysluonteinen sairaanhoitajan työ
  • matkailijan rokotukset ja neuvonta
  • etävastaanotot

Työsuhde on tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttava ja määräaikainen ajalle 1.11.2026-30.10.2027 ajalle. Työajat Jyväskylässä sijoittuvat arkipäivisin klo 7-21 välille ja viikonloppuisin klo 9-17 välille, työajat ovat joustavia ja äkillisiinkin tarpeisiin sovittavia.

Miksi töihin Terveystaloon?

Meillä arki rakentuu sujuvuudesta ja toisista välittämisestä, jatkuvasta halusta kehittyä ja ennen kaikkea inhimillisistä kohtaamisista. Vaikka maailma muuttuu, meidän tapamme tehdä työtä säilyy: Terveystalossa sinä voit keskittyä tekemään sitä, mikä on tärkeintä – terveyttä.

  • Arkemme on sujuvaa. Panostamme lähijohtamiseen ja esihenkilötyöhön, jotta jokainen ammattilaisemme saa työssään tarvittavan tuen. Ammattirajat ylittävä tiimityö, joustavuus ja edistykselliset hoitopolkumme tukevat arjen työtä.
  • Välitämme toisistamme. Meillä jokainen on oma arvostettu itsensä, oman alansa huippuosaaja ja tärkeä osa työyhteisöä. Osaajatutkimuksemme mukaan ammattilaisemme arvostavat muun muassa lämmintä työyhteisöämme, hyvää esihenkilötyötä ja lähijohtamista sekä mahdollisuutta onnistua omassa työssä.
  • Teemme vaikuttavaa työtä. Terveystalossa on ainutkertaista osaamista aina ennaltaehkäisystä perusterveydenhuoltoon, suunterveyteen ja erikoissairaanhoitoon. Käytössämme ovat ainutlaatuiset oman työn laatumittarit ja digitaaliset hoitopolut kaikkiin yleisimpiin sairauksiin. Panostamme myös ammattilaistemme laadukkaaseen kouluttautumiseen, kehittymiseen ja ammatilliseen kasvuun.
  • Kotimainen ja vastuullinen. Vastuullisuus on meille sydämen asia. ISS ESG:n arvioinnissa kuulumme globaalisti oman alamme kärkeen, ja Suomalainen työ ry on myöntänyt meille Avainlippu-tunnuksen osoituksena Suomessa tuotetusta ja työllistävästä palvelusta. Teemme työtä suomalaisten terveyden ja koko yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin eteen tinkimättömällä ammattitaidolla. Suomen suurimpana yksityisenä terveydenhuoltoalan toimijana vaalimme kotimaisia juuria ja olemme ylpeitä suomalaisista omistajistamme.
  • Monimuotoinen ja yhdenvertainen. Terveystalossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia riippumatta sukupuolesta, iästä, etnisestä tai kansallisesta taustasta, kansalaisuudesta, kielestä, uskonnosta, vakaumuksesta, mielipiteestä, vammasta, terveydentilasta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta tai muusta ominaisuudesta.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Pätevyysvaatimuksena tehtävään on sairaanhoitajan tutkinto. Tehtävässä edellytämme hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Tehtävä sisältää asiantuntijuutta vaativia työtehtäviä, joissa pääset hyödyntämään vahvaa työkokemusta eri-ikäisten asiakkaiden hoitotyössä. Arvostamme erinomaista palveluasennetta, sairaanhoitajan työn moniosaamista ja kykyä toimia nopeasti vaihtuvissa tilanteissa.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Täytäthän sähköisen hakemuksen liitteineen viimeistään 23.10.2026 mennessä oheisen hakupainikkeen kautta. Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Mahdollisiin kysymyksiin vastaa mielellään palveluvastaava Marjukka Hurskainen sähköpostitse marjukka.hurskainen@terveystalo.com.

Tervetuloa Terveystaloon!

title: Product Lead, Business Systems
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Product Lead, Business Systems
NYC CEO Office Location
Hybrid

Anticipated deadline to submit application: October 23, 2026 before 5pm EST. Position may close early if application limit is met. Apply promptly for full consideration.

The Opportunity

At CEO, Product Managers and Product Leads own a portion of the organization’s technology ecosystem and staff user experience with a focus on ensuring efficient, compliant, and integrated systems that minimize user friction.

The Product Lead - Business Systems serves as a strategic, technical, leader for CEO’s financial and operations systems. This role owns the Finance and Operations platforms strategy. An immediate priority will be supporting the end-to-end execution of our Finance technological transformation with implementation partners—including the modernization of accounting, financial planning, and grants management systems. Over time, this role will oversee adjacent enterprise platforms, including Payroll, Procurement, and potentially Contracts and People Systems.

This individual serves as a crucial organizational leader, bridging strategy, operations, and technical implementation. They will work closely with business leadership, key stakeholders, IT operations and implementation partners and to co-design, configure, deploy, maintain and support these platforms. They are responsible for driving continuous improvement, navigating complex trade-offs, and managing external vendor partners to support high-quality delivery.

As part of our mission, we strongly encourage individuals who have lived experience of incarceration or involvement in the justice system to apply for this role.

Who We Are

The Center for Employment Opportunities (CEO) provides employment services to people recently released from incarceration. Across the United States, 8,000-9,000 people participate in CEO each year, transitioning to employment that supports themselves, their families, and their communities.

What began as a demonstration project of the Vera Institute of Justice in the 1970s to address employment barriers facing the formerly incarcerated following release in New York City has grown into the leading reentry employment organization in the country, where over 30,000 formerly incarcerated individuals have secured full-time employment since 1996.

Who You Are

  • You have at least 7+ years of progressive experience in enterprise business systems, internal product management, or IT product ownership within complex organizations.
  • You have demonstrated experience in leading multi-year enterprise platform transformations (e.g., ERP, Financial Systems, HRIS) from vendor selection through post-implementation governance.
  • You have a proven track record managing technology roadmaps, writing specifications, prioritizing backlogs, and leading cross-functional deployments.
  • You have experience in collaborating closely with external implementation providers or technology consultants on large-scale system overhauls.
  • you have strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to navigate reporting lines across Finance leadership and product departments.
  • You have proven experience in influencing and advising Senior Leadership on technology investments, trade-offs, and risk management.
  • You have deep expertise in managing and directing external implementation partners, systems integrators, and software vendors on large-scale overhauls.

Preferred

  • You have expertise in core financial workflows, accounting principles, grants management structures, and fund accounting in complex, multi-entity, or non-profit context.
  • You have professional certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), PMP, or administrator-level credentials in major financial planning or accounting software suites.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Key responsibilities of the Product Lead, Business Systems include but are not limited to:

Business Systems Strategy & Roadmap Execution

  • Define, own, and execute the roadmap for CEO’s financial and operations systems in alignment with organization priorities.
  • Drive the convergence and modernization strategy for adjacent systems and processes (e.g., Payroll, Procurement, Contracts) to eliminate data silos and manual handoffs.
  • Lead and/or co-lead (with the implementation partner/lead and business owner) the implementation of finance and operations platforms and related processes .

Solutions Identification and Development

  • Team with stakeholders and the implementation provider to co-design, blueprint, configure and implement new Finance systems.
  • Lead the strategic selection, blueprinting, and architectural design of future business systems in collaboration with executive stakeholders and vendors.
  • Lead internal product discovery deep dives as needed, mapping workflows across teams and translating distinct stakeholder needs into technical specs.
  • Lead rigorous, cross-functional processes to identify, evaluate and select relevant vendors, implementation partners, and third-party tools.

Implementation and Change Management

  • Develop role-specific onboarding materials and documentation to upskill staff on new systems and workflows.
  • Lead change management, communication plans, and training rollouts for the updated platforms to ensure high staff adoption in partnership with business owner.
  • Serve as the chief strategic translator between non-technical executive stakeholders, finance teams, and external technical development teams/implementation partners.
  • Establish continuous feedback loops to identify and remove operational friction, ensuring compliance and internal controls do not impede staff productivity.

Ongoing Governance and Operations Support

  • Balance the reactive requests by teams with building resilient future systems aligned to organization priorities.
  • Establish clear data governance structures, security access levels, and change control protocols in tight alignment with IT security standards and external audit compliance.
  • Manage the configuration, user permissions, control frameworks, and day-to-day functional administration of the systems in partnership with IT Operations.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support sustainable growth and maintenance.
  • Manage external technology vendors, configuration partners, and implementation consultants as needed, holding them accountable to delivery timelines, specifications, and technical standards.
  • Troubleshoot complex, tier-2 and tier-3 functional issues, managing escalation paths to software vendors or support partners when required.
  • Define, track, and optimize system KPIs related to operational effectiveness (e.g., speed to close, grant tracking compliance, reporting accuracy) and general platform satisfaction.
  • Audit and optimize data flows, API connections, and cross-platform integrations between financial tools and secondary organizational systems to prevent data fragmentation.
  • Monitor industry trends and upcoming software releases to proactively suggest features, automation improvements, and optimizations.
  • Monitor tools performance using data and qualitative employee feedback to identify, isolate, and eliminate friction points and drive continuous improvement.
  • Other duties as assigned

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $118,000 to $140,000. Consistent with CEO's compensation philosophy, we place candidates within a given salary range based on comparable tenure in title, relevant knowledge, skills, and experience. title: Shift Lead
description:
Job Summary:

Opens and closes the store in the absence of store management, including all required systems startups, required cash handling, and ensuring the floor and stock room are ready for the business day. Responsible for opening back door of store for deliveries. Completes product returns, order voids, customer refunds, cash drops to the safe, and provides change as requested to cash registers. Models and delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience.

Job Responsibilities:

Customer Experience
  • Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
  • Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).
Operations
  • Responsible for holding store keys to open and close without management as necessary.
  • Assists with and coaches other team members to work with warehouse and vendor ordering process as the orders are created, reviewed, and received, including opening the backdoor for vendor deliveries.
  • Responsible and accountable for registering all related sales on assigned cash register, including records of scanning errors, price verifications, items not on file, price modifications, and voids.

  • Assists manager or assistant store manager in evaluating and developing displays, including promotional, seasonal, super structures, and sale merchandise. Completes resets and revisions.
  • Maintains accurate inventory counts; maintains the accuracy of on-hand quantities including, but not limited to, basic departments, stockroom, and overstock locations.
  • Assist with ensuring the Outdate program is followed with team members.
  • Responsible for basic department pricing and making daily price changes; ensures proper signage is displayed at the store to support accurate pricing of products. Ensures any additional pricing tasks related to local regulations and/or regulatory compliance programs are completed accurately and within the required time frame.
  • Assist with bookkeeping activities, including cash report, cash counts, ledgers, and bill payment as necessary or as requested.
  • Assists with exterior and interior maintenance by ensuring clean, neat, orderly store condition and appearance, including requesting store or system repairs as required in manager absence, or as requested by manager.
  • Assists with separation of food items (e.g., raw foods from pre-cooked) and product placement as specified by policies/procedures (e.g., raw and frozen meats on bottomshelves). For consumable items, assists in stock rotation, using the first in, first out method and restock outs.
  • Supports execution of Pickup program.
  • Has working knowledge of store systems and store equipment.
  • Assist at Pharmacy out window as requested in states where allowed without licensure, certifcation, or registration, or have met the requirements for licensure, certification or registration by state Boards of Pharmacy in states that require such.
  • Ensures compliance with state and local laws regarding regulated products (e.g., alcoholic beverages and tobacco products).
  • Responsible for bag checks of team members before leaving the store.
  • Complies with all company policies and procedures; maintains respectful relationships with coworkers.
  • Completes special assignments and other tasks as assigned.
Training & Personal Development
  • Attends training and completes PPLs requested by Manager.
Communications
  • Serves as a liaison between management and non-management team members by communicating assigned tasks to team members when store management is not present.
  • Reports disciplinary issues and customer complaints to management.




Basic Qualifications
  • One year of prior leadership, supervisory, or retail key holder work experience.
  • Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English. (Except in Puerto Rico)
  • Willingness to work flexible schedule, including evening and weekend hours.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Prefer the knowledge of store inventory control.
  • Obtains and maintains valid PTCB or ExCPT certification or pharmacy license as required by state.

title: Gjerdrum asylmottak søker vaktmester
description:
Vil du ha en arbeidsplass med mening, spennende menneskemøter og kollegaer med variert fagbakgrunn?

Et asylmottak er et tilbud om midlertidig bolig for personer som søker beskyttelse (asyl) i Norge. Her bor personer i alle aldre og fra flere forskjellige land i påvente av å få asylsøknaden behandlet. Som mottaksansatte jobber vi helhetlig med bosettingsforberedende og returforberedende arbeid, og vi har forskjellige ansvarsområder. Vaktmester skal bidra til at beboerne har et trygt og meningsfullt bomiljø, og at mottakets bygningsmasse har den standarden som UDI og andre sektormyndigheter krever.

Vi søker en vaktmester, i 50% stilling, som bidrar til å skape en meningsfylt hverdag for våre beboere og ansatte

Som vaktmester har du ansvaret for å holde oversikt, og utføre daglige vedlikeholdsoppgaver på mottaket. I tillegg deltar du i mangfoldet av arbeidsoppgaver. Du skal være i tett relasjon til beboerne og kollegaer, både i miljø og ved eventuelle administrative oppgaver. Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere, og du må være fleksibel og løsningsorientert. Det kan være muligheter for ekstravakter utover 50%.

Viktige arbeidsoppgaver er:

  • Medansvar for brannvernsforebyggende arbeid opp mot beboere og ansatte
  • Ha oversikt over bygningsmassens vedlikeholdsbehov og utføre forebyggende tiltak
  • Utføre daglig vedlikeholdsarbeid og vaktmesteroppgaver
  • Være kontaktperson for aktuelle samarbeidspartnere
  • Veiledning av kollegaer opp mot sitt ansvarsområde
  • Veiledning og praktisk bistand til beboere
  • Psykososial bistand til beboere
  • Helhetlig bosettingsforberedende og returforberedende arbeid
  • Aktiv deltakelse i obligatoriske møter
  • Bistå kollegaer ved behov

Utførelse av andre arbeidsoppgaver som ligger til mottaksdriften.

Kvalifikasjons- og kompetansekrav

  • Relevant praktisk erfaring
  • Ønskelig med relevante fagbrev
  • God kunnskap om brannvernlovgivningen, branntekniske forhold ved bygninger og brannforebyggende arbeid.
  • Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper
  • Gyldig norsk førerkort
  • God økonomiforståelse
  • Gode datakunnskaper

Av personlige egenskaper vektlegger Corvita at:

  • Du er effektiv, strukturert og ryddig, og møter tidsfrister du har ansvar for
  • Du kan søke og tilegne deg ny kunnskap raskt, og formidle dette videre
  • Du er glad i mennesker, og har sterk evne til å oppnå kontakt og skape gode relasjoner med andre
  • Du er selvstendig, og har god pådriver- og gjennomføringsevne
  • Du er lojal mot arbeidsgivers mål, prioriteringer, driftsmodell og oppdraget fra UDI


Vi tilbyr:

  • Ansettelse i en seriøs virksomhet
  • Opplæring og veiledning
  • Fagnettverk med personer i samme stilling i Corvita sine mottak
  • Viktige arbeidsoppgaver i et flerkulturelt miljø
  • Positive og engasjerte kollegaer som er stolt av arbeidsplassen sin
  • Lønn etter avtale
  • Pensjons- og forsikringsordning

Interessert?

Send inn din søknad via søknads lenke. Søknader blir gjennomgått og vurdert fortløpende.

Vi er opptatt av mangfold, og vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte til å søke hos oss, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonshemming, «hull i CV», nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn.

title: SMB Account Director, Talent Solutions
description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

We are looking for an Account Director to join our team as a trusted adviser with a relentless focus on bringing value to our customers within our SMB segment. In this role, you will own a defined book of business and be responsible for closing both renewals and expansion opportunities across LinkedIn’s Talent and Learning solutions.

This is a closing role that blends hunting and farming—but all within an existing customer base. You’ll be responsible for proactively identifying growth opportunities, driving strategic conversations, and securing long-term commitments—without the need for net-new logo acquisition. Success requires a mix of commercial acumen, curiosity, and a consultative mindset that helps customers get the most out of their investment.

You’ll be responsible for strengthening customer relationships and ensuring long-term value, all while consistently hitting revenue goals and contributing to our team’s success.

Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrated ability to find and manage high-level business in an evangelistic sales environment

  • Ability to gather and use data to inform decision making and persuade others

  • Ability to assess business opportunities and read prospective buyers

  • Ability to orchestrate the closure of business with an accurate understanding of prospect needs

  • Ability to be coachable

title: Security Specialist
description:
About eSentire:
Founded in 2001 and headquartered in Waterloo, Ontario, eSentire is a global leader in eSentire, the Authority in Managed Detection and Response (MDR), protects the critical data and applications of 2000+ organizations in 80+ countries across 35 industries from known and unknown cyber threats by providing Exposure Management, Managed Detection and Response and Incident Response services designed to build an organization's cyber resilience & prevent business disruption. Founded in 2001, eSentire protects the world's most targeted organizations, with 65% of its global base recognized as critical infrastructure, vital to economic health and stability. By combining open XDR platform technology, 24/7 threat hunting, and proven security operations leadership, eSentire's award-winning MDR services and team of experts help organizations anticipate, withstand and recover from cyberattacks..

About the Role:
eSentire’s Security Operations Centre (SOC) organized into three specialized service delivery teams (Customer Excellence, Investigations, and Incident Response) working in close partnership with AI SOC Innovation, which builds and operates eSentire’s unified AI-first investigation platform. The SOC delivers services to customers worldwide on a 24x7 basis and is trusted by organizations globally to detect and respond to cyber threats and protect them from business disruption.

The Customer Excellence team is the primary frontline for eSentire’s customers. It provides 24x7 live support, runs escalations and outreach for complex or sensitive situations, and drives the enablement and QA programs that keep the SOC’s people, process, and tools continuously improving.

The Security Specialist is a senior individual contributor and a trusted expert. You are deeply technical, fully immersed in eSentire’s offerings, and quick to spot a process or tool that doesn’t work as efficiently or accurately as it could. Colleagues, customers, and partner teams count on your judgment.

You build the content and automated case playbooks that make the team faster, diagnose problems, and carry feedback to teams across eSentire. You also take part in live support, lead complex and sensitive escalations and named-resource engagements, and audit and coach on support quality. Specialists provide key support in escalated situations.

This role reports to a Security Lead or Security Manager

Responsibilities:
Responsibilities may evolve over time to meet changing business priorities and operational requirements.
Live support, complex escalations & named-resource engagements – 50%.

Take part in live support, picking up the technical and high-impact cases that need your depth and acting as an expert resource for the shift.
Lead complex or sensitive customer escalations and named-resource engagements as needed.
Own escalated situations and high-stakes conversations, representing the SOC.
Take handoffs from Senior Security Analysts when an escalation needs deeper expertise and explain why it moved so the next one is handled earlier.
Contribute to After Action Reviews and RCAs for the escalations you led, including the underlying gaps and proposed fixes.

Content, playbooks & continuous improvement – 35%.

Build and deliver content (training, knowledge base articles, guides) that improves customer support outcomes.
Design automated case playbooks that speed up resolution and reduce touchpoints for customers, in partnership with SOC Innovation. Validate the content works for the people who use it and revise when it doesn’t.
Perform high-level troubleshooting and diagnostic review to identify issues in services, tooling, and processes, and trace them to root cause.
Work cross-functionally to report issues, shape and help develop new functionality, and confirm that fixes work in practice.
Capture and share feedback within the SOC, with case references and evidence attached. Follow up so it is acknowledged and routed.

Quality audits & coaching – 15%.

Audit customer support work for quality, response times, and interaction skills, using the team’s quality criteria.
Coach analysts on what the audits show, in partnership with their Security Lead. The Lead keeps ownership of performance management, so share individual results and patterns with them.
Turn patterns across audits into coaching focus areas, content, or process changes.

Standing expectations
These apply at every level of the Customer Excellence team.

Hold the customer’s interest as the deciding factor in every judgment call.
Work in lockstep with Technical Account Managers: share anything that affects the customer relationship early and stay aligned on what each of you is telling the customer.
Keep case records and documentation accurate and current, so anyone can pick up the work without going back to the customer.
Stay current on threats, eSentire’s detection coverage, SOC tooling, processes, and AI-driven capability as they evolve

Requirements:

7-10+ years’ experience in a Security Operations Centre (MDR or MSSP) or customer-facing security role, including leading escalations or complex case management.
Advanced knowledge of adversary behaviour and the MITRE ATT&CK framework: you can map observed activity to techniques, explain the attack chain to a customer in plain language, and judge severity and likely next steps.
Advanced knowledge of Windows internals and endpoint telemetry: process trees and parent/child relationships, services, scheduled tasks, registry, persistence mechanisms, credential access, lateral movement, and Windows event logs. Working knowledge of Linux and macOS endpoint behaviour.
Hands-on investigation experience with EDR platforms (such as CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, or equivalent), including interpreting detections, scoping activity across hosts, and knowing which response actions are safe to take and when.
Hands-on experience with SIEM and log platforms (such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or equivalent), including writing and tuning queries (SPL, KQL, or similar) and regular expressions to validate a detection and scope an incident.
Working knowledge of networking and network telemetry: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S and TLS, plus proxy, firewall, and NDR or packet capture data, well enough to separate malicious traffic from benign.
Working knowledge of cloud and identity security: Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, Active Directory, and AWS, Azure, or GCP audit logs. This includes authentication flows (SSO, MFA, Kerberos, OAuth) and common abuse patterns such as token theft, MFA fatigue, and business email compromise.
Experience with email and phishing analysis: message headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, and URL and attachment triage.
Understanding of how detections are built and tuned, including the trade-off between false positives and false negatives. You can explain why a detection misfired and what would make it more accurate.
Experience troubleshooting complex issues in security tooling and services, such as agent health, log ingestion gaps, integration or API failures, and tracing them to root cause. You can read JSON and API responses.
Working knowledge of AI and LLM concepts in cybersecurity, with the ability to translate a process into clear decision logic (inputs, conditions, outputs, and failure cases) that another team can automate, and to build or use tooling that improves efficiency and supports security investigations.
Experience applying responsible and ethical AI practices in security, including refining prompts and interpreting results to reduce bias and support objective conclusions, contributing to model training and validation, assessing when AI-generated conclusions are safe or need manual review, and identifying and communicating emerging AI risks (e.g., drift, adversarial inputs, inconsistent logic) while staying current on AI-powered threats and defensive capabilities.
Experience auditing, coaching, or mentoring others, formally or informally.
Experience building training, knowledge content, or documented procedures that other people use.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead sensitive conversations and drive escalated issues to resolution.
Work scheduled shifts in a 24x7 operation, which can include nights, weekends, and holidays.

Preferred Requirements:

Industry certifications (GCIH, GCFA, GX-FA, GCFR, GPEN, GEIR, etc.) or equivalent.
Ability to read and write scripts for triage and analysis (PowerShell or Python, for example).
Experience with digital forensics, malware triage, or sandbox analysis.
Experience applying threat intelligence to investigations or detection improvement.
Exposure to case automation, SOAR, or playbook design work.
Experience maintaining a knowledge base or playbooks rooted in adult learning (andragogical) principles.
Familiarity with MDR/XDR tooling.

This posting is for an existing vacancy

We celebrate diversity, operating with mutual respect and consideration, in an environment that fosters inclusivity for all. We believe that a variety of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences make us stronger – if you’re enthusiastic about this opportunity but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. It takes a diverse set of thoughts, cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives to be a true market leader.
